title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESOURCES AND SUPPORT SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH AN INTELLECTUAL OR DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITY.
purpose: To (1) evaluate and implement best practices for expanding employment and transportation opportunities for persons with an intellectual or developmental disability, (2) ameliorate waiting lists for Medicaid waiver program services for such persons, (3) establish an emergency services alert system to help locate such persons when they are reported missing, (4) provide funding for a voluntary registration system for such persons for public safety purposes, (5) increase income and asset limits for medical assistance for such persons, (6) evaluate changing a statutory definition associated with such persons and Intelligence Quotient criteria for such persons, (7) establish a career pipeline for behavioral health and human services positions to ensure an adequate number of providers to serve such persons, and (8) establish a bill of rights for such persons.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE BOND COVENANT RESTRICTIONS.
purpose: To extend the restrictions pledged for certain bond issuances.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN REVISIONS TO THE EDUCATION STATUTES.
purpose: To make revisions to how public education is funded in the state.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To (1) establish early voting beginning in 2023 for certain elections and beginning in 2024 for certain primaries, special elections and referenda, (2) establish the number of days and hours of, and implement procedures for the conduct of, such early voting, (3) provide for same-day election and same-day primary registrations during periods of early voting, (4) make conforming changes to deadlines for the performance of certain duties prior to an election or primary, and (5) require the Secretary of the State to undertake efforts to educate the public about early voting and train registrars of voters regarding the administration of early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE PENSION CALCULATIONS AND THE TRANSPORTATION ALLOWANCE.
purpose: To remove mileage reimbursement from legislator pension calculations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MILEAGE REIMBURSEMENT FOR LEGISLATORS.
purpose: To restrict mileage reimbursement to legislators who drive to work and prohibit legislators who are passengers from collecting the reimbursement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE SOUTHEAST AREA TRANSIT DISTRICT TO INCREASE BUS SERVICES AND SUPPORT THE NEW LONDON SMART RIDE SERVICE.
purpose: To provide funding to the Southeast Area Transit District to increase bus services and support the New London Smart Ride service.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PENSION CALCULATIONS FOR LEGISLATORS AND THE TRANSPORTATION ALLOWANCE.
purpose: To exclude mileage reimbursements from the calculation of legislators' pensions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUBLIC SAFETY CAPACITY OF SQUANTZ POND STATE PARK.
purpose: To protect the public safety of state parks and the transit areas surrounding the entrance to our state parks.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF TERRAMATION FOR HUMAN REMAINS.
purpose: To allow for the use of terramation for the decomposition and elimination of human remains in order to create the most ecological means of a green funeral and to provide an alternate to greenhouse gas emissions created by cremation.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROCESSING OF RABBITS IN THE STATE FOR CONSUMPTION AND USE BY CONSUMERS AND CERTAIN COMMERCIAL ENTITIES.
purpose: To provide a means for the processing of rabbits in the state for consumption by consumers and retail food establishments.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CARRYING OF PISTOLS AND REVOLVERS IN STATE PARKS.
purpose: To allow any person who holds a permit to carry a pistol or revolver to carry such pistol or revolver in state parks.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY RATE INCREASES OF ELECTRICITY AND NATURAL GAS.
purpose: To require legislative approval of rate increases of electricity and natural gas.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CAP ON RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT TAX CREDITS.
purpose: To increase the amount of research and development tax credits a biotechnology business may utilize in an income year.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING PERSONNEL TRAINING SERVICES FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exclude personnel training services from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STUDENT LOAN PRINCIPAL PAID.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction of up to five thousand dollars of student loan principal paid by the taxpayer for a taxable year.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO CONSTRUCT A MIDDLESEX COUNTY FIRE TRAINING SCHOOL.
purpose: To authorize funding for construction of a Middlesex County Fire Training School.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CHILD TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To establish a child tax credit against the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR FULL-TIME HOME HEALTH CARE COSTS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction of up to sixty thousand dollars for the cost of full-time home health care.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS.
purpose: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DIVESTMENT OF STATE FUNDS FROM COMPANIES THAT HOLD PUERTO RICAN DEBT.
purpose: To authorize the State Treasurer to divest from any companies that hold the debt of the Commonwealth of Puerto Rico due to the ongoing fiscal and humanitarian crisis on the island.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING THE FINAL DAY OF DIWALI AS A STATE HOLIDAY.
purpose: To establish the final day of the Diwali festival as a state holiday.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PRESENTATION OF PHOTO IDENTIFICATION TO VOTE.
purpose: To require presentation of photo identification to vote.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM EXTENDING THE OPERATING HOURS OF CERTAIN ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR PERMITTEES.
purpose: To establish a pilot program extending the hours of operation of certain alcoholic liquor permittees in certain municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINORS AND SOCIAL MEDIA ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To require a social media company to obtain consent from a minor's parent or guardian before allowing the minor to establish a social media account if the minor is younger than sixteen years of age.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION TO ESTABLISH A POLICY REGARDING FREE SPEECH ON CAMPUS.
purpose: To require institutions of higher education to establish a policy regarding free speech on campus.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF STUDENT HEALTH SERVICES AT THE REGIONAL CAMPUSES OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To require The University of Connecticut to provide student health services at the university's regional campuses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SEMIMONTHLY DISBURSEMENTS OF SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM BENEFITS.
purpose: To avert depletion of supplemental nutrition assistance program benefits early in the month and higher food prices based on increased demand when all beneficiaries receive and use benefits in the same time period.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PAYMENT OF FUNERAL AND BURIAL EXPENSES ON BEHALF OF CHILDREN WHO ARE VICTIMS OF GUN VIOLENCE.
purpose: To provide financial assistance to families bereaving the death of a child, age seventeen or under, who was the victim of gun violence.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR THEFT OF A FIREARM.
purpose: To increase the penalty for stealing a firearm to a class B felony.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CASTLE DOCTRINE.
purpose: To fully adopt the "castle doctrine" by establishing a rebuttable presumption that if a homeowner believes it necessary to use deadly force to repel an intruder, then that belief is a reasonable belief.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONS WHO MAY CLAIM A DISQUALIFICATION FROM SERVICE AS A JUROR.
purpose: To allow persons age seventy or older to opt out of service as a juror.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPENSATION OF INCARCERATED INDIVIDUALS.
purpose: To increase prison wages and benefits so that incarcerated individuals can fund their potential reentry into the community.

title: AN ACT DELAYING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF CERTAIN CHANGES TO MOTOR VEHICLE PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT STATUTES.
purpose: To delay by one year the implementation of changes made to various motor vehicle property tax assessment statutes by sections 497 to 509, inclusive, of public act 22-118.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOGS AND OUTDOOR DINING AREAS.
purpose: To authorize restaurant owners to permit dogs in outdoor dining areas of restaurants.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF EMINENT DOMAIN FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES.
purpose: To prohibit the state and municipal governments from exercising the use of eminent domain for commercial purposes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC COMMENT PERIODS AT PUBLIC AGENCY MEETINGS.
purpose: To require public comment periods at all public agency meetings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF CANNABIDIOL TO INMATES.
purpose: To permit the administration of cannabidiol to inmates in correctional institutions for treatment of symptoms related to post-traumatic stress disorder and management of chronic pain.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A SERVICE ANIMAL TO ACCOMPANY ITS HANDLER IN AN AMBULANCE.
purpose: To allow a service animal to accompany its handler in an ambulance.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CERTIFICATE OF LIVE BIRTH FOR A DECEASED FETUS OR INFANT.
purpose: To require the Department of Public Health to revise the certificate of live birth for a deceased fetus or infant by removing the watermark of "deceased" across the certificate and inserting the word "deceased" in a more discreet manner at the bottom of the certificate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYMENT OF LAWFUL PERMANENT RESIDENTS AS POLICE OFFICERS AND FIREFIGHTERS.
purpose: To permit individuals who are classified as lawful permanent residents of the United States under federal law to be employed as police officers and firefighters.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE OPERATION OF GREYHOUND RACING AND SIMULCASTING OF OUT-OF-STATE GREYHOUND RACING IN THE STATE.
purpose: To prohibit the operation of greyhound racing in the state and to prohibit off-track betting operators from simulcasting out-of-state greyhound racing.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN APPLICANT FOR A MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR LICENSE WHO IS SIXTEEN OR SEVENTEEN YEARS OF AGE TO COMPLETE A SAFETY COURSE ON THE EFFECTS AND IMPACT OF MARIJUANA.
purpose: To ensure teenage drivers are properly educated on the dangers of operating a motor vehicle while under the influence of marijuana.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DIRECT SALES OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To allow a consumer to purchase a motor vehicle directly from the motor vehicle manufacturer without requiring the motor vehicle manufacturer to have a franchise agreement with a car dealer in the state.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING SMALL MUNICIPALITIES TO REDUCE SPEED LIMITS ON CERTAIN STATE ROADS.
purpose: To permit small municipalities to reduce the speed limit on certain state roads to improve traffic and pedestrian safety.

title: AN ACT NAMING A PORTION OF CONNECTICUT ROUTE 372 IN CROMWELL IN HONOR OF MAYOR ALLAN SPOTTS.
purpose: To name a portion of Connecticut Route 372 in honor of Mayor Allan Spotts in recognition of his contributions and public service to the town of Cromwell.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEFINITION OF "ARMED FORCES".
purpose: To include the United States Space Force in the definition of "armed forces".

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FEES FOR VETERANS' SPECIALTY LICENSE PLATES.
purpose: To provide certain veterans' specialty license plates to veterans for no cost.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING FROM LICENSING REQUIREMENTS CERTAIN CHILD CARE SERVICES FOR CHILDREN OF MEMBERS OF THE UNITED STATES MILITARY.
purpose: To exempt from licensing requirements certain child care services administered by the federal government, on federal property or for the benefit of military families.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE RELEASE OF HELIUM BALLOONS.
purpose: To limit the harm to Long Island Sound and other state waterways from the release of helium balloons.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING REDEMPTION CENTERS AND DEALERS THAT HOST REVERSE VENDING MACHINES TO PROVIDE CERTAIN INFORMATION TO CONSUMERS WHEN REVERSE VENDING MACHINES ARE OUT OF ORDER.
purpose: To provide necessary consumer information when reverse vending machines are inoperable.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION AND ANNUITY INCOME AND DISTRIBUTIONS FROM CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To allow the personal income tax deduction for distributions from certain individual retirement accounts to be fully effective sooner and to replace the current personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension and annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts to eliminate the marriage penalty, qualifying income thresholds and the cliff effect.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING ALL AIRCRAFT FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To provide a uniform sales and use taxes exemption to all aircraft.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCESS FOR PUBLIC HEALTH AND CIVIL PREPAREDNESS EMERGENCY DECLARATIONS.
purpose: To modify the process for public health and civil preparedness emergency declarations.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ONLINE POSTING OF REGULAR MEETING AGENDAS BY PUBLIC AGENCIES.
purpose: To require all public agencies to post regular meeting agendas on such agencies' Internet web sites.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SENTENCE FOR MURDER COMMITTED DURING AN INCIDENCE OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To permit a sentence of life imprisonment without the possibility of parole for those who commit murder during an incidence of domestic violence.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NEW CRIME OF MURDER FOR SUPPLYING FENTANYL TO A PERSON WHO DIES FROM AN OVERDOSE.
purpose: To establish a new crime of murder for those responsible for supplying fentanyl to a victim of an overdose.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING DISABLED VETERANS FROM PROPERTY TAXATION.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to exempt disabled veterans from property taxation.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE DEADLINE FOR ZONING ENFORCEMENT OFFICER CERTIFICATION.
purpose: To change the date by which zoning enforcement officers must obtain certain certification to January 1, 2024.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING MORAL AND PHILOSOPHICAL OBJECTIONS AS AN EXEMPTION TO IMMUNIZATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To allow a waiver for moral and philosophical objections to the immunization requirements.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH CARE FACILITIES TO GIVE EVERY PATIENT ACCESS TO A DAILY VISITOR.
purpose: To assure that patients of health care facilities receive access to a daily visitor.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM RATES.
purpose: To reduce the financial burden of long-term care insurance premium rate increases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE NEXT GENERATION SCIENCE STANDARDS AND THE CLIMATE CHANGE CURRICULUM TAUGHT TO STUDENTS.
purpose: To amend the portion of the Next Generation Science Standards as it relates to the climate change curriculum requirement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERFORMANCE EVALUATIONS FOR SUPERINTENDENTS OF SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To ensure that performance evaluations for superintendents of schools are completed in a transparent manner.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT.
purpose: To repeal the minimum budget requirement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF A MINIMUM READING PROFICIENCY LEVEL AS PART OF THE HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To require high school graduates to be able to read at a minimum of an eighth-grade reading level.

title: AN ACT CLASSIFYING SCHOOL ADMINISTRATORS AS MANAGEMENT EMPLOYEES FOR THE PURPOSES OF THE TEACHER NEGOTIATION ACT.
purpose: To classify school administrators as management employees for purposes of collective bargaining.

title: AN ACT SEPARATING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To provide for an independent energy regulatory authority.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING GREEN ROOF TECHNIQUES FOR CERTAIN NEW CONSTRUCTION.
purpose: To reduce impermeable surface area runoff on new construction and provide for enhanced stormwater management.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE AND MUNICIPAL CONTRACTS FOR THE PURCHASE AND INSTALLATION OF ARTIFICIAL TURF FIELDS.
purpose: To prohibit municipal and state contracts for the purchase and installation of artificial turf fields that pose health and environmental concerns.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF NONORGANIC PESTICIDES ON STATE OWNED PROPERTIES AND ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To require the use of organic pesticides on state owned properties and school grounds.

title: AN ACT SEPARATING THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To enable the Department of Energy and the Department of Environmental Protection to fully pursue their separate statutory purposes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A BLACK BEAR HUNTING LOTTERY IN NORTHWESTERN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To establish a black bear hunting season in northwestern Connecticut through a lottery style system.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF SHOTGUNS AND RIFLES FOR SUNDAY HUNTING ON PRIVATE PROPERTY.
purpose: To expand Sunday hunting on private lands from bow and arrow to shotguns and rifles.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE AND REPLACING IT WITH FEES FOR STATE PARK AND FOREST VISITORS.
purpose: To eliminate the Passport to the Parks motor vehicle registration fee and replace it with fees that are charged to visitors of state parks and state forests.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RESTORATION OF ALEWIFE COVE IN NEW LONDON AND WATERFORD.
purpose: To restore Alewife Cove in order to improve animal habitat and promote economic development.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SUNDAY HUNTING ON STATE LANDS.
purpose: To authorize hunting on state lands on Sundays.

title: AN ACT DISCONTINUING THE USE OF POLYSTYRENE TRAYS IN SCHOOLS AND FOR FOOD CONTAINERS OFFERED BY CERTAIN RESTAURANTS.
purpose: To discontinue the use of polystyrene for school lunch trays and for food containers provided by certain restaurants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLASSIFICATION OF NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS REGARDING ENERGY CONSUMPTION.
purpose: To establish a working group to evaluate the energy consumption classification procedure for nonprofit organizations.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A WATER LINE ON JACKSON STREET IN THE TOWN OF THOMASTON.
purpose: To construct a water line on Jackson Street in Thomaston.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING BUSINESS TRAINING PROGRAMS AND BUSINESS TRAINING SERVICES FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exclude business training programs and business training services from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR SIDEWALKS AND BIKE LANES IN GROTON.
purpose: To provide funding for construction and repair of sidewalks and bike lanes in the town of Groton.

title: AN ACT WITHDRAWING CONNECTICUT FROM THE AGREEMENT AMONG THE STATES TO ELECT THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES BY NATIONAL POPULAR VOTE.
purpose: To withdraw the state from the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING ELECTION DAY REGISTRATION.
purpose: To eliminate election day registration.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RANKED-CHOICE VOTING FOR STATE AND FEDERAL OFFICES.
purpose: To provide for ranked-choice voting for state and federal offices.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RECIPROCITY IN OCCUPATIONAL AND PROFESSIONAL LICENSING.
purpose: To allow for reciprocity for an occupational or professional license for which there exists a national certification and an individual seeking such license has received such certification.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ALLERGENS SAFETY FOR PATRONS IN FOOD RETAIL.
purpose: To require food allergen labeling in restaurant menus by requiring restaurants to display the eight most common allergens present in each dish.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TUITION WAIVERS FOR THE DEPENDENT CHILD OF ANY POLICE OFFICER OR FIREFIGHTER WHO DIES IN THE LINE OF DUTY.
purpose: To provide tuition waivers at public institutions of higher education for the dependent children of police officers and firefighters who die in the line of duty.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ABLE-BODIED PUBLIC ASSISTANCE BENEFICIARIES TO WORK OR VOLUNTEER.
purpose: To require able-bodied public assistance beneficiaries to work or volunteer to receive benefits unless they are exempt under federal law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FEDERAL WAIVER TO COMPEL ABLE-BODIED MEDICAID RECIPIENTS TO WORK OR VOLUNTEER.
purpose: To require able-bodied Medicaid recipients to work or volunteer to receive or maintain Medicaid benefits.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR PEER SUPPORT SERVICES PROVIDED BY CERTIFIED PEER COUNSELORS.
purpose: To require: (1) The Commissioner of Public Health to adopt regulations (A) providing for the certification and education of peer support specialists, and (B) specifying the peer support services that a certified peer support specialist may provide to another individual in this state; and (2) health insurance coverage for peer support services provided by certified peer support specialists on an outpatient basis.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CUSTODIAL INTERFERENCE IN THE FIRST DEGREE.
purpose: To amend section 53a-97 of the general statutes to align the statute with Connecticut common law with respect to the crime of custodial interference.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DUTIES AND LIABILITY OF CAMPGROUND OWNERS.
purpose: To promote campground safety for visitors and legal certainty to campground owners.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF THE PROBATE COURT TO ORDER A PERSON WITH A SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER OR PSYCHIATRIC DISABILITY TO SUBMIT TO AN INVOLUNTARY MEDICAL EVALUATION AND ASSISTED OUTPATIENT MEDICAL TREATMENT.
purpose: To provide a Probate Court with the authority to order a person with a substance use disorder or psychiatric disability to submit to an involuntary medical evaluation and assisted outpatient medical treatment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF THE UNIFORM REAL PROPERTY TRANSFER ON DEATH ACT.
purpose: To provide for the adoption of the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PREVAILING WAGE THRESHOLD FOR REMODELING AND RENOVATION.
purpose: To (1) increase the total cost threshold for certain public works projects, and (2) index total cost thresholds to inflation.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPAL ADOPTION AND ENFORCEMENT OF BLIGHT ORDINANCES CONCERNING COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to adopt and enforce blight ordinances with respect to commercial properties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ABANDONED AND BLIGHTED PROPERTY RECEIVERSHIP IN CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To remove the limitation on the applicability of the statute to municipalities with populations of thirty-five thousand or more.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING UNIFORM STANDARDS FOR TEMPERATURE AND HUMIDITY IN SCHOOLS ACROSS THE STATE.
purpose: To require the same standards for temperature and humidity in schools across the state.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING THE USE OF PSILOCYBIN FOR MEDICINAL AND THERAPEUTIC PURPOSES.
purpose: To allow the use of psilocybin for medicinal and therapeutic purposes, including, but not limited to, the provision of physical, mental or behavioral health care.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING IMPROVEMENT IN THE TREATMENT OF PERSONS WHO ARE SUICIDAL OR HAVE ATTEMPTED SUICIDE.
purpose: To improve the treatment of persons who are suicidal or have attempted suicide.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING AN ADVANCED PRACTICE REGISTERED NURSE CERTIFIED AS A NURSE ANESTHETIST TO PRACTICE MEDICINE WITHOUT DIRECT OVERSIGHT BY A PHYSICIAN TO THE SAME EXTENT AS AN ADVANCED PRACTICE REGISTERED NURSE CERTIFIED AS A NURSE PRACTITIONER OR CLINICAL NURSE SPECIALIST.
purpose: To allow an advanced practice registered nurse who holds and maintains certification as a nurse anesthetist to render services without direct oversight by a physician to the same extent that an advanced practice registered nurse who holds and maintains certification as a nurse practitioner or clinical nurse specialist may render services without such direct oversight.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HOSPITALS TO HAVE AN URGENT CARE CENTER LOCATED NEAR THEIR EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT TO CARE FOR PATIENTS WHO DO NOT REQUIRE EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES.
purpose: To give patients seeking urgent care a more affordable option than the services provided at emergency departments.

title: AN ACT AUGMENTING THE STATE'S ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE STATUTE.
purpose: To strengthen the state's environmental justice law with enhanced public participation and the authority to deny applications for new, renewed, expanded or modified permits affecting facilities in order to protect the public health and environment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SMALL CELL SITING AND SMART METER OPT-IN.
purpose: To give municipalities different options in conducting the siting for small cell installations and to prohibit electric utilities from installing smart meters if the customer does not opt in and consent to the installation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCESS FOR OBJECTING TO ACTIONS TAKEN BY UTILITY COMPANIES PURSUANT TO A VEGETATION MANAGEMENT PLAN.
purpose: To give property owners enhanced time to object to a utility company's vegetation management plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY TREATMENT AND TRANSPORTATION OF POLICE DOGS INJURED IN THE LINE OF DUTY.
purpose: To allow emergency medical services personnel to provide emergency treatment and transportation to police dogs injured in the line of duty.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING HEALTH AND ATHLETIC CLUB SERVICES AND FEES FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt health and athletic club services and fees from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING REAL ESTATE AGENTS FROM INFORMING PROSPECTIVE BUYERS OR SELLERS OF RESIDENTIAL REAL ESTATE THAT STATE LAW REQUIRES AN ATTORNEY TO DRAFT A PURCHASE AND SALE AGREEMENT.
purpose: To prohibit a real estate agent from informing a prospective buyer or seller of residential real estate that state law requires an attorney who is licensed and in good standing in this state to draft a purchase and sale agreement.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE, BARTER OR OFFERING FOR SALE OR BARTER OF DEAD KANGAROOS AND ANY PRODUCT MADE FROM DEAD KANGAROOS.
purpose: To establish the Kangaroo Protection Act of 2023.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL LUNCH AVAILABILITY TO ALL STUDENTS.
purpose: To provide school lunch availability to all students regardless of their parents' ability to pay.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARENTAL ACCESS TO SCHOOL CURRICULA AND OTHER COURSE MATERIALS.
purpose: To provide transparency in education.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING RETIRED PAROLE OFFICERS TO PROVIDE SCHOOL SECURITY SERVICES.
purpose: To enable retired parole officers to serve as armed school security officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARENTAL ACCESS TO SCHOOL CURRICULA AND OTHER COURSE MATERIALS.
purpose: To provide transparency in education.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RECOVERY SCHOOL IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To ensure educational and treatment opportunities for high school students in recovery.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF THE NATURALIZATION TEST AS PART OF THE HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To promote civics education and encourage participation in the democratic process among high school students.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE BOTTLE BILL.
purpose: To reduce the cost of beverages to consumers.

title: AN ACT DISCONTINUING THE PERMITTING OF TRAWLERS IN THE MARINE WATERS OF THE STATE.
purpose: To reduce the waste of biodiversity that is killed and not landed and reduce the impact of trawler emissions.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF LEGHOLD AND BODY-CRUSHING TRAPS.
purpose: To prevent cruelty to animals caused by the use of leghold and body-crushing traps.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF CERTAIN ANIMALS IN TRAVELING ANIMAL ACTS.
purpose: To prohibit the use of certain animals in traveling animal acts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND TRANSFERRING ENERGY FUNCTIONS FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TO THE NEW DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To create a Department of Energy and transfer energy-related functions from the current Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to the new Department of Energy.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To repeal the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX AND THE TAX ON FUELS AND GASOHOL.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax and the tax on fuels and gasohol.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INDEXING OF INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To require that income thresholds for personal income tax be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEDUCTION AND WITHHOLDING OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX FROM PENSION AND ANNUITY DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that payers of pension and annuity distributions deduct and withhold personal income tax from such distributions.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT WITHDRAWING CONNECTICUT FROM THE NATIONAL POPULAR VOTE INTERSTATE COMPACT.
purpose: To withdraw the state from the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RANKED-CHOICE VOTING FOR MUNICIPAL OFFICES.
purpose: To allow municipalities to provide for ranked-choice voting for municipal offices.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION TO CONDUCT A STUDY AND SUBMIT A REPORT CONCERNING KRATOM.
purpose: To require the Department of Consumer Protection to study the health effects of kratom and submit a report containing the results of such study and the department's recommendations concerning kratom regulation.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE DEFINITION OF MUNICIPALITY.
purpose: To amend subsection (a) of section 8-30g of the general statutes to redefine "municipality" to include any village.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOMES AND THE CALCULATION OF THE TEN PER CENT AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEAL THRESHOLD.
purpose: To include mobile manufactured homes, affordable at certain income levels, in the calculation of the ten per cent threshold for the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY OWNED BY A BUSINESS ORGANIZATION THAT IS EXEMPT FROM THE PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To increase the original value of tangible personal property of a business organization that is eligible for exemption to not more than one thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPALITIES TO PROHIBIT THE TRAPPING AND HUNTING OF ANIMALS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to prohibit the trapping and hunting of animals.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE CERTIFICATE OF NEED PROGRAM.
purpose: To improve access to and reduce the costs of health care.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A MORAL OR PHILOSOPHICAL OBJECTION AS AN EXEMPTION TO THE SCHOOL IMMUNIZATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To allow a moral or philosophical objection as an exemption to the school immunization requirements.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO SUBSTANCE ABUSE TREATMENT FACILITIES.
purpose: To expand access to substance abuse treatment facilities.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CONNECTICUT TO JOIN THE COUNSELING COMPACT.
purpose: To increase access to professional counselors in the state, provide patients with continuity of care and ensure new state residents, including military spouses, can practice in the state without undue delay.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIABILITY FOR PHYSICAL HARM CAUSED BY FIREARMS AND REQUIRING LIABILITY INSURANCE PRIOR TO THE PURCHASE OF A FIREARM.
purpose: To require people who own firearms to take responsibility for any accident or crime that is committed with such firearm and to encourage secure storage of firearms to avoid accidents or crimes committed by firearms.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING FEES FOR VETERAN SPECIALTY LICENSE PLATES.
purpose: To eliminate fees charged to veterans for veteran specialty license plates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCEDURE.
purpose: To include dwelling units that meet certain income requirements into the ten per cent threshold of the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS AND THE CIRCUIT BREAKER PROGRAM AND ELIMINATING THE ESTATE AND GIFT TAXES.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for certain personal income tax deductions, increase the qualifying income thresholds for the circuit breaker program and eliminate the estate and gift taxes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REGIONAL GRANT FUND TO PROVIDE TRANSPORTATION FOR NONAMBULATORY NURSING HOME RESIDENTS FOR SOCIAL VISITS.
purpose: To enhance the quality of life and health outcomes for nonambulatory nursing home residents by increasing opportunities for socialization by providing medically appropriate transportation for visits with family and friends.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING OVERTIME AND MILEAGE REIMBURSEMENT PAYMENTS FROM STATE EMPLOYEE PENSION CALCULATIONS.
purpose: To prohibit travel reimbursement and overtime pay from being included in the calculation of state employee pensions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRANSFER AND RENOVATION OF THE XL CENTER.
purpose: To prevent further state spending on a facility that could be renovated privately and restored to the property tax base.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT AT NEW LONDON HIGH SCHOOL.
purpose: To reimburse the town of New London for certain abatement and demolition work associated with the school building project at New London High School.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING SCHOOL DISTRICTS TO OPT OUT OF THE COMMON CORE STATE STANDARDS.
purpose: To allow school districts to opt out of the Common Core State Standards and to choose an alternative standard for its curriculum.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISPLAY OF THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES FOR STUDENTS IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To ensure that students are able to learn about the foundation of the rights and liberties of all citizens of the United States of America.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE EDUCATION COST SHARING GRANT.
purpose: To fully fund the education cost sharing grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE.
purpose: To strengthen the state's environmental justice statute.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DELIBERATE FEEDING OF BLACK BEARS AND AUTHORIZING A LIMITED BEAR HUNTING SEASON.
purpose: To manage the black bear population and protect residents of the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAPTIVE CETACEANS IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To better protect the health and well-being of cetaceans.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE AND TRADE OF SHARK FINS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To ban the sale and trade of all shark fins in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PRESENCE OF CONSERVATION OFFICERS AND STAFF AT STATE PARKS.
purpose: To decrease incidents of vandalism at state parks.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INSTALLATION OF ELECTRONIC SALES KIOSKS AT HARKNESS STATE PARK FOR THE COLLECTION OF DAILY PARKING FEES FROM OUT-OF-STATE RESIDENTS.
purpose: To discourage out-of-state residents from failing to pay daily parking fees at Harkness Memorial State Park.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HABITUATION OF BLACK BEARS.
purpose: To address intentional and unintentional feeding of black bears, as well as provide a grant program to use proven nonlethal techniques to avoid conflicts, establish black bear cub rehabilitation guidelines and put in place a funding mechanism to compensate for structural damages made by black bears on farms.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ADOPTION OF EPA AIR REGULATIONS AND THE REPEAL OF CALIFORNIA AIR STANDARDS.
purpose: To remove Connecticut' reliance on the California emissions standards and base Connecticut's Clean Air regulations on the U.S. Environmental Protection Agency standards.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE EFFECTS OF OFFSHORE WIND ON THE FISHING INDUSTRY.
purpose: To study the effects of offshore wind on Connecticut's fishing industry.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADJUDICATION OF DISPUTES BETWEEN MUNICIPALITIES AND CERTAIN MUNICIPAL WATERWORKS SYSTEMS.
purpose: To make the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority the arbiter in disputes between towns and municipal water providers in neighboring towns.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FILING OF HIGHWAY USE TAX RETURNS.
purpose: To reduce the frequency of filing highway use tax returns for affected carriers.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME AND CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNT DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR VOLUNTEER EMERGENCY MEDICAL TECHNICIANS AND VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for taxpayers who serve regularly as volunteer emergency medical technicians or volunteer firefighters.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE MANUFACTURER'S LICENSE FEE FOR CAMP TRAILERS.
purpose: To reduce the manufacturer's license fee for camp trailers to one hundred dollars.

title: AN ACT LIMITING PROJECTS ELIGIBLE FOR GRANTS FROM THE SMALL TOWN ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To limit grants from the small town economic assistance program to only those projects necessary to maintain public health and safety and for critical infrastructure.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR INFRASTRUCTURE REPAIRS AND EXHIBITS AT CONNECTICUT'S BEARDSLEY ZOO.
purpose: To provide funding to Connecticut's Beardsley Zoo for infrastructure repairs and exhibits.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING BONE HEALTH AND OSTEOPOROSIS MONTH.
purpose: To raise awareness of a critical women's health issue.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DUTIES AND POWERS OF THE STATE TREASURER REGARDING UNCLAIMED PROPERTY.
purpose: To more effectively return unclaimed property to state residents by modifying the current duties and powers of the State Treasurer regarding such unclaimed property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION AND REPEAL OF STATE AGENCY REGULATIONS.
purpose: To streamline and simplify the regulations of Connecticut state agencies.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PREPUBLICATION APPROVAL OF AN OBITUARY BY A SURVIVING SPOUSE.
purpose: To require that a newspaper published in this state obtain approval from a decedent's surviving spouse before publishing an obituary concerning the decedent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAID SOLICITORS OF CHARITABLE FUNDS AND CHARITABLE ORGANIZATION TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To modify various disclosure, publication, recordkeeping and reporting requirements applicable to charitable organizations and paid solicitors of charitable funds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISABILITY INSURANCE BENEFITS FOR AN INSURED ELIGIBLE FOR LEAVE UNDER THE CONNECTICUT PAID LEAVE AUTHORITY.
purpose: To set forth requirements for a disability insurer to provide disability insurance benefits to an insured who is eligible for leave under the Connecticut Paid Leave Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EQUAL PARENTING TIME.
purpose: To ensure that the parents of a minor child have equal parenting time when the court enters an order of joint custody of the minor child.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CRIME VICTIM'S PARTICIPATORY RIGHTS IN A VIOLATION OF PROBATION HEARING.
purpose: To ensure that a crime victim has participatory rights in any hearing concerning a violation of probation by the person who committed the criminal act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FULL IMPLEMENTATION OF THE CASTLE DOCTRINE.
purpose: To fully adopt the "castle doctrine".

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CASH BAIL.
purpose: To provide that a cash bail with a deposit of ten per cent be offered only by an order of the court and shall not be authorized automatically.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE OF FENTANYL TO A MINOR.
purpose: To protect minors from being targeting by fentanyl dealers.

title: AN ACT CREATING A STATE CAUSE OF ACTION FOR A VIOLATION OF THE FEDERAL HEALTH INSURANCE PORTABILITY AND ACCOUNTABILITY ACT OF 1996.
purpose: To create a state cause of action for an individual to recover damages for violations of the federal Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act of 1996 (HIPAA).

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICE OF AN EMPLOYEE'S RIGHT TO CHOOSE TO NOT BE A MEMBER OF A UNION.
purpose: To provide clear notice of an employee's right to choose not to be a member of a union.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION FOR TELECOMMUNICATORS.
purpose: To treat public safety dispatchers in the same manner as other first responders for purposes of workers' compensation coverage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REMOVAL OF SATELLITE DISHES FROM RESIDENTIAL DWELLINGS.
purpose: To prevent the overcrowding of satellite dishes on rooftops.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE ONLINE PUBLICATION OF MUNICIPAL LEGAL NOTICES.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to post legal notices on municipal Internet web sites in lieu of publication in a newspaper.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR NEW STATE MANDATES.
purpose: To require new municipal mandates to be approved by at least two-thirds of the members of each chamber of the General Assembly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR CERTAIN FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYERS.
purpose: To establish a municipal option for a property tax abatement for certain first-time homebuyers.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN VACANT LOTS FROM CONFORMANCE WITH ZONING REGULATIONS.
purpose: To specify that construction on certain vacant lots shall not be required to conform with changes in zoning regulations adopted after the approval of a subdivision or resubdivision plan.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTAL NOTIFICATION PRIOR TO THE TERMINATION OF A PREGNANCY BY A MINOR.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of a minor are protected when facing an unplanned pregnancy.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CHILDREN TO ASSERT A RELIGIOUS EXEMPTION FROM THE IMMUNIZATION REQUIREMENTS FOR ATTENDING SCHOOL.
purpose: To restore the religious exemption from immunization requirements for school children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LICENSING RECIPROCITY FOR HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To expand licensing reciprocity for health care providers licensed in other states.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MANAGEMENT, CARE AND ADMINISTRATION OF CEMETERIES BY THE STATE ON BEHALF OF CEMETERY ASSOCIATIONS PURSUING DISSOLUTION.
purpose: To aid in the transfer of operations of a cemetery when a cemetery association cannot locate a successor or purchaser.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF COMMUNITY-BASED BEREAVEMENT AND GRIEF COUNSELING ORGANIZATIONS AND SERVICES FOR CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To require the Commission on Women, Children, Seniors, Equity and Opportunity to conduct a study of community-based bereavement and grief counseling organizations and services for children and families and make recommendations for the implementation of a state-wide program for the delivery of such services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LEARN HERE, HEAL HERE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the number of mental health care providers in the state.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING ALTERNATIVE HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS TO PROVIDE CERTAIN ALTERNATIVE HEALTH CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To establish a safe harbor for alternative health care providers to provide certain alternative health care services.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING EMERGENCY CONTRACEPTION TO BE SOLD AND DISPENSED VIA VENDING MACHINES LOCATED AT INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To reduce barriers to obtaining emergency contraception.

title: AN ACT REFORMING THE BAIL SYSTEM.
purpose: To reform the bail system and provide additional oversight and accountability to bail bondsmen.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE SALE AND USE OF CONSUMER FIREWORKS.
purpose: To authorize the sale and use of consumer fireworks in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SUSPENSION OF A MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSE OF ANY PERSON WHO CAUSES SIGNIFICANT PROPERTY DAMAGE RESULTING FROM THE USE OF A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To increase public safety by suspending the motor vehicle operator's license of any person who causes significant property damage resulting from or caused by the use or operation of a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SUSPENSION OF A MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSE FOR FAILURE TO OBEY A TRAFFIC CONTROL SIGNAL THAT CAUSES DEATH OR PROPERTY DAMAGE.
purpose: To increase public safety by suspending the motor vehicle operator's license of any person who fails to obey a traffic control signal and such failure results in death or property damage.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE FEE FOR ISSUANCE OF PURPLE HEART NUMBER PLATES.
purpose: To allow veterans, members of the armed forces and surviving spouses of such veterans and members to obtain number plates recognizing the Military Order of the Purple Heart at no additional cost beyond the cost to register a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONVEYANCE OF AN EASEMENT OVER A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE TOWN OF WATERFORD.
purpose: To convey an easement over a parcel of state land in the town of Waterford for the purpose of constructing an access road.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF FLASHING WRONG WAY SIGNS THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To increase public safety by expanding the amount of highway exit ramps with wrong way signs with actuated flashers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VETERANS AND THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE.
purpose: To exempt veterans from payment of the Passport to the Parks motor vehicle registration fee.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING DISABLED VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE WHEN REGISTERING A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To exempt disabled veterans from the Passport to the Parks fee when registering a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DELIVERY OF MORTGAGE MODIFICATIONS UNDER THE EZEQUIEL SANTIAGO FORECLOSURE MEDIATION PROGRAM.
purpose: To: (1) Require a mortgagee that agrees to modify a mortgage pursuant to the Ezequiel Santiago Foreclosure Mediation Program to deliver such modification to the mortgagor at least fifteen business days prior to the first payment due date under such modification; (2) provide that the failure to timely deliver a modification shall constitute grounds for a court to order certain relief; and (3) provide that any failure to reissue or otherwise correct a modification may constitute (A) a defense to a foreclosure action, and (B) an unfair trade practice.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE THIRTY-MINUTE TIME MANDATE REQUIRED FOR EDUCATOR LUNCH PERIODS.
purpose: To eliminate the thirty-minute time mandate required for lunch periods for certified employees in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE FUNDING TO PROVIDE FREE BREAKFAST AND LUNCH FOR ALL STUDENTS FROM KINDERGARTEN TO GRADE TWELVE.
purpose: To provide universal free school meals to children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE CONNECTICUT GUIDELINES FOR EDUCATOR EVALUATION.
purpose: To allow educators who are rated as exemplary or proficient to continue to use their teaching hours focused on classroom instruction and student development by not requiring annual evaluations for such high-achieving educators, and providing educators with continuing support who have not yet reached exemplary and proficient evaluation ratings.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING MUNICIPAL FINANCIAL DECISION-MAKING FOR CERTAIN SCHOOL-RELATED EXPENSES.
purpose: To reserve to municipalities decision-making authority regarding the provision of school-related noneducational services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TEACHER CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR ADJUNCT COLLEGE PROFESSORS.
purpose: To alleviate the teacher shortage in the state by making adjunct college professors eligible to teach in public high schools.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE AND DISTRIBUTION OF SINGLE-USE PLASTIC WATER BOTTLES IN CERTAIN STATE BUILDINGS AND REQUIRING THE INSTALLATION OF REUSABLE BOTTLE WATER -FILLING STATIONS IN SUCH BUILDINGS.
purpose: To reduce plastic waste and promote environmentally friendly practices.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSERVATION OF CERTAIN WATERS AND LANDS OF THE UPPER FARMINGTON RIVER.
purpose: To assess the need to explore and plan for ways to best conserve one of the state's largest remaining contiguous blocks of forested open space as well as to protect the federally designated Wild and Scenic Upper Farmington River.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY THE EPIDEMIC OF DOMESTIC DOG ATTACKS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To develop recommendations for legislation to address the epidemic of domestic dog attacks in the state and to expedite appeals of animal control officer orders and minimize the time impounded animals are held at taxpayer expense.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING HUNTING BY FIREARM ON PRIVATE PROPERTY INCLUDING ON SUNDAYS.
purpose: To allow hunting of all animals by firearm on private property on all days, including Sundays.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING SENIOR CITIZENS AND VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE AND LIMITING SUCH FEE TO THE REGISTRATION OF ONE VEHICLE WHEN A PERSON REGISTERS MULTIPLE VEHICLES.
purpose: To exempt senior citizens and veterans from the Passport to the Parks vehicle registration fee and to apply such vehicle registration fee to only one vehicle when a person registers more than one vehicle with the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING HUNTERS TO UTILIZE FIREARMS FITTED WITH SOUND SUPPRESSORS.
purpose: To authorize hunters to use firearms fitted with sound suppressors.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NEW AND RENOVATED CONSTRUCTION OF PUBLIC BUILDINGS AND SCHOOLS TO BE ENERGY EFFICIENT AND UTILIZE RENEWABLE SOURCES OF ENERGY.
purpose: To ensure that future building projects, such as schools, are energy efficient and not fully reliant on fossil fuels.

title: AN ACT RESTRICTING THE USE OF NEONICOTINOIDS  FOR NONAGRICULTURAL PURPOSES AND SEEDS TREATED WITH SIMILAR PESTICIDES.
purpose: To protect human health and the environment including pollinators.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NOISE LIMITS ON OFFSHORE WIND FACILITIES AND ENVIRONMENTAL AND JOB CREATION FACTORS IN THE PROCUREMENT OF WIND ENERGY.
purpose: To establish noise limits for offshore wind facilities providing energy to Connecticut electric customers and require environmental and job creation standards in the state's procurement of wind energy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMMISSION ON ENVIRONMENTAL STANDARDS IN THE PROCUREMENT OF WIND ENERGY.
purpose: To make the commission on environmental standards a permanent entity assisting wind energy development instead of requiring a new commission to be created every time there is a new procurement.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING OFFSHORE WIND DEVELOPERS TO ESTABLISH A COMPENSATION FUND.
purpose: To require offshore wind energy developers to create a fund that will compensate for negative impacts to fisheries and the environment, as well as compensate for not creating the number of jobs agreed to in their contracts.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deduction for Social Security benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS AND VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE MEMBERS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any stipend paid by a municipality, a volunteer fire department of a municipality or a volunteer ambulance association of a municipality, to a volunteer firefighter or volunteer ambulance member.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR TAXPAYERS WHO PROVIDE HOME INSTRUCTION TO THEIR DEPENDENT CHILDREN.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for taxpayers who provide home instruction to their dependent children who have been officially withdrawn from school in accordance with the provisions of section 10-184 of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINORITY REPRESENTATION.
purpose: To provide that, for purposes of minority representation, unaffiliated persons elected or appointed to boards, commissions or other similar bodies be deemed unaffiliated for the duration of their terms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANCELLATION OF CERTAIN CONSUMER MEMBERSHIPS AND SUBSCRIPTION SERVICES.
purpose: To provide consumers with the ability to cancel certain memberships and subscriptions online or through a mobile application.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WINE MANUFACTURING BY FARM WINERIES.
purpose: To allow a farm winery permittee to use grapes from any Connecticut farm to manufacture wine.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FROM RECEIVING MONEY FOR SOLICITING STUDENTS TO GAMBLE ONLINE.
purpose: To prohibit public institutions of higher education from receiving money or profiting from directly soliciting students to gamble online.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONNECTICUT HIGHER EDUCATION SUPPLEMENTAL LOAN AUTHORITY TO ESTABLISH AN INCOME-DRIVEN LOAN REPAYMENT OPTION.
purpose: To require the Connecticut Higher Education Supplemental Loan Authority to offer an income-driven loan repayment option to certain borrowers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSON-CENTERED, COORDINATED MEDICAL, BEHAVIORAL HEALTH AND ORAL HEALTH CARE FOR MEDICAID RECIPIENTS.
purpose: To establish person-centered, medical home care plans coordinating medical, behavioral health and oral health care for new Medicaid enrollees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOME INSPECTIONS OF RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To require a purchaser of residential property to obtain a home inspection of the property, including condominiums and other common interest ownership communities, by a licensed home inspector in this state, before the final sale of the residential property.

title: AN ACT REMOVING THE SUNSET DATE FOR THE HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE MANDATE FOR TELEHEALTH SERVICES.
purpose: To remove the sunset date of June 30, 2023, for the health insurance coverage mandate for telehealth services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR BREAST RECONSTRUCTION.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage, without any out-of-pocket expense, for nipple reconstruction or nipple tattooing for all insureds who have undergone a breast reconstruction surgery for a medically necessary purpose, including prophylactic mastectomies.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN ANNUAL INDEPENDENT AUDIT OF THE PARTNERSHIP PLAN 2.0.
purpose: To require an annual independent audit of the books and accounts of the Comptroller, maintained for the partnership plan 2.0.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A POLICE OFFICER'S ABILITY TO REQUEST CONSENT TO SEARCH A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To allow police officers the ability to request consent to search a motor vehicle in order to take illegal weapons and drugs off the street, as well as assist in collecting evidence of a crime.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PENALTIES FOR MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT AND CRIMES INVOLVING FIREARMS.
purpose: To increase penalties for motor vehicle theft and crimes involving firearms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY OWNER'S LIABILITY FOR THE EXPENSES OF REMOVING A FALLEN TREE OR LIMB.
purpose: To impose liability on certain owners of real property for the expenses of removing a tree or limb that falls on an adjoining owner's private real property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERMISSIBLE DISQUALIFICATIONS FROM JUROR SERVICE.
purpose: To allow persons age seventy or older to opt out of service as a juror.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCLOSURE OF SALARY RANGES IN JOB POSTINGS.
purpose: To require employers to disclose salary ranges in all job postings.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPALITIES TO ESTABLISH A PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR CERTAIN CONDOMINIUM UNITS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to establish a property tax abatement for condominium units that do not receive certain municipal services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOVERY OF ATTORNEY'S FEES AND COSTS IN ACTIONS FOR WRONGFUL PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT.
purpose: To permit the recovery of attorney's fees and costs in successful actions for wrongful property tax assessment.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING FOR THE DISPOSAL OF DEAD HUMAN BODIES THROUGH NATURAL ORGANIC REDUCTION.
purpose: To allow for the disposal of dead human bodies through natural organic reduction.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PRIVATE EQUITY FIRMS TO DISCLOSE CERTAIN FINANCIAL INFORMATION PRIOR TO PURCHASING OR INVESTING IN HEALTH CARE INSTITUTIONS.
purpose: To increase health care institution ownership transparency by requiring private equity firms that purchase or make large investments in health care institutions in the state to disclose certain financial information prior to such purchase or investment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INTERNET AND PERSONAL CELLULAR TELEPHONE ACCESS FOR PATIENTS OF HOSPITALS FOR TREATMENT OF PERSONS WITH PSYCHIATRIC DISABILITIES.
purpose: To allow patients being treated for psychiatric disabilities access to the Internet and their personal cell phones.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING USE OF DEADLY FORCE.
purpose: To ensure that peace officers are properly evaluated for the use of force.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO REIMBURSE MUNICIPALITIES FOR COSTS RELATED TO REMOVAL OF PFAS FROM FIRE APPARATUS.
purpose: To establish a grant program to reimburse municipalities for costs related to removal of PFAS from fire apparatus.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING 9-1-1 DISPATCHERS.
purpose: To designate dispatchers as first responders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING USE OF FLASHING RED LIGHTS BY CERTAIN MEDICALLY TRAINED PERSONNEL.
purpose: To allow medically trained personnel to more quickly respond to emergency situations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AWARD OF DOUBLE OR TREBLE DAMAGES TO AN INJURED PARTY IN A CIVIL ACTION RESULTING FROM THE EVASION OF RESPONSIBILITY IN THE OPERATION OF ANY VEHICLE OR STREET RACING.
purpose: To permit an injured party to recover double or treble damages in civil actions for personal injury or property damage involving a person who evades responsibility in the operation of a vehicle or participates in street racing and thereby inhibits the ability of the injured party to identify such person and obtain insurance coverage for such injury or damage.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO ASSIST MUNICIPALITIES WITH IMPROVING AND MAINTAINING BUS STOPS.
purpose: To establish a grant program to assist municipalities with improving conditions at bus stops and protecting passengers from weather conditions at such stops.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF AUTOMATED TRAFFIC ENFORCEMENT SAFETY DEVICES.
purpose: To authorize the use of automated traffic enforcement safety devices to enforce speed limits and stopping at red lights.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING A VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE SERVICE TO USE FLASHING BLUE LIGHTS.
purpose: To allow a member of a volunteer ambulance service to use flashing blue lights while on the way to or at the scene of an emergency requiring the services of such member.

title: AN ACT NAMING A PORTION OF CONNECTICUT ROUTE 156 IN OLD LYME IN HONOR OF MERVIN F. ROBERTS.
purpose: To name a portion of Connecticut Route 156 in honor of Mervin F. Roberts.

title: AN ACT NAMING A PORTION OF U.S. ROUTE 1 IN OLD SAYBROOK IN HONOR OF VELMA THOMAS.
purpose: To name a portion of U.S. Route 1 in Old Saybrook in honor of Velma Thomas.

title: AN ACT NAMING A PORTION OF CONNECTICUT ROUTE 145 IN WESTBROOK IN HONOR OF PAUL J. CONNELLY.
purpose: To name a portion of Connecticut Route 145 in Westbrook in honor of Paul J. Connelly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE BENEFITS FOR RETIRED TEACHERS.
purpose: To restore one-third state subsidy to retired teachers enrolled in the Teachers' Retirement Board Medicare supplement health insurance package.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RETIREE MEMBERS OF THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BOARD.
purpose: To increase the number of retired teachers on the Teachers' Retirement Board from two to four.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTION OF MEMBERS TO THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BOARD.
purpose: To reform the procedures for election of members to the Teachers' Retirement Board.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR A BILINGUAL NURSE'S AIDE PROGRAM IN NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To authorize an appropriation of one hundred fifty thousand dollars to establish a pilot bilingual curriculum for a CNA program in New Haven.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCENTIVES TO ADDRESS THE SHORTAGE OF CHILD CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To encourage participation by private industry in addressing the shortage of child care facilities.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING GUARDIANS AD LITEM TO BE STATE EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To require guardians ad litem to be state employees because they play an important role in a child's life and should be held to a higher standard of accountability.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TIME TO ADOPT THE MUNICIPAL AID PORTION OF THE STATE BUDGET.
purpose: To aid municipalities in their budget making process.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR A STUDY AND PLAN CONCERNING THE CONNECTION OF CERTAIN PARCELS IN HAMDEN TO THE MUNICIPAL SEWER SYSTEM.
purpose: To appropriate funds for a study and plan to connect certain businesses in Hamden to the municipal sewer system.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A VIRTUAL SCHOOL IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To offer an alternative education opportunity for certain students who are unable to attend school in person.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING CURRENT EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS IN SCHOOL READINESS PROGRAMS FROM THE STAFF QUALIFICATIONS REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To grandfather current early childhood educators in school readiness programs from the staff qualifications requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARENTAL INVOLVEMENT IN EDUCATION.
purpose: To promote transparency and parental involvement in the development of the curriculum that will be taught in the school district.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TEACHING OF CLIMATE CHANGE INSTRUCTION IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
purpose: To help close the opportunity gap, further environmental justice and protect the environment by educating all children in grades three to twelve, inclusive, about the role humans have played in accelerating climate change, and equipping all students with the tools necessary to be part of a green economy.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE CIVICS CREDIT REQUIREMENT FOR HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION.
purpose: To increase citizenship and civic literacy by requiring students to earn one full credit of civics instruction as part of high school graduation requirements in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FULL FUNDING OF SPECIAL EDUCATION AND EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT FUNDING TO ALLIANCE DISTRICTS AND DISTRESSED MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To provide more equitable education funding by increasing special education and education cost-sharing grant funding to alliance districts and school districts for distressed municipalities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SCOPE OF REVIEW PROCESS FOR THE ADOPTION OF NEW CURRICULUM GUIDES AND MATERIALS AND PROVIDING FOR LEGISLATIVE APPOINTMENTS TO THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To provide transparency and solicit community input on newly developed curriculum guides and materials by the State Board of Education.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TO DEVELOP A COMPREHENSIVE BEAR MANAGEMENT PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the development of a comprehensive bear management program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NIGHT TIME LIGHTING OF STATE-OWNED BUILDINGS FOR THE PROTECTION OF BIRDS.
purpose: To prevent birds from flying into the sides of buildings and to reduce light trespass and light pollution.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ADOPTION OF EMISSION STANDARDS BASED ON THE REGULATIONS OF THE UNITED STATES ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AGENCY RATHER THAN THE STATE OF CALIFORNIA.
purpose: To remove the state's reliance on California emissions standards and base the state's emissions regulations on federal standards.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EFFORTS TO COMBAT INVASIVE PLANTS.
purpose: To strengthen efforts to combat invasive plants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENFORCEMENT OF LAWS IN CERTAIN WATERS OF LONG ISLAND SOUND.
purpose: To reduce criminal incidents on the waters lying between Connecticut and the bordering states.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ZERO-EMISSION AFTERMARKET CONVERSION PROJECT.
purpose: To increase the number of zero-emission vehicles.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FAIR CHASE IN HUNTING.
purpose: To promote fair chase in hunting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HUNTING AND PUBLIC SAFETY.
purpose: To promote hiker safety.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY INCREASED ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMPETITION IN THE ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION MARKET.
purpose: To study the consumer benefit of increased accountability and competition in the electric distribution market.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF INCREASED ACCOUNTABILITY AND COMPETITION IN THE ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION AND TRANSMISSION INDUSTRY.
purpose: To study the consumer benefit of increased accountability and competition in the electric distribution and transmission industry.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ENERGY CONTRACTS, THE ORGANIZATION OF STATE AGENCIES AND STATE ENERGY POLICY.
purpose: To reduce electricity rates, create transparency in the funding of legislative policies and study ratepayer benefits of natural gas expansion and increased competition in the electric distribution market.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEARINGS ON WAIVER REQUESTS BEFORE THE CONNECTICUT SITING COUNCIL.
purpose: To require a Siting Council hearing on requests for a waiver of Siting Council rules or prior orders.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO RENOVATE SEASIDE STATE PARK.
purpose: To provide funding to renovate Seaside State Park.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR FIRST-TIME HOME BUYERS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for first-time home buyers.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR MARRIED INDIVIDUALS FILING JOINTLY.
purpose: To increase, for married individuals filing jointly, the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts, to twice the amount of the qualifying income threshold for an unmarried individual.

title: AN ACT SUNSETTING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To sunset the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES RATE AND THE IMPOSITION OF ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To (1) require the rate of the sales and use taxes to be reduced annually to reflect the amount of increased revenue to the state attributable to inflation, and (2) eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM PAYMENTS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for premiums paid for long-term care insurance.

title: AN ACT RESTORING THE RATE OF THE CREDIT AGAINST THE AFFECTED BUSINESS ENTITY TAX.
purpose: To restore the rate of the credit against the affected business entity tax to ninety-three and one-hundredths per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COLLECTION COSTS OF STATE TAXES AND FEES.
purpose: To require each state agency to evaluate the collection costs taxes and fees administered and to eliminate any tax or fee for which the cost of collection exceeds the revenue received by the state from the imposition of such tax or fee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCOPE OF DEBT TO BE PAID DOWN WITH EXCESS REVENUE.
purpose: To include the state's bond indebtedness on par with payments to the State Employees Retirement Fund and the Teachers' Retirement Fund in the order of payment priorities after the required transfers to the Budget Reserve Fund under section 4-30a of the general statutes have been made.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE MARGINAL TAX RATES FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To reduce each marginal tax rate for the personal income tax by one per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR CERTAIN TEACHERS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for certain teachers for classroom supplies purchased by the teacher with such teacher's personal funds.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING FRUIT SEEDS AND LIVESTOCK FEED FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt the sale of fruit seeds and livestock feed from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO ADDRESS FLOODING AND INFRASTRUCTURE ISSUES AT WHITE SANDS BEACH.
purpose: To provide funds to the town of Old Lyme to address ongoing flooding and associated infrastructure issues at White Sands Beach.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION AND REPAIR OF INFRASTRUCTURE RELATED TO WASTEWATER MANAGEMENT IN OLD LYME.
purpose: To provide funding to the town of Old Lyme for construction and repair of infrastructure related to wastewater management.

title: AN ACT COMBINING THE PETROLEUM PRODUCTS GROSS EARNINGS TAX AND THE MOTOR VEHICLE FUELS TAX.
purpose: To combine the petroleum products gross earnings tax and the motor vehicle fuels tax and impose one tax on a per-gallon basis.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING FARM VEHICLES FROM THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To exempt farm vehicles from the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF A POLICE BOAT FOR NEW FAIRFIELD.
purpose: To provide funding to purchase a police boat for use by the resident state troopers in New Fairfield to enhance public safety and the ecological well-being of the properties on Candlewood Lake.

title: AN ACT REDUCING FILING FEES FOR SMALL BUSINESSES.
purpose: To reduce the fees for small business filings with the Secretary of the State.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTATE TAX EXEMPTION THRESHOLD AND THE CAPS ON ESTATE AND GIFT TAXES.
purpose: To reduce the estate tax exemption threshold to three million six hundred thousand dollars and eliminate the caps on estate and gift taxes.

title: AN ACT CONTINUING THE RESTRICTIONS PLEDGED FOR CERTAIN BOND ISSUANCES.
purpose: To continue the restrictions pledged for bonds issued during a certain period of time.

title: AN ACT ADJUSTING CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX RATES AND INCOME THRESHOLDS.
purpose: To (1) adjust the personal income tax thresholds for taxpayers making less than one hundred seventy-five thousand dollars and reducing the applicable rate to four per cent, and (2) require that income thresholds for personal income tax be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation.

title: AN ACT MODIFYING THE PROCESS FOR DECLARING PUBLIC HEALTH AND CIVIL PREPAREDNESS EMERGENCIES.
purpose: To update the statutes concerning civil preparedness and public health emergencies and executive order emergency powers and to retain a legislative role in defining the duration of such powers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING QUALIFYING CONTRIBUTION AMOUNTS TO PARTICIPATING STATE-WIDE OFFICE CANDIDATES UNDER THE CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase to one thousand dollars the individual qualifying contribution amount for state-wide office candidates under the Citizens' Election Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A COORDINATED STATE STRATEGY TO FIGHT OPIOID ABUSE.
purpose: To coordinate state efforts to fight the scourge of opioid abuse and the deadly effects of fentanyl.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER AGREEMENTS, CONSUMER BILLS, TELECOMMUNICATIONS AND TICKETING.
purpose: To: (1) Require any business that enters into a consumer agreement that contains an automatic renewal or continuous services provision to provide various consumer notices, and enable any consumer who enters into such an agreement online to terminate such agreement online; (2) require certain persons doing business in this state to provide bills to certain consumers in paper form; and (3) provide that certain persons doing business in this state shall not impose any charge or fee for providing bills to consumers in paper form.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDING FROM THE OPIOID SETTLEMENT FUND TO BE USED TO SUPPLY A PATIENT WHO HAS BEEN PRESCRIBED AN OPIOID DRUG WITH A PERSONAL-USE PHARMACEUTICAL DISPOSAL SYSTEM.
purpose: To require funding from the Opioid Settlement Fund to be used to simultaneously supply a patient receiving an opioid drug prescription with a personal-use pharmaceutical disposal system without additional costs to the dispensing pharmacy or the patient.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TOBACCO BAR EXPANSION AND RELOCATION.
purpose: To allow for the expansion, change in location and establishment of tobacco bars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ONLINE BUILDING PERMIT APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To allow municipalities to accept online building permit applications.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FEDERAL, STATE AND MUNICIPAL AGENCY EMPLOYEES AND CERTAIN SKILLED TRADES.
purpose: To eliminate a provision exempting federal, state and municipal agency employees from certain requirements concerning skilled tradespersons.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER CREDIT SCORES AND BACKGROUND CHECKS.
purpose: To provide that a consumer's credit score shall not be decreased exclusively because the consumer is the subject of a background check.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HIRING RATIO FOR CERTAIN SKILLED TRADES.
purpose: To build a stronger and well-trained workforce to meet the growing need for resiliency, efficiency, infrastructure and green technology.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE OMBUDSMAN'S OFFICE FOR BEHAVIORAL HEALTHCARE COVERAGE.
purpose: To expand access to behavioral health care by establishing a state ombudsman's office to reduce private and public insurance reimbursement barriers for small and group health care providers.

title: AN ACT FACILITATING SAFE OPIOID PRESCRIPTION DISPOSAL BY HUSKY HEALTH PROGRAM MEMBERS.
purpose: To encourage the safe disposal of opioids.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF HUSKY HEALTH BENEFITS TO ALL INCOME-ELIGIBLE PERSONS REGARDLESS OF IMMIGRATION STATUS.
purpose: To expand HUSKY Health benefits to all income-eligible persons regardless of immigration status.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LOCAL DETERMINATION OF DEED-RESTRICTED AFFORDABLE HOUSING LEVELS.
purpose: To allow each municipality to determine the percentage of deed-restricted affordable housing that is appropriate for such municipality.

title: AN ACT CREATING THE HOUSING OPPORTUNITIES TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To create a tax credit for landlords who provide housing for justice-impacted individuals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCESS AND REMOVING THE MUNICIPAL OPT-OUT DEADLINE FOR ACCESSORY APARTMENTS.
purpose: To include dwelling units that meet certain income requirements into the calculation of the ten per cent threshold for the affordable housing appeals procedure and to remove the deadline for any municipality to opt-out of the as-of-right allowance of accessory apartments.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE EFFECTS OF EVICTIONS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the costs and effects of residential evictions on property owners.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE COVERAGE TO INCLUDE ELECTRIC BICYCLES.
purpose: To require homeowners insurance policies to provide coverage for electric bicycles that are lost, stolen or damaged in an automobile accident.

title: AN ACT UPDATING THE SEXUAL OFFENDER REGISTRY.
purpose: To allow certain aging, offense-free, lifelong registrants to deregister after twenty years in order to reduce strain on Connecticut's social systems for aging community members who represent a diminished risk to community safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAINING FOR JUDGES AND PROSECUTORS CONCERNING COERCIVE CONTROL.
purpose: To expand the recognition of coercive control for improved safety within families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STRANGULATION WHEN COMMITTED IN FURTHERANCE OF AN ACT OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To increase the criminal penalty for strangulation when committed in furtherance of an act of domestic violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PENALTIES FOR MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT AND CRIMES INVOLVING FIREARMS.
purpose: To increase penalties for motor vehicle theft and crimes involving firearms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHOTO IDENTIFICATION UPON RE-ENTRY INTO THE COMMUNITY.
