purpose: To ensure that formerly incarcerated persons have photo identification upon re-entry to the community.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING CERTAIN OFFENSES FROM ELIGIBILITY FOR AUTOMATIC ERASURE.
purpose: To ensure records are retained pertaining to those who commit egregious criminal acts.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING MURDER WITH SPECIAL CIRCUMSTANCES TO INCLUDE MURDER COMMITTED DURING AN INCIDENCE OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To increase the sentence imposed on those who commit murder during an incidence of domestic violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CRIME OF ENTICING A JUVENILE TO COMMIT A CRIMINAL ACT.
purpose: To hold accountable young adults who recruit juveniles into criminal activity.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PENALTIES FOR MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT AND CRIMES INVOLVING A FIREARM.
purpose: To increase the penalties associated with motor vehicle theft and crimes involving firearms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCOUNTABILITY IN DELINQUENCY MATTERS INVOLVING THE MOST SERIOUS JUVENILE OFFENDERS.
purpose: To promote public safety by creating accountability in delinquency matters involving the most serious juvenile offenders.

title: AN ACT REESTABLISHING THE FAMILY WITH SERVICE NEEDS PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide diversion services for at-risk children.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE FEE FOR CERTAIN BUSINESSES FILING AN ANNUAL REPORT WITH THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To reduce the fee for certain businesses filing an annual report with the Secretary of the State from eighty dollars to twenty dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCLOSURE OF PROPERTY HELD IN TRUST BY THE EXECUTOR OF A WILL.
purpose: To require the executor of a will to disclose to the Probate Court a copy of any trust of the decedent that includes real or personal property that is not transferred by the terms of the will in order to better account for assets held by the decedent and to ensure the integrity of the Probate Court process.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PRESUMPTION OF JOINT CUSTODY IN MATTERS INVOLVING THE CARE AND CUSTODY OF A MINOR CHILD.
purpose: To create a rebuttable presumption of joint custody and shared parenting time in matters involving the care and custody of a minor child.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC EMPLOYEES' SELECTION OF AN EXCLUSIVE BARGAINING UNIT.
purpose: To protect public employees' right to elect a union of their choice to represent their interests.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VIDEO SURVEILLANCE OF VENDING MACHINES.
purpose: To protect vending machines and other property by allowing video surveillance in areas designated for the health and personal comfort of employees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENACTMENT OF NEW MUNICIPAL MANDATES.
purpose: To require new municipal mandates to be approved by at least two-thirds of the members of each chamber of the General Assembly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN FINANCIALLY DISTRESSED MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To require the Auditors of Public Accounts to audit certain financially distressed municipalities and require legislative review of debt service contracts between such municipalities and the Office of Policy and Management.

title: AN ACT CONSOLIDATING THE NEW HARTFORD VOLUNTEER FIRE DISTRICT AND THE PINE MEADOW FIRE DISTRICT.
purpose: To authorize the consolidation of the New Hartford Volunteer Fire Department and the Pine Meadow Fire Department in the town of New Hartford.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE REGULATION OF FIREARMS BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To prohibit the regulation of firearms by municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STORAGE OF EVICTED TENANTS' POSSESSIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that municipalities store the possessions of evicted tenants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIRE DISTRICTS.
purpose: To allow fire districts in limited circumstances to assess a safety fee on certain nonprofit organizations, excluding houses of religious worship and hospitals, for the provision of certain services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY THE IMPACT OF UNCLAIMED OR ABANDONED REAL PROPERTY ON MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To determine what consequences are incurred by municipalities as a result of unclaimed or abandoned real property.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE REGULATION OF FIREARMS BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To preempt the regulation of firearms by municipalities.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES TO ESTABLISH TRAFFIC AUTHORITIES.
purpose: To authorize certain municipalities to establish traffic authorities.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CONSENT FROM A PARENT OR GUARDIAN PRIOR TO PROVIDING MENTAL OR BEHAVIORAL HEALTH CARE SERVICES TO A CHILD.
purpose: To allow parents and guardians to make the health care decisions that are in the best interests of their children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THERAPIES FOR TREATING NEUROLOGICAL DISEASES.
purpose: To provide greater access to critical therapies, including, but not limited to, physical therapy, for treating neurological diseases, including, but not limited to, amyotrophic lateral sclerosis.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE STATE TO JOIN THE PHYSICAL THERAPY LICENSURE COMPACT.
purpose: To authorize the state to join the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUBSTANCE USE DISORDER TREATMENT AND RECOVERY FACILITIES.
purpose: To address incidents of recidivism and substance use order.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTAL NOTIFICATION PRIOR TO THE TERMINATION OF A PREGNANCY BY A MINOR.
purpose: To ensure that parental authority regarding the best interests of a minor child is respected by the state, except in extraordinary circumstances, when such child is facing an unplanned pregnancy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIRE MARSHALS CARRYING PISTOLS OR REVOLVERS WHILE PERFORMING THEIR DUTIES.
purpose: To permit fire marshals who meet certain criteria to carry pistols or revolvers while performing their duties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIREARM INCIDENT REPORTS AND A TASK FORCE ON RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION OF POLICE OFFICERS.
purpose: To require police officers to provide firearm incident reports and the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection to annually report on such incident reports.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING APPEALS REGARDING GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY OF POLICE OFFICERS, SEARCHES OF MOTOR VEHICLES, PURCHASE OF SURPLUS MILITARY EQUIPMENT, USE OF FORCE BY POLICE OFFICERS AND PURSUIT OF SUSPECT POLICIES.
purpose: To ensure police officers have the tools, resources, training and peace of mind to protect our communities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANCELLATION OR REVOCATION OF A POLICE OFFICER'S CERTIFICATION FOR UNDERMINING PUBLIC CONFIDENCE IN LAW ENFORCEMENT.
purpose: To make clear the circumstances under which a police officer's certification may be cancelled or revoked.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ACCOUNT TO COMPENSATE FAMILIES OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS KILLED IN THE LINE OF DUTY.
purpose: To appropriately care for the families of law enforcement officers killed in the line of duty.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF THE CRISIS INITIATIVE PILOT PROGRAM THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Division of State Police to expand the CRISIS Initiative pilot program to all areas of the state in order to facilitate the use of community mental health and substance abuse services rather than incarceration.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for law enforcement officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO THE FEDERAL 1033 PROGRAM BY MUNICIPAL LAW ENFORCEMENT AGENCIES.
purpose: To allow municipal law enforcement's access to the federal 1033 program for emergency response, relief and rescue services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF REMOVABLE WINDSHIELD PLACARDS TO HOME CARE SERVICE AGENCIES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to issue removable windshield placards to a home care service agency for each employee who uses a motor vehicle in the course of employment and permit such employee to park and travel in certain restricted areas.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION AND NOTIFICATION.
purpose: To enable law enforcement officers to more quickly and efficiently contact the family of an injured or deceased person.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN CAR DEALERS TO FILE REGISTRATION APPLICATIONS ELECTRONICALLY WITH THE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To provide expedited same-day car registration for car dealers.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTIES FOR PASSING A SCHOOL BUS.
purpose: To increase the penalties for passing a school bus.

title: AN ACT NAMING STATE ROAD 597 IN SOUTHINGTON IN HONOR OF LIEUTENANT COLONEL DENNIS P. CONROY.
purpose: To name a portion of state road 597 in Southington in honor of Lieutenant Colonel Dennis P. Conroy.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING TRAFFIC-CALMING MEASURES IN THE TOWN OF HAMDEN.
purpose: To implement traffic-calming measures on Dixwell Avenue and Whitney Avenue in the town of Hamden to reduce traffic and improve public safety.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING THE UNITED STATES SPACE FORCE IN THE DEFINITION OF "ARMED FORCES".
purpose: To include the United States Space Force in the definition of "armed forces".

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE INTENTIONAL FEEDING OF WILDLIFE.
purpose: To prohibit the intentional feeding of wildlife, restrict the use of bird feeders and disallow the improper storage of food, garbage and wildlife attractants in order to reduce the frequency and likelihood of negative human interactions with such wildlife.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUBLICATION OF MUNICIPAL LEGAL NOTICES.
purpose: To save municipalities thousands of taxpayer dollars and recognize that municipalities maintain Internet web sites to communicate with their residents and that state residents are familiar with obtaining such information online.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE STATE FROM MANDATING A COVID-19 VACCINATION.
purpose: To prohibit the state of Connecticut or any employee thereof from mandating a COVID-19 vaccination.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING EMPLOYERS AND PUBLIC OFFICIALS FROM REQUIRING PROOF OF COVID-19 VACCINATION.
purpose: To prohibit employers and public officials from requiring proof of COVID-19 vaccination.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF A RECIPROCAL FOOD TRUCK VENDOR PERMIT OR LICENSE.
purpose: To allow for more efficiency for food truck vendors by reducing paperwork and saving costs associated with obtaining a permit or license from every municipality in which a food truck vendor seeks to operate.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE OF ELECTRONIC NICOTINE DELIVERY SYSTEMS AND VAPOR PRODUCTS THAT ARE FLAVORED OR HAVE A NICOTINE CONTENT GREATER THAN THIRTY-FIVE MILLIGRAMS PER MILLILITER.
purpose: To improve public health and lower health care costs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTRONIC APPLICATION AND ISSUANCE OF A TEMPORARY REGISTRATION.
purpose: To establish a more efficient and consumer-friendly process to obtain a temporary registration.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BENEFITS AND THE PURCHASE OF ADDITIONAL YEARS OF SERVICE.
purpose: To eliminate retired teacher benefits from being prorated and make the Teachers' Retirement System more equitable for retired teachers who purchased additional years of service for out-of-state service.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers that face increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TIMELY PASSAGE OF THE STATE BUDGET.
purpose: To prevent legislators and constitutional officers from being paid unless a state budget is passed on time.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT COMMUNITY PROVIDERS TO COMPENSATE THEM FOR THE COSTS OF INFLATION.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers that face increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDED BY NONPROFIT AGENCIES.
purpose: To index funding for nonprofit providers of health and human services to inflation to better ensure access to services for Connecticut residents, and to require the legislature periodically review rates to ensure they are adequate to meet the needs of the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDS ALLOCATED TO NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To prevent state agencies from recouping unspent funds allocated to nonprofit, private providers of health and human services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OPERATION OF GROUP HOMES BY NONPROFIT COMMUNITY-BASED PROVIDERS.
purpose: To reduce costs and enhance services provided by the Departments of Developmental Services, Mental Health and Addiction Services and Social Services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CONNECTICUT INFRASTRUCTURE BANK.
purpose: To establish the Connecticut Infrastructure Bank.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MENTORSHIP PROGRAM FOR TEACHERS WORKING UNDER A DURATIONAL SHORTAGE AREA PERMIT.
purpose: To establish a mentorship program for teachers who work under a durational shortage area permit.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR LEGISLATIVE APPOINTMENTS TO THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To ensure that the interests of parents are represented when developing state-wide education policy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROHIBITION OF DUAL INSTRUCTION AS PART OF REMOTE LEARNING.
purpose: To clarify the prohibition on dual instruction as part of remote learning for students receiving special education.

title: AN ACT INCREASING EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATOR SALARIES.
purpose: To increase the compensation of early childhood educators by aligning such educators' salaries with the early childhood educator compensation schedule established by the Office of Early Childhood.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN AUDIT OF THE USE OF FEDERAL COVID-19 FUNDS BY BOARDS OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To conduct a state-wide audit of how school districts have been expended federal COVID-19 funding during the previous two fiscal years.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CESSATION OF EDTPA AS PART OF EDUCATOR PREPARATION PROGRAMS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To replace the use of edTPA with an alternative preservice performance assessment.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR BILINGUAL EDUCATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase funding for bilingual education programs in the state.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE CONFINEMENT OF EGG-LAYING HENS.
purpose: To promote food safety, protect public health and advance animal welfare.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DIVERSION OF FOOD WASTE FROM THE SOLID WASTE STREAM.
purpose: To encourage a reduction in the amount of trash generated and reduce town costs for garbage disposal.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PRESERVATION OF STONE WALLS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To preserve stone walls throughout the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MAXIMUM WEIGHT LOAD FOR DAIRY TRUCKS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To create parity between Connecticut and neighboring states concerning the maximum weight load for dairy trucks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF NEONICOTINOIDS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To decrease the effect of pesticides that affect pollinators and human beings.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE TO ONE VEHICLE PER HOUSEHOLD.
purpose: To charge only one motor vehicle registration fee per household for the Passport to the Parks program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAMPING IN STATE PARKS.
purpose: To allow campers to camp at state parks as long as there are campsites open and available.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INTENTIONAL FEEDING, ATTRACTING OR ENTICING OF BLACK BEARS, THE TAKING OF BEARS THAT DAMAGE AGRICULTURAL PRODUCTS OR LIVESTOCK AND THE USE OF FORCE AGAINST WILDLIFE.
purpose: To limit interactions between humans and wild bears in Connecticut in order to protect both wildlife and human life and livelihood by curbing human behavior that threatens the ability of bears to live in the wild, enabling farmers to protect their livelihoods from the depredation caused by bears and clarifying the ability of a person to protect themselves in the event of an attack by a bear.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF BIOSOLIDS BY FARMERS.
purpose: To study the conversion and use of biosolids into fertile soils for use by farmers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FILLING OF VACANCIES ON THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY.
purpose: To ensure the continued effective operation of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority by maintaining full membership.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR VETERANS' DISABILITY BENEFIT PAYMENTS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for veterans' disability benefit payments.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME AND CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNT DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A TAX CREDIT FOR FARM PRODUCTS DONATED TO CHARITABLE ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To provide farmers with a tax credit for goods they donate to charitable organizations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DEDUCTION OF CERTAIN BUSINESS EXPENSES BY CANNABIS ESTABLISHMENTS.
purpose: To authorize the deduction of certain business expenses by cannabis establishments on their state tax returns.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE SALE OF BOOKS AT ELEMENTARY SCHOOL BOOK FAIRS FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt the sale of books sold at elementary school book fairs from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO PROVIDE GRANTS TO NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS FOR CAPITAL AND INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide funding to nonprofit health and human services providers for capital and infrastructure projects.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR PRINCIPAL AND INTEREST PAYMENTS ON POST-SECONDARY EDUCATION LOANS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction of up to ten thousand dollars annually for the principal and interest paid by a taxpayer on a post-secondary education loan.

title: AN ACT REESTABLISHING THE JOB EXPANSION TAX CREDIT PROGRAM.
purpose: To reestablish the job expansion tax credit program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SENIORS.
purpose: To require that, for seniors, (1) the qualifying income threshold for any personal income tax deduction be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation, and (2) the personal income tax deduction for any distribution from certain individual retirement accounts be effective for taxable years commencing on or after January 1, 2023, in lieu of the current phase-in schedule.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS AND VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE MEMBERS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any stipend paid by a municipality, a volunteer fire department of a municipality or a volunteer ambulance association of a municipality, to a volunteer firefighter or volunteer ambulance member.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR MOTOR VEHICLE PROPERTY TAXES PAID AND CONCERNING THE ASSESSMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To (1) establish a credit against the personal income tax for half the amount of motor vehicle property tax paid by an individual to a municipality, and (2) prohibit municipalities from assessing a motor vehicle at a higher value than the previous tax year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION AND ANNUITY INCOME AND DISTRIBUTIONS FROM CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To increase the availability of the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension and annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts and eliminate the cliff effect.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CREATION OF AN INTERSTATE COMPACT FOR THE TAX TREATMENT OF INVESTMENT FUND NET PROFITS ATTRIBUTABLE TO CERTAIN INVESTMENT MANAGEMENT SERVICES.
purpose: To create an interstate compact to treat certain net profits of investment funds as ordinary income rather than investment profits subject to capital gains tax.

title: AN ACT PHASING OUT THE FILM PRODUCTION TAX CREDITS.
purpose: To phase out the film production tax credits.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR EDUCATIONAL ACCESS AND OPPORTUNITY SCHOLARSHIP DONATIONS.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for donations made to nonprofit entities that provide educational access and opportunity scholarships.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHOTO IDENTIFICATION AT THE POLLS AND REPORTING OF VOTER FRAUD.
purpose: To require photo identification in order to vote, establish a program for electors to obtain such identification at no cost and require registrars of voters to report to the Secretary of the State incidents of voter fraud.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTIONS LEGISLATION.
purpose: To promote support from both political parties when making changes to election laws.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCLAIMERS ON POLITICAL ADVERTISING.
purpose: To (1) disclose when registered lobbyists are featured on political advertising, and (2) require sufficient disclaimer text-to-background contrast on political advertising so that such text can be clearly read.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN ASPECTS OF EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To implement several changes designed to promote secure, convenient and fiscally responsible early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINORS AND DIGITAL PRIVACY.
purpose: To prohibit the collection and commercial use of certain digital information concerning minors.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE LEMON LAW TO INCLUDE BOATS.
purpose: To extend the lemon law to include boat purchasers and lessees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEMPORARY LIQUOR PERMITS FOR NONPROFIT ENTITIES AND LIQUOR DONATIONS.
purpose: To modify the application process for nonprofit entities seeking temporary liquor permits for events and allow wholesalers to donate limited quantities of alcoholic beverages for such events.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRADUATED SCHEDULE OF CANNABIS LICENSE APPLICATION FEES.
purpose: To establish a graduated schedule of license application fees that increase in proportion to the number of license applications that a person submits to participate in the adult-use cannabis market.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OCCUPATIONAL LICENSES AND VETERANS.
purpose: To enable a person to satisfy the requirements necessary to receive an occupational license through military training.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF CANNABIS.
purpose: To provide for greater parity between the state's regulation of cannabis and its regulation of other regulated substances.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONLEGEND DRUG SALES IN VENDING MACHINES.
purpose: To allow certain nonlegend drugs, including, but not limited to, emergency contraception, to be dispensed or sold in vending machines.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE HOURS DURING WHICH CERTAIN LIQUOR PERMITTEES MAY SELL ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR FOR ON-PREMISES CONSUMPTION.
purpose: To extend the hours during which certain liquor permittees may sell alcoholic liquor for on-premises consumption.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STUDENT LOAN SUBSIDY PROGRAM FOR FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To establish a student loan subsidy program for first responders.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A DEBT-FREE STATE COLLEGE PROGRAM FOR EMPLOYEES OF DAY CARE FACILITIES, HOME HEALTH CARE AGENCIES AND NURSING HOMES.
purpose: To establish a debt-free college program at public institutions of higher education for employees of day care facilities, home health care agencies and nursing homes for the purpose of addressing workforce shortages and economic stability for such employees.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE ROBERTA B. WILLIS SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM TO STUDENTS ATTENDING PRIVATE CAREER SCHOOLS.
purpose: To expand the Roberta B. Willis Scholarship program to include students attending private career schools.

title: AN ACT PRIORITIZING SCHOLARSHIPS FOR STUDENTS ENROLLED IN EDUCATION OR EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To prioritize students enrolled in education and early childhood education programs to receive awards under the Roberta B. Willis Scholarship program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLINICAL PLACEMENTS FOR NURSING STUDENTS, REPORTING BY THE OFFICE OF WORKFORCE STRATEGY, PROMOTION OF THE DEVELOPMENT OF THE INSURANCE INDUSTRY AND CONNECTICUT HIGHER EDUCATION SUPPLEMENTAL LOAN AUTHORITY STUDENT LOAN SUBSIDY PROGRAMS FOR VARIOUS PROFESSIONS.
purpose: To (1) establish a working group to develop a plan to establish clinical placements at state facilities for nursing students at public institutions of higher education, (2) allow a tax credit for nursing preceptors, (3) require the development of a plan for establishing a registered apprenticeship program for teachers, (4) require the Insurance Commissioner to promote development of the insurance industry, and (5) require the establishment of Student Loan Subsidy Program for high-demand professions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE-FUNDED MEDICAL ASSISTANCE FOR ELIGIBLE PERSONS UP TO AGE TWENTY-SIX.
purpose: To provide health care as a human right to persons not otherwise insured by expanding state-funded medical assistance to income-eligible persons up to age twenty-six regardless of immigration status.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE CLAWBACK OF SAVINGS RETAINED BY NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To prevent state agencies from recouping funds retained by nonprofit, private providers of human services who otherwise meet state contractual requirements.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT RATES FOR METHADONE MAINTENANCE TREATMENT.
purpose: To provide equitable reimbursement rates for methadone maintenance treatment providers and expand access to treatment.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING ADMINISTRATIVE BURDENS FOR HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS.
purpose: To eliminate administrative burdens for nonprofit health and human services providers and ensure timely payment for such services.

title: AN ACT INDEXING STATE FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES TO INFLATION RATES.
purpose: To ensure that state funding for nonprofit providers of health and human services covers their costs, adjusted for inflation, and provides access by state residents to such services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONDOMINIUMS AND THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCEDURE.
purpose: To include affordable condominiums in the calculation of the ten per cent threshold for the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOMELESSNESS AND LOWER-INCOME HOUSING ACCESSIBILITY.
purpose: To create housing opportunities for individuals experiencing homelessness and prioritize lower-income individuals in the expansion of affordable housing programs.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE TREATMENT AND PREVENTION OF OBESITY.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for the treatment and prevention of obesity.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING DISCRIMINATION IN INSURANCE UNDERWRITING BASED ON THE BREED OF A HOMEOWNER'S DOG.
purpose: To prohibit discrimination in insurance underwriting based on the breed of a homeowner's dog.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING UNIFORM REQUIREMENTS FOR THE PRIOR AUTHORIZATION PROCESS FOR HEALTH INSURANCE POLICIES IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To establish uniform requirements for the prior authorization process for health insurance policies in this state.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH INSURANCE COMPANIES FROM REQUIRING PRIOR AUTHORIZATION AND STEP THERAPY.
purpose: To prohibit health insurance companies from (1) requiring prior authorization, and (2) requiring a prescription drug to be prescribed more than once for an insured before such insured's health care provider may prescribe a different prescription drug for such insured.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH CARE INSURERS FROM RETROACTIVELY DENYING HEALTH INSURANCE CLAIMS FOR BEHAVIORAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE SERVICES.
purpose: To prohibit health care insurers from retroactively denying health insurance claims and clawing back payments for behavioral health and substance abuse services: (1) After one year from the date of such service when prior authorization for such service was issued and the health care provider was paid for such service; and (2) when the health care insurer fails to provide written notice and an explanation of retroactive denial of the claim to the health care provider for such service within one year from the date of such service.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR DIAGNOSTIC AND SCREENING COLONOSCOPIES.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide full health insurance coverage, without any out-of-pocket expense, for (1) diagnostic and screening colonoscopies, and (2) any necessary medical procedure preparation when recommended by a health care provider within such provider's scope of practice.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ACCESS TO GENETIC SCREENING FOR CRITICALLY ILL NEWBORNS.
purpose: To provide access to genetic screening for critically ill newborns.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINIMUM AGE FOR ARREST OF A CHILD.
purpose: To raise the minimum age for arrest of a child from ten years to twelve years of age.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MODIFICATION FOR SENTENCES BASED ON OR ENHANCED DUE TO A MARIJUANA OFFENSE.
purpose: To effectuate sentence modification for any individual serving a sentence of incarceration or supervised release on a controlling marijuana offense or whose sentence was extended due to a sentence enhancement related to a marijuana offense.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VICTIMS OF CRIME.
purpose: To ensure victims of crime are appropriately compensated for loss, as well as able to fully participate in the criminal process of the offender.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADJUDICATION OF CERTAIN CRIMES WITHIN THE GEOGRAPHICAL AREA WHERE SUCH CRIMES WERE COMMITTED.
purpose: To reduce an additional burden on crime victims by requiring certain crimes to be adjudicated where the offense occurred.

title: AN ACT REPEALING RESTRICTIONS ON CANNABIS-RELATED STOPS OR SEARCHES OF A PERSON OR MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To restore the ability of a law enforcement officer to use the odor of cannabis as a basis to support an investigatory stop or search of a person or motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROFESSIONAL MALPRACTICE COMMITTED BY A GUARDIAN AD LITEM IN A FAMILY RELATIONS PROCEEDING.
purpose: To: (1) Ensure that parents, guardians and others aggrieved by the professional malpractice of a guardian ad litem appointed in a family relations matter have the ability to bring a civil malpractice action against such guardian ad litem, and (2) abolish qualified or absolute immunity as a defense that may be raised by a guardian ad litem in a professional malpractice action.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPENSATION PAID FOR JURY SERVICE.
purpose: To reduce the financial burden of serving on a jury by increasing the per diem rate of compensation for jurors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT FUND ANNUITANTS.
purpose: To allow municipal retirees to make changes to their designated annuitant after retirement payments have begun to ensure that the wishes of municipal retirees in reference to their annuitant are respected.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPLAINTS AGAINST STATE AND MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To inform other municipalities and states of accused wrongdoing of a state or municipal employee that resigned before finality of the complaint against them.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REMOVAL OF CHILDREN FROM THEIR HOMES BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To prohibit the removal of children from their homes in the absence of parental notification and a determination that abuse or neglect has occurred.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COUNCILS OF GOVERNMENTS AND GRANT FUNDING.
purpose: To treat councils of governments as municipalities for the purposes of grant funding.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN PROPERTY LOCATED ON CERTAIN NATIVE AMERICAN LANDS FROM PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To exempt real and tangible personal property located on certain Native American lands from property tax.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE PROPERTY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To eliminate the property tax on motor vehicles and require the state to reimburse municipalities for the resulting revenue loss.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF INFORMATION RELATING TO THE LICENSING OF DOGS.
purpose: To facilitate the annual licensing of dogs by requiring the provision of information concerning the law relating to dog licensing by businesses concerned with the care of dogs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESIDENTIAL AND MUNICIPAL OUTDOOR LIGHTING.
purpose: To specify that residential and municipal outdoor lighting shall be limited in terms of voltage and direction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO PUBLIC BEACHES, COASTAL RESOURCES AND ASSOCIATED FACILITIES.
purpose: To provide expanded access to beaches, coastal resources and associated facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ASSESSMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES FOR PROPERTY TAXATION.
purpose: To prohibit municipalities from assessing motor vehicles for property taxation at higher values than in the previous tax year.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PAYMENT OF MUNICIPAL TAXES AND FEES IN ADDITIONAL INSTALLMENTS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to provide taxpayers an additional option for the payment of taxes and fees, and eliminate expenses related to the mailing of billing statements.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING SMOKING IN A MOTOR VEHICLE WHEN A CHILD IS PRESENT.
purpose: To prevent children from being exposed to smoking and secondhand smoke while in a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING SMOKING IN A MOTOR VEHICLE WHILE A CHILD IS PRESENT.
purpose: To prohibit smoking in a motor vehicle while a child is present.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PROVISION OF EDUCATIONAL MATERIALS REGARDING CYTOMEGALOVIRUS.
purpose: To require the Department of Public Health to provide child care providers, certain physicians and nurse-midwives regarding cytomegalovirus and the treatments for and prevention of cytomegalovirus.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING DOCTORAL CANDIDATES IN PSYCHOLOGY TO PROVIDE SUPERVISED TELEHEALTH COUNSELING SERVICES.
purpose: To allow doctoral candidates in psychology to provide supervised telehealth counseling services to patients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BEHAVIORAL HEALTH CARE WORKFORCE.
purpose: To enhance the behavioral health care workforce in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCOPE OF PRACTICE REVIEW.
purpose: To make the submittal by the Department of Public Health of scope of practice reviews for health care professionals to scope of practice review committees voluntary rather than mandatory.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CHILDREN TWELVE YEARS OF AGE AND OLDER TO RECEIVE A VACCINATION WITHOUT THE CONSENT OF A PARENT OR GUARDIAN.
purpose: To enable children access to vaccinations without the consent of a parent or guardian.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHYSICIAN ASSISTANTS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that physicians must supervise physician assistants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSOCIATE LICENSURE FOR MARITAL AND FAMILY THERAPISTS, CLINICAL SOCIAL WORKERS AND MASTER SOCIAL WORKERS AND PROFESSIONAL COUNSELORS.
purpose: To enhance the behavioral health workforce in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADMINISTRATIVE REQUIREMENTS FOR STATE-CONTRACTED NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To remove unnecessary administrative requirements for state-contracted nonprofit providers of health and human services and to ensure timely payment for such services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE FILE NUMBERS ON MARRIAGE LICENSES.
purpose: To require that any reference to a state file number be (1) removed from all current and future versions of the state's marriage license form, and (2) accompanied by a disclaimer that such number has no legal purpose and is used for administrative purposes only.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A COST-BENEFIT ANALYSIS OF ESTABLISHING A HUSKY FOR ALL, UNIVERSAL HEALTH CARE FINANCING SYSTEM.
purpose: To require a study of the costs and benefits of transitioning from the current health care system in the state to a universal, single payer health care system.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CAUSE OF DEATH OF TERMINALLY ILL PERSONS WHO SELF-ADMINISTER A LETHAL DOSE OF MEDICATION.
purpose: To provide notice to the next of kin that a member of the family passed away due to assisted suicide.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SELF-ADMINISTRATION OF LETHAL MEDICATIONS BY TERMINALLY ILL ADULTS.
purpose: To provide aid in dying to terminally ill patients.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF EXPLODING TARGETS.
purpose: To prohibit the use of exploding targets on public and private  property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTER TRAINING GRANT AWARD PROGRAM.
purpose: To modify the volunteer firefighter training grant award program by including the cost of Firefighter II and Pump Operator certifications for grant awards and all volunteer fire departments to be eligible for grants to cover the cost of Firefighter I certifications and by changing the grant recipient to be the regional fire schools.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM REGARDING COLLECTION AND REFERRAL OF INFORMATION ON HATE CRIMES, BIAS INCIDENTS AND CRIMES WITH BIAS ELEMENTS.
purpose: To establish a pilot program to standardize and streamline the collection of data on hate crimes, bias incidents and crimes with bias incidents in order to assist law enforcement with investigation and prosecution of these crimes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING 9-1-1 DISPATCHERS AS FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To designate 9-1-1 dispatchers as first responders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ARREST POWERS OF POLICE OFFICERS RESPONDING TO REQUESTS FOR MUTUAL AID.
purpose: To enable police departments and officers keep communities safe when mutual aid is requested.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENTS TO VOLUNTEER FIRE COMPANIES FOR RESPONDING TO CALLS IN STATE PARKS.
purpose: To provide payments to volunteer fire companies for responding to calls in state parks.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GREATER HARTFORD REGIONAL LAW ENFORCEMENT TASK FORCE TO COMBAT ILLEGAL ROADWAY TRAFFIC ACTIVITY.
purpose: To establish a Greater Hartford Regional Law Enforcement Task Force to Combat Illegal Roadway Traffic Activity.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE USE OF GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEM TECHNOLOGY TO TRACK AND RESPOND TO OPIOID OVERDOSES.
purpose: To create a task force to study the use of global positioning system technology to track and respond to opioid overdoses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHOTOGRAPHIC AND VIDEOGRAPHIC SPECIAL EFFECTS.
purpose: To allow for the sale, purchase and use of photographic and videographic special effect smoke bombs in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SMOKE AND CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTOR AFFIDAVIT PROVIDED BY TRANSFERORS OF RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To simplify the smoke and carbon monoxide detector affidavit regarding residential property to encourage more sellers to sign such affidavit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY INTERVENTION BY A POLICE OFFICER WHEN A PERSON IS EXPERIENCING A NARCOTICS OVERDOSE.
purpose: To address the opioid epidemic by allowing victims an increased opportunity for medical care and intervention at a treatment facility or hospital.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS, FIRE POLICE OFFICERS AND VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE MEMBERS.
purpose: To allow a personal income tax deduction for a stipend made by a municipality, volunteer fire department or volunteer ambulance association to a volunteer firefighter, fire police officer or volunteer ambulance member.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PENSIONS FOR POLICE OFFICERS AND FIREFIGHTERS EMPLOYED BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To require all municipalities to provide police officers and firefighters with a pension that has benefits that are comparable or superior to those provided by Municipal Employees Retirement System.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ALTERNATIVE PHYSICAL ABILITY TESTING REQUIREMENTS FOR FEMALE CANDIDATES FOR FIREFIGHTER POSITIONS.
purpose: To allow for a more diverse class of candidates for firefighter positions at municipal and volunteer fire departments by recognizing that additional female candidates would qualify for such positions based on revised physical standards that offer an alternative to the fifty-pound simulated vest test component of the Candidate Physical Ability Test.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ILLUMINATION OF THE GOLD STAR MEMORIAL BRIDGE.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Transportation to illuminate the Gold Star Memorial Bridge.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NAME OF THE THAMES RIVER.
purpose: To require the Commissioners of Transportation and Energy and Environmental Protection to (1) consult with the  Eastern Pequot Tribe, the Mashantucket Pequot Tribe and the Mohegan Tribe of Indians of Connecticut with regards to restoring the name of the Thames River to a former name, and (2) apply for federal approval of such former name.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF IDENTITY CARDS TO APPLICANTS UNABLE TO ESTABLISH LEGAL PRESENCE IN THE UNITED STATES.
purpose: To authorize the issuance of identity cards to applicants unable to establish legal presence in the United States.

title: AN ACT STUDYING THE USE OF HYBRID TRAINS ON THE METRO-NORTH COMMUTER RAILROAD.
purpose: To study the feasibility of operating hybrid trains on the Danbury line of the Metro-North Commuter Railroad.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING GUIDELINES TO GOVERN VEGETATION MANAGEMENT ALONG STATE HIGHWAYS.
purpose: To establish guidelines that govern vegetation management along state highways by the Department of Transportation.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REMOVABLE WINDSHIELD PLACARD ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To establish a Removable Placard Advisory Council to advise the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles, medical professionals, law enforcement officers and the general public regarding the proper issuance and use of removable windshield placards for persons who are blind and persons with disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NEW RAIL CARS ON THE WATERBURY BRANCH OF THE METRO-NORTH COMMUTER RAILROAD.
purpose: To replace the aging rail cars on the Waterbury branch line of the Metro-North Commuter Railroad.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING AN EXEMPTION FROM LICENSING REQUIREMENTS FOR MILITARY CHILD CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To allow military child care providers to be exempted from duplicate state licensing if already certified through the military.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING THE UNITED STATES SPACE FORCE IN REFERENCES TO THE UNITED STATES ARMED FORCES.
purpose: To include the United States Space Force in the definition of "armed forces".

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR HOME CARE COSTS FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for home care costs for veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENEWAL OF MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSES BY CERTAIN VETERANS.
purpose: To allow certain veterans to renew their motor vehicle operator's license at no charge.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING SUPPORT FOR GRANDPARENTS RAISING CHILDREN.
purpose: To enhance the quality of life and reduce the effects of trauma on children by supporting grandparents who are raising them.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE TRANSPORTATION ALLOWANCE.
purpose: To replace the transportation allowance for legislators with reimbursement of actual travel costs incurred.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDS FROM THE JUUL LABS SETTLEMENT FOR SMOKING CESSATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To ensure the funds from the JUUL settlement are used for smoking cessation, prevention and mitigation programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RETIREMENT BENEFITS FOR TEACHERS WHO WORKED THROUGH THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC.
purpose: To provide a teacher pandemic pension credit for teachers who worked full-time during the COVID-19 pandemic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEMBERSHIP OF THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BOARD.

purpose: To reinstate performance-informed budget review.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HIRING OF ADDITIONAL TAX ENFORCEMENT AGENTS AT THE DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE SERVICES.
purpose: To ensure proper enforcement of tax laws and maximize state revenue.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR HAND-HELD ORANGE FLAGS TO BE USED BY PEDESTRIANS IN CROSSWALKS.
purpose: To enable pedestrians to cross dangerous intersections more safely.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO MAINTAIN TWO IWO JIMA STATUES IN THE CITY OF NEW BRITAIN.
purpose: To help maintain two Iwo Jima statues in New Britain and ensure its integrity.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING REPAYMENT OF A FEDERAL LOAN FOR THE UNEMPLOYMENT TRUST FUND.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MANAGEMENT OF THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT SYSTEM BY THE STATE COMPTROLLER.
purpose: To increase transparency and responsiveness of the teachers' retirement system on behalf of retired teachers.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH FOR GUN VIOLENCE PREVENTION.
purpose: To provide funding to the Department of Public Health to support reduction of community gun violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A GRANT TO THE SPANISH COMMUNITY OF WALLINGFORD, INC.
purpose: To continue the valuable services provided by the Spanish Community of Wallingford, Inc. to the region that were negatively impacted by a reduction in grant funding.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO PROVIDE SERVICES TO FAMILIES WITH SERVICE NEEDS.
purpose: To assist parents and municipalities to address behavior by juveniles who engage in unlawful behavior, truancy and attendance cases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES AND INFLATIONARY ADJUSTMENTS TO FUNDING.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers that face increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To prevent state agencies from recouping funds retained by nonprofit, private providers of human services.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR GUN VIOLENCE PREVENTION PROGRAMS IN CERTAIN CITIES.
purpose: To continue to fund Project Longevity gun violence prevention programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CHILDHOOD CANCER AWARENESS ACCOUNT.
purpose: Strengthen the childhood cancer awareness account with increased funding and research grants.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR FREE STUDENT MEALS.
purpose: To require all public schools make available school meals to all students free of charge.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT COMMUNITY-BASED PROVIDERS OF HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers that face increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONPROFIT COMMUNITY PROVIDERS AND INCREASING FUNDING BASED ON INFLATION.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers that face increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF EDUCATION SAVINGS ACCOUNTS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF BANKING.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study, and submit a report, concerning education savings accounts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE STATE OF CONNECTICUT BANK.
purpose: To establish the State of Connecticut Bank.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCLOSURES OF FINANCIAL RECORDS TO THE COMMISSIONER OF SOCIAL SERVICES.
purpose: To provide that financial institutions disclosing certain financial records to the Commissioner of Social Services shall disclose such records within thirty calendar days.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVIDING OF PAPER COPIES OF PERIODIC STATEMENTS BY FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS.
purpose: To provide that each financial institution shall provide a paper copy of each periodic statement for each depositor who does not have access to online banking.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE OF THE CANNABIS OMBUDSMAN WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To establish the Office of the Cannabis Ombudsman within the Department of Economic and Community Development.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO AFFORDABLE EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION.
purpose: To increase reimbursement rates, address wages, and staff recruitment and retention in early childhood education with the goal of expanding access to affordable early childhood education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FINGERPRINTING PROCESS FOR CHILD CARE PROVIDERS AND STAFF MEMBERS.
purpose: To streamline the fingerprinting process for child care providers and staff members.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO GRANT WAIVERS FOR IMPLEMENTING A READING CURRICULUM MODEL OR PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to grant waiver to local or regional boards of education from implementing a reviewed and recommended reading curriculum model or program unless the department can demonstrate that the reading curriculum model or program in use by such board does not meet the requirements set forth in section 10-14hh of general statutes.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING PARENTS TO OPT OUT OF BUS SERVICE FOR HIGH SCHOOL STUDENTS.
purpose: To allow parents to opt out of bus service for their children who are in grades nine to twelve, inclusive.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FINGERPRINT DATA OF TEACHERS.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to serve as the central repository of teacher fingerprint data and to share such data with local or regional boards of education for the purpose of reducing the number of times teachers are required to have fingerprints taken.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE FISCAL IMPACT OF A SCHOOL VOUCHER PROGRAM.
purpose: To study the state and local fiscal impact of a school voucher program for the purpose of increasing educational opportunities, especially in economically challenged school districts.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OFF-DUTY LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To allow off-duty police officers to carry firearms used in the performance of official duties on school grounds.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE STATE LIBRARIAN TO ESTABLISH A STATE-WIDE BOOK GIFTING PROGRAM FOR CHILDREN.
purpose: To require the State Librarian to establish a state-wide book gifting program for children under the age of five for the purpose of advancing new and strengthening existing local Dolly Parton's Imagination Library programs.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING ALL MINOR PARENTS TO REQUEST ADULT EDUCATION CLASSES.
purpose: To allow all parents, not just mothers, who are under the age of seventeen to request permission to attend adult education classes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY INSTRUCTION AS PART OF THE HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To require all Connecticut high school students to complete a course in financial literacy as a part of high school graduation requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY INSTRUCTION AS PART OF THE HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To require all Connecticut high school students to complete a course in financial literacy so that they will obtain broad financial literacy skills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNIVERSAL FREE AND HEALTHY SCHOOL MEALS.
purpose: To provide free and healthy school breakfasts and lunches to all students in public schools, regardless of family income.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LATER SCHOOL START TIMES AT PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
purpose: To require later school start times at public schools for the purpose of facilitating an environment and schedule conducive to learning by kids and teenagers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TUITION ASSISTANCE FOR STUDENTS ENROLLED IN A TEACHER PREPARATION PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide a tuition credit for students in a teacher preparation program and to fund annual teacher professional development opportunities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND OF THE PRESS FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To protect student expression and student publications except when such expression or publications are obscene, libelous, slanderous or disrupt school activities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECTS AT JEFFERSON ELEMENTARY SCHOOL AND NEW BRITAIN HIGH SCHOOL.
purpose: To authorize the school building projects at Jefferson Elementary School and New Britain High School in New Britain for a school building project grant.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE NEED FOR AND IMPACT OF STANDARDIZED EXAMINATIONS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the impacts of standardized examinations on students and to develop recommendations to improve implementation of such examinations and for alternate methods to measure student achievement.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING AN EXEMPTION FROM THE READING CURRICULUM MODEL OR PROGRAM REQUIREMENT FOR CERTAIN SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To exempt high performing school districts from the requirements of the state-mandated reading curriculum.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING REIMBURSEMENT OF THE COST TO TRANSPORT SPECIAL EDUCATION STUDENTS OUTSIDE OF DISTRICT.
purpose: To reimburse municipalities for the cost of transporting special education students to schools outside of district.

title: AN ACT ADDING NONVOTING TEACHER MEMBERS TO THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To add two nonvoting teacher members to the State Board of Education for the purpose of providing such perspectives to said board.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE COMMISSIONER OF EDUCATION TO ESTABLISH A TEACHER AND PARENT ADVISORY COMMITTEE.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Education to establish a Teacher and Parent Advisory Committee for the purpose of bridging the gap between development and implementation of policy.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SUNDAY HUNTING ON PRIVATE AND PUBLIC LANDS BY SHOTGUN OR RIFLE.
purpose: To expand Sunday hunting beyond private lands by bow and arrow in order to include public lands and to authorize the use of shotguns and rifles.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUBLIC SAFETY CAPACITY OF STATE PARKS.
purpose: To provide for the safety of state park visitors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF POTABLE WATER TO AREAS IMPACTED BY WELL CONTAMINATION.
purpose: To deliver potable water to areas impacted by well contamination.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONNECTICUT'S CLIMATE FUTURE.
purpose: To ensure an environmentally sustainable and economically prosperous future for Connecticut by reducing greenhouse gas emissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ZERO TOLERANCE WHILE HUNTING.
purpose: To prohibit the consumption of alcohol while hunting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF NONBIODEGRADABLE WRISTBANDS.
purpose: To eliminate nonbiodegradable litter on our streets that ends up in storm drains and waterways.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING POLLINATOR HEALTH AND REGULATING NONAGRICULTURAL PESTICIDE USE.
purpose: To ban the use of toxic pesticides that harm the environment and human health and to protect pollinators and their ecosystems.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE REDUCTION OF SINGLE-USE PLASTIC STRAWS.
purpose: To reduce plastic use and waste.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN BLACK BEAR MEASURES AND CARRYING HAND GUNS IN STATE FORESTS.
purpose: To improve public safety, protect private property and promote the welfare of a burgeoning black bear population.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE.
purpose: To right the legacy of injustice inherent in the permitting process and to enable state decisions to enhance environmental and public health protections under the state's environmental justice law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REDUCING PLASTICS AND DEVELOPING CONNECTICUT'S ECONOMY IN THE RECYCLABLE AND COMPOSTABLE PACKAGING SECTOR.
purpose: To decrease consumption of single-use plastic products, improve consumer understanding of what is recyclable or compostable and what is not and develop a robust Connecticut industry to manufacture, market and distribute viable, environmentally sound alternatives to petroleum-based plastics.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE OF DOGS, CATS AND RABBITS IN PET SHOPS.
purpose: To prohibit the sale of animals in pet shops that originate from "puppy mills" and other inhumane commercial breeding facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HELIUM AND LIGHTER-THAN-AIR BALLOONS.
purpose: To protect the environment from the release of balloons.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE.
purpose: To exempt veterans from the Passport to the Parks motor vehicle registration fee.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE TO REVISE MUNICIPAL ANIMAL SHELTER REGULATIONS.
purpose: To adhere to best practices relating to animal shelter operations by requiring municipal regulations to comport with state-mandated regulations for private shelters.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVING OF FISHING LICENSE FEES FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To waive fishing license fees for veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SURPLUS FOOD DONATION AND ESTABLISHING FOOD COMPOSTING REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To help households in need of food and reduce food waste in the municipal solid waste stream.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CARRYING OF FIREARMS IN STATE PARKS.
purpose: To allow firearms in state parks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DESMOND'S LAW.
purpose: To clarify the authority under Desmond's law and further protect animals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF THE COMMISSIONER OF AGRICULTURE TO PURCHASE CERTAIN FARMLAND AT AGRICULTURE VALUE.
purpose: To protect farmland and enable it to continue to be worked as farmland.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING PESTICIDE APPLICATION RESTRICTIONS TO COMMUNITY GREENS AND STATE PUBLIC LANDS.
purpose: To prohibit the use of pesticides on community greens and state public lands.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NEONICOTINOIDS FOR NONAGRICULTURAL USE AND THE USE OF SEEDS TREATED WITH PESTICIDES.
purpose: To minimize the use of toxic pesticides that affect the environment and human health and protect pollinators.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING SENIOR CITIZENS AND DISABLED VETERANS FROM THE "PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE" WHEN REGISTERING A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To provide financial relief to senior citizens and disabled veterans from the "Passport to the Parks fee" when registering a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL PARTICIPATION IN THE AQUIFER PROTECTION PROGRAM OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To foster stronger collaboration between the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection and municipalities in selecting aquifers that are eligible for protection.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING RECYCLING BINS NEAR REVERSE VENDING MACHINES.
purpose: To provide a recycling receptacle next to reverse vending machines for those recyclable items that are rejected.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION FROM MODIFYING A CONSENT ORDER WITHOUT THE AGREEMENT OF THE OTHER PARTIES TO SUCH AGREEMENT.
purpose: To ensure that any consent order entered into by a party and the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection, or the commissioner's designee, is not modified or revoked without the consent of the parties affected by the order.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUNDAY HUNTING WITH A RIFLE ON PRIVATE LANDS.
purpose: To allow Sunday hunting on private lands with a rifle.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING TESTING OF CERTAIN CONSUMER PRODUCTS ON DOGS.
purpose: To prohibit the use of dogs for the testing of consumer products.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF PUBLIC HEALTH FROM INCINERATION POLLUTION.
purpose: To protect public health by prohibiting new or expanded waste incineration, pyrolysis or gasification facilities in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLIMATE CHANGE MITIGATION.
purpose: To expand Connecticut's zero-carbon electricity supply goal to apply to all electricity in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE VACCINATION REQUIREMENTS FOR DOMESTIC PETS.
purpose: To create a task force to review the vaccination requirements for domestic pets.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF OLD-GROWTH AND MATURE FORESTS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To identify, plan for, and manage and protect, old-growth and mature forests, and to provide a mechanism for ongoing reporting to and informing the General Assembly on the status of old-growth forests in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENFORCEMENT OF BOATING LAWS ON CERTAIN BODIES OF WATER NEAR THE STATE BORDER.
purpose: To reduce criminal incidents on the waters lying between Connecticut and the bordering states.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE AND USE OF ANTICOAGULANT RODENTICIDES.
purpose: To protect wildlife in the food chain by prohibiting anticoagulant rodenticides.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FUNDING FOR THE CONNECTICUT INVASIVE PLANT WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To support research efforts regarding terrestrial invasive plants, in an effort to protect woodland environments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT FOOD POLICY COUNCIL.
purpose: To update the Food Policy Council's authority to include a public process and the guidance on creating local food policy councils.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF XERISCAPING AND OTHER LOW-IMPACT LANDSCAPING BY CERTAIN HOMEOWNERS.
purpose: To encourage low-impact landscaping that benefits the environment while protecting homeowners from rules or regulations that may affect the use and effectiveness of such practices.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN INDEPENDENT COMMISSION FOR THE PROVISION OF PEER-REVIEWED SCIENTIFIC INFORMATION ON HEALTH AND ENVIRONMENTAL RISKS OF INVOLUNTARY EXPOSURE TO TOXINS.
purpose: To establish an independent commission to provide scientific information on the public health and environmental risks associated with toxin exposure.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE TAX CREDIT FOR THE PURCHASE OF WILDLIFE DETERRENT COMPOSTER FOR FOOD COMPOSTING.
purpose: To reduce food waste in the waste stream by encouraging food composting with the purchase and use of composters that will not attract or encourage the unintentional feeding of wildlife.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HUMAN COMPOSTING THROUGH NATURAL ORGANIC REDUCTION.
purpose: To offer state residents an environmentally responsible alternative to burial and cremation.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PERIODIC REVIEW OF INVESTIGATIONS RELATING TO DEATHS OR SERIOUS INJURIES ON THE WATERWAYS OF THE STATE THAT MAY BE CAUSED BY ALCOHOL OR DRUG USE.
purpose: To enhance boating safety and investigations of serious accidents due to vessel operation while impaired.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HIGH-FREQUENCY COMMERCIAL SEISMIC SURVEYING IN LONG ISLAND SOUND FOR GAS AND OIL EXPLORATION.
purpose: To protect marine mammals, marine ecosystems, shoreline tourism and fishing industries.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE AND USE OF SEEDS COATED WITH NEONICOTINOIDS.
purpose: To halt the decline of pollinators, other insects, and insect-eating birds that results from the use of neonicotinoid-coated seeds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FACILITATION OF UPGRADES TO STATE WATER SYSTEMS.
purpose: To facilitate necessary upgrades to water systems throughout the state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING WATER COMPANIES TO FINE RESIDENTS FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH DROUGHT-RELATED WATER RESTRICTIONS.
purpose: To address increasing concerns regarding drought conditions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERMITS FOR THE SALE OF EXCESS WATER.
purpose: To reduce administrative burdens and ensure the continued availability of drinking water supplies in affected service areas.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING WATER QUALITY AND RESILIENCY SURCHARGES COLLECTED FROM WATER COMPANY CUSTOMERS.
purpose: To facilitate necessary upgrades to water systems throughout the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC FACILITIES LOCATED ON PRIME FARMLAND, FARMLAND OF STATE-WIDE IMPORTANCE OR CORE FOREST LANDS.
purpose: To enable the restoration of farmlands that host certain solar projects to production agricultural condition.

title: AN ACT RESTRICTING NEONICOTINOID USE AND THE USE OF SEEDS TREATED WITH PESTICIDES.
purpose: To minimize the use of toxic pesticides that affect the environment and human health and to protect pollinators.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR THE UNAUTHORIZED USE OF ALL-TERRAIN VEHICLES ON STATE LAND.
purpose: To deter the unauthorized use of all-terrain vehicles on state land.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE USE OF ORGANIC SYSTEMS FOR PESTICIDE MANAGEMENT ON STATE AND MUNICIPAL LANDS.
purpose: To protect human health as well as pollinators and birds from poisoning from certain pesticides.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STRIP MINING REGULATIONS.
purpose: To strengthen regulations concerning strip mining.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISPOSAL OF CERTAIN COMMERCIAL ORGANIC WASTES.
purpose: To address the disposal of certain commercial organic wastes.

purpose: To restore municipal rights to determine authorized uses in areas covered by municipal harbor management commissions.

title: AN ACT IMPROVING STANDARDS FOR INLAND WETLAND COMMISSION AUTHORITY MEMBERSHIP AND ENFORCEMENT.
purpose: To strengthen inland wetland and watercourse protections to better protect communities and Long Island Sound from the impacts of climate change.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REDUCTION OF SINGLE-USE PLASTICS WASTE.
purpose: To reduce the use of single-use plastics and the inefficient waste stream created by such plastics in order to protect the marine habitat and human health.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM FOR THE REDUCTION OF FOOD WASTE IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To address food waste in our schools and establish an educational opportunity for communities to address a needed environmental change in behavior.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ELIMINATION OF ALL POLYSTYRENE PRODUCTS FROM SCHOOLS.
purpose: To reduce the negative environmental impact of large-scale polystyrene product usage in public schools.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING GAS AND ELECTRIC UTILITIES FROM THE SALES TAX AND GROSS EARNINGS TAX.
purpose: To reduce electricity and heating costs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NATURAL GAS AND ELECTRIC RATE INCREASES AND A STUDY OF UTILITY SERVICE TERRITORIES.
purpose: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to issue detailed explanations concerning why a gas or electric rate increase is justified and to create a task force to study breaking up or reassigning natural gas and electric distribution territories in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STUDY OF SECURITY PROTOCOLS TO PROTECT ELECTRICITY TRANSMISSION INFRASTRUCTURE.
purpose: To study methods used to protect electricity infrastructure from acts of terrorism or attack.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANIES FROM RECOVERING LOBBYING COSTS FROM RATEPAYERS.
purpose: To prohibit electric distribution companies from recovering lobbying costs from their ratepayers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENTS FOR THE OPERATION OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY AND OFFICE OF CONSUMER COUNSEL.
purpose: To reduce policy-related costs on utility bills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRIC CUSTOMER ARREARAGES.
purpose: To reduce the costs borne by ratepayers on account of the arrearages and delinquency of other electric customers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ELECTRIC SUPPLIERS TO OBTAIN SURETY BONDS.
purpose: To protect energy consumers and ensure third-party electric suppliers operate responsibly.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING ELECTRIC SUPPLIERS TO ENTER INTO VARIABLE RATE CONTRACTS.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE STATE'S HYDROPOWER ASSETS.
purpose: To study hydropower assets in the state and their benefits.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY TO CONSIDER CERTAIN FACTORS IN ELECTRIC, GAS AND WATER RATE AMENDMENT PROCEEDINGS.
purpose: To direct the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to consider specific factors in their rate amendment proceedings for electric, gas and water companies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL FOR RATE INCREASES OF ELECTRICITY AND NATURAL GAS.
purpose: To require legislative approval of rate increases of electricity and natural gas.

title: AN ACT CREATING A GRANT PROGRAM TO FUND SITE IMPROVEMENTS PRIOR TO INSTALLING SOLAR PHOTOVOLTAIC SYSTEMS.
purpose: To eliminate cost barriers for some residents and businesses who wish to install solar photovoltaic systems due to necessary site improvements prior to installation.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR ENERGY EFFICIENCY PROGRAMS.
purpose: To supplement funding for energy efficiency programs identified in the Conservation and Load Management Plan by allocating twenty million dollars from the state budget to support such programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UTILITY REVENUE DECOUPLING FORMULAS AND LOST SALES FROM STORM-RELATED OUTAGES.
purpose: To give the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority the discretion to determine an appropriate revenue decoupling formula and to exclude utility recovery associated with lost sales from storm-related outages.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING PUBLIC SERVICE COMPANIES FROM RECOVERING LOBBYING COSTS AND CERTAIN OTHER COSTS FROM RATEPAYERS.
purpose: To prohibit public utilities from recovering lobbying costs, trade association dues and charitable donations from their ratepayers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WATER COMPANY LOANS.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO SOLAR TECHNOLOGY FOR MANUFACTURERS IN DISTRESSED MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To expand access to solar technology for manufacturers that operate in distressed municipalities.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY TO REGULATE RESIDENTIAL INTERNET SERVICE.
purpose: To require the regulation of all residential Internet service as a public utility in the state.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING A CUMULATIVE INTERNET DATA USAGE CAP.
purpose: To prevent the institution of a cumulative Internet data usage cap.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CREDITS OR REIMBURSEMENTS TO ELECTRIC CUSTOMERS FOLLOWING SERVICE OUTAGES.
purpose: To entitle customers of electric distribution companies to a credit or reimbursement for food, medicine or other perishable items due to a service outage lasting more than forty-eight hours.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING INTERNET SERVICE PROVIDERS THAT ARE STATE CONTRACTORS TO ADOPT A NET NEUTRALITY POLICY.
purpose: That the general statutes be amended to require Internet service providers that are state contractors to adopt a net neutrality policy.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING VIRTUAL NET METERING TO NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To allow nonprofits to participate in virtual net metering.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PLEDGE TO BONDHOLDERS REGARDING CERTAIN BUDGETING AND BONDING RESTRICTIONS.
purpose: To continue the restrictions pledged for bonds issued during a certain period of time.

purpose: To provide funding to the town of Groton to restore and repaint its historic boathouse on Beebe Cove at Spicer Park.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE IMPACT OF UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE PAYMENTS ON SMALL BUSINESS EMPLOYERS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the impact of unemployment insurance payments on small business employers in the state.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR AN INDOOR YOUTH SPORTS FACILITY IN MANCHESTER.
purpose: To provide funds to construct an indoor youth sports facility in Manchester.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EXCISE TAX ON AMMUNITION TO PROVIDE FUNDING FOR COMMUNITY GUN VIOLENCE AND INTERVENTION PROGRAM GRANTS.
purpose: To establish an excise tax on the purchase of ammunition by a business for sale at retail and dedicate the revenue generated from such tax to fund grants through the community gun violence intervention and prevention program, with the advice of the Commission on Community Gun Violence Intervention and Prevention.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING HEALTH CLUB AND ATHLETIC CLUB MEMBERSHIP DUES AND INITIATION FEES FROM THE DUES OR INITIATION FEES TAX.
purpose: To exempt health club and athletic club membership dues and initiation fees from the dues or initiation fees tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM PAYMENTS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction of fifty per cent of the amount of the premiums paid for long-term care insurance for a taxable year.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING A CERTAIN FEE FOR AUTOMOBILES EXEMPT FROM EMISSIONS INSPECTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the forty-dollar fee specified under subdivision (3) of subsection (k) of section 14-164c of the general statutes for automobiles that are exempt from emissions inspections.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAPITAL GAINS SURCHARGE.
purpose: To establish a surcharge of five per cent of the net gain from the sale or exchange of capital assets and on dividend and interest income on certain taxpayers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX ON DIGITAL ADVERTISING SERVICES FOR CERTAIN BUSINESSES.
purpose: To establish a ten per cent tax on the annual gross revenues derived from digital advertising services for any business with annual gross revenues exceeding ten billion dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REFUNDABLE CHILD TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To establish a refundable child tax credit against the personal income tax in the amount of five hundred dollars per child for up to three children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROPERTY TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR A PRIMARY RESIDENCE OR MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To increase the maximum allowable credit against the personal income tax for a person's primary residence or motor vehicle to six hundred dollars and make the credit refundable for a person over sixty-five years of age.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE-WIDE PROPERTY TAX ON CERTAIN COMMERCIAL AND RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To establish a state-wide property tax at the rate of 2 mills on commercial and residential real property with an assessed value of more than one million five hundred thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE RATE OF THE CORPORATION BUSINESS TAX.
purpose: To increase the rate of the corporation business tax to eleven and one-half per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CORPORATION BUSINESS TAX SURCHARGE.
purpose: To extend the imposition of the corporation business tax surcharge and increase the rate of such surcharge to twenty per cent.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE SERVICES TO HIRE ADDITIONAL IN-HOUSE AUDITORS.
purpose: To require the Department of Revenue Services to hire fifty additional in-house auditors to assist in the closing of the state's tax gap.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING ADDITIONAL PERSONAL INCOME TAX BRACKETS AND MARGINAL RATES FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH CONNECTICUT TAXABLE INCOME OF OVER ONE MILLION DOLLARS.
purpose: To establish additional personal income tax income brackets and marginal rates for individuals with Connecticut taxable income of over one million dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TAX INCIDENCE REPORT REQUIRED FROM THE COMMISSIONER OF REVENUE SERVICES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Revenue Services to provide additional information in the tax incidence report required under section 12-7c of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE SERVICES TO PROVIDE INFORMATION ABOUT THE STATE'S TAX GAP.
purpose: To require the Department of Revenue Services to provide information to the finance, revenue and bonding committee concerning the state's tax gap.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INDEXING OF INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To require that income thresholds for personal income tax be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE-WIDE PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To establish a state-wide property tax at the rate of 3 mills and reimburse state residents.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CORPORATE TAX OFFSET PROGRAM TO ASSIST HOME HEATING OIL CUSTOMERS DURING PERIODS OF ENERGY COST EMERGENCIES.
purpose: To establish a corporate tax offset program to assist home heating oil customers during periods of energy cost emergencies.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR STUDENT LOAN PAYMENTS MADE BY CERTAIN TEACHERS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for student loan payments made by individuals actively employed as teachers in a preschool, elementary or secondary education program.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT EXPENSES TAX CREDIT FOR PASS-THROUGH ENTITIES.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for research and development expenses of pass-through entities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REFORMATION OF CERTAIN TAXES AND TAX EQUITY.
purpose: To reform certain taxes to reduce taxes for middle-income taxpayers and seniors and to increase collections, investigations and reporting by certain state agencies.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR CLASSROOM SUPPLIES PURCHASED BY TEACHERS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax of up to seven hundred fifty dollars annually for classroom supplies purchased by a teacher with such teacher's personal funds.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OR RENOVATION OF A BUILDING FOR THE LEBANON DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC WORKS.
purpose: To provide funding to construct or renovate a building for the Lebanon Department of Public Works.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BUSINESS OPERATING LOSS CARRYOVER PERIOD.
purpose: To increase, from twenty years to thirty years, the period over which business operating losses may be deducted as an operating loss carry-over.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO COMPLETE THE CONSTRUCTION OF A FIELD HOUSE AND ATHLETIC COMPLEX FOR REGIONAL SCHOOL DISTRICT 13.
purpose: To provide funding for the town of Durham to complete the construction of the field house and athletic complex for Regional School District 13.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR UPGRADES TO THE EMERGENCY SERVICES RADIO SYSTEM FOR THE TOWN OF BROOKFIELD.
