purpose: To provide funding for the town of Brookfield to update its emergency services radio system.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE ESTATE AND GIFT TAXES EXEMPTION THRESHOLDS.
purpose: To reduce the estate and gift taxes exemption thresholds to three million dollars.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE TAX ON DIESEL FUEL.
purpose: To eliminate the tax on diesel fuel sold or used by a distributor in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICABLE PERCENTAGE OF THE EARNED INCOME TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To increase the applicable percentage of the earned income tax credit to forty-one and one-half per cent of the federal earned income tax credit.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR SEWER SYSTEM UPGRADES IN MANCHESTER.
purpose: To provide funding for critical sewer system upgrades in Manchester.

title: AN ACT REVISING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION AND ANNUITY INCOME AND DISTRIBUTIONS FROM CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To revise the current personal income tax deductions for social security benefits, pension and annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEDUCTION AND WITHHOLDING OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX FROM CERTAIN PAYMENTS AND DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that personal income tax be deducted and withheld from certain payments and distributions.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE STATE'S PLEDGE TO BONDHOLDERS REGARDING CERTAIN BUDGETING AND BONDING RESTRICTIONS AND SPECIFYING CONDITIONS FOR REIMPOSING SUCH PLEDGE.
purpose: To continue the restrictions pledged for bonds issued for twenty years or until the state's unfunded liabilities exceed twenty per cent of the annual budget and specify conditions for reimposing such pledge in the future.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE RATE OF THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To reduce the rate of the sales and use taxes to six per cent.

title: AN ACT REPLACING THE MUNICIPAL PROPERTY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES WITH A STATE-WIDE PROPERTY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To (1) replace the municipal property tax on motor vehicles with a state-wide property tax on motor vehicles at a fixed mill rate across the state, and (2) require the revenue generated from such tax to be distributed to municipalities based on the resulting revenue loss incurred by each municipality.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CHILD TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To establish a child tax credit against the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENTS TO YMCA CAMP SLOPER IN THE TOWN OF SOUTHINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding for capital improvements to YMCA Camp Sloper in the town of Southington.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEDUCTION AND WITHHOLDING OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX FROM CERTAIN PAYMENTS AND DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that personal income tax be deducted and withheld from certain payments and distributions.

title: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS AND CONCERNING THE CLIFF EFFECT.
purpose: To (1) increase, for married individuals filing jointly, the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts, (2) require the qualifying income thresholds for such deductions for all eligible filers to be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation, using the consumer price index, and (3) provide for income threshold phase-outs to eliminate the cliff effect.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OVERSIGHT OF CONTRACTS OF THE CONNECTICUT PORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To promote transparency and ethical standards in the execution of contracts by the Connecticut Port Authority by subjecting the authority to supervision of the State Contracting Standards Board permanently.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR OF THE STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION.
purpose: To provide that the State Elections Enforcement Commission shall appoint its executive director with the advice and consent of either house of the General Assembly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRIMARIES.
purpose: To adopt the top-two primary system used by California.

title: AN ACT REESTABLISHING THE LEGISLATIVE PROGRAM REVIEW AND INVESTIGATIONS COMMITTEE.
purpose: To reestablish the Legislative Program Review and Investigations Committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION RELATED TO ELECTIONS COMPLAINTS.
purpose: To provide to the respondent of a State Elections Enforcement Commission complaint, at all times during the process of resolving such complaint, all information known to the complainant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION INVESTIGATIONS.
purpose: To (1) require an election complaint to be resolved not later than sixty days after filing, and (2) in the case of an elections enforcement case closed due to a finding of no violation, prohibit the use of such case in any electioneering communication against the candidate who was the subject of such case.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISTRIBUTION OF COPIES OF THE REVISED STATUTES.
purpose: To replace the requirement that legislators be provided with copies of the revised statutes upon their request with a requirement that two copies of the revised statutes be provided for each caucus.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO INFORMATION ON VOTING.
purpose: To provide informational materials concerning voting at town halls and other municipal buildings.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE ACCEPTANCE OF PRIVATE FUNDS FOR ELECTION-RELATED PURPOSES.
purpose: To prohibit the acceptance and use of private funds for election administration or elector registration purposes.

title: AN ACT INSTITUTING RANKED-CHOICE VOTING FOR MUNICIPAL, STATE AND FEDERAL ELECTIONS.
purpose: To institute ranked-choice voting for municipal, state and federal elections.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING INCARCERATED INDIVIDUALS TO VOTE.
purpose: To allow incarcerated individuals to vote.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR TWO WEEKS OF EARLY VOTING PRIOR TO ELECTIONS.
purpose: To provide for two weeks of early voting prior to elections.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MANDATORY VOTING.
purpose: To make changes to election laws designed to institute mandatory voting and incentivize civic engagement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINOR PARTIES AND THE CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide for equal treatment of major and minor political parties under the Citizens' Election Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAMPAIGN FINANCE AND PARTY ENDORSEMENT AND NOMINATION SCHEDULES.
purpose: To implement several changes to campaign finance laws designed to reduce barriers for certain candidates.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING A SHELTER PET AS THE STATE PET.
purpose: To designate a shelter pet as the state pet.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONVEYANCE OF A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE TOWN OF FARMINGTON.
purpose: To convey a parcel of state land to the town of Farmington.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC FINANCING OF CAMPAIGNS FOR MUNICIPAL OFFICE.
purpose: To allow public financing from the Citizens' Election Fund for campaigns for municipal office.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN ONLINE LIST OF LARGE STATE CONTRACTORS FOR WHISTLEBLOWER PURPOSES.
purpose: To make available a list for potential whistleblowers or human rights hearing referees to consult to determine whether a private company is a large state contractor.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HOURS OF VOTING.
purpose: To move from six o'clock a.m. to eight o'clock a.m. the time the polls open on the day of an election.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY RANKED-CHOICE VOTING IN CERTAIN ELECTIONS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the implementation of ranked-choice voting in certain elections.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR TWO FULL WEEKENDS OF EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To afford electors two full weekends prior to the day of an election to participate in early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCARCERATED INDIVIDUALS AND VOTING.
purpose: To allow incarcerated individuals to become electors and to vote.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUDITS OF REGISTRY LISTS BY THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Secretary of the State to conduct, every four years, a state-wide audit of the registry list of each municipality in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DESIGNATION OF POLLING PLACES.
purpose: To require a public hearing and a vote of the legislative body prior to any move of polling places from one election to the next.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNIVERSAL CIVIC DUTY VOTING.
purpose: To require that each qualified elector cast a ballot at an election.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VOTING RIGHTS OF CERTAIN PROTECTED CLASSES.
purpose: To allow for (1) the identification and challenge of certain election practices that may impair protected class voting rights, and (2) the remedy of such impairment.

title: AN ACT CONVEYING A PARCEL OF STATE LAND TO THE CITY OF NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To convey a parcel of state land to the city of New Haven.

title: AN ACT REESTABLISHING THE LEGISLATIVE PROGRAM REVIEW AND INVESTIGATIONS COMMITTEE.
purpose: To reestablish the Legislative Program Review and Investigations Committee.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR TEN DAYS OF EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To provide for ten days of early voting and the hours of voting during such ten days.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING TIMES FOR EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To establish times for the conduct of early voting at elections.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REPAIR OF ELECTRONIC DEVICES.
purpose: To require electronic device manufacturers to make available the documentation, parts and tools needed to maintain, modify and repair such devices.

title: AN ACT ENSURING THAT A CERTAIN PERCENTAGE OF THE MONEYS IN THE PREVENTION AND RECOVERY SERVICES FUND BE ALLOCATED TO THE REGIONAL BEHAVIORAL HEALTH ACTION ORGANIZATIONS FOR THE PROVISION OF PREVENTION AND RECOVERY SERVICES.
purpose: To require a certain percentage of the moneys in the "Prevention and Recovery Services Fund" to be allocated to the regional behavioral health action organizations for the provision of prevention and recovery services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE'S REGULATED CANNABIS MARKETS.
purpose: To ensure safety and equity in the cannabis industry.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH WARNING LABELS FOR CONSUMER PRODUCTS CONTAINING TETRAHYDROCANNABINOL.
purpose: To provide that a rotating, graphic health warning label shall be prominently displayed in each advertisement for, and on all packaging containing, a consumer product that includes tetrahydrocannabinol.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRESCRIPTION DRUG COSTS.
purpose: To provide that no prescription drug manufacturer may sell a prescription drug in this state at a price that exceeds such drug's reference price.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF CANNABIS CAFES AND RESTAURANTS OFFERING CANNABIS-INFUSED FOOD ITEMS.
purpose: To permit the establishment of cannabis cafes and restaurants offering cannabis-infused food items.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS' SOCIAL CLUBS FROM LIQUOR PERMIT FEES.
purpose: To exempt veterans' social clubs from liquor permit fees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LOTTERY PROCESS FOR THE ADULT-USE CANNABIS MARKET.
purpose: To provide that no individual or business entity may file more than one application as part of the lottery process for the adult-use cannabis market.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILDREN AND CANNABIS ADVERTISEMENTS, MARKETING AND PACKAGING.
purpose: To provide that no person shall advertise, market or package any cannabis product in a manner that is directed toward children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOLDS ON CREDIT AND DEBIT CARDS FOR GASOLINE PURCHASES.
purpose: To provide that no gas station or convenience store that accepts credit or debit cards for the retail sale of gasoline shall place, or allow a third party to place, a hold on any credit or debit card account in an amount larger than the actual purchase amount for the gasoline purchased.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SOURCE OF CONCRETE AGGREGATES FOR RESIDENTIAL FOUNDATIONS.
purpose: To require concrete suppliers that pour residential foundations to exclusively use concrete aggregates from quarries.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING QUALITY STANDARDS FOR CONCRETE USED IN RESIDENTIAL APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To require that the quality of concrete used in residential applications meets or exceeds current industry standards for concrete used in commercial applications.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHARMACY CLOSURE ACTION PLANS.
purpose: To require a retail pharmacy that closes for longer than forty-eight hours to file an action plan for filling existing orders for prescription drugs and accepting new orders for such drugs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUPERMARKETS AND EXCESS EDIBLE FOOD.
purpose: To require supermarkets to make a good faith effort to make excess edible food available to food relief organizations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE FOR RETIRED PART-TIME FACULTY OF THE STATE SYSTEM OF PUBLIC HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To provide health insurance for retired adjunct faculty of the state system of public higher education who taught not less than two hundred twenty credit hours in aggregate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STUDENT REPRESENTATION ON THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To restore student representation on the Board of Regents for Higher Education and to increase student involvement in developing policies.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STUDENT LOAN REIMBURSEMENT PROGRAM FOR STATE RESIDENTS.
purpose: To establish a student loan reimbursement program for state residents who graduated from a state university, college, private career school or technical institution.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEBT-FREE COMMUNITY COLLEGE PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the debt-free community college program for students who were previously enrolled in a regional community-technical college and need to complete credits for graduation.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A VIRTUAL FINANCIAL LITERACY SEMINAR FOR STUDENT LOANS.
purpose: To require the development of a virtual student loan financial literacy seminar and to require students to complete such seminar before accepting a student loan.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING IN-STATE TUITION AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FOR REFUGEES AND ASYLUM SEEKERS.
purpose: To allow refugees, asylum seekers and recipients of other kinds of humanitarian visas to qualify for in-state tuition at public institutions of higher education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT AUTOMATIC ADMISSIONS PROGRAM.
purpose: To allow students with a class rank percentile in the top fifty per cent of such student's graduating class to apply to public institutions of higher education through the Connecticut Automatic Admissions Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A SCHOOL OF VETERINARY MEDICINE.
purpose: To require the Board of Regents for Higher Education to establish a school of veterinary medicine.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRAINING OF SOLAR INSTALLATION WORKERS.
purpose: To expand and improve the solar installation workforce.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT COMMUNITY PROVIDERS.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers of health and human services that face increased costs due to inflation and increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT INDEXING STATE RATES OF PAYMENT FOR HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES TO INFLATION.
purpose: To ensure adequate state funding for health and human services.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CLAWBACK OF CERTAIN FUNDS RETAINED BY NONPROFIT PRIVATE PROVIDERS OF HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To prevent state agencies from recouping funds retained by nonprofit, private providers of human services who otherwise meet contractual requirements.

title: AN ACT INCREASING ACCESS TO METHADONE MAINTENANCE TREATMENT BY INCREASING MEDICAID RATES FOR PROVIDERS.
purpose: To increase access to methadone maintenance treatment by increasing Medicaid reimbursement rates and establishing a minimum rate of one hundred dollars per week, per client.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING ADMINISTRATIVE BURDENS AND ENSURING TIMELY PAYMENTS FOR NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS.
purpose: To eliminate administrative burdens for nonprofit health and human services providers and ensure timely payment for services by improving the state contracting system.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADEQUATE AND EQUITABLE STATE FUNDING FOR NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To make nonprofit human services providers whole, allow for predictability in their budgeting, recognize the services they provide and payment losses suffered during the pandemic, and ensure their future viability to serve state residents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID PAYMENT PARITY FOR HOSPITALS PROVIDING LONG-TERM, ACUTE CARE.
purpose: To address the Medicaid payment disparity between hospitals providing long-term, acute care and reduce the risk of such hospitals receiving lower Medicaid reimbursement than others and reducing services or closing.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING INCOME AND ASSET LIMITS FOR THE MED-CONNECT PROGRAM FOR WORKING PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES AND INCREASING ASSET LIMITS FOR HUSKY C.
purpose: To strengthen the safety net for persons with disabilities and elderly persons.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING COMPENSATION FOR SPOUSES WHO PROVIDE CARE FOR PARTICIPANTS IN STATE-FUNDED HOME CARE.
purpose: To allow spouses to receive compensation for home health care of spouses enrolled in state-funded home care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CONSUMER'S RIGHT TO REPAIR POWERED WHEELCHAIRS.
purpose: To enable owners of powered wheelchairs to conduct necessary maintenance and prompt repairs of such wheelchairs, averting unnecessary delays, excessive expenses and negative impacts on their quality of life.

title: AN ACT INCREASING INCOME AND ASSET LIMITS FOR MEDICAID WAIVER PROGRAMS.
purpose: To ensure all Connecticut residents have equal access to critical medical and long-term care benefits under Medicaid waiver programs while retaining enough to help cover home repairs, car repairs, rent increases and other emergencies.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT RATES FOR DENTAL CARE.
purpose: To ensure an adequate pool of providers to serve dental care needs of Medicaid recipients by providing adequate compensation for such care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROMPT PAYMENT OF HOME HEATING OIL VENDORS IN THE LOW-INCOME HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To pay home heating oil vendors participating in the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program in a more timely and efficient manner.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING NUTRITIONAL HEALTH OF SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE BENEFICIARIES BY AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF MULTIVITAMINS ON ELECTRONIC BENEFIT TRANSFER CARDS.
purpose: To improve nutrient deficiencies and minimize susceptibility to impaired immune functioning, illnesses and chronic diseases by providing authorization and state funding, if necessary, for purchases of multivitamins by supplemental nutrition assistance beneficiaries using electronic benefit transfer cards.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LICENSURE OF AND HUSKY HEALTH PROGRAM COVERAGE FOR INTERNATIONAL BOARD CERTIFIED LACTATION CONSULTANTS.
purpose: To expand access to the services of International Board Certified Lactation Consultants by authorizing their licensure and providing coverage for their services under the HUSKY Health program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FAIR COMPENSATION FOR VENDORS PARTICIPATING IN THE LOW-INCOME HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To ensure adequate access by low-income persons to home heating energy assistance by ensuring home heating oil vendors are paid a fair price for their services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SAFE DISPOSAL OF OPIOID PRESCRIPTIONS BY MEDICAID BENEFICIARIES.
purpose: To ensure safe disposal of unused opioid prescriptions by Medicaid beneficiaries.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING CONNECTICUT FATHERHOOD INITIATIVE PROGRAMS.
purpose: To dedicate more funding and resources to the Connecticut Fatherhood Initiative and establish new certified CFI programs in underserved communities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMUNICATION ACCESS FOR DEAF, HARD OF HEARING AND DEAFBLIND PERSONS IN HEALTH CARE SETTINGS.
purpose: To improve communication access for the deaf and hearing impaired in health care settings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPENSATION OF FAMILY CAREGIVERS IN MEDICAID WAIVER PROGRAMS ADMINISTERED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES.
purpose: To allow more family members of enrollees in Medicaid waiver programs administered by the Department of Developmental Services to be hired and compensated for care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DRUG TESTING OF PERSONS RECEIVING STATE-ADMINISTERED CASH ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To require periodic drug testing for certain cash assistance benefits.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ABLE-BODIED ADULT PUBLIC ASSISTANCE BENEFICIARIES TO WORK OR VOLUNTEER.
purpose: To require able-bodied, adult public assistance beneficiaries to work or volunteer to receive benefits unless they are exempt under federal law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CONNECTICUT BASIC INCOME PILOT PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a pilot basic income program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO LONG-TERM SUPPORTS AND RESOURCES FOR AGING IN PLACE.
purpose: To strengthen long-term care services and supports and to ensure under served elderly persons receive services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR THE TOP FIVE SERVICES DELIVERED BY SCHOOL-BASED HEALTH CENTERS.
purpose: To allow for the top five services of school-based health centers to be billable to Medicaid.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID COVERAGE OF AUTHORIZED COMMUNITY VIOLENCE PREVENTION SERVICES.
purpose: To expand authorized community violence prevention services by providing Medicaid funding for qualified beneficiaries.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CERTIFIED RESPITE PROGRAM FOR PARENTS OF CHILDREN WITH CRITICAL ILLNESSES.
purpose: To establish a respite program for parents of children with critical illnesses.

title: AN ACT SYNCHRONIZING STATE BENEFIT ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES TO FEDERAL BENEFIT ELIGIBILITY CRITERIA FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To reduce confusion and remove a barrier to employment for persons with disabilities who receive benefits.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE CLAWBACK OF SAVINGS RETAINED BY NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS.
purpose: To prohibit the state from recovering savings retained by nonprofit, private providers of health and human services at the end of a fiscal year when such providers otherwise meet state contractual requirements.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING INCENTIVES FOR GROCERY STORE CONSTRUCTION IN "FOOD DESERTS".
purpose: To expand access to affordable and nutritious food in "food desert" communities.

title: AN ACT REMOVING RESTRICTIONS ON FUNDING FOR SUPPORT OF SEXUAL ASSAULT VICTIMS.
purpose: To provide adequate funding to support sexual assault victims and survivors.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID PAYMENT RATES FOR METHADONE MAINTENANCE TREATMENT.
purpose: To increase and equalize Medicaid reimbursement rates for methadone maintenance treatment and provide increased access to methadone treatment and related services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKERS.
purpose: To provide Medicaid reimbursement for the services of community health workers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF CRIMINAL PENALTIES FOR ABUSE, ABANDONMENT AND FINANCIAL EXPLOITATION OF ELDERLY PERSONS, PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES OR CONSERVED PERSONS.
purpose: To study criminal penalties for abuse, abandonment and financial exploitation of elderly persons, persons with disabilities or conserved persons.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM TO EXPAND ACCESS TO HEARING TESTS AND HEARING AIDS FOR SENIOR CITIZENS.
purpose: To increase the quality of life and mitigate the risks of developing dementia for certain eligible senior citizens with hearing difficulties by increasing access to hearing screening tests and hearing aids.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NOTICE OF A PROPOSED INVOLUNTARY TRANSFER OR DISCHARGE OF A NURSING FACILITY RESIDENT, FAMILY COUNCILS IN MANAGED RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITIES, COORDINATION OF DEMENTIA SERVICES, NURSING HOME TRANSPARENCY AND HOMEMAKER-COMPANION AGENCIES.
purpose: To study the needs of senior citizens in the state in order to ensure the allocation of adequate resources.

title: AN ACT ADJUSTING INCOME ELIGIBILITY CAPS FOR SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE TO OFFSET INCREASES IN SOCIAL SECURITY PAYMENTS.
purpose: To offset the effects of increased Social Security payments on eligibility for supplemental nutrition assistance.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MUNICIPAL RIGHT OF FIRST REFUSAL FOR AFFORDABLE PROPERTY DEVELOPMENTS.
purpose: To grant a right of first refusal to municipalities for set-aside developments and to require that any municipalities exercising such right complete such developments within eight years.

title: AN ACT REDUCING MUNICIPAL CONVEYANCE TAX REMITTANCES FOR AFFORDABLE HOUSING.
purpose: To reduce the municipal conveyance tax remittance to the state by ten per cent for any affordable housing developed by the municipality.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEAL MORATORIUMS.
purpose: To expand the number of units qualifying for the calculation of an affordable housing appeals moratorium.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING FOR PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To ensure the statutes regarding housing are consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and the Fair Housing Act to provide more housing opportunities in the community for people with disabilities.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS THRESHOLD.
purpose: To increase the affordable housing appeals threshold.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATUTES REGARDING HOUSING.
purpose: To ensure the statutes regarding housing are consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and the Fair Housing Act to provide more housing opportunities in the community for people with disabilities.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOMES AND AFFORDABLE HOUSING DEVELOPMENTS UNDER CONSTRUCTION IN THE CALCULATION OF THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS THRESHOLD.
purpose: To include mobile manufactured homes and affordable housing developments currently under construction in the calculation of the affordable housing appeals threshold.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REAL PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENTS FOR CERTAIN FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYERS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to abate up to five hundred dollars of property taxes per assessment year for certain first-time home buyers obtaining a loan from the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.

title: AN ACT LOWERING THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS THRESHOLD IN MUNICIPALITIES THAT PROVIDE AFFORDABLE HOUSING FUNDING.
purpose: To enable towns that financially encourage affordable housing to meet affordable housing goals established by section 8-30g of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT REVISING STATUTES CONCERNING HOUSING FOR PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To ensure the statutes regarding housing are consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and the Fair Housing Act to provide more housing opportunities in the community for people with disabilities.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PLACARDS AT REAL PROPERTIES AFFECTED BY AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To require developers who submit affordable housing applications to erect placards with certain required information at the proposed site of development.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS IN HIGHLY DEVELOPED MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To reduce the affordable housing appeals threshold in small, highly developed municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING JUSTICE.
purpose: To establish a winter eviction moratorium, increase funding for the rental assistance fund, increase tenants' rights and promote the construction of new affordable housing.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY MANDATORY PUBLIC COMMENT PERIODS AT PUBLIC AGENCY MEETINGS.
purpose: To require public comment periods at all public agency meetings.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TASK FORCE REGARDING AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS MORATORIUMS.
purpose: To create a task force to recommend simplifications of the affordable housing appeals moratorium calculation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM RATE INCREASES.
purpose: To require insurers that file rate increases of twenty per cent or more for long-term care insurance policies to spread such increases over not less than five years.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY CONCERNING THE PLACEMENT OF LIMITS ON LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM RATE INCREASES.
purpose: To require the Insurance Department to conduct a study concerning the regulation of long-term care insurance premium rate increases.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CREDIT UNIONS, BANKS AND REALTOR ASSOCIATIONS OR ORGANIZATIONS TO ESTABLISH OR PARTICIPATE IN ASSOCIATION HEALTH PLANS.
purpose: To authorize (1) credit unions and banks chartered in this state, and (2) any professional association or organization of realtors to establish or participate in association health plans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OWNERSHIP AND PROPERTY ASSESSMENTS IN COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To: (1) Limit the percentage of housing units, including condominiums and other common interest ownership communities, that a realtor can purchase in a community; and (2) require that property assessments in common interest ownership communities be conducted by an independent assessor.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE POLICIES FROM DISCRIMINATING BASED ON THE USE OF ALUMINUM ELECTRICAL WIRING IN COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To prohibit homeowners insurance policies from discriminating when setting rates or offering a policy providing coverage for a condominium, cooperative association or other common interest ownership community, based on the use of aluminum electrical wiring, until 2032.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE POLICIES TO PROVIDE COVERAGE FOR STOLEN CATALYTIC CONVERTERS.
purpose: To provide that each automobile insurance policy that is issued, renewed, amended or endorsed in this state shall provide coverage for the full retail reimbursement of a stolen catalytic converter, excluding the cost of the policyholder's deductible.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER PROTECTION FOR LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE.
purpose: To provide consumer protections for policyholders of long-term care insurance.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE PERIL OF COLLAPSE FOR PROPERTIES AFFECTED BY CRUMBLING FOUNDATIONS.
purpose: To require homeowners insurance policies in this state to provide coverage for the peril of collapse for properties affected by crumbling foundations.

title: AN ACT ADDING PYRITE TO THE CRUMBLING FOUNDATIONS REMEDIATION SCHEME AND CONCERNING DISCLOSURES TO POTENTIAL HOMEBUYERS.
purpose: To: (1) Include pyrite in the state's crumbling foundations remediation scheme; and (2) require the inclusion of a disclosure on realty documents that informs a potential homebuyer that if such homebuyer waives the home inspection, the Connecticut Foundation Solutions Indemnity Company, Inc., will not allow you to receive financial aid.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRIOR AUTHORIZATION FOR HEALTH CARE PROVIDER SERVICES IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To require the Insurance Department to conduct a study concerning prior authorization issues in this state.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR FERTILITY TREATMENT.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to expand coverage for fertility treatment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPIOIDS AND INSURANCE.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide health insurance coverage, without prior authorization or a prescription, and regardless of whether naloxone is available over the counter, for not less than one generic opioid antagonist and device.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOMEOWNER ASSOCIATIONS AND DISCLOSURE.
purpose: To require the unit resale requirements set forth in section 47-270 of the general statutes apply to individual homes in a homeowner association.

title: AN ACT REMOVING THE SUNSET DATE FOR HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR TELEHEALTH SERVICES.
purpose: To remove the sunset date of June 30, 2023, for the health insurance coverage mandate for telehealth services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING CONTRACTED RATES FOR LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To establish contracted rates for long-term care insurance policies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL LOSS RATIOS FOR PATIENT DENTAL CARE.
purpose: To establish the same medical loss ratio standard for dental insurers that currently applies to medical insurers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR TRAINED SERVICE DOGS.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for trained service dogs for critical illness based on medical prescription.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR SCREENING AND DIAGNOSTIC COLONOSCOPIES.
purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide coverage for screening and diagnostic colonoscopies.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR OPTIONAL ANESTHESIA FOR REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH MEDICAL PROCEDURES.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide health insurance coverage for patients or health care providers requesting optional anesthesia for vaginal, cervical and uterine medical procedures, including, but not limited to, loop electrosurgical excision procedure, colposcopy, ablation and intrauterine device insertion.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR OPERATING A MOTOR VEHICLE WITHOUT INSURANCE.
purpose: To increase the penalty for operating a motor vehicle without insurance.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR DIABETIC NEEDS.
purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide coverage for diabetic needs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR EPINEPHRINE CARTRIDGE INJECTORS, HEALTH CARRIERS AND PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS.
purpose: To place a cap on the cost for epinephrine cartridge injectors.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING ASSOCIATION HEALTH PLANS FOR GROUP AND SOLO PRACTICES AND EXEMPTING PRACTICES COVERED UNDER SUCH PLANS FROM CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF THE INSURANCE STATUTES.
purpose: To: (1) Require the Insurance Commissioner to adopt regulations to enable two or more group and solo practices to form a bona fide group or association of employers for the purpose of offering and providing health coverage to such group and solo practices and their employees; and (2) exempt such group and solo practices from certain provisions of the insurance statutes governing health insurance provided to small employers and their employees.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING ROOM AND BOARD PAYMENTS TO IN-PATIENT SUBSTANCE ABUSE HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To include room and board payments to in-patient substance abuse health care providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH CARE TRANSPARENCY AND ACCESSIBILITY.
purpose: To provide for informed medical decision-making and to ensure that health care facilities provide transparent and accessible care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGISTRATION PERIOD FOR CERTAIN OFFENDERS ON THE SEXUAL OFFENDER REGISTER.
purpose: To allow certain offense-free, lifelong registrants to deregister after twenty-five years.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REQUIREMENTS FOR PROFESSIONAL BAIL BONDSMEN AND SURETY BAIL BOND AGENTS.
purpose: To (1) reform the professional bail bond and surety bond system by requiring bondmen and agents establish and maintain trustee accounts and penalize failure to do so, and require the licensure authorities to audit such accounts at least annually, and (2) prohibit pretrial release based on a promise to appear in the case of a defendant charged with certain crimes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE GPS MONITORING PROGRAM FOR HIGH-RISK DOMESTIC VIOLENCE OFFENDERS.
purpose: To protect the most vulnerable victims of domestic violence from their prior offenders by expanding the successful alert notification monitoring pilot program.

title: AN ACT REINSTATING THE DEATH PENALTY.
purpose: To reinstate the death penalty.

title: AN ACT AN ACT CONCERNING THE RIGHT OF A FORMER OWNER OF REAL PROPERTY TO REPURCHASE THE REAL PROPERTY WHEN THE PROPERTY WAS TAKEN THROUGH EMINENT DOMAIN.
purpose: To give a former owner of real property taken by eminent domain the opportunity to buy back the real property when the property is subsequently not used by the state or political subdivision for the purpose for which it was taken.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN UNIT OWNERS' ASSOCIATIONS FROM CERTAIN BUSINESS FILING FEES ASSESSED BY THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To exempt unit owners' association of a common interest ownership community consisting of fewer than fifty units from certain business filing fees assessed by the Secretary of the State.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSISTANCE PROVIDED TO INDIVIDUALS WHOSE SENTENCES ARE COMMUTED BY THE BOARD OF PARDONS AND PAROLES.
purpose: To assist incarcerated individuals who are transitioning back into the community.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A RIGHT OF PUBLICITY.
purpose: To protect from infringement by others an individual's right in the use of his or her name, voice, distinctive mannerisms and gestures, signature, photograph or likeness.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FILING OF A PETITION TO PERMIT GRANDPARENT VISITATION WITH A GRANDCHILD.
purpose: To allow a grandparent the right of visitation with his or her grandchild upon demonstrating to the court that clear and convincing evidence support the granting of such visitation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TIME PERIOD FOR THE DISTRIBUTION OF PROPERTY IN A DECEDENT'S ESTATE.
purpose: To reduce the time it takes for property to transfer to a beneficiary upon the death of the decedent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A PILOT PROGRAM FOR THE MEDIATION OF CONDOMINIUM-RELATED DISPUTES.
purpose: To establish a program within the Probate Court system for the mediation of disputes that arise between condominium unit owners and associations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COURT AUTHORITY TO ENTER AN ORDER OF SUPPORT FOR AN ADULT CHILD WHO IS TWENTY-ONE OR OLDER AND HAS AN INTELLECTUAL, MENTAL OR PHYSICAL DISABILITY.
purpose: To allow a judge to order support for an individual beyond the age of twenty-one who has disabilities and resides with and is principally dependent on a parent.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE PROBATE COURT FILING FEE FOR AN APPLICATION FOR CHANGE OF NAME.
purpose: To eliminate the Probate Court fee for filing an application for change of name and to protect the privacy of those who do not want such personal information published.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OWNERSHIP OF ANCIENT PRIVATE ROADS.
purpose: To establish a mechanism for determining property ownership of an ancient private road.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FORFEITURE OF A JUDICIAL RETIREMENT SALARY.
purpose: To allow for the forfeiture of the vested right to a retirement salary in the event an individual takes an extended period of unauthorized absence from duty that results in the individual being subject to an administrative disciplinary hearing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HUMAN RIGHTS REFEREES EMPLOYED BY THE COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS AND OPPORTUNITIES.
purpose: To revise the employment qualifications and duties of human rights referees employed by the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MAXIMUM AMOUNT OF DAMAGES THAT MAY BE CLAIMED IN A SMALL CLAIMS ACTION.
purpose: To increase the maximum amount of money damages that may be claimed in a small claims action to ten thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINIMUM AGE TO BE ELIGIBLE TO MARRY.
purpose: To require that a person be not less than eighteen years of age to be eligible to marry.

title: AN ACT PRECLUDING A PERSON CONVICTED OF A CRIME INVOLVING DOMESTIC VIOLENCE FROM SEEKING ALIMONY FROM A SPOUSE WHO WAS THE VICTIM OF SUCH VIOLENCE.
purpose: To preclude a person convicted of a crime involving domestic violence from collecting alimony from the spouse who was abused by such person.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CRIME OF HARMFUL COMMUNICATION WITH A MINOR.
purpose: To establish the crime of harmful communication with a minor.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROBATE FEES AND LIENS.
purpose: To reduce inequity in probate matters through a reform of the probate fee structure.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPEDITIOUS SCHEDULING OF HEARINGS INVOLVING PENDENTE LITE ALIMONY AND SUPPORT.
purpose: To ensure timely receipt of temporary financial support during dissolution and custody proceedings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CIVIL PROTECTION ORDERS.
purpose: To enhance the protections provided through civil protection orders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IMPROVEMENT OF THE CHILD SUPPORT ENFORCEMENT SYSTEM IN THE STATE.
purpose: To improve the child support enforcement system in the state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING GUARDIANSHIP TEAMS FOR PROBATE DECISION-MAKING ON BEHALF OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To allow a person with disabilities to utilize a team guardianship model for probate decision-making, as is allowed in Massachusetts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADMISSION OF EVIDENCE RELATING TO SEAT BELT USE IN CIVIL MATTERS.
purpose: To allow evidence of whether a person was wearing a seat belt to be admissible at the time of trial.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE JURISDICTIONAL DAMAGE LIMIT IN SMALL CLAIMS MATTERS.
purpose: To increase the jurisdictional damage limit in small claims matters in order to enhance court access for all who are seeking small claims.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A COURT ORDERED STAY OF EXECUTION IN A SUMMARY PROCESS ACTION.
purpose: To require that a tenant make use and occupancy rent payments to the court during the pendency of any stay of execution of judgment in a summary process action.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ANIMAL CRUELTY.
purpose: To revise statutes relating to animal cruelty.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RECIPROCAL TUITION ASSISTANCE FOR CHILDREN ADOPTED OUT OF FOSTER CARE IN NEIGHBORING STATES.
purpose: To provide opportunities for children adopted out of foster care to receive tuition assistance.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCLOSURE OF CERTAIN RECORDS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Children and Families to disclose unredacted records to any employee of the Judicial Branch for legitimate purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NUMBER OF WAGE AND HOUR INSPECTORS AT THE LABOR DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To increase the number of wage and hour inspectors at the Labor Department in order to monitor the increasing number of wage theft complaints in the state.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING LEGISLATOR CONTRIBUTIONS TO THE FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE INSURANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that legislators contribute to the Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program since they are not eligible to avail themselves of the program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF STATE MARSHALS' HEALTH BENEFITS.
purpose: To require the State Marshal Commission to study state marshals' health benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION COVERAGE FOR FIREFIGHTERS' CANCER.
purpose: To provide workers' compensation for firefighters diagnosed with cancer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY REGARDING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A FLEXIBLE SPENDING ACCOUNT PROGRAM FOR CHILD CARE EXPENSES.
purpose: To require the Comptroller to conduct a study regarding the establishment of a state-administered flexible spending account program for residents of the state for expenses incurred for child care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYMENT OF INDIVIDUALS IN AGRICULTURAL LABOR.
purpose: To amend the definition of employment for individuals working in agricultural labor.

title: AN ACT GRANTING MUNICIPAL AUTHORITY TO PROHIBIT THE OBSTRUCTION OF SCENIC VIEWS.
purpose: To allow municipalities to prohibit the construction of fences or the planting of trees, shrubs or other vegetation that would interfere with a property owner's ability to maintain an unobstructed view of a body of water or shoreline.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCOME AND EXPENSE INFORMATION AND INCOME-PRODUCING REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To ensure accurate grand list information and establish uniform penalties for taxpayers who fail to submit accurate information on or timely file an income and expense form.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IDLING OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To authorize municipal enforcement of a state agency regulation prohibiting the idling of a motor vehicle for more than three minutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADDITIONAL PROPERTY TAX AND RENTAL CREDITS AND RELIEF PROGRAMS FOR SENIORS.
purpose: To establish additional property tax and rental credits and relief programs for seniors, such as a homestead exemption or a refundable property tax credit.

title: AN ACT PHASING OUT THE PROPERTY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES AND REIMBURSING MUNICIPALITIES FOR LOST REVENUE.
purpose: To phase out the property tax on motor vehicles and reimburse municipalities for the resulting revenue loss.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL VALUATION OF MOTOR VEHICLES FOR PROPERTY TAXATION.
purpose: To repeal the changes made to various motor vehicle property tax assessment statutes by sections 497 to 509, inclusive, of public act 22-118.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF MUNICIPAL SPENDING OF COVID-19 RELIEF FUNDS.
purpose: To require a study how municipalities utilized federal COVID-19 relief funds.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE PROCESS BY WHICH CERTAIN HOMES ARE ASSESSED FOR PROPERTY TAXATION PURPOSES.
purpose: To require a study of and recommendations concerning the process by which single-family homes and multi-family homes are assessed for the purpose of property taxation.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPALITIES TO IMPOSE A TAX ON THE ENDOWMENT FUNDS OF PRIVATE INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to impose a tax on the endowment funds of a private institution of higher education located in the municipality.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE UTILIZATION OF THE OPIOID SETTLEMENT FUND.
purpose: To permit municipalities to develop local and regional strategies for utilizing moneys distributed into the Opioid Settlement Fund.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPALITIES TO IMPOSE FEES FOR CERTAIN COSTS ON OWNERS OF TAX-EXEMPT REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to impose a fee on owners of real property exempt from property tax for the use of municipal services such as police, fire and emergency medical services and the costs of road maintenance.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR VETERANS' PRIMARY RESIDENCES.
purpose: To provide a property tax abatement to veterans of up to three thousand dollars of the amount due on a veteran's primary residence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR VETERAN'S MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To provide a property tax abatement to veterans of up to one thousand five hundred dollars of the amount due on a veteran's motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR M-DAY SERVICE MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL GUARD.
purpose: To establish a property tax exemption of one hundred thousand dollars of the assessed value of a primary residence in the state for any M-Day service member of the National Guard and reimburse municipalities for the resulting revenue loss from the General Fund.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A TWO-THIRDS VOTE OF THE GENERAL ASSEMBLY TO CREATE OR EXPAND UNFUNDED MANDATES TO MUNICIPALITIES AND SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To require a two-thirds vote of each chamber of the General Assembly to enact legislation to create or expand an unfunded mandate to a municipality or school district.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSTRUCTION OF SIDEWALKS AND PEDESTRIAN CROSSWALKS IN NEW DEVELOPMENTS.
purpose: To permit municipalities to waive requirements concerning the construction of certain sidewalks and pedestrian crosswalks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL CHARTER REVISION.
purpose: To clarify when revisions to municipal charters may go into effect after approval.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE ASSESSMENT OF INTEREST AND PENALTIES ON CERTAIN PROPERTY TAX BILLS.
purpose: To prohibit municipalities from assessing interest and penalties on delinquent property tax bills when such delinquency is due to a billing error.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM AND REEMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To prohibit certain retired members of the municipal employees' retirement system from collecting a retirement allowance upon reemployment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ZONING REGULATIONS ADOPTED TO PROMOTE ENERGY EFFICIENCY AND RENEWABLE ENERGY.
purpose: To allow local energy efficiency and renewable energy zoning regulations to override or supplement the State Building Code.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELIGIBILITY TO VOTE AT CERTAIN MUNICIPAL MEETINGS.
purpose: To permit voting at certain meetings by noncitizen residents who are otherwise eligible to vote at such meetings.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE PROPERTY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To eliminate the property tax on motor vehicles.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY WAYS TO PROTECT CERTAIN OWNERS OF PERSONAL PROPERTY AND AUTOMOBILES.
purpose: To establish a task force to study ways to protect owners of personal property and automobiles from harassment by certain corporations.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FUNDING TO REGIONAL COUNCILS OF GOVERNMENTS FOR PROJECTS THAT SUPPORT THE GOALS OF THE VISION ZERO COUNCIL.
purpose: To provide funding to regional councils of governments for projects that support the goals of the Vision Zero Council.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL FIRE DISTRICTS AND MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC UTILITIES.
purpose: To permit municipal fire districts to join or establish a municipal electric utility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL FINANCIAL DATA REPORTING.
purpose: To establish a system of municipal financial data reporting modeled after the OpenCheckbook portal.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PROVISION OF CERTAIN INFORMATION BY OWNERS OF COMMERCIAL AND RESIDENTIAL PROPERTY THAT RESIDE IN ANOTHER JURISDICTION.
purpose: To require owners of commercial and residential property located in the state who reside in another jurisdiction to provide certain information to the municipalities in which such properties are located.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPAL WAIVER OF INTEREST ON CERTAIN DELINQUENT PAYMENTS.
purpose: To authorize a municipal option for the reduction or waiver of the interest rate on delinquent payments of certain taxes, rates, charges and assessments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE METROPOLITAN DISTRICT OF HARTFORD COUNTY.
purpose: To (1) require annual audits of the Metropolitan District of Hartford County, (2) establish a task force to examine the organization and operation of the district and permitting commissioners from nonmember municipalities to vote on certain rates, and (3) require the board of commissioners of the district to adopt, administer and enforce a model code of ethics.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO QUALITY HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To reduce costs and enhance services provided by the Departments of Developmental Services, Mental Health and Addiction Services and Social Services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BEHAVIORAL HEALTH WORKFORCE.
purpose: To expand the behavioral health workforce by eliminating barriers to licensure for newly graduated clinicians.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING CONNECTICUT TO JOIN THE PHYSICAL THERAPY COMPACT.
purpose: To permit Connecticut to join the Physical Therapy Compact.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HEALTH OF ACTIVE DUTY MEMBERS AND THEIR FAMILIES.
purpose: To protect the health of military and their families and reduce disease transmission by authorizing the Department of Public Health to provide information about access to available resources for COVID-19 testing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BEHAVIORAL AND MENTAL HEALTH POLICY AND OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE.
purpose: To clarify membership, operations and procedures of the Behavioral and Mental Health Policy and Oversight Committee.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE BREAST AND CERVICAL CANCER EARLY DETECTION AND TREATMENT REFERRAL PROGRAM TO INCLUDE LUNG CANCER SCREENINGS.
purpose: To promote lung cancer screenings.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CONNECTICUT TO JOIN THE PHYSICAL THERAPY COMPACT.
purpose: To increase access to physical therapy services.

title: AN ACT FUNDING FOR THE REGIONAL BEHAVIORAL HEALTH ACTION ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To assure adequate funding for the regional behavioral health action organizations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BILINGUAL COMPETENCY EVALUATIONS FOR NURSE'S AIDES.
purpose: To allow the Department of Public Health to contract with a national testing vendor to offer competency evaluations for certified nurse's aides in Spanish.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH TO LICENSE DANCE AND MOVEMENT THERAPISTS.
purpose: To establish licensure for dance and movement therapists in the state.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING CONNECTICUT TO JOIN THE PHYSICAL THERAPY LICENSURE COMPACT.
purpose: To permit Connecticut to join the Physical Therapy Licensure Compact thereby improving access to physical therapy services by increasing the mobility of eligible physical therapists to work in multiple states.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTAL NOTIFICATION OF THE PROVISION OF ANY MEDICAL OR MENTAL HEALTH SERVICE TO A MINOR.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of a minor are protected when requiring medical or mental health treatment.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OUT-OF-STATE BEHAVIORAL HEALTH PROVIDERS TO PROVIDE TELEHEALTH SERVICES TO A RESIDENT OF ANOTHER STATE WHILE SUCH RESIDENT IS IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To allow, on a permanent basis, a person, who is appropriately licensed as a behavioral health provider in another state or territory of the United States or the District of Columbia, to provide telehealth services to a resident of another state while such resident is in this state, provided the behavioral health provider (1) has a preexisting professional relationship with such resident; and (2) maintains professional liability insurance, or other indemnity against liability for professional malpractice, in an amount that is equal to or greater than that required for behavioral health providers licensed pursuant to chapter 383b of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING FOOD ALLERGY AWARENESS IN RESTAURANTS.
purpose: To develop guidelines for restaurants, customers and health departments on the best practices of managing food allergens.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUSIC THERAPY LICENSURE.
purpose: To (1) recognize that music therapy affects public health, safety, and welfare and that the practice of music therapy should be subject to regulation, (2) assure professional conduct on the part of music therapists, (3) improve the availability of music therapy services provided by a qualified professional to persons in need of such services, and (4) protect the public from the practice of music therapy by unqualified individuals.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTIFICATION OF RENEWABLE ENERGY INSTALLATIONS WITHIN PUBLIC WATER SUPPLY WATERSHEDS.
purpose: To ensure that the Department of Public Health and local water company are notified of any proposed solar array or other renewable energy installation within a watershed used for public water supply.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SAFE DISPOSAL OF FENTANYL PRODUCTS BY HEALTH CARE INSTITUTIONS.
purpose: To require the Department of Public Health to develop protocols for the safe disposal by health care institutions of fentanyl products.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING MUNICIPALITIES TO BE ASSIGNED AS A PRIMARY AREA SERVICE RESPONDER.
purpose: To allow the Department of Public Health to assign a municipality as a primary area service responder.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY TO DETERMINE IF COMPETENCY TESTING FOR CERTIFIED NURSE'S AIDES, PHLEBOTOMISTS AND ELECTROCARDIOGRAPHY TECHNICIANS SHOULD BE OFFERED IN OTHER LANGUAGES.
purpose: To require the Department of Public Health to study whether competency testing for certified nurse's aides, phlebotomists and electrocardiography technicians should be offered in languages other than English.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY AND ACCOUNTABILITY OF PROGRAMS FOR PERSONS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY.
purpose: To ensure the safety and well-being of persons with intellectual disability who are participating in a day care program, day camp program, recreational program or program of community-based residential facilities, respite care or emergency placement administered by the Department of Developmental Services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING LICENSURE OF MUSIC THERAPISTS.
purpose: To establish licensure for music therapist in the state.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO MENTAL HEALTH PRACTITIONER INFORMATION.
purpose: To expand access to mental health practitioner information for residents of Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR REDUCING LEAD POISONING.
purpose: To assist municipal health departments and district departments of health in lead abatement, educating the public regarding lead contamination and lead poisoning, preventing lead contamination and lead poisoning and conducting lead inspections in response to the lower threshold for blood lead levels.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF INFORMATION TO THE PUBLIC BY HOSPITALS.
purpose: To require oversight of hospitals that change from a nonprofit hospital to a for-profit hospital.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LICENSE RENEWAL FEE AND SCHEDULE FOR LICENSED CLINICAL SOCIAL WORKERS.
purpose: To increase licensure periods for licensed clinical social workers and reduce licensure fees for licensed clinical social workers employed by nonprofit entities.

title: AN ACT RECOGNIZING K-9 SEARCH AND RESCUE ORGANIZATIONS AS A RESCUE SERVICE.
purpose: To recognize K-9 search and rescue organizations as a rescue service in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PATIENT BROKERING FOR OUT-OF-STATE ADDICTION REHABILITATION SERVICES.
purpose: To restrict a form of patient brokering by prohibiting individuals from receiving a fee for coordinating out-of-state addiction rehabilitation services for an individual suffering from addiction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMPLETION OF CLINICAL HOURS BY STUDENT NURSES IN A SCHOOL SETTING.
purpose: To remove barriers to student nurses of redundant background checks.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE VISION ZERO COUNCIL.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Vision Zero Council.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING GROCERY STORES TO SELL CIDER AND SMALL WINERY WINES.
purpose: To: (1) Expand the existing grocery store beer permit to include sales of (A) cider, and (B) wine manufactured by small wineries; and (2) specify that a grocery store may not sell cider or small winery wine if such store is located within one thousand feet of a package store.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF TECHNICAL STANDARDS FOR MEDICAL DIAGNOSTIC EQUIPMENT THAT PROMOTE ACCESSIBILITY IN HEALTH CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To require medical diagnostic equipment purchased by certain health care facilities to meet technical standards for accessibility by persons with disabilities.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING MEDICAL MALPRACTICE INSURERS AND HEALTH CARE PROVIDER LICENSING ENTITIES FROM TAKING ANY ADVERSE ACTION AGAINST A MEDICAL PROVIDER DUE TO AN ADVERSE ACTION TAKEN BY ANOTHER STATE AS A RESULT OF SUCH PROVIDER'S INVOLVEMENT IN THE TERMINATION OF A PREGNANCY.
purpose: To protect health care providers in the state from any adverse actions taken by another state as a result of a provider's involvement in the termination of a pregnancy.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES TO EXPAND RESPITE CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To provide relief to more stressed caregivers with family members receiving services from the Department of Developmental Services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES TO ASSIST PROVIDERS TO TRANSITION TO ELECTRONIC MEDICAL RECORDS.
purpose: To facilitate the transition from paper to electronic medical records by third-party providers that contract with the Department of Developmental Services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PATIENT ACCESS TO MEDICAL RECORDS.
purpose: To ensure that patients have affordable access to their medical records.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF TRAINING RELATING TO CHILD TRAUMA TO PARENTS.
purpose: To increase a parent's understanding of child trauma.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A PERSON OR AN ENTITY RESPONSIBLE FOR CONTAMINATING A PRIVATE WELL TO REPAIR OR REPLACE THE WELL.
purpose: To ensure state residents have access to clean and safe well water.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A DEFINITION FOR "DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITY".
purpose: To expand eligibility for Medicaid home and community-based waiver services provided by the Department of Developmental Services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DISABILITY COMPETENCY REQUIREMENTS FOR MEDICAL AND DENTAL LICENSURE.
purpose: To ensure that physicians and dentists are cognizant of the need to make special accommodations for their patients with physical disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NOTIFICATION OF A PARENT OR GUARDIAN WHEN A MINOR SEEKS TO TERMINATE A PREGNANCY.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of a minor are protected when facing an unplanned pregnancy.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A MORAL OR PHILOSOPHICAL OBJECTION AS AN EXEMPTION TO THE IMMUNIZATION REQUIREMENTS FOR ATTENDING SCHOOL.
purpose: To allow a moral or philosophical objection as an exemption to the school immunization requirements.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING LICENSURE BY RECIPROCITY FOR OUT-OF-STATE MENTAL HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To provide greater access to health care by allowing licensure by reciprocity for mental health providers licensed in other states.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VIOLATIONS OF THE STATUTES GOVERNING CERTIFICATES OF NEED AND THE HEALTH SYSTEMS PLANNING UNIT.
purpose: To allow (1) a person or health care entity that fails to seek certificate of need approval to be subject to a civil penalty whether or not such failure was wilful, and (2) the executive director of the Office of Health Strategy to issue cease and desist orders to any person or health care entity that violates a provision of chapter 368z of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RADIOLOGIC TECHNOLOGISTS AND NUCLEAR MEDICINE TECHNOLOGISTS.
purpose: To implement policies to address the shortage of radiologic technologists and nuclear medicine technologists in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ANXIETY SCREENING FOR CHILDREN.
purpose: To require anxiety screening for any person between the ages of eight and eighteen at such person's annual physical examination.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCOMMODATIONS FOR PERSONS DIAGNOSED WITH LEARNING DISABILITIES WHEN TAKING CERTAIN LICENSURE EXAMS.
purpose: To require improved testing accommodations for those with diagnosed learning disabilities for licensure exams.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM ALLOWING POLICE TO USE A SYSTEM THAT LAUNCHES A GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEM DEVICE ONTO ANOTHER VEHICLE.
purpose: To implement a pilot program and provide funding to certain police departments to install a system on police cruisers that permits a police officer to launch a global positioning system device onto another vehicle, to enable police to track vehicles and apprehend auto thieves without a high-speed chase.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN REQUIREMENTS FOR FANTASY CONTEST ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To prohibit provisions requiring fantasy contest accounts to have two-factor authentication and a thirty-minute reminder.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO ADDRESS VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTER SHORTAGES.
purpose: To establish a state-wide task force to address volunteer firefighter shortages.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE NAME AND ADDRESS OF A LOTTERY WINNER FROM DISCLOSURE UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To protect lottery winners from harassment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSENT TO SEARCH MOTOR VEHICLES AND POLICE PURSUITS.
purpose: To ensure police officers have the tools, resources, training and peace of mind to protect our communities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM TO FUND USE OF DEVICES THAT PROVIDE AN ALTERNATIVE TO HIGH-SPEED PURSUITS.
purpose: To support and test the use of devices that provide high-speed pursuit alternatives, to benefit police and public safety.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING TRAINING ON SECONDARY EXPOSURE TO FENTANYL AND REQUIRING ALL FIRST RESPONDERS TO CARRY NALOXONE.
purpose: To save lives and combat the opioid epidemic through harm reduction and treatment strategies that will support individuals and communities struggling with, treating and responding to, substance use disorders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SECURE STORAGE OF FIREARMS.
purpose: To expand the requirements for secure storage of a firearm at home.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO ADDRESS FIRST RESPONDER RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION AND DESIGNATING 9-1-1 DISPATCHERS AS FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To establish a working group to address first responder recruitment and retention and designate 9-1-1 dispatchers as first responders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SANDY HOOK WORKERS ASSISTANCE PROGRAM AND FUND.
purpose: To (1) eliminate time restrictions on requests for assistance from the Sandy Hook Workers Assistance program, (2) seek to recover funds from a charitable trust or entity currently operating the program, (3) require additional reports to the General Assembly on the fund's operation, and (4) provide a mechanism for future transfers of the fund to a charitable trust or entity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING 9-1-1 DISPATCHERS.
purpose: To allow 9-1-1 dispatchers to have the same benefits and access to resources as other first responders.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE USE OF OPIOID SETTLEMENT FUNDS TO EQUIP MUNICIPAL POLICE OFFICERS WITH OPIOID ANTAGONISTS.
purpose: To give municipal police officers the tools they need to provide for public safety, save lives and combat the opioid epidemic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC SAFETY AND CHILDREN WITH SPECIAL NEEDS.
purpose: To support the safety of special needs children and first responders in the case of an emergency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TARGET PISTOLS DESIGNED FOR USE IN THE OLYMPIC GAMES AND LOWER LEVEL SANCTIONED COMPETITIONS.
purpose: To exclude from the definition of "assault weapon" any rimfire target pistols that are designed for use in target shooting events at the Olympic games and lower level sanctioned competitions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING 9-1-1 DISPATCHERS.
purpose: To change the designation of 9-1-1 dispatchers to qualify them as first responders and entitle them to all relevant benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To add 9-1-1 dispatchers as first responders.

title: AN ACT ENSURING THAT ANIMALS, FISH, BIRDS AND REPTILES ARE NOT USED AS PRIZES.
purpose: To prohibit the use of animals, fish, birds and reptiles as prizes at carnivals and other events.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING FIREFIGHTER TRAINING ON EXTINGUISHING FIRES INVOLVING ELECTRIC VEHICLES.
purpose: To require that firefighters receive training on extinguishing electric vehicle fires.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CARRY PERMIT RECIPROCITY.
purpose: To secure permit or certificate reciprocity between Connecticut and other states that have substantially similar standards for carrying a firearm.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSFER OF ASSAULT WEAPONS AND LARGE CAPACITY MAGAZINES.
purpose: To allow the legal transfer of an assault weapon possessed under a certificate of possession and large capacity magazines possessed under a declaration of possession between people who already legally possess such weapons or magazines.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING POLICE OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To allow sworn police officers carrying proper identification to carry their firearms anywhere in the state, except as prohibited by federal law.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TERM OF AMMUNITION CERTIFICATES.
purpose: To extend the term of an ammunition certificate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEAVE OF LEVEL TWO OR NONESSENTIAL STATE EMPLOYEES ASSISTING IN A CIVIL PREPAREDNESS EMERGENCY.
purpose: To permit level two or nonessential state employees who volunteer with a local organization for civil preparedness to assist in a civil preparedness emergency or local civil preparedness emergency without loss of pay, vacation time, sick leave or earned overtime accumulation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING APPOINTMENT OF SWORN STATE POLICE PERSONNEL.
purpose: To ensure public safety on Connecticut's highways.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for law enforcement officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PURPLE ALERT SYSTEM.
purpose: To establish a purple alert system to help locate certain missing persons.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING GOVERNMENT ENTITIES FROM TRACKING PASSENGER MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To protect personal privacy by prohibiting a government entity from tracking passenger motor vehicles.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING WRONG-WAY DRIVERS.
purpose: To increase road safety and prevent wrong-way drivers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE ON-THE-ROAD SKILLS TEST BY DRIVERS' SCHOOLS FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To expand access to the on-the-road skills test for persons with disabilities by permitting a drivers' school to administer such test.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM ON THE WILBUR CROSS PARKWAY AND MERRITT PARKWAY.
purpose: To deter certain commercial motor vehicles from driving on the Wilbur Cross Parkway and Merritt Parkway.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DRIVER EDUCATION ON THE DANGERS OF DRIVING UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF CANNABIS.
purpose: To include instruction on the dangers of driving while under the influence of cannabis in driving instruction courses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEMS AND OTHER NAVIGATION APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To prevent drivers from mistakenly driving the wrong way or accessing prohibited highways while using global positioning systems or other navigation applications.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TEMPORARY REGISTRATION OF MOTOR VEHICLES AND TRAILERS.
purpose: To allow an individual to purchase a motor vehicle or trailer and transport the motor vehicle or trailer home on the same day.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING WRONG-WAY DRIVING COUNTERMEASURES.
purpose: To prevent wrong-way driver-related fatalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF RUMBLE STRIPS TO PREVENT WRONG-WAY DRIVING.
purpose: To prevent wrong-way driving on highways by causing a tactile vibration and audible rumbling at entrance and exit ramps.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE "MOVE OVER" LAW.
purpose: To expand the operator's duty to move over one lane when approaching one or more emergency vehicles to include the duty to exercise control over the operator's vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGISTRATION OF COMPOSITE MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To allow a composite motor vehicle to be registered as an antique, rare or special interest motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF TRAFFIC SPIKES ON HIGHWAY ENTRANCE AND EXIT RAMPS.
purpose: To prevent wrong-way driving by installing traffic spikes on highway entrance and exit ramps.

title: AN ACT WAIVING THE MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSE AND REGISTRATION FEE FOR A SPOUSE OF A VETERAN OR MEMBER OF THE ARMED FORCES WHO HAS A DISABILITY AND IS UNABLE TO DRIVE.
purpose: To waive any motor vehicle operator's license and registration fee for a spouse of a veteran or member of the armed forces when such veteran or member has a disability and is unable to drive.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FARE-FREE PUBLIC BUS TRANSPORTATION.
purpose: To make fare-free public bus transportation permanent for residents of the state.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING THE USE OF FLASHING BLUE LIGHTS ON FIRE APPARATUS.
purpose: To increase the visibility of fire apparatus and the safety of firefighters, and to prevent accidents when firefighters are on the way to or at the scene of a fire or other emergency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POSSESSION OF CATALYTIC CONVERTERS.
purpose: To require a license to possess more than one detached catalytic converter and establish criminal penalties for the unlicensed possession of more than one detached catalytic converter.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE VISIBILITY OF PRIVATE DELIVERY SERVICE EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To require employees of a private delivery service company to wear high-visibility apparel when delivering items.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCESS TO OBTAIN A LICENSE FOR REPAIRING MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To simplify the process for an auto repair business to obtain a license with the Department of Motor Vehicles.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE OF A FIRE APPARATUS OR AMBULANCE WITHOUT A NEW CAR DEALER'S LICENSE.
purpose: To provide that any person engaging in the business of selling a fire apparatus or ambulance in the state without a new car dealer's license shall be guilty of a class C felony and fined ten thousand dollars for each violation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A WILDFLOWER HIGHWAY VEGETATION PROGRAM.
purpose: To plant wildflowers on the medians and shoulders of the state's highways.

title: AN ACT OFFERING THE EXAMINATION FOR A MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSE IN NEPALI.
purpose: To remove barriers to obtain a motor vehicle operator's license for Nepali residents of the state.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE TRANSPORTATION TASK FORCE CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF TRANSPORTATION SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES, SENIOR CITIZENS AND VETERANS.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the transportation task force established pursuant to special act 18-3 and to support aging in place, reduce social isolation and increase access to essential services and employment with increased mobility services across the state.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING OPEN ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTAINERS IN MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To reduce the number of crashes and fatalities resulting from drivers operating under the influence of alcohol.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOTOR VEHICLE NOISE POLLUTION.
purpose: To establish a pilot program to use acoustic cameras to gather data on motor vehicle noise pollution.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING PEDESTRIAN SAFETY MEASURES ON THE ANSONIA-DERBY TOWN LINE.
purpose: To increase pedestrian safety on Division Street, the Ansonia-Derby town line.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RENEWAL PROCESS FOR A SCHOOL BUS DRIVER'S LICENSE.
purpose: To require the Department of Motor Vehicles, when renewing a school bus driver's license, to simplify the examination for school bus operation or make such examination less frequent.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTIES FOR STREET RACING.
purpose: To combat illegal street racing by increasing the penalties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAINING FOR LOCAL TRAFFIC AUTHORITIES.
purpose: To require that local traffic authorities receive training in order to increase knowledge and make decisions that increase traffic and pedestrian safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LOCAL TRANSPORTATION PROJECTS.
purpose: To expand the role of regional councils of governments in certain projects and match state and federal funding programs for local transportation.

title: AN ACT STUDYING ALTERNATIVE TRANSPORTATION FUNDING STRATEGIES.
purpose: To study alternative transportation funding strategies, including a mileage-based user fee, so that the Special Transportation Fund remains fiscally solvent in the future.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RESTORATION OF SERVICES ON THE SHORE LINE EAST RAIL LINE.
purpose: To require the Department of Transportation to restore service on the Shore Line East rail line.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WRONG-WAY DRIVER EDUCATION.
purpose: To include instruction on the dangers of wrong-way driving in driving instruction courses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF TRAFFIC AND PEDESTRIAN SAFETY MEASURES.
purpose: To improve traffic and pedestrian safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NEW RAIL CARS ON THE WATERBURY AND DANBURY BRANCH LINES OF THE METRO-NORTH COMMUTER RAILROAD.
purpose: To improve the quality of rail service and encourage the use of public transportation in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INFORMATION COLLECTED BY AN AUTOMATED NUMBER PLATE RECOGNITION SYSTEM.
purpose: To restrict the use of information collected by automated number plate recognition systems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OPERATION AND MAINTENANCE OF THE AMISTAD.
purpose: To ensure that the Amistad, Connecticut's official state flagship, be operational and maintained in excellent condition.

title: AN ACT RESTORING SERVICE ON THE SHORE LINE EAST RAIL LINE.
purpose: To restore service on the Shore Line East rail line.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NONEMERGENCY AND NONCONSENSUAL TOWING OF MOTOR VEHICLES ON PRIVATE PROPERTY.
purpose: To reduce conflict between towing companies and motor vehicle owners.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL TRAFFIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To reduce municipal traffic violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PEDESTRIAN SAFETY.
purpose: To protect pedestrian safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN INDICATION ON MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSES AND IDENTITY CARDS FOR GOLD STAR FAMILY MEMBERS.
purpose: To provide an indication on motor vehicle operator's licenses and identity cards for gold star family members.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SPECIALTY LICENSE PLATES FOR DISABLED VETERANS.
purpose: To provide the Disabled American Veterans specialty license plates to disabled veterans at no cost.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN ORGANIZATIONS THAT SUPPORT OVERSEAS MILITARY PERSONNEL.
purpose: To (1) establish an account for the purposes of providing financial support to certain organizations that coordinate care packages for overseas military personnel, and (2) appropriate moneys for such purposes.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING SERVICE IN TIME OF WAR AS AN ELIGIBILITY CRITERION FOR CERTAIN VETERANS' BENEFITS.
purpose: To eliminate service in time of war as an eligibility criterion for certain state and municipal veterans' benefits.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS' PENSIONS FROM THE CALCULATION OF INCOME FOR CERTAIN BENEFITS.
purpose: To exempt all veterans' pension benefits from the calculation of income when determining eligibility for state and municipal benefits granted to veterans.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING VETERANS' DISABILITY BENEFITS FROM QUALIFYING INCOME WHEN DETERMINING PROPERTY TAX RELIEF.
purpose: To exclude veterans' disability benefits from qualifying income when determining eligibility for property tax relief.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study mental health services for veterans and make recommendations for expansion of such services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OBITUARIES FOR CERTAIN VETERANS.
