purpose: To identify philanthropic means of covering obituary costs for veterans who leave modest estates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A GRANT PROGRAM FOR THE REIMBURSEMENT OF CERTAIN LICENSING, CERTIFICATION, REGISTRATION OR TUITION FEES.
purpose: To establish, and appropriate funds for, a grant program for the reimbursement of certain licensing, certification, registration and tuition fees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF ADVOCACY AND ASSISTANCE WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS.
purpose: To increase the number of veterans' service officers in the Office of Advocacy and Assistance.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR MILITARY FUNERAL HONOR GUARD DETAIL COMPENSATION.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for compensation received as a result of participation in military funeral honor guard details.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE PAYMENT OF SALARIES TO LEGISLATORS IN THE ABSENCE OF A BUDGET.
purpose: To encourage debate and passage of the state budget in a timely manner.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE BENEFITS FOR RETIRED TEACHERS.
purpose: To restore one-third state subsidy to retired teachers enrolled in the Teachers' Retirement Board Medicare supplement health insurance package.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARTIAL MORTGAGE PAYMENTS.
purpose: To provide that mortgage lenders and mortgage servicers shall accept and apply any partial mortgage payment made by a mortgagor.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AWARDING OF GRANTS FROM THE CONNECTICUT ARTS ENDOWMENT FUND.
purpose: To provide that grants may be awarded from the Connecticut Arts Endowment Fund to nonprofit organizations that operate facilities in this state and would otherwise be eligible for such grants but for their incorporation in a state other than this state.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING REMOTE LEARNING FOR STUDENTS REQUIRING A MEDICAL ACCOMMODATION.
purpose: To allow remote learning for students requiring a medical accommodation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPANDED ELIGIBILITY FOR THE CARE 4 KIDS PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand eligibility for the Care 4 Kids program to include college students and participants in work training programs to ensure adequate child care for parents pursuing a career.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE JUVENILE JUSTICE POLICY AND OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE CONCERNING EDUCATION.
purpose: To implement the education recommendations of the Juvenile Justice Policy and Oversight Committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STUDENT ASSESSMENTS.
purpose: To audit the costs and time spent implementing mastery examinations with the goal of making such implementation more cost and time-effective and to establish a pilot program for an innovative model of student assessment and school quality measurement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO DRINKING WATER IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To ensure access to drinking water in schools.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE WITHHOLDING OF RECESS AS A FORM OF DISCIPLINE.
purpose: To prohibit schools from withholding recess as a form of discipline.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE STATE TO FULLY FUND SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To require the state to fully fund special education for the purposes of providing equal education opportunity to all special needs students in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SEIZURE-SAFE SCHOOLS.
purpose: To require training, education and planning regarding seizures to ensure the safety of children with epilepsy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF FIRE DRILLS AND CRISIS RESPONSE DRILLS DURING THE SCHOOL YEAR.
purpose: To conduct fire drills and crisis response drills in a more appropriate and sensitive manner during the school year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY IN THE PUBLIC SCHOOL CURRICULUM.
purpose: To include financial literacy in the public school curriculum.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CURSIVE WRITING INSTRUCTION FOR STUDENTS IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL.
purpose: To ensure that all students receive the educational benefits of learning to write in cursive.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CONNECTICUT WHOLE MILK IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To allow Connecticut whole milk in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CURSIVE WRITING INSTRUCTION FOR STUDENTS IN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL.
purpose: To ensure that all students receive the educational benefits of learning to write in cursive.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR LEGISLATIVE APPOINTMENTS TO THE STATE BOARD OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To ensure that the interests of parents are represented when developing state-wide education policy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NUTRITIONAL VALUE OF SCHOOL LUNCHES AND BREAKFASTS.
purpose: To post the nutritional value of school lunches and breakfasts for the purpose of promoting healthy eating habits by students.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO CONDUCT A STUDY CONCERNING SCHOOL START TIMES.
purpose: To establish a task force to conduct a study concerning school start times.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT A SCHOOL DISTRICT MAY REDUCE ITS MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT WHEN IT EXPERIENCES A DECLINE IN STUDENT ENROLLMENT.
purpose: To provide mandate relief by allowing school districts greater authority to reduce their education budgets when there is reduced student enrollment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EDUCATOR SAFETY.
purpose: To protect teachers and educators from violence in the classroom.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCESS FOR GRANTING CHARTERS TO NEW CHARTER SCHOOLS.
purpose: To eliminate the two-step process for granting charters to new charter schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT.
purpose: To accelerate the full implementation of the education cost-sharing grant.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OFF-DUTY POLICE OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS USED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF OFFICIAL DUTIES ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To allow off-duty police officers to carry firearms used in the performance of official duties on school grounds.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OFF-DUTY POLICE OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS USED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF OFFICIAL DUTIES ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To allow off-duty police officers to carry firearms used in the performance of official duties on school grounds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF SPECIAL EDUCATION AND THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A NEUTRAL STATE PANEL FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To require the state to pay the full cost of special education and to establish a neutral state panel to decide special education placements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE EXCESS COST THRESHOLD FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To modify the excess cost threshold for special education costs in order to reduce the financial hardship on small school districts with low student enrollment.

title: AN ACT CREATING EDUCATION SAVINGS ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To create education savings accounts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION AND OF THE PRESS FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To protect student expression and student publications except when such expression or publications are obscene, libelous, slanderous or disrupt school activities.

title: AN ACT EQUALIZING THE REIMBURSEMENT PERCENTAGE FOR THE VARIOUS TYPES OF SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECTS.
purpose: To create parity between the reimbursement percentages for new school construction projects and renovation projects under the school building project grant program.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE NOTICE PERIOD TO WITHDRAW FROM A COOPERATIVE ARRANGEMENT BETWEEN BOARDS OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To require three years, rather than one year, notice for a board of education to withdraw from an agreement for cooperative arrangements with any other board of education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SPECIAL EDUCATION STUDENTS AND THE EDUCATION COST-SHARING FORMULA.
purpose: To include special education students as an additional need-student weight for purposes of calculating a town's education cost-sharing grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF ALTERNATIVE METHODS FOR CREDIT RECOVERY FOR HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION.
purpose: To review alternative methods for high school credit recovery.

title: AN ACT ENHANCING HEALTH CARE PATHWAY PROGRAMS TO CONNECT STUDENTS WITH NURSES.
purpose: To address the shortage of registered nurses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN ANNUAL NOTICE TO SCHOOL DISTRICTS REGARDING THE AVAILABILITY OF CERTAIN YOUTH SUICIDE PREVENTION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To encourage boards of education to use free and available youth suicide prevention programs in the school district.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENHANCEMENT OF PARENTAL ENGAGEMENT IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To enhance parental engagement through informational sessions provided by the Department of Education.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A LIMITED BEAR HUNTING SEASON.
purpose: To manage the black bear population and protect residents of the state.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING HUNTING ON SUNDAYS BY SHOTGUN OR RIFLE ON PRIVATE AND PUBLIC LANDS.
purpose: To authorize hunting on Sunday on private and public lands by shotgun or rifle.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SCHOOL OFFICIALS TO RAISE AND RELEASE BUTTERFLIES.
purpose: To free school officials to raise caterpillars and release butterflies when teaching the butterfly life cycle to students.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASING SOLAR CANOPIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To increase the number of solar canopies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHANGES TO THE VIRTUAL NET METERING PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand virtual net metering and community solar projects.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING INTERNET SERVICE AS AN ESSENTIAL PUBLIC UTILITY AND CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF ENERGY, CABLE AND INTERNET SERVICE.
purpose: To designate Internet as an essential public utility and to authorize and enhance the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority's oversight powers over energy, cable, and Internet service providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ROOFTOP SOLAR INSTALLATIONS.
purpose: To expand rooftop solar installations in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENT TO VENDORS PARTICIPATING IN THE LOW INCOME HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To make higher-margin payments to heating fuel companies participating in the Low Income Home Energy Assistance Program anytime the wholesale price of diesel reaches three dollars per gallon.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLIMATE CHANGE MITIGATION.
purpose: To require electricity generated in the state to be one hundred per cent zero emission by 2040.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFIT CHARGE.
purpose: To suspend the combined public benefit charge.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR VOLUNTEER EMERGENCY MEDICAL TECHNICIANS AND VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for taxpayers who serve regularly as volunteer emergency medical technicians or volunteer firefighters.

title: AN ACT DEDICATING THE SALES AND USE TAXES REVENUE GENERATED FROM ALCOHOL SALES TO CERTAIN PURPOSES.
purpose: To dedicate all sales and use taxes revenue generated from the sale, acceptance or receipt in this state of alcohol to rehabilitation and treatment programs, drunk driving prevention efforts and the establishment of a recovery school.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deduction for Social Security benefits.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR ENVIRONMENTAL REMEDIATION OF A PROPERTY IN MIDDLEFIELD.
purpose: To provide funding for environmental remediation in the town of Middlefield.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME FOR MARRIED INDIVIDUALS FILING JOINTLY.
purpose: To increase to one hundred fifty thousand dollars the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income, for married individuals filing jointly.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING INDEXING OF INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX AND THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS.
purpose: To require that income thresholds for personal income tax and qualifying income thresholds for personal income tax deductions be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation, using the consumer price index.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LUXURY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To increase the dollar threshold that triggers the imposition of the "luxury tax" on the sale, acceptance or receipt in this state of a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE PETROLEUM PRODUCTS GROSS EARNINGS TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the petroleum products gross earnings tax.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO EXTEND THE TRAIN PLATFORM AT THE STRATFORD RAILROAD STATION.
purpose: To provide funding to extend the train platform at the Stratford Railroad Station served by Metro-North Railroad.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX AND CONCERNING THE TAX ON FUELS AND GASOHOL.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax and suspend the phase-in of the tax on fuels and gasohol.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR REMOVAL OF PFAS FROM FIRE EQUIPMENT AND DECONTAMINATION, RENOVATION AND REPLACEMENT OF FIRE EQUIPMENT AFFECTED BY PFAS.
purpose: To provide funding to fire departments to remove PFAS from fire equipment and decontamination, renovation and replacement of fire equipment affected by PFAS.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING DAYLIGHT SAVING TIME.
purpose: To end the practice of advancing the standard of time for daylight saving time.

title: AN ACT APPORTIONING THE STATE'S ELECTORAL COLLEGE VOTES FOR PRESIDENT AND VICE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES.
purpose: To award Connecticut's Electoral College votes based on results both state-wide and within each congressional district.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AGREEMENT AMONG THE STATES TO ELECT THE PRESIDENT OF THE UNITED STATES BY NATIONAL POPULAR VOTE.
purpose: To withdraw the state from the Agreement Among the States to Elect the President of the United States by National Popular Vote.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF ATLANTIC STANDARD TIME.
purpose: To require the state to adopt Atlantic Standard Time upon the enactment of legislation in Massachusetts, Rhode Island and New York adopting said time and federal approval of such change.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADJUDICATION OF MATTERS BROUGHT BEFORE THE STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION.
purpose: To allow a respondent in a written complaint filed with the State Elections Enforcement Commission pursuant to section 9-7b of the general statutes or any agency-initiated investigation brought by State Elections Enforcement Commission to petition to transfer the matter to the superior court for the judicial district of New Britain.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMPENSATION OF LEGISLATORS AND CONSTITUTIONAL OFFICERS.
purpose: To undo the changes to the compensation of elected officials made by public act 22-85 to restore more control over such compensation.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROCESS FOR THE ADDITION OF STATUES TO THE STATE CAPITOL BUILDING, A PLAN FOR SIGNAGE AROUND SAID BUILDING AND A STATE HISTORICAL COMMISSION.
purpose: To develop a process for identifying and commissioning additional statues for the exterior of the State Capitol building that reflect the diversity of the state and to establish the State Historical Commission.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL OF EXTENSIONS OF EMERGENCY DECLARATIONS AND LIMITING THEIR DURATION.
purpose: To restore the power of the legislative branch during civil preparedness and public health emergencies by requiring legislative approval of extensions of such emergencies and limiting their duration.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHOTO IDENTIFICATION FOR PURPOSES OF VOTING AND REPORTS OF VOTER FRAUD.
purpose: To require photo identification in order to vote, establish a program for electors to obtain such identification at no cost and require registrars of voters to report to the Secretary of the State incidents of voter fraud.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NATIONAL POPULAR VOTE INTERSTATE COMPACT.
purpose: To withdraw the state from the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING ANN PETRY DAY.
purpose: To designate a day of recognition for Ann Petry, a Connecticut author who lived in Old Saybrook.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RECOVERY OF DAMAGES FROM THE HOME IMPROVEMENT GUARANTY FUND.
purpose: To allow an owner to recover funds from the Home Improvement Guaranty Fund if the owner receives, from a court of competent jurisdiction, a money judgment against a business entity of which a certificate holder is a member, partner or employee.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RIGHT TO REPAIR MOTORIZED WHEELCHAIRS.
purpose: To provide that: (1) A motorized wheelchair manufacturer shall provide to a motorized wheelchair owner or independent repairer all parts, embedded software, firmware, tools and technical documentation necessary for the owner or repairer to perform diagnostic, maintenance and repair work on the wheelchair; (2) any failure to provide such parts, software, firmware, tools and technical documentation constitutes an unfair or deceptive act or practice within the meaning of the Connecticut Unfair Trade Practices Act; and (3) no such manufacturer shall be required to divulge any trade secret to an owner or independent repairer.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A LIQUOR AUCTION PERMIT.
purpose: To establish a liquor auction permit.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN SOLAR WORKERS TO OBTAIN A LICENSE TO PERFORM ELECTRICAL WORK.
purpose: To provide that no person may install a solar project that is capable of generating at least one megawatt of electricity unless such person has first obtained a license to perform electrical work.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PROFESSIONAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM FOR REGULATED PROFESSIONS TO INCLUDE PHARMACISTS.
purpose: To expand the professional assistance program for regulated professions to include pharmacists.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GASOLINE PRICE TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To require gasoline retailers to disclose to consumers a breakdown of the various components comprising the retail price of gasoline.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPRENTICE HIRING RATIO.
purpose: To require an apprentice ratio of one apprentice to one occupational licensee.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SMALL BUSINESSES PRIMARILY ENGAGED IN CHEESE SALES TO SELL BEER AND WINE.
purpose: To allow a small business that primarily engages in retail cheese sales to sell beer and wine.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM TO MAKE OPIOID ANTAGONISTS AVAILABLE IN VENDING MACHINES.
purpose: To establish a pilot program to make opioid antagonists, including, but not limited to, naloxone, available in vending machines.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CANNABIS CULTIVATORS TO PERIODICALLY STUDY THE HEALTH EFFECTS OF CANNABIS.
purpose: To require cannabis cultivators to periodically study the mental and physical health effects of cannabis.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SENIOR DISCOUNTS.
purpose: To provide that any person doing business in this state who offers a senior discount to consumers shall offer such discount in addition to any other discount such person offers to consumers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN BUSINESSES TO EMPLOY A CONSUMER LIAISON IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To require each entity doing business in this state to employ a person in this state who is available to answer questions posed, and address issues raised, by consumers in this state regarding such entity's operations.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE RESPONSIBLE AND EQUITABLE REGULATION OF ADULT-USE CANNABIS ACT.
purpose: To repeal the Responsible and Equitable Regulation of Adult-Use Cannabis Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCEPTABLE FORMS OF PAYMENT FOR RETAIL GOODS AND SERVICES.
purpose: To provide that no person who offers or sells, at retail, any good or service to a consumer in this state shall refuse to accept cash as a form of payment for such good or service, post any sign stating that such person will not accept cash as payment for such good or service, or charge a higher price to such consumer because such consumer pays in cash.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WINE MANUFACTURING BY FARM WINERIES.
purpose: To allow a farm winery permittee to use grapes from any Connecticut farm to manufacture wine.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TUITION WAIVERS FOR PARAEDUCATORS WHO SEEK A DEGREE IN EDUCATION.
purpose: To allow tuition waivers for paraeducators who enroll in a program at a public institution of higher education for a degree in education.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION TO SHARE LIBRARY MATERIALS WITH PUBLIC LIBRARIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To share the books and educational resources held at the libraries of public institutions of higher education with public libraries in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INVESTIGATIONS OF INTIMATE PARTNER VIOLENCE BY INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To require an institution of higher education to allow victims of intimate partner violence to participate in any investigation or administrative hearing conducted by such institution in cases where the accused is a student or employee of such institution, but the victim is not.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TUITION REIMBURSEMENT PROGRAM FOR GRADUATES OF MEDICAL SCHOOLS PROVIDING MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To establish a tuition reimbursement program for graduates of medical schools in the state who provide mental health services for the purpose of addressing the shortage of such services in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TUITION WAIVERS FOR GRADUATE DEGREE PROGRAMS AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To ensure that tuition waivers at public institutions of higher education include graduate degree programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REPORT ON THE EFFECTIVENESS OF PROGRAMS AND SERVICES OFFERED BY THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To review the programs and services administered or provided by the Board of Trustees of The University of Connecticut.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE OF FOOD ADVOCACY.
purpose: To create the Office of Food Advocacy to provide for a centralized resource to address food insecurity in the state.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE TEMPORARY FAMILY ASSISTANCE TIME LIMIT FOR BENEFICIARIES ENGAGED IN EDUCATIONAL, VOCATIONAL TRAINING AND CERTIFICATION PROGRAMS IN PURSUIT OF STABLE EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To afford temporary family assistance beneficiaries engaged in educational, vocational training or certification programs enough time to pursue stable employment opportunities, reduce poverty and homelessness and fill a pressing need in the labor market for educated and trained workers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY THE ACQUIRED BRAIN INJURY MEDICAID WAIVER PROGRAMS.
purpose: To review the acquired brain injury Medicaid waiver programs to determine whether changes are needed to better serve participants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXEMPTIONS FROM THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCEDURE.
purpose: To include additional dwelling units that meet certain income requirements in the calculation of the ten per cent threshold for the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To expand access to fair rent commissions to smaller municipalities.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE RIGHT TO COUNSEL PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the right to counsel program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TENANTS' RIGHTS.
purpose: To strengthen tenants' rights in the state by prohibiting landlords from harassing tenants, protecting tenant unions, requiring translation services for certain documents and communications, limiting the use of certain tenant screening materials and preventing lapse-of-time evictions where landlords have sought a rent increase exceeding fifteen per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OWNER-OCCUPIED UNITS AND THE DISCLOSURE OF FINANCIAL INFORMATION AND SURVEILLANCE FOOTAGE IN CONDOMINIUM ASSOCIATIONS.
purpose: To protect owners of condominium units by requiring a minimum amount of owner-occupied units and requiring the disclosure of financial reports and certain surveillance footage upon request.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE PRIOR AUTHORIZATION PROCESS BY HEALTH INSURERS FOR HEALTH INSURANCE POLICIES ISSUED IN THIS STATE IN THE PRECEDING TEN YEARS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the prior authorization process by health insurers for health insurance policies issued in this state in the preceding ten years, and to make recommendations to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HOMEOWNERS INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE PERIL OF COLLAPSE.
purpose: To require homeowners insurance policies to provide coverage for the peril of collapse.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN HEALTH CARRIERS FROM REQUIRING STEP THERAPY FOR PRESCRIPTION DRUGS PRESCRIBED TO TREAT MENTAL OR BEHAVIORAL HEALTH CONDITIONS.
purpose: To provide that health carriers delivering, issuing, renewing, amending or continuing certain individual and group health insurance policies and contracts in this state shall not require the use of step therapy for prescription drugs prescribed to treat behavioral health conditions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE FOR EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATORS.
purpose: To require the Comptroller to offer the partnership plan 2.0 to early childhood educators.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE UNIFORM REAL PROPERTY TRANSFER ON DEATH ACT.
purpose: To allow an owner of real property to pass the property simply and directly by operation of law to a beneficiary upon the owner's death.

title: AN ACT CLASSIFYING THE DEALING OF ILLEGAL DRUGS THAT RESULT IN THE DEATH OF ANOTHER AS MANSLAUGHTER IN THE FIRST DEGREE.
purpose: To classify the dealing of illegal drugs that leads to a death as manslaughter in the first degree.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPASSIONATE OR MEDICAL PAROLE AND CREDITS AWARDED FOR RELEASE DURING AN EMERGENCY DECLARATION.
purpose: To modify standards used to determine when an inmate may be eligible for compassionate parole release and establish a system for credits to be awarded to inmates toward release from imprisonment in the time of an emergency declaration.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TERMINATION OF PARENTAL RIGHTS OF ANY PERSON WHO PERPETRATES A SEXUAL ASSAULT THAT RESULTS IN THE BIRTH OF A CHILD.
purpose: To terminate the parental rights of any person who perpetrates a sexual assault that results in the birth of a child.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY FOR AND USE OF FORCE BY LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING USE OF FORCE BY A PEACE OFFICER.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASED ACCOUNTABILITY FOR PROBATE COURT JUDGES.
purpose: To enhance accountability, transparency and fairness in the Probate Court system.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY TO LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CRIMINAL PENALTIES FOR CRIMES INVOLVING DOMESTIC VIOLENCE AND ABUSE.
purpose: To create harsher penalties for domestic violence or abuse occurring in the presence of minors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POLICE VERIFICATION OF REGISTERED SEXUAL OFFENDERS' ADDRESSES.
purpose: To ensure that registered sexual offenders are compliant with statutory setbacks and that the officials of the proper municipality are notified where the registered sexual offenders live.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PAYMENT OF CHILD SUPPORT BY A PARENT WHO IS AWARDED SOLE CUSTODY OF A MINOR CHILD.
purpose: To prohibit a court from ordering a parent who is awarded sole legal custody of a minor child to pay child support for such child to the noncustodial parent.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING THE RECOVERY OF REASONABLE ATTORNEY'S FEES IN A SUCCESSFUL ACTION FOR WRONGFUL PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT.
purpose: To permit the recovery of reasonable attorney's fees in a successful action for wrongful property tax assessment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING INDIVIDUALS TO OPT OUT OF THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE PROGRAM.
purpose: To allow individuals to choose whether or not they participate in the paid family and medical leave program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CAP ON STATE EMPLOYEE PENSIONS.
purpose: To put a cap on state pensions at one hundred thousand dollars per year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REOPENING OF THE STATE CAPITOL AND LEGISLATIVE OFFICE BUILDING AFTER EXPIRATION OF A PUBLIC HEALTH EMERGENCY DECLARATION.
purpose: To ensure public participation and open access to government by members of the general public.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMMISSION TO STUDY AND CREATE THE ONLINE RECORDING OF LAND RECORDS AND MAPS.
purpose: To create a commission to study and establish a state-wide system for the online recording of land records and maps.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADDITIONAL PROPERTY TAX RELIEF FOR CERTAIN SENIORS.
purpose: To provide additional property tax relief for seniors who have resided in their homes for more than thirty years.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PAYMENTS IN LIEU OF TAXES.
purpose: To increase grant money to municipalities for nontaxable properties.

title: AN ACT PROTECTING PROPERTY OWNERS AGE FIFTY AND OLDER FROM FORECLOSURE.
purpose: To prevent foreclosure for certain delinquent property owners age fifty or older.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE OFFICE OF POLICY AND MANAGEMENT TO STUDY THE FREEZE TAX RELIEF PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Office of Policy and Management to study the property tax relief program established under section 12-129b of the general statutes to determine the costs to municipalities for accepting new participants and what qualifying factors, if any, for admittance are appropriate.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF ADDITIONAL PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR CERTAIN VETERANS.
purpose: To increase the amount of additional property tax exemptions for certain veterans.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE MUNICIPAL OPT OUT OPTION FOR ACCESSORY APARTMENTS.
purpose: To allow any municipality to opt out of the as-of-right allowance of accessory apartments beyond the current deadline of January 1, 2023.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REIMBURSEMENTS TO MUNICIPALITIES THAT RESPOND TO STATE HIGHWAY EMERGENCIES.
purpose: To provide compensation to municipalities for expenses related to responding to the scene of an accident or other emergency on a state highway.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDS RECEIVED FROM THE MULTISTATE AGREEMENT WITH JUUL LABS.
purpose: To require that the funds received by the state from the multistate agreement with JUUL Labs be used to support the state's tobacco control program.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE ADMINISTRATION OF VACCINES AND TESTING BY PHARMACISTS.
purpose: To reduce the costs of administering vaccines and performing certain medical testing, and expand access to vaccines and medical testing.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE LICENSE RENEWAL FEE FOR REGISTERED NURSES.
purpose: To address the state-wide shortage of registered nurses.

title: AN ACT ASSIGNING THE TOWN OF EAST HADDAM A PRIMARY SERVICE AREA RESPONDER.
purpose: To assign the Town of East Haddam a primary service area responder.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A MORAL OR PHILOSOPHICAL OBJECTION AS AN EXEMPTION TO SCHOOL IMMUNIZATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To allow children with a moral or philosophical objection to receiving a vaccine to attend school in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT ENCOURAGING THE INDEPENDENT PRACTICE OF ADVANCED PRACTICE REGISTERED NURSES.
purpose: To increase the number of independently practicing advanced practice registered nurses and improve access to health care for Connecticut residents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PSYCHEDELIC-ASSISTED THERAPY PILOT PROGRAM.
purpose: To fund the psychedelic-assisted therapy pilot program.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING THE DELEGATION OF CERTAIN DENTAL PROCEDURES TO A DENTAL ASSISTANT.
purpose: To allow the delegation of certain dental procedures to a dental assistant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINIMUM STAFFING LEVELS FOR NURSES.
purpose: To create safer working environments for nurses by improving the nurse-to-patient staffing ratios.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING BARRIERS TO ADVANCED PRACTICE REGISTERED NURSES AND PHYSICIAN ASSISTANTS PRACTICING IN THE STATE.
purpose: To eliminate barriers to advanced practice registered nurses and physician assistants practicing in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING 9-1-1 DISPATCHERS AS FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To allow 9-1-1 dispatchers to have the same benefits and access to training as other first responders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REQUIREMENTS RELATED TO GHOST GUNS.
purpose: To strengthen requirements related to ghost guns.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING FEES RELATED TO THE PROCUREMENT OF CERTAIN PERMITS.
purpose: To eliminate all fees related to the procurement of a permit to exercise any constitutional right.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE BALLISTIC VESTS TO CERTAIN CANINE OFFICERS.
purpose: To protect canine officers from gunshots, explosives, stab wounds and blunt force trauma, such as being kicked or beaten with a heavy object.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HARASSMENT OF A POLICE DOG.
purpose: To protect police dogs from harassment while in the performance of law enforcement duties.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE POLICE OFFICER STANDARDS AND TRAINING COUNCIL TO DEVELOP A POLICY PERMITTING POLICE OFFICER INTERACTIONS WITH THE PUBLIC WITHOUT THE USE OF BODY-WORN RECORDING EQUIPMENT UNDER LIMITED CIRCUMSTANCES.
purpose: To ensure that police officers who are off duty or otherwise do not have access to their body-worn recording equipment are able to protect the public.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ACCOUNT TO COMPENSATE FAMILIES OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS KILLED IN THE LINE OF DUTY.
purpose: To appropriately care for the families of law enforcement officers killed in the line of duty.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING OF ONLINE GAMING ACCOUNTS AND OFFERS OF AND ADVERTISEMENTS FOR FINANCIAL ENTICEMENTS TO PARTICIPATE IN GAMING.
purpose: To prohibit funding an online gaming account from any financial source other than one that is exclusively owned by the user of the account, and prohibit offers of and advertisements for a financial enticement to participate in gaming activity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE AND USE OF CONSUMER FIREWORKS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To authorize the sale and use of consumer fireworks.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ACCOUNT TO COMPENSATE FAMILIES OF LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS KILLED IN THE LINE OF DUTY.
purpose: To appropriately care for the families of law enforcement officers killed in the line of duty.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SIGNS INDICATING THE LOCATION OF THE GOLD STAR FAMILIES MEMORIAL MONUMENT.
purpose: To erect signs informing motorists and tourists of the location of the Gold Star Families Memorial Monument.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A BUS STATION IN THE TOWN OF BERLIN.
purpose: To increase the availability of public transportation in the town of Berlin.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RED-LIGHT CAMERA PILOT PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF WATERBURY.
purpose: To authorize the use of automated traffic enforcement safety devices to enforce stopping at red lights and reduce dangerous and reckless driving in the city of Waterbury.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A HEADLIGHT SAFETY INSPECTION AT THE TIME OF AN EMISSIONS INSPECTION.
purpose: To promote driver safety by ensuring that the headlights of a motor vehicle function properly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OPERATION OF A MOTOR VEHICLE BY A PERSON UNDER TWENTY-ONE YEARS OF AGE WHILE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF MARIJUANA.
purpose: To adopt a zero-tolerance law that prohibits a person who is less than twenty-one years of age from driving under the influence of marijuana.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING "JAKE-BRAKING".
purpose: To alleviate excessive noises on roadways caused by the use of engine compression brake devices in densely populated residential areas.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LOUD AND EXCESSIVE MOTOR VEHICLE NOISE.
purpose: To reduce loud and excessive noise from motor vehicles.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE WHEN REGISTERING A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To exempt veterans from the Passport to the Parks fee when registering a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO HEARING TESTS AND HEARING AIDS FOR SENIOR CITIZENS.
purpose: To increase the quality of life and mitigate the risks of developing dementia for senior citizens with hearing difficulties by increasing access to hearing screening tests and hearing aids.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF PORTIONS OF THE STATE BUDGET APPROPRIATING AID TO MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To provide predictability to municipalities when determining their budget.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDS FROM THE DRUG ASSETS FORFEITURE REVOLVING ACCOUNT.
purpose: To increase drug treatment options in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF SCHOOL MEAL PROGRAMS.
purpose: To reduce child hunger and food insecurity by restoring the free school meals that were available during the COVID-19 pandemic for students who may be in need of free meals, but are not otherwise eligible to receive them under current law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MODIFICATION OF DISTRICT REFERENCE GROUP CATEGORIES USED FOR SCHOOL FINANCING PURPOSES.
purpose: To provide a more equitable allocation of school financing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ACCELERATION OF THE FULL FUNDING PHASE IN UNDER THE EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT FORMULA.
purpose: To provide more support to school districts by accelerating the full funding of the education cost-sharing grant.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE WAYS IN WHICH A BOARD OF EDUCATION MAY EXPEND ITS ALLIANCE DISTRICT GRANT FUNDS.
purpose: To allow boards of education to use their alliance district funds on a more diverse set of expenses to support students.

title: AN ACT INCREASING EXCESS COST GRANT PAYMENTS TO SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To provide more support to boards of education for the cost of special education services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECONSIDERATION OF INELIGIBLE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT GRANT EXPENSES FOR REIMBURSEMENT.
purpose: To allow for previously deemed ineligible school building project expenses to be reconsidered for grant reimbursement.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OFF-DUTY LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To allow off-duty police officers to carry firearms used in the performance of official duties on school grounds.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING SCHOOL DISTRICTS FROM HOSTING LARGE SCALE PUBLIC EVENTS UNRELATED TO SCHOOL ACTIVITIES WHILE SCHOOL IS IN SESSION.
purpose: To protect student and educator safety by prohibiting the use of school buildings and property for large scale public events while school is in session.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MONEY-FOLLOWS-THE-CHILD APPROACH TO EDUCATION FUNDING.
purpose: To implement a money-follows-the-child approach to education funding in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DATE ON WHICH A CHILD MUST TURN FIVE YEARS OLD IN ORDER TO ENROLL IN KINDERGARTEN.
purpose: To amend the date by which a child must turn five years of age in order to enroll in kindergarten from January first to October first of the school year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DATE ON WHICH A CHILD MUST TURN FIVE YEARS OLD IN ORDER TO ENROLL IN KINDERGARTEN.
purpose: To make Connecticut more consistent with other states and to improve academic outcomes by requiring students to have reached age five by August first of the year they enter kindergarten.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF SCHOOL MEAL PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require public schools and charter schools to provide free breakfasts and lunches to all students regardless of family income.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CONNECTICUT CIVICS EDUCATION TASK FORCE.
purpose: To enhance the teaching of civics, citizenship and American government in grades kindergarten to twelve, inclusive, in public schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE TECHNICAL ASSISTANCE PROVIDED AS PART OF THE AFTER SCHOOL GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To make revisions to the technical assistance requirements under the after school grant program to align with federal requirements and to ensure accountability and the provision of quality services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CONNECTICUT SUMMER LEARNING COVID-19 RECOVERING INITIATIVE.
purpose: To establish the Connecticut Summer Learning COVID-19 Recovering Initiative and to ensure that funds appropriated for such program do not lapse at the end of the fiscal year.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE PROMOTION OF RACIAL AND SEXUAL SUPREMACY IN CONNECTICUT SCHOOLS.
purpose: To prohibit the promotion of racial and sexual supremacy in Connecticut schools.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE PROMOTION OF RACIAL AND SEXUAL SUPREMACY IN SCHOOLS IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To ensure that all students are treated fairly and equally in Connecticut's schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE STATE-WIDE MASTERY EXAMINATION.
purpose: To reduce the amount of time spent preparing for and administering the state-wide mastery examination and to address the cost effectiveness of standardized assessments.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FUNDING FOR MANDATORY TRAINING PROGRAMS FOR EDUCATORS TO HELP IDENTIFY STUDENTS SUFFERING FROM MENTAL ILLNESS.
purpose: To require the state to fund mandatory training programs for educators to help identify students suffering from mental illness.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY INSTRUCTION AS PART OF THE HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To require all Connecticut high school students to complete a course in financial literacy so that they will obtain broad financial literacy skills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF PERSONAL FINANCE EDUCATION AND A COURSE ON FINANCIAL LITERACY IN THE HIGH SCHOOL CURRICULUM.
purpose: To include personal finance education in the high school curriculum so that students can learn financial literacy skills and have equitable access to personal finance skills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NONDISCLOSURE OF CERTAIN COMMUNICATIONS BETWEEN TEACHERS AND STUDENTS.
purpose: To protect public school teachers from FOIA requests pertaining to communications with students regarding sensitive subjects, such as sexual orientation, gender identity and race, that take place during school-sponsored activities.

title: AN ACT ADDRESSING THE ELEMENTARY LITERACY GAP.
purpose: To address the elementary literacy gap by empowering student and parental engagement with an evidence-based home reading program.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH FROM MAKING RESCISSIONS OR OTHER REDUCTIONS TO A TOWN'S EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT DURING THE FISCAL YEAR.
purpose: To prohibit the Governor from making rescissions to towns' education cost-sharing grant during a fiscal year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GREEN ENERGY AND SCHOOLS.
purpose: To promote and fund the build out of a green energy initiative by providing school building project grant reimbursement and minimum budget requirement relief for solar and geothermal installations to school buildings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF A HIGH SCHOOL DIPLOMA FOR PERSONS WHO RECEIVE A CERTIFICATE OF COMPLETION OR COMPLETE THE GENERAL EDUCATIONAL DEVELOPMENT TEST.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to issue a high school diploma to any person who receives a certificate of completion or satisfactorily completes the General Educational Development test.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING STUDENT ATHLETES TO COMPETE IN INTERSCHOLASTIC ATHLETICS THAT CORRESPONDS WITH THEIR BIOLOGICAL GENDERS.
purpose: To require student athletes to compete in sporting events that correspond to their biological genders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS AND UPDATES TO THE TEACHER CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To ensure that public schools have adequate staffing to provide proper education services to students by supporting, encouraging, facilitating, streamlining and adjusting teacher certification requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF A UNIFORM TRAINING PROGRAM FOR SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICERS.
purpose: To utilize school resource officers for positive outcomes in schools by mandating and increasing training for school resource officers.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE BIRTH-TO-THREE PROGRAM.
purpose: To ensure that services provided under the birth-to-three program continue for children ages three to five, inclusive, who are not eligible for special education and related services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION EXCESS COST GRANT.
purpose: To assist school districts with funding for education by fully funding the special education excess cost grant.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING SCHOOL DISTRICTS TO INCLUDE PROFESSIONAL EVALUATORS AT PLANNING AND PLACEMENT TEAM MEETINGS IN WHICH INDIVIDUALIZED EDUCATION PROGRAMS ARE DEVELOPED OR DISCUSSED.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of a child are represented by mandating that professional evaluators are to be present at planning and placement team meetings in which individualized education programs are developed or discussed.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HOLOCAUST AND GENOCIDE EDUCATION AND AWARENESS CURRICULUM.
purpose: To provide the State Education Resource Center with funding for training, equipment and professional development for purposes of implementing the Holocaust and genocide education and awareness program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AFRICAN-AMERICAN AND BLACK STUDIES AND PUERTO RICAN AND LATINO STUDIES PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide the State Education Resource Center with funding for training, equipment and professional development for purposes of implementing the African-American and black studies and Puerto Rican and Latino studies program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN AEROSPACE ADVANCED MANUFACTURING HIGH SCHOOL.
purpose: To establish a working group to develop an aerospace advanced manufacturing high school for the purpose of supporting the aerospace manufacturing education and job training pipeline in the state.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT.
purpose: To repeal the minimum budget requirement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOCIAL AND EMOTIONAL LEARNING.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Social and Emotional Learning and School Climate Advisory Collaborative.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SEIZURE SAFE SCHOOLS.
purpose: To adopt the Seizure Safe Schools Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SPECIAL SERVICES ENDORSEMENT FOR SCHOOL NURSES.
purpose: To create a special services endorsement for school nurses for the purposes of ensuring new school nurses are prepared for the position.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY ON ACCOMMODATING RELIGIOUS HOLIDAYS IN SCHOOL CALENDARS.
purpose: To study how best to accommodate religious holidays for all students without negatively impacting the school calendar.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN ENGLISH LANGUAGE LEARNER PARENT BILL OF RIGHTS.
purpose: To establish an English Language Learner Parent Bill of Rights in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING A REDUCTION OF THE MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT FOR BOARDS OF EDUCATION THAT SHARE SERVICES OR ESTABLISH REGIONAL SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To promote efficiency in shared school services.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STUDENT ATHLETES WHO WERE BORN AS MALES FROM PARTICIPATING IN WOMEN'S INTERSCHOLASTIC ATHLETIC EVENTS.
purpose: To eliminate unfair competition in women's interscholastic sporting competition.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM TIME REQUIRED FOR THE DAILY LUNCH PERIOD FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To ensure that students in grades kindergarten to twelve, inclusive, have sufficient time to consume their lunch so that they may be more prepared for learning during the school day.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL DISTRICTS WITH THE HIGHEST PERFORMANCE BASED ON THE ACCOUNTABILITY INDEX.
purpose: To provide an exception from state education mandates for school districts that have an accountability index in the top ten per cent of all school districts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MONEY-FOLLOWS-THE-CHILD APPROACH TO PROVIDING SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To replace the current system of funding special education with a money-follows-the-child approach for the purpose of promoting parental choice and fair funding.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EMPLOYMENT OF ARMED SCHOOL SECURITY OFFICERS IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
purpose: To allow for the employment of armed school resource officers and school security officers in public schools.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OFF-DUTY LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS TO CARRY FIREARMS ON SCHOOL GROUNDS.
purpose: To allow off-duty law enforcement officers to carry firearms on school grounds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF A STATE-WIDE PLAN FOR RESPONDING TO LARGE-SCALE SCHOOL CRISIS EVENTS.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to develop a state-wide plan for responding to large-scale school crisis events.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF SCHOOL SECURITY INFRASTRUCTURE GRANT FUNDS FOR THE EMPLOYMENT OF ARMED SECURITY OFFICERS.
purpose: To allow school districts to use school security infrastructure competitive grant program funds to employ armed school security officers.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE EXECUTIVE BRANCH FROM MAKING RESCISSIONS TO A TOWN'S EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT DURING THE FISCAL YEAR.
purpose: To prohibit the Governor from making rescissions to towns' education cost sharing grants during a fiscal year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION EXCESS COST GRANT.
purpose: To fully fund the special education excess cost grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF SCHOOL SECURITY AND SAFETY PLANS.
purpose: To require boards of education to implement the school security and safety plans for each school under the jurisdiction of such boards.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF SCHOOL EMERGENCY SITUATIONS AND CRISIS RESPONSE DRILLS IN STUDENTS' INDIVIDUALIZED EDUCATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To include school emergency situations and crisis response drills in a student's individualized education program in order to accommodate such student's needs during emergencies.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC SCHOOLS BE EQUIPPED WITH CLASSROOM DOORS THAT LOCK FROM THE INSIDE.
purpose: To require all public school classrooms to be equipped with doors that are able to be locked from inside the classroom.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REIMBURSEMENT TO SCHOOL DISTRICTS FOR FORMER MAGNET SCHOOL STUDENTS WHO ENROLL IN A PUBLIC SCHOOL AFTER OCTOBER FIRST.
purpose: To provide reimbursement on a pro rata basis to school districts for former magnet school students who enroll in a public school after October first.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE MANDATE THAT BOARDS OF EDUCATION IMPLEMENT CERTAIN READING CURRICULUM MODELS OR PROGRAMS.
purpose: To make implementation of certain reading curriculum models or programs optional for boards of education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSIDERATION OF AIR POLLUTANT SATURATION IN THE APPROVAL OF AIR PERMITS.
purpose: To require the consideration of existing air pollution in an area when issuing a new air permit in such area.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE AND PERSONS SIXTY-FIVE AND OLDER.
purpose: To exempt senior citizens from the Passport to the Parks fee.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE.
purpose: To exempt veterans from the Passport to the Parks fee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BIOSOLIDS AND SOIL AMENDMENTS.
purpose: To remove biosolids from the Department of Agriculture's list of approved soil amendments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF PROCESSING FACILITIES IN THE STATE FOR HARES, RABBITS AND PIKAS.
purpose: To regulate processing facilities in the state for hares, rabbits and pikas.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BILLING FOR ELECTRICITY AT CUSTOMERS' FORMER PREMISES.
purpose: To prevent former building owners and tenants from being billed for electric service they do not use because they sold or moved out of the property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTRIFICATION OF TRANSPORTATION IN THE STATE.
purpose: To (1) require state vehicle procurement to be fully electric, (2) streamline the permitting and opening of new electric vehicle charging sites, (3) create state offices to provide technical assistance to local governments concerning the Inflation Reduction Act, (4) require utilities to plan for the increased use of electric vehicles in the state and fund related grid improvements, and (5) accelerate electrification of the state's school bus fleet.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING HARDSHIP CUSTOMERS TO CONTRACT WITH ENERGY SUPPLIERS.
purpose: To permit hardship customers to contract with energy suppliers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SMALL HYDROPOWER FACILITIES.
purpose: To require electric distribution companies to purchase electricity supplied by small hydropower facilities.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REDESIGN UPPER WHALLEY AVE IN THE TOWN OF NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide funding for the redesign of upper Whalley Avenue in the city of New Haven.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PROPERTY TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR A PRIMARY RESIDENCE OR MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To increase the maximum allowable credit against the personal income tax for a person's primary residence or motor vehicle to five hundred dollars.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING CERTAIN BOND COVENANTS.
purpose: To extend certain bond covenants.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR GRANTS-IN-AID TO NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS FOR CERTAIN CAPITAL AND INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide funding for the nonprofit grant program to provide grants to nonprofit health and human services providers for certain capital and infrastructure projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FARM WINERY PERMITTEES.
purpose: To provide that not less than twenty-five per cent of a farm winery permittee's total annual wine and brandy ingredients shall be grown in this state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR GRANTS-IN-AID TO NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS FOR CERTAIN CAPITAL AND INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide funding for the nonprofit grant program to provide grants to nonprofit health and human services providers for certain capital and infrastructure projects.

title: AN ACT LOWERING THE RATE OF THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX ON INCOME SPENT ON CHILD CARE.
purpose: To allow the portion of certain taxpayers' income that is spent on child care to be taxed at lower rates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REMOTE NOTARIZATION.
purpose: To allow notaries public to perform notarizations electronically.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CORRECTION OF DEFECTS FOR RETURNED ABSENTEE BALLOTS.
purpose: To require local election officials to notify electors in the event of defects with returned absentee ballots so that such defects may be corrected and such absentee ballots may be cast.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING PERMANENT EASTERN STANDARD TIME.
purpose: To eliminate daylight saving time and adopt permanent eastern standard time.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE GOVERNOR'S EMERGENCY POWERS.
purpose: To limit the duration of the Governor's power to declare a public health or civil preparedness emergency and ability to extend such an emergency unilaterally.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPEN PRIMARIES.
purpose: To allow unaffiliated electors to vote in the primaries of political parties.

title: AN ACT APPLYING PERSONAL DATA PRIVACY STANDARDS TO STATE AGENCIES.
purpose: To apply the requirements of public act 22-15 concerning personal data privacy to state agencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION AUDITS.
purpose: To require the timely completion of State Elections Enforcement Commission audits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASED FUNDING TO MUNICIPALITIES FOR UPGRADED VOTING TABULATORS.
purpose: To increase funding to municipalities for the purchase or lease of upgraded voting tabulators.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONPARTISANSHIP OF STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION STAFF.
purpose: To prohibit State Elections Enforcement Commission staff from engaging in partisan political activity.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CONNECTICUT AGE-APPROPRIATE DESIGN CODE.
purpose: To adopt a Connecticut Age-Appropriate Design Code that creates privacy and safety obligations for providers of online products and services accessed by children.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH WARNING LABELS FOR CONSUMER PRODUCTS CONTAINING TETRAHYDROCANNABINOL.
purpose: To provide that a rotating, graphic health warning label shall be prominently displayed in each advertisement for, and on all packaging containing, a consumer product that includes tetrahydrocannabinol.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE STATE TO MANUFACTURE INSULIN.
purpose: To authorize the state to manufacture insulin.

title: AN ACT ADDING ADDITIONAL STUDENT MEMBERS TO THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To add two additional student advisory committee members to the Board of Regents for Higher Education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REIMBURSEMENT OF INDEPENDENT CONNECTICUT-BASED NONPROFIT HOSPITALS FOR UNCOMPENSATED CARE OF NONCITIZENS OF THE UNITED STATES.
purpose: To provide financial relief to independent Connecticut-based nonprofit hospitals for nonrecoverable costs associated with care and treatment of noncitizens of the United States.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MEDICAL RESPITE PILOT PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a pilot program that creates temporary housing opportunities for people receiving medical treatment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CALCULATION OF THE TEN PER CENT AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEAL THRESHOLD.
purpose: To include dwelling units that meet certain income requirements into the calculation of the ten per cent threshold for the affordable housing appeals procedure.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE COURT ADVOCATE PROGRAM TO INCLUDE ALL ANIMALS.
purpose: To expand the court advocate program to include all animals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF JUDICIAL PROCEDURES IN THE HOUSING SESSION OF THE SUPERIOR COURT.
purpose: To require the Judicial Branch to conduct a review of the judicial procedures in the housing session of the Superior Court to ensure that such procedures are consistent with the state's Right to Counsel program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICATION OF THE DEFENSE OF GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY IN ACTIONS FILED AGAINST A POLICE OFFICER OR LAW ENFORCEMENT UNIT.
purpose: To permit a police officer or law enforcement unit to seek an interlocutory appeal of a trial court's denial of the application of the defense of governmental immunity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LOCAL AND STATE COOPERATION IN THE ENFORCEMENT OF FEDERAL IMMIGRATION LAW.
purpose: To ensure that local and state officials are fully cooperating with law enforcement personnel in the enforcement of federal immigration law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR CRIMES COMMITTED AGAINST THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To extend the statute of limitations for the prosecution of crimes committed against the elderly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEATH PENALTY.
purpose: To reinstate the death penalty.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE CASTLE DOCTRINE.
purpose: To fully adopt the castle doctrine.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NEW CRIME OF MURDER FOR THE SUPPLY OF ILLEGAL DRUGS TO A VICTIM OF AN OVERDOSE.
purpose: To establish a new crime of murder for those responsible for supplying illegal drugs to a victim of an overdose.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOTOR VEHICLE STOPS AND THE ODOR OF CANNABIS.
purpose: To allow police officers to use odor of cannabis as a basis for a motor vehicle stop or search.

title: AN ACT MODIFYING THE DEFINITION OF EMPLOYER IN THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE ACT.
purpose: To amend the definition of employer in the Paid Family and Medical Leave Act to provide financial relief to employees of small businesses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARTICIPATION IN VOCATIONAL AGRICULTURAL WORK PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require payment of workers' compensation insurance through a state-purchased insurance pool for vocational agricultural students and that such students be exempt from claiming unemployment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OCCUPATIONAL LICENSES AND THE DISCLOSURE AND DETERMINATION OF IMMIGRATION STATUS.
purpose: To prevent disclosure or determination of immigration status from being required in the obtaining or maintaining of a state granted professional or occupational license.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION DEATH BENEFITS AND THE COST-OF-LIVING AND INFLATION RATES.
purpose: To allow individuals who receive workers' compensation death benefits to receive an amount that puts them at the same level as their peers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCLOSURE OF SALARY RANGES ON PUBLIC AND INTERNAL JOB POSTINGS.
purpose: To decrease the gender wage gap by requiring employers to disclose salary ranges on public and internal job postings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE BRANCH EMPLOYEES AND THE RIGHT TO COLLECTIVELY BARGAIN.
purpose: To allow legislative branch employees to unionize and collectively bargain.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING USE OF AN EMPLOYEE'S PERSONAL VEHICLE FOR EMPLOYMENT PURPOSES.
purpose: To require employees be reimbursed when they are required to use their personal vehicle to carry out the duties of their job.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINIMUM WAGE FOR PERSONS UNDER THE AGE OF EIGHTEEN.
purpose: To reduce the minimum wage rate for persons under the age of eighteen and eliminate the ninety-day limitation on such reduced minimum wage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF FIREFIGHTERS WHO DEVELOP CANCER.
purpose: To create a presumption that a firefighter's diagnosis of cancer arose out of and in the course of employment.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide additional options to a worker under the Paid Family and Medical Leave program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REPORTING REQUIREMENTS OF THE LABOR DEPARTMENT AND THE UNEMPLOYED ARMED FORCES MEMBER SUBSIDIZED TRAINING AND EMPLOYMENT PROGRAM.
purpose: To update funding and the Labor Departments' reporting requirements for the Unemployed Armed Forces Member Subsidized Training and Employment Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT-FUNDED BROWNFIELD REMEDIATION AND DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS AND THE PREVAILING WAGE STATUTES.
purpose: To include Department of Economic and Community Development-funded brownfield remediation projects in prevailing wage requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE AND MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES AND COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To provide clear notice of an employee's right to choose to not be a member of a union.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESTRICTIVE EMPLOYMENT AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To end the practice of forced noncompete agreements in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITIES AND THE MINIMUM WAGE.
purpose: To prohibit employers from paying employees with intellectual disabilities less than the minimum wage when they are able to perform the tasks of their position.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING WORKERS' COMPENSATION FOR POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS INJURIES TO POLICE TECHNICIANS.
purpose: To include police technicians for post-traumatic stress workers' compensation eligibility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYERS AND EMPLOYEES' UNION MEMBERSHIPS.
purpose: To make it a discriminatory practice for an employer to ask an employee if they have ever been a member of a union.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELIGIBILITY FOR UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS AND SEASONAL AGRICULTURAL BUSINESSES.
purpose: To update the basis on which unemployment benefits will be required to be paid and protect seasonal agricultural businesses from disproportionate taxation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LABOR DEPARTMENT AND WAGE ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To ensure that the Labor Department has the staff to investigate wage theft.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC WORKS PROJECTS AND PROJECT LABOR AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To require analysis of certain information regarding project labor agreements and that such analysis be available to the public.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PREVAILING WAGE FOR NEW CONSTRUCTION AND RENOVATIONS.
purpose: To increase the prevailing wage threshold for new construction and renovations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE EMPLOYEES AND EQUITABLE HOLIDAYS.
purpose: To offer full-time state employees with two floating holidays per fiscal year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ROOFTOP SOLAR INSTALLATIONS IN COMMON INTEREST COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To permit owners of a condominium unit or a unit in a cooperative to install a solar power generating system on the roof of such unit, as long as the roof is not shared with another unit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVIEW OF MOTOR VEHICLE DEALERSHIP AND REPAIR LICENSE APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To require planning and zoning commissions to review and approve applications for dealing in or repairing motor vehicles pursuant to current zoning regulations, prior to the approval of such licenses by zoning boards of appeals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOLAR FARMS.
purpose: To require solar farms to comply with local planning and zoning laws.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE REQUIREMENT OF A DONATION OF LAND AS A CONDITION OF SUBDIVISION APPROVAL.
purpose: To prohibit municipalities from requiring a donation of land from an applicant for subdivision of land as a condition of subdivision approval.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WRITTEN NOTICE REGARDING THE DISCOVERY OF LEAD PAINT IN NURSERY SCHOOL AND PRESCHOOL PROGRAM BUILDINGS.
purpose: To protect and ensure the safety of children attending a nursery school or preschool program where lead paint has been discovered.

title: AN ACT REGARDING PRIMARY SERVICE AREA RESPONDERS.
purpose: To shift responsibility for assignment of a primary area service responder from the Department of Public Health to municipalities that have been designated as primary service areas and choose to assign such responder.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ENDOMETRIOSIS TRAINING FOR SCHOOL NURSES.
purpose: To require that school nurses and school-based health center nurses be trained in endometriosis with trainings that include information on systemic racism.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENT OF CIVIL PENALTIES BY NURSING HOMES AND RESIDENTIAL CARE HOMES.
purpose: To require that a nursing home facility or residential care home on which a civil penalty has been imposed pay such penalty from moneys set aside for administrative costs and expenses of the nursing home facility or residential care home.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING PUBLIC ACCESS TO RESIDENTIAL WATER TESTING RESULTS.
purpose: To allow public access to residential water testing results.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING HAIRDRESSERS AND COSMETICIANS TO PRACTICE AS A NAIL TECHNICIAN WITHOUT OBTAINING A NAIL TECHNICIAN LICENSE OR TEMPORARY PERMIT.
purpose: To allow licensed hairdressers and cosmeticians to practice as a nail technician without a nail technician license or temporary permit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PILOT PROGRAM FOR AN OVERDOSE PREVENTION CENTER AND AUTHORIZING THE PROVISION OF NALOXONE THROUGH VENDING MACHINES.
purpose: To save lives and combat the opioid epidemic through a number of policies and harm reduction strategies that will support individuals and communities struggling with substance use disorder.

title: AN ACT RESTRICTING THE USE OF COVENANTS NOT TO COMPETE FOR PHYSICIAN ASSISTANTS, NURSE PRACTITIONERS AND ADVANCED PRACTICE REGISTERED NURSES.
purpose: To improve patient care and support the health care workforce by extending restrictions of covenants not to compete for physicians to other health care practitioners, including physician assistants, nurse practitioners and advanced practice registered nurses.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HOSPITALS TO PROVIDE FAMILIES OF A STILLBORN INFANT A MINIMUM OF TWENTY-FOUR HOURS TO MAKE DECISIONS REGARDING BURIAL OR CREMATION.
purpose: To require hospitals to provide families of a stillborn infant at least twenty-four hours before making decisions regarding burial or cremation.

title: AN ACT CODIFYING AN INDIVIDUAL'S RIGHT TO OWN, POSSESS AND CARRY A FIREARM.
purpose: To codify the right of an individual to own, possess and carry a firearm for personal protection and practice.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AMENDMENTS TO THE STATE BUILDING CODE, THE FIRE SAFETY CODE AND THE STATE FIRE PREVENTION CODE REGARDING BED AND BREAKFAST OCCUPANCY LIMITS.
purpose: To amend the State Building Code, the Fire Safety Code and the State Fire Prevention Code to increase occupancy limits in bed and breakfast establishments in order to support economic development by enabling bed and breakfasts to operate safely and compliantly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF A POLICE OFFICER TO TRANSPORT A PERSON TO AN EMERGENCY ROOM OR A SUBSTANCE ABUSE FACILITY.
purpose: To allow a police officer to take a person into protective custody and transport such person to an emergency room or a substance abuse facility if the officer has administered an opioid antagonist to such person or taken other lifesaving measures.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING STANDARDS FOR THE REMOVAL OF TREES FROM STATE HIGHWAYS.
purpose: To establish standards for the removal of trees, shrubs or other vegetation from state highways.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUTOMOBILE INSURANCE COMPLIANCE.
purpose: To allow a motor vehicle owner up to thirty days to remedy any motor vehicle insurance compliance issue.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FLASHING WRONG WAY SIGNS ON ALL HIGHWAY EXIT RAMPS.
purpose: To stop wrong way driving.

title: AN ACT STUDYING IMPROVEMENTS TO PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION BETWEEN RESIDENTIAL ZONES AND COMMERCIAL AND INDUSTRIAL ZONES IN THE SAME MUNICIPALITY.
purpose: To improve suburban public transportation services to promote job growth and strengthen the local economy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN EXPANSION OF COMMUTER RAIL LINES TO THE TOWN OF NEW MILFORD.
purpose: To expand ridership on Connecticut's commuter rails.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NORTHWESTERN CONNECTICUT TRANSIT DISTRICT.
purpose: To expand the Northwestern Connecticut Transit District.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCONTINUATION OF LEASE AGREEMENTS WITH RAIL FREIGHT COMPANIES.
purpose: To authorize the Commissioner of Transportation to discontinue a lease agreement and freight rights with a rail freight company for failure to maintain minimum safety standards or when poor maintenance of a rail line is deemed to constitute a risk to the public safety.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR DISCOUNTED HUNTING, TRAPPING AND FISHING LICENSES FOR VETERANS AND ACTIVE DUTY MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES.
purpose: To provide a discounted rate for certain hunting, trapping and fishing licenses, permits, tags and stamps to veterans and active duty members of the armed forces.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASED FUNDING FOR THE PROVISION OF MUNICIPAL VETERANS SERVICES.
purpose: To provide for increase funding to municipalities for the provision of municipal veterans services.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR URBAN RENEWAL PROJECTS AND URBAN REDEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To provide funding for urban renewal projects and urban redevelopment.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO MAINTAIN HELICOPTERS USED IN SEARCH AND RESCUE.
purpose: To provide critical funding for helicopter search and rescue.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PAUSING OF DEBT OBLIGATIONS BY INDIVIDUALS IN SUBSTANCE ABUSE TREATMENT PROGRAMS.
purpose: To provide that: (1) An individual may pause a debt obligation for thirty days following entry into a certified in-patient or out-patient substance abuse treatment program, provided such individual (A) is a debtor in this state, and (B) completes such program; (2) debt collection practices concerning such debt obligation shall be prohibited during such time period; and (3) the reason for the pause shall remain confidential.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EFFORTS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO ASSIST IN THE RECRUITMENT OF PERSONS INTO MANUFACTURING PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require the Department of Economic and Community Development to assist in efforts to increase the recruitment of eligible job seekers and high school students into manufacturing programs by promoting manufacturing careers to students at community colleges and high schools, creating programs for job seekers, holding career fairs or advertising on television, radio stations or by other digital means.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RECOMMENDATIONS BY THE COMMISSIONER OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT REGARDING CERTAIN TAX CREDITS.
purpose: To implement any recommendations made by the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development pursuant to section 158 of public act 22-118 to extend research and development tax credits to pass-through entities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCREASED INVESTMENT IN ARTS, CULTURE AND TOURISM.
purpose: To require the Department of Economic and Community Development to increase economic activity and workforce development by increasing investment in arts, culture and tourism in the state, and to create processes to identify strategic goals, metrics and accountability structures for such investment, which shall be supported by the appropriation of the sum of fifty-eight million five hundred thousand dollars to said department, from the General Fund.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING, ENCOURAGING AND SUPPORTING THE TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND CAREER SYSTEM.
purpose: To promote, encourage and support the Technical Education and Career System.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REMOTE PARTICIPATION OF MEMBERS OF LOCAL BOARDS OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To permit local boards of education to decide whether to permit remote participation of members by majority vote.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE FARM TO SCHOOL PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the farm to school program to include the development of such programs that sustain relationships with local farms and producers, and provide student enrichment, healthy outcomes for children and enhanced agricultural economy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING YOUTH SERVICE BUREAUS.
purpose: To provide increased funding to youth service bureaus to alleviate staffing shortfalls to adequately serve the needs of youth in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISORDERED EATING AWARENESS IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To require local and regional boards of education to include goals for reducing disordered eating in school wellness policies.

title: AN ACT LIMITING STUDENT SUSPENSIONS FOR MINOR INFRACTIONS.
purpose: To limit student suspensions for minor infractions, such as cursing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN EXIT SURVEY FOR TEACHERS.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to develop an exit survey for teachers who retire or leave the profession for the purpose of improving teacher attrition and retention.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCORPORATION OF PLAY-BASED LEARNING IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To incorporate play-based learning in grades prekindergarten to five, inclusive, for the purpose of improving the development of students' executive functions and reducing the negative impact of high levels of childhood anxiety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FREE SCHOOL LUNCH PROGRAM.
purpose: To continue the free school lunch program at public schools.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC SCHOOL EDUCATORS TO RECOGNIZE EACH STUDENT BY THE BIOLOGICAL GENDER OF SUCH STUDENT.
purpose: To require public school educators to recognize each student by the biological gender of such student.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SPECIAL EDUCATION ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To establish a special education advisory council to advise the Department of Education and the State Board of Education on issues related to special education teacher attrition and ideas for retention.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AVAILABILITY OF EPINEPHRINE IN EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To authorize early childhood education programs to stock and make available epinephrine.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE BEST PRACTICES FOR PROVIDING COMPREHENSIVE THERAPEUTIC EDUCATION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To study best practices for providing comprehensive therapeutic education programs to meet the mental health needs of students in public schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF LOCALLY GROWN FOOD IN SCHOOL FOOD PROGRAMS.
purpose: To allow boards of education to establish farm-to-table programs with local farms.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING BOARDS OF EDUCATION TO REVISE SCHOOL BUS ROUTES TO REFLECT ACTUAL STUDENT RIDERSHIP.
purpose: To assist boards of education in reducing school transportation costs by allowing them to revise school bus routes to reflect actual student ridership.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPANION ANIMAL WELFARE.
purpose: To study companion animal welfare.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SEPARATING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To provide for an independent energy regulatory authority.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY CONVERTING BIOSOLIDS INTO ENERGY.
purpose: To study converting biosolids into energy.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE INSTALLATION OF LIGHTING FIXTURES IN THE WEST RIVER AREA OF THE CITY OF NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide funding for the installation of lighting fixtures in the West River area of the city of New Haven.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR CERTAIN COLLEGE GRADUATES WITH STEM DEGREES.
purpose: To reestablish a credit against the personal income tax for certain college graduates who receive a degree in a science, technology, engineering or math-related field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CAP ON RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT TAX CREDITS.
purpose: To increase the amount of research and development tax credits a taxpayer may utilize in an income year.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF A POLICE STATION IN NEW CANAAN.
purpose: To provide funding to construct a new police station that includes a regional training facility in New Canaan.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR EDUCATIONAL ACCESS AND OPPORTUNITY SCHOLARSHIP DONATIONS.
