purpose: To establish a tax credit for donations made to nonprofit entities that provide educational access and opportunity scholarships.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR THE INSTALLATION OF IN-HOME SECURED STORAGE UNITS FOR FIREARMS OR MEDICATIONS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax of up to one thousand dollars for in-home secured storage units installed to store firearms or medications.

title: AN ACT CONVEYING A PARCEL OF STATE LAND TO THE TOWN OF CHESHIRE FOR ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT PURPOSES.
purpose: To convey a parcel of state land in the town of Cheshire to the town of Cheshire for economic development purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF PRINT AND DIGITAL ADVERTISING BY THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Department of Administrative Services to award more state contracts for print and digital advertising to nonprofit entities and Connecticut-owned media outlet entities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DIVESTMENT OF STATE FUNDS FROM FOSSIL FUEL CORPORATIONS.
purpose: To authorize the State Treasurer to divest from any fossil fuel corporation to mitigate the effects of climate change.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE UPDATING OF STATE FORMS AND APPLICATIONS TO INCLUDE A NONBINARY GENDER OPTION.
purpose: To require all state agency forms and applications to be updated with a nonbinary gender option.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE-WIDE PRESCRIPTION DRUG STEWARDSHIP PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a state-wide prescription drug stewardship program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHARMACISTS AND OPIOID ANTAGONISTS.
purpose: To enable a pharmacist to prescribe an opioid antagonist, including, but not limited to, naloxone, to a person who is unable to obtain an opioid antagonist from another source as a patient or on behalf of another person.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PILL PRESSES AND PARAPHERNALIA.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to revise certain provisions of the regulations of Connecticut state agencies in order to provide that a pill press constitutes paraphernalia.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPIOIDS DISPENSED IN CERTAIN COMMUNITY SETTINGS.
purpose: To require that opioids dispensed to patients in certain community settings be dispensed in blister packs.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GREEN JOBS CORPS PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a green jobs corps program to outline a talent development strategy, help communities respond to climate change and reduce carbon emissions.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE NUMBER OF STUDENT MEMBERS ON THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES OF THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT AND THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To add two additional student members to the Board of Trustees of The University of Connecticut and the Board of Regents for Higher Education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNUSED VETERAN TUITION WAIVERS.
purpose: To allow any child of a veteran to use tuition waivers for which such veteran was eligible, but did not use.

title: AN ACT REDEFINING SET-ASIDE DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To redefine "set-aside development" to reduce the required time period for deed restrictions.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR RAPID WHOLE GENOME SEQUENCING FOR CRITICALLY ILL CHILDREN.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide coverage for rapid whole genome sequencing for a critically ill child (1) when ordered by such child's health care provider, and (2) when clinical criteria are met.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TIERED SYSTEM FOR THE CONNECTICUT SEX OFFENDER REGISTRY.
purpose: To create a tiered system for the sex offender registry.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF CHEMICAL AGENTS ON MINORS BEING HELD IN CUSTODY.
purpose: To prohibit the use of chemical agents on minors who are in custody of the Department of Correction, Judicial Branch or Department of Children and Families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLASS ACTION LAWSUITS FOR FAILURE TO COMPLY WITH CERTAIN REGULATIONS REGARDING MINIMUM FAIR WAGE.
purpose: To prohibit class action lawsuits for failure to comply with certain regulations of Connecticut state agencies regarding minimum fair wage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADVANCED ENERGY COMPANIES AND THE WORKFORCE.
purpose: To ensure the state has the workforce necessary for the advanced energy and energy-efficiency manufacturing field.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAID SICK TIME AND MENTAL HEALTH.
purpose: To require employers to provide two mental health days per calendar year to eligible employees.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE TIP CREDIT AND USE OF THE FEDERAL MINIMUM WAGE EXEMPTIONS FOR EMPLOYERS OF DISABLED PERSONS.
purpose: To eliminate the exemptions to the Connecticut minimum wage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNDOCUMENTED WORKERS AND UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS.
purpose: To allow undocumented individuals to be eligible for unemployment benefits.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING WORKERS' COMPENSATION FOR POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS INJURIES TO CERTAIN FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To expand workers' compensation coverage for post-traumatic stress injuries to additional first responders and other personnel.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEMPORARY EMPLOYMENT AGENCIES AND INDIVIDUALS WITHOUT SOCIAL SECURITY NUMBERS.
purpose: To allow individuals without Social Security numbers to obtain work through temporary employment agencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE COMPENSATION.
purpose: To ensure fair application of unemployment compensation to all employers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HEALTH OF FIREFIGHTERS.
purpose: To create a presumption that a firefighter's diagnosis of cancer arose out of and in the course employment and create a working group to study the health of and create preventative measures for firefighters.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS INJURIES AND WORKERS' COMPENSATION.
purpose: To remove the narrow standards required for workers' compensation coverage for post-traumatic stress injuries and expand coverage to other public safety personnel.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE PROGRAM TO TEACHERS.
purpose: To allow teachers to participate in the paid family and medical leave program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN SIGNAGE ON PEDESTRIAN CROSSWALK SIGNALS.
purpose: To enable pedestrians to report inoperative pedestrian crosswalk signals.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HAIRDRESSERS AND COSMETICIANS TO BE TRAINED IN WORKING WITH CHILDREN WITH AUTISM AND OTHER SPECIAL NEEDS.
purpose: To require registered hairdressers and cosmeticians to be trained in working with children with autism and other special needs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PATIENT ACCESS TO REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH CARE.
purpose: To protect patient access to reproductive health care from the moral or religious objections of providers, institutions and pharmacists.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ENDOMETRIOSIS DATA AND BIOREPOSITORY PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a program to (1) foster basic research and clinical collaborations designed to help understand the pathology, drivers and impact of endometriosis; (2) allow for curation of information from a diverse cross-section of communities to ensure representation of all ethnic groups; (3) support the identification of biomarkers of the disease to provide earlier diagnosis; (4) catalyze the advancement of new therapeutic strategies, along with early access for Connecticut residents to the latest therapeutic options as they are developed; (5) support better care management of the disease; and (6) serve as a centralized resource to disseminate information, educate the public and raise awareness in order to promote early detection in adolescents and adults.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE DEADLINE BY WHICH PERSONS PRACTICING AS A NAIL TECHNICIAN SHALL OBTAIN A LICENSE OR PERMIT.
purpose: To extend the deadline by which a person practicing as a nail technician shall obtain a license or permit from the Department of Public Health to January 1, 2024.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NAIL TECHNICIAN LICENSURE.
purpose: To allow nail technicians practicing in the state for a period of not less than two years prior to January 1, 2024, to apply for a nail technician license.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CARDIAC HEALTH OF STUDENT ATHLETES.
purpose: To protect children from cardiac emergencies while participating in school athletic activities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING HOME HEALTH AGENCY PROCEDURES TO PREVENT DIVERSION AND POISONING FROM PRESCRIPTION DRUGS.
purpose: To require home health agencies to implement procedures to prevent diversion and poisoning from prescription drugs.

title: AN ACT LIMITING, MONITORING AND TRACKING THE DISPENSING AND ADMINISTRATION OF OPIOID DRUGS BY VETERINARIANS.
purpose: To limit, monitor and track the dispensing and administration of opioid drugs by veterinarians.

title: AN ACT LIMITING ORDERS RELATED TO FIREARMS AND AMMUNITION DURING A CIVIL PREPAREDNESS OR PUBLIC HEALTH EMERGENCY.
purpose: To prohibit the Governor or any municipality from restricting lawful possession of a firearm or ammunition during a civil preparedness or public health emergency.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING GAS LEAK DETECTORS IN NEW AND EXISTING CONSTRUCTION THAT USES COMBUSTIBLE GAS.
purpose: To require all structures that use combustible gas to be equipped with a gas leak detector.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF ADDITIONAL LIGHTING ALONG U.S. ROUTE 7 IN THE TOWN OF NEW MILFORD.
purpose: To require the installation of additional lighting along U.S. Route 7 in the town of New Milford.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF THE TERM  "LATINX" BY STATE AGENCIES.
purpose: To prohibit the use of the term "Latinx" by state agencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE AGENCY COMPLAINTS REGARDING INDIVIDUALS OR GROUPS TO SOCIAL MEDIA PLATFORMS.
purpose: To require state agencies to hold a hearing prior to contacting a social media platform to complain about an individual or group and to authorize such individual or group to appeal any adverse decision.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SAFEGUARDING THE RIGHTS, HEALTH, FINANCES AND QUALITY OF LIFE OF NURSING HOME RESIDENTS.
purpose: To require timely eligibility determinations for Medicaid applicants, require notification of such determinations to such applicants, prohibit nursing homes from taking steps to recover costs of care until Medicaid eligibility is determined and heighten penalties for nursing homes that misuse state funds earmarked for staff wage enhancements or violate minimum staffing requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCLOSURE OF NATURAL PERSON OWNERSHIP RECORDS.
purpose: To require the disclosure of certain natural person ownership interests in real property.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY HOUSING DEVELOPMENTS.
purpose: To create a task force to review statutory exemptions and permissions for freestanding housing developments.

title: AN ACT CREATING AN ACCESSIBLE HOMES TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To create an accessible homes tax credit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS, TENANT UNIONS AND HOUSING CODE VIOLATION FORMS.
purpose: To allow certain tenants unions to bring complaints to fair rent commissions and require that local housing code violation forms be available in Spanish.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PENALTIES FOR THE VIOLATION OF MUNICIPAL REGULATIONS AND ORDINANCES.
purpose: To increase the maximum penalty for violation of a municipal regulation or ordinance to five hundred dollars for a first violation and seven hundred fifty dollars for a second or subsequent violation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROOF OF IDENTITY, CITIZENSHIP AND RESIDENCY FOR PURPOSES OF VOTING.
purpose: To require (1) persons to present proof of United States citizenship and Connecticut residency prior to registering to vote, and (2) electors to present photo identification prior to voting.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING ADDITIONAL DATA PRIVACY PROTECTIONS FOR MINORS.
purpose: To establish additional data privacy protections for minors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCENTIVES FOR TRANSIT-ORIENTED DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To increase the financial viability of municipal transit-oriented development projects.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS.
purpose: To appropriate moneys to the Department of Veterans Affairs for the purpose of paying the expenses of providing required meals to overnight staff, rather than paying such expenses from the department's institutional general welfare fund.

title: AN ACT PROTECTING EDUCATORS IN TEACHING CERTAIN SUBJECTS AND TOPICS IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To ensure that Connecticut public school educators are able to provide instruction in a work environment that is free from harassment, intimidation or physical violence stemming from ideological differences of opinion about certain subjects or topics, including, but not limited to, gender, sexuality, race, racism and climate change.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ZERO-CARBON EMISSIONS.
purpose: To create policies and accountability for reaching the state's carbon-reduction goals.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE SCOPE OF PRACTICE OF PHARMACISTS.
purpose: To expand public access to qualified, expedited health care services, reduce the cost burden borne by taxpayers for unnecessary trips to the emergency room, reduce trauma to elders, enhance families' convenience when caring for loved ones, and avoid duplication in treatments for common health care issues.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEFINITION OF MEDIAN INCOME IN THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCESS.
purpose: To allow municipalities to choose the method of determining median income under section 8-30g of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HOSTILE ARCHITECTURE.
purpose: To prohibit the installation of hostile architecture in public spaces.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF LOW EMBODIED CARBON CONCRETE IN STATE CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS.
purpose: To reduce emissions associated with concrete in any state construction projects administered by the Departments of Administrative Services and Transportation in an effort to combat climate change.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF A CERTAIN SOCIAL NETWORKING APPLICATION BY STATE EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To prohibit the use of TikTok on state-owned or state-issued electronic equipment.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE HISTORIC PRESERVATION COUNCIL TO REVIEW TERMINOLOGY USED AT STATE LANDMARKS AND OTHER PUBLIC MARKINGS AND MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS.
purpose: To require the Historic Preservation Council to (1) review state landmarks and other public markings across the state for terminology deemed offensive, and (2) make recommendations for a priority list for removal of such terminology.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE COMMISSIONER OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO ESTABLISH AN AIRPORT DEVELOPMENT ZONE IN THE CITY OF HARTFORD AND THE TOWN OF WETHERSFIELD.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to establish an airport development zone comprised of census blocks within a two-mile radius of Hartford Brainard Airport, in the city of Hartford and the town of Wethersfield.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CONDOMINIUM OWNERS AND CONDOMINIUM UNIT OWNERS' ASSOCIATIONS TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR CERTAIN TAX CREDITS.
purpose: To allow condominium owners and condominium unit owners' associations to be eligible for certain historic structures renovation tax credits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROGRAM TO ENCOURAGE SUPPORT OF IN-STATE BUSINESSES AND MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Economic and Community Development to create: (1) A central database for a program into which in-state businesses and municipalities may opt to participate to encourage support of such businesses and municipalities; and (2) an Internet web site concerning such program.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING SELF-DEFENSE AS AN AFFIRMATIVE DEFENSE TO THE OFFENSE OF ILLEGALLY TAKING A MOOSE OR BEAR.
purpose: To establish self-defense as an affirmative defense to the offense of illegally taking a moose or bear.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC SERVICE COMPANY RATES AND EARNINGS IN EXCESS OF THEIR AUTHORIZED RATE OF RETURN.
purpose: To (1) change the rules for when the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority is required to hold an investigation concerning utility companies' earnings in excess of their authorized return on equity, (2) require that the earnings sharing mechanism for utility overearnings directs a greater share to ratepayers, and (3) to give the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority flexibility on how it directs any overearnings to ratepayers.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE NONPROFIT GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide funding for the nonprofit grant program to provide grants to nonprofit health and human services providers for certain capital and infrastructure projects.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP CONCERNING SAFE ONLINE PRACTICES.
purpose: To establish a working group to study the issue of online harassment of individuals and make recommendations concerning necessary changes in state law to penalize online harassment of individuals and guidelines for reporting online harassment of municipal and state-elected officials.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROFESSIONAL ENGINEERS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to adopt regulations to establish a structural engineer endorsement to the professional engineer license, and require licensed professional engineers to complete not less than fifteen hours of continuing professional education annually.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REAL ESTATE CONVEYANCE TAX REMITTANCES AND AFFORDABLE HOUSING PLANS.
purpose: To allow municipalities that have submitted affordable housing plans to retain more real estate conveyance taxes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENTS FOR CERTAIN LANDLORDS.
purpose: To provide incentives to landlords to reduce rents by providing property tax abatements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AFFORDABLE HOUSING MORATORIUMS.
purpose: To expand the units which may be counted towards an affordable housing appeals moratorium.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMERCIAL AND MIXED-USE SPACE IN AFFORDABLE HOUSING DEVELOPMENTS.
purpose: To support the vitality of commercial districts by requiring certain affordable housing developments to provide commercial or mixed-use space.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENTS FOR CERTAIN SENIOR-OWNED DEED RESTRICTED PROPERTIES.
purpose: To increase the supply of affordable housing by providing tax abatements for senior citizens who voluntarily deed restrict certain properties.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING AFFORDABLE HOUSING OPPORTUNITIES FOR SENIORS NEAR TRANSIT ROUTES.
purpose: To expand affordable housing opportunities for seniors within a certain distance of any transit route.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICES OF RENT INCREASES AND LIMITING RENTAL INCREASES.
purpose: To require a landlord to provide sixty days' notice of a proposed rent increase and to limit rent increases to not more than one hundred dollars per month.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO CONDUCT A STUDY OF ADEQUATE HOUSING.
purpose: To study adequate supportive housing options.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AFFORDABLE DWELLING UNITS LOCATED NEAR TRANSIT STATIONS.
purpose: To provide incentives for municipalities to permit the development of affordable housing near transit stations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROSPECTIVE TENANT CREDIT REPORTS.
purpose: To require landlords to provide copies of credit reports to prospective tenants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENT STABILIZATION.
purpose: To cap annual rent increases at four per cent plus the increase in the regional consumer price index.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESSORY DWELLING UNITS AND AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS MORATORIUMS.
purpose: To allow certain accessory dwelling units to count for housing-unit equivalent points.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CORRECTION ADVISORY COMMITTEE.
purpose: To make adjustments to the membership and procedures of the Correction Advisory Committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOTIONS FOR USE AND OCCUPANCY PAYMENTS IN HOUSING MATTERS.
purpose: To expedite the time frame for the entry of a court order on a plaintiff's motion for use and occupancy payments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DRIVING WHILE UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF CANNABIS.
purpose: To establish parameters for drug impaired driving.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNAUTHORIZED OR FORCED INVASIVE MEDICAL PROCEDURES.
purpose: To penalize civilly and criminally those administering unauthorized or forced invasive medical procedures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF SPORTS OFFICIALS.
purpose: To protect sports officials from harassment and assault.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSAULT OF A SPORTS OFFICIAL.
purpose: To make assault of a sports official a misdemeanor crime.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF VICTIMS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To ensure that those who carry out acts of domestic violence or abuse are held responsible in a consistent manner, while also protecting the victims by removing the responsibility of pressing charges from them.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INTIMATE PARTNER AND DOMESTIC VIOLENCE MURDER .
purpose: To define and create a crime for domestic violence and intimate partner murder.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SENTENCING FOR VIOLENT CRIMES COMMITTED WITH A FIREARM.
purpose: To increase the term of sentencing for violent crimes committed with a firearm.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILD ABUSE AND MURDER AND CHANGING THE "GOOD BEHAVIOR" STANDARD.
purpose: To increase the sentence an offender receives for child abuse and murder and change the standard for early release for "good behavior".

title: AN ACT INCREASING BAIL FOR OFFENDERS WHO VIOLATE PROTECTIVE ORDERS.
purpose: To require an increase in a person's bail amount if such person violates a protective order.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REPEAT MOTOR VEHICLE THEFTS BY A JUVENILE.
purpose: To treat second and subsequent motor vehicle thefts by a juvenile as a serious juvenile offense with discretionary transfer to the regular criminal docket.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS CONCERNING HOME INVASIONS.
purpose: To extend the statute of limitations concerning home invasions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICATION-ASSISTED TREATMENT FOR OPIOID USE DISORDER IN CORRECTIONAL FACILITIES.
purpose: To save lives and combat the opioid epidemic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CRIMINAL ACTIVITY AGAINST INFRASTRUCTURE.
purpose: To protect and deter criminal activity against infrastructure.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MONITORING OF REPEAT VIOLATORS OF PROTECTIVE ORDERS.
purpose: To require monitoring bracelets for repeat violators of protective orders in domestic violence cases.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM NUMBER OF TEXTS AND EMAIL AN INCARCERATED PERSON MAY SEND OR RECEIVE.
purpose: To increase the minimum number of texts and email that an incarcerated person may send or receive.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE JUVENILE JUSTICE POLICY AND OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE.
purpose: To implement the 2023 recommendations of the Juvenile Justice Policy and Oversight Committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POLICE NOTIFICATION UNDER THE SEXUAL OFFENDER REGISTRY.
purpose: To ensure that when a sex offender is transferred across state lines into this state to a congregate living situation, the police in the offender's residing town shall be notified and the state's sexual offender registry will be updated.

title: AN ACT LIMITING WHO MAY BE RELEASED ON A PROMISE TO APPEAR.
purpose: To protect the public from violent offenders.

title: AN ACT RAISING THE AGE FOR A JUVENILE TO BE ARRESTED FOR AN OFFENSE.
purpose: To provide children with support rather than arrest by increasing the minimum age of a child in the juvenile justice system to fourteen years of age.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PENALTIES FOR MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT AND CRIMES INVOLVING FIREARMS.
purpose: To increase penalties for motor vehicle theft and crimes involving firearms.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PENALTIES FOR MOTOR VEHICLE THEFT AND CRIMES INVOLVING FIREARMS.
purpose: To increase penalties for motor vehicle theft and crimes involving firearms.

title: AN ACT REDEFINING NEGLECT OF A CHILD.
purpose: To protect responsible parents and encourage the development of children.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR POSSESSION OF CHILD PORNOGRAPHY.
purpose: To increase the penalty for possession of child pornography.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CRIMINAL TRESPASS LAW.
purpose: To allow landowners to mark their boundaries with stripes of purple paint in lieu of fencing or "No Trespassing" signs.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING THE VICTIM ADVOCATE INPUT IN THE CHARGING OF A DEFENDANT.
purpose: To permit the Victim Advocate to provide an opinion in a hearing format for or against charges by prosecutors that is different from the recommendation from law enforcement.

title: AN ACT RESTORING QUALIFIED IMMUNITY FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To reduce ambiguity and provide guidance for police officers regarding proper actions in the field.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE JUVENILE JUSTICE POLICY AND OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE.
purpose: To expand the membership of the Juvenile Justice Policy and Oversight Committee by adding four new voting members who are directly impacted by the juvenile justice system.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A SAFETY PLAN FOR VICTIMS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To ensure there is a safety plan in place to protect victims of domestic violence before the perpetrators of such violence are released.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PILOT PROGRAM OF GLOBAL POSITIONING MONITORING OF PERPETRATORS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE WHO ARE SUBJECT TO A RESTRAINING ORDER.
purpose: To expand the program of global positioning monitoring of perpetrators of domestic violence who are subject to a restraining order.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CIVIL AND CRIMINAL STATUTES OF LIMITATIONS ON CHILD SEXUAL ABUSE MATTERS.
purpose: To eliminate the state's civil and criminal statutes of limitations concerning child sexual abuse matters in order to allow for trauma-informed pathways for civil and criminal justice seekers who are victims of child sexual abuse to pursue charges or damages when ready.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISSEMINATION OF INTIMATE IMAGES TO MORE THAN ONE PERSON BY ELECTRONIC MEANS.
purpose: To elevate the penalty for dissemination of intimate images in the case of dissemination to multiple persons by certain electronic means.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF SELF DEFENSE IN THE CASE OF AN IMMINENT THREAT OF USE OF DEADLY PHYSICAL FORCE.
purpose: To better enable an individual to defend himself or herself or a third person from the imminent use of deadly physical force or infliction of great bodily harm.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CASTLE DOCTRINE.
purpose: To fully adopt the castle doctrine by establishing a rebuttable presumption that if a homeowner believes it necessary to use deadly force to repel an intruder, then that belief is a reasonable belief.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR VEHICULAR MANSLAUGHTER.
purpose: To increase the penalty for individuals guilty of vehicular manslaughter.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CRIME OF OFFERING CANNABIS-CONTAINING ITEMS FOR CONSUMPTION WITHOUT DISCLOSING THAT THEY CONTAIN CANNABIS.
purpose: To prevent individuals from inadvertently consuming cannabis.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CRIME OF HARMFUL COMMUNICATION WITH A MINOR.
purpose: To establish the crime of harmful communication with a minor.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOUPMENT OF STATE COST ATTRIBUTABLE TO LOW-WAGE EMPLOYERS.
purpose: To require certain employers to pay a quarterly fee to the Labor Commissioner for each employee that receives less than twenty dollars an hour in wages.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DELINQUENT PROPERTY TAXES FOR OWNERS AGE FIFTY-FIVE AND OLDER.
purpose: To cap the interest rates on delinquent property taxes owed by property owners age fifty-five and older at twelve per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TAX ASSESSMENT OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING.
purpose: To standardize the property tax valuation of affordable housing using the actual income approach.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LICENSING REQUIREMENTS FOR NAIL TECHNICIANS.
purpose: To allow nail technicians practicing in the state for a period of not less than two years prior to January 1, 2024, to apply for a nail technician license.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE POWERS OF A MUNICIPAL POLICE OFFICER PROVIDING ASSISTANCE IN ANOTHER MUNICIPALITY ON REQUEST.
purpose: To specify that a municipal police officer providing assistance in another municipality, on a request from the other municipality's police chief, has the same arrest powers in the other municipality as the officer has in the officer's own municipality.

title: AN ACT SUSPENDING A YOUTH'S ABILITY TO OBTAIN A DRIVER'S PERMIT OR LICENSE FOR HAVING COMMITTED CERTAIN MOTOR VEHICLE OFFENSES.
purpose: To cause a delay in a youth's ability to obtain a learner's permit or driver's license as a consequence of having committed certain offenses involving a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVIEW OF EXISTING REGULATIONS OF CONNECTICUT STATE AGENCIES.
purpose: To make modifications to the process for reviewing agency regulations to determine whether they are obsolete, inconsistent or ineffective and change the deadlines for such review.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIENS ON REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To require sixty days' notice and an appeal opportunity prior to the effectiveness of any lien.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY ON ACCESS TO LOANS USED TO PURCHASE MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOMES.
purpose: To require the Departments of Banking and Housing to jointly conduct a study concerning ways to provide greater access to loans used by individuals to purchase mobile manufactured homes, and decrease the denial rate for such loans, for the purpose of promoting homeownership.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR GRANTS-IN-AID TO NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS FOR CERTAIN CAPITAL AND INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide funding for the nonprofit grant program to provide grants to nonprofit health and human services providers for certain capital and infrastructure projects.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO EXPAND THE OPERATIONS OF THE COMMUNITY HEALTH CENTER OF WATERBURY.
purpose: To provide funding to expand the operations of the Community Health Center of Waterbury.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SPECIALIZED LAW ENFORCEMENT TRAINING.
purpose: To provide specialized law enforcement training.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE MANUFACTURING APPRENTICESHIP TAX CREDIT PROGRAM TO OTHER TRAINING PROGRAMS.
purpose: To expand the manufacturing apprenticeship tax credit program to other training programs that address the need for a skilled workforce.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE WORKING GROUP REGARDING THE PROTECTION AND PRESERVATION OF HISTORIC PROPERTIES.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the working group, established pursuant to special act 21-13, regarding the protection and preservation of historic properties.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR MINORITY START-UPS, PUBLIC SERVICES, RECOVERY INITIATIVES AND RESEARCH.
purpose: To provide funding for start-ups to minority entrepreneurs, projects providing public services to minorities, recovery initiatives for minorities and innovative research by minorities.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR SUPPORTING ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT OPPORTUNITIES INTERNATIONALLY.
purpose: To provide funding for the purpose of supporting economic development opportunities internationally for organizations that have successfully initiated and implemented economic development opportunities that benefit the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING YOUTH SERVICE BUREAUS AND JUDICIAL REVIEW BOARDS.
purpose: To revise the policies, programming and operational procedures of youth service bureaus and judicial review boards that are pertinent to courts and civil procedures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLIMATE RESILIENCY FUNDS AND PROJECTS.
purpose: To authorize the Treasurer to invest funds on behalf of municipalities that establish Coastal Resiliency Reserve Funds and to require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to maximize the state's receipt of federal funds for climate resiliency projects undertaken by the state and municipalities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP ON THE RESTORATION OF EEL GRASS.
purpose: To establish a working group to identify ways to restore eel grass along the state's shoreline.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INTENTIONAL RELEASE OF CERTAIN BALLOONS.
purpose: To prohibt the release of helium and lighter-than-air balloons.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDING FOR BIKEWAYS, GREENWAYS AND RECREATIONAL TRAILS.
purpose: To provide funding for bikeways, trails and greenways.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OPEN SPACE AND WATERSHED LAND ACQUISITION GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide funding for the open space and watershed land acquisition grant program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN HARVESTING OF HORSESHOE CRABS.
purpose: To prohibit the hand-harvesting of horseshoe crabs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NATURAL ORGANIC REDUCTION.
purpose: To provide authorization for the use of certain open space as sights for green burials and to authorize the use of natural organic reduction in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY FOR TIRES.
purpose: To establish extended producer responsibility for tires.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENTS OF AGRICULTURE AND ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To study the regulations of the Departments of Agriculture and Energy and Environmental Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CIGARETTES, TOBACCO PRODUCTS, ELECTRONIC NICOTINE DELIVERY SYSTEMS AND VAPOR PRODUCTS.
purpose: To prohibit (1) the sale of flavored cigarettes, tobacco products, electronic nicotine delivery systems and vapor products, and (2) smoking and the use of electronic nicotine delivery systems and vapor products in a motor vehicle while a minor is present in such vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RETIREE MEMBERS OF THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BOARD.
purpose: To increase the number of retired teachers on the Teachers' Retirement Board from two to four.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTION OF MEMBERS TO THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BOARD.
purpose: To reform the procedures for election of members to the Teachers' Retirement Board.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMISSION STANDARDS FOR GAS-POWERED HOME APPLIANCES AND ESTABLISHING A LOAN FUND FOR REPLACEMENT OF SUCH APPLIANCES.
purpose: To reduce emissions from gas-powered home appliances.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE AGENCY CLIMATE-FRIENDLY FOOD PURCHASING PLAN.
purpose: To use the state's procurement power to reduce dependence on foods with a high carbon footprint and discourage food production that degrades earth's resources and that promotes health.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DECOUPLING OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To restructure the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority as a fully independent regulatory agency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF ELECTRIC GRID SECURITY.
purpose: To determine the security of the existing electric grid and examine ways to enhance protection.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING ELECTRIC SERVICE SHUTOFFS DURING SUMMER MONTHS FOR CERTAIN RESIDENTIAL CUSTOMERS.
purpose: To prohibit electric service shutoffs during summer for some economically disadvantaged customers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEST BED TECHNOLOGIES.
purpose: To facilitate the consideration of cost-saving technology by evaluating and testing the technologies at state agencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF ENERGY DATA COLLECTION AND PUBLIC ACCESS.
purpose: To guarantee public access to the data needed to set informed climate targets and accurately monitor progress against such targets.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' TECHNICAL SKILLS FOR SOLAR INSTALLATIONS.
purpose: To consider changes to the technical skills required to professionally install solar panels.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF ENERGY FROM HYDROPOWER FACILITIES.
purpose: To encourage the continuity of existing and future hydroelectric facilities in Connecticut by awarding them power purchase contracts based on the state's standard rate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE HYDROGEN TASK FORCE.
purpose: To consider the recommendations of the state's Hydrogen Task Force.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A BROADBAND DATA BILL OF RIGHTS.
purpose: To facilitate access to broadband performance data to protect consumers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEAT PUMP DRYERS.
purpose: To make heat pump clothes dryers more accessible to consumers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FINANCING PROGRAM FOR RENEWABLE HOME ENERGY PROJECTS.
purpose: To enable seniors on fixed incomes and moderate-income residents with significant debt to finance renewable energy home improvements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCENTIVES FOR RESIDENTIAL HEAT PUMPS, GEOTHERMAL PUMPS AND BATTERY STORAGE.
purpose: To create a state incentive to supplement federal tax credits and further incentivize Connecticut consumers to switch to more environmentally friendly systems.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT PROGRAM FOR MUSICAL AND THEATRICAL PRE-TOUR PRODUCTION COSTS.
purpose: To establish a tax credit program for eligible musical and theatrical production companies for certain pre-tour production costs.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME FOR MARRIED INDIVIDUALS FILING JOINTLY.
purpose: To increase, for married individuals filing jointly, the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONDUCT TOWARD ELECTION OFFICIALS IN POLLING PLACES.
purpose: To prohibit intimidation, harassment or threatening of election officials in polling places and provide for criminal prosecution of anyone engaged in such conduct.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EARLY VOTING AT PRIMARIES.
purpose: To provide for at least one week of early voting at primaries.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRIMARY DAY REGISTRATION.
purpose: To apply election-day registration procedures to primaries.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING SURVIVORS OF HOMICIDE VICTIMS AWARENESS MONTH.
purpose: To support the survivors of homicide by educating and influencing the public about the impact of homicide on families and communities by designating a month that encompasses the holidays.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANDIDATES FOR ELECTIVE OFFICE AND ROBOCALLS.
purpose: To provide that campaigns for candidates for elective office shall not make automated telephone calls to voters between the hours of eight o'clock p.m. and nine o'clock a.m.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RIGHT TO REPAIR CONSUMER ELECTRONICS.
purpose: To establish a right to repair consumer electronics.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEBIT CARDS AND CASH DISCOUNTS FOR GASOLINE PURCHASES.
purpose: To provide that any gasoline seller that offers any discount to induce a consumer to purchase gasoline with cash shall provide the same discount to a consumer who purchases gasoline with a debit card.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANNABIS RETAILERS AND EQUITY JOINT VENTURES.
purpose: To enable certain cannabis retailers to establish additional equity joint ventures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A TAX CREDIT FOR COLLEGE STUDENTS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To provide a tax credit for college students in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LOW INCOME HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM BENEFITS AND VENDOR ACCESS.
purpose: To increase energy assistance benefits to reflect inflation in the fuel market and expand vendor access to small local oil distributors.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING MEDICAID COVERAGE FOR CERTIFIED, REGISTERED DIETITIAN-NUTRITIONIST (RDN) SERVICES PROVIDING MEDICAL NUTRITION THERAPY.
purpose: To address nutrition-related chronic disease and health disparities by ensuring Medicaid beneficiaries have access to medical nutrition therapy.

title: AN ACT CREATING THE FIRST-TIME HOME BUYERS PROGRAM.
purpose: To create the First-Time Home Buyers Program in distressed communities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY ELIMINATING THE PRIOR AUTHORIZATION REQUIREMENT FOR HEALTH INSURANCE POLICIES ISSUED IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To establish a task force to study eliminating the prior authorization requirement for health insurance policies issued in this state to facilitate timely and appropriate care.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR PRENATAL CARE, LABOR AND DELIVERY SERVICES, POSTPARTUM CARE, AND COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH NEONATAL INTENSIVE CARE UNIT STAYS.
purpose: To require health insurers to provide coverage for all costs associated with (1) prenatal care, (2) labor and delivery services, (3) postpartum care, and (4) costs associated with neonatal intensive care unit stays.

title: AN ACT PROTECTING CRITICAL INFRASTRUCTURE.
purpose: To make anyone who attacks or intentionally damages critical infrastructure liable for felony prosecution.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR THE CRIME OF GENITAL MUTILATION.
purpose: To facilitate prosecution of those accused of genital mutilation in the past.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPENSATION FOR PART-TIME MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF PARDONS AND PAROLES.
purpose: To increase the per diem rate of compensation for part-time members of the Board of Pardons and Paroles.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATION IN CIVIL ACTIONS ALLEGING SEXUAL ABUSE, SEXUAL EXPLOITATION OR SEXUAL ASSAULT.
purpose: To eliminate the statute of limitation on bringing a civil action for personal injury caused by sexual abuse, sexual exploitation or sexual assault.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINORITY REPRESENTATION RULE AND CERTAIN MUNICIPAL BODIES.
purpose: To specify that the minority representation rule shall not apply to nonelective and nonappointive municipal bodies.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE MILL RATE CAP FOR MOTOR VEHICLES AND REIMBURSING MUNICIPALITIES FOR LOST REVENUE.
purpose: To reduce the cap for mill rates imposed on motor vehicles to 28 mills and reimburse municipalities for any resulting revenue loss.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DELAYED PROPERTY TAX PAYMENTS AND MUNICIPAL CLERICAL ERRORS.
purpose: To prohibit municipalities from penalizing taxpayers for delayed payment of property tax if such delays were caused by municipal clerical error.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR CERTAIN ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS.
purpose: To permit condominium associations and owners to claim a property tax exemption for electric vehicle charging stations.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING MUNICIPAL OPEN CONTAINER DISTRICTS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to establish "open container" districts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AID IN DYING FOR TERMINALLY ILL PATIENTS.
purpose: To provide aid in dying to terminally ill patients.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE OF FLAVORED TOBACCO PRODUCTS, ELECTRONIC NICOTINE DELIVERY SYSTEMS AND VAPOR PRODUCTS.
purpose: To prohibit the sale of flavored tobacco products, electronic nicotine delivery systems and vapor products.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE IMPACT OF HOSPITAL CONSOLIDATIONS AND THE ACQUISITION OF HOSPITALS BY PRIVATE EQUITY FIRMS.
purpose: To determine whether hospital consolidations and the acquisition of hospitals by private equity firms have a negative impact on health care access quality and cost.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BUILDING AND MAINTENANCE OF PIGSTIES.
purpose: To allow a pigsty to be built or maintained on marshy ground or land subject to overflow, and within three hundred feet of any inhabited house or public meeting house upon property other than that of the proprietor of the pigsty.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING FEMALE GENITAL MUTILATION.
purpose: To end the practice of female genital mutilation.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING MINIMUM STAFFING RATIOS FOR NURSES IN HEALTH CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To prevent nurses from being overworked due to staffing shortages and improve direct patient care and staff morale.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH CONCERNING THE PRACTICE OF PLASMAPHERESIS, CLINICAL LABORATORIES AND BLOOD DONATION CENTERS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To improve Connecticut's regulations concerning plasmapheresis, blood collection and similar procedures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MOBILE NARCOTIC TREATMENT PROGRAM.
purpose: To adjust the policies, permitting and procedures relating to the mobile narcotic treatment program in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRACKING BY POLICE OF CERTAIN PERSONS CONVICTED OF CRIMES OF ABUSE.
purpose: To enable police to track certain persons convicted of domestic violence crimes or other significant abuse.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SHARING AND ANALYSIS OF EMERGENCY CALL RESPONSE DATA.
purpose: To require the sharing of emergency call response data among agencies and allow analysis of data that assists in understanding the impact of changes in the availability of hospital and emergency medical services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To increase access to unique and specialty training opportunities for law enforcement officers seeking continuing education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RADIO EQUIPMENT IN LAW ENFORCEMENT VEHICLES.
purpose: That radio equipment in law enforcement vehicles be capable of scanning frequencies used by law enforcement units in neighboring towns, in order to support mutual aid responses between towns and more easily share information that is time sensitive and might be delayed if shared through traditional mechanisms.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO PROVIDE RECOMMENDATIONS ON POLICE OFFICER, FIREFIGHTER AND FIRST RESPONDER RETENTION AND BENEFITS.
purpose: To improve retention and reduce job turnover in law enforcement, fire safety, emergency services and other first responder fields.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FUNDING OF TRANSIT DISTRICTS IN URBANIZED AREAS.
purpose: To eliminate the provision that limits the amount of funds distributed to transit districts in urbanized areas.

title: AN ACT LIMITING AUTOMOBILE DEALER CONVEYANCE FEES.
purpose: To prohibit a dealer from charging a dealer conveyance fee or processing fee in an amount greater than one per cent of the selling price of the motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FLASHING BLUE LIGHTS BY VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE SERVICES.
purpose: To differentiate the color of flashing lights on a vehicle used by a member of a volunteer ambulance service from a maintenance vehicle owned and operated by the Department of Transportation.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING WRONG-WAY DRIVING COUNTERMEASURES.
purpose: To reduce wrong-way driving.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MILITARY EXPERIENCE OR TRAINING AND CERTAIN OCCUPATIONAL LICENSING REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To allow military experience and training to count toward satisfying certain occupational licensing requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR REGULATION.
purpose: To: (1) Authorize (A) alcoholic liquor manufacturers to enter into alternating proprietorship agreements, and (B) certain liquor permittees to enter into contract manufacturing agreements; (2) establish temporary auction permits; (3) provide that a permitted manufacturer of spirits or beer that also holds a farmers' market sales permit may sell, and offer free tastings of, its spirits or beer at a farmers' market operated as a nonprofit enterprise or association; (4) expand the off-site farm winery sales and wine, cider and mead tasting permit to include additional liquor permittees; (5) eliminate the sunset date concerning the period during which certain liquor permittees may sell liquor in sealed containers for off-premises consumption; (6) replace temporary beer and liquor permits with a temporary liquor permit for noncommercial entities; (7) authorize the Department of Consumer Protection to issue farmers' market sales permits to spirits manufacturers; (8) authorize certain liquor manufacturers that hold out-of-state shipper's permits for beer to engage in additional sales and shipping activities under festival permits; (9) provide that no person who assists an applicant, backer or liquor permittee in submitting an application for a liquor permit shall submit, or cause to be submitted, any false statement in connection with such application, or engage in any conduct which delays or impedes the Department of Consumer Protection in processing such application, provide that submitting any such statement or engaging in any such conduct shall constitute an unfair or deceptive trade practice within the meaning of the Connecticut Unfair Trade Practices Act and authorize the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to impose civil penalties on any person who submits any such statement or engages in any such conduct; (10) provide that a liquor permittee shall be a director, employee, member, officer, partner or shareholder of its backer; (11) provide that the department may summarily suspend a renewed liquor permit if the liquor permittee fails to timely submit a fire marshal certificate to the department; (12) subject beer manufacturers to beer keg identification, receipt and refund requirements; (13) eliminate special club, charitable organization, nonprofit public television corporation and nonprofit corporation permits; and (14) make minor, technical and conforming changes to the Liquor Control Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MODIFICATION OF AND REPEALING OBSOLETE PROVISIONS AND STATUTES RELEVANT TO THE LABOR DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Labor Department by modifying and repealing obsolete provisions and statutes relevant to the Labor Department.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICE OF DISCONTINUANCE OF PRESCRIPTION MEDICATION UNDER A WORKERS' COMPENSATION CLAIM.
purpose: To require employers or insurers acting on behalf of employers to (1) provide notice of a proposed discontinuance or reduction of coverage of an employee's prescription medication, and (2) obtain approval before such discontinuance or reduction takes effect.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STANDARD WAGES FOR CERTAIN SERVICE WORKERS AND PAID LEAVE.
purpose: To require employers with state contracts or agreements to provide certain service workers with paid leave.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT RETIREMENT SECURITY PROGRAM.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Comptroller concerning the administration of the Connecticut Retirement Security Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENTS AND AMBULANCE COMPANIES AND THE DEFINITION OF EMPLOYER UNDER THE STATE OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT.
purpose: To ensure volunteer fire departments and ambulance companies are considered under CONN-OSHA jurisdiction.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR CERTAIN HOMELESSNESS RESPONSE PROGRAMS.
purpose: To provide funding for certain homelessness response programs.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A COMMISSION ON HOMELESSNESS.
purpose: To establish the Commission on Homelessness.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ONLINE PUBLICATION OF LEGAL NOTICES BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To permit the posting of advertisements of legal notices on municipal Internet web sites.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY OWNED BY A BUSINESS ORGANIZATION THAT IS EXEMPT FROM THE PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To increase the amount of tangible personal property owned by a business organization that is exempt from the property tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR CERTAIN FIRST-TIME HOME BUYERS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to abate up to five hundred dollars per assessment year of property taxes for certain first-time homebuyers who obtain a loan from the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ZONING REGULATIONS AND COMMUNITY RESIDENCES.
purpose: To repeal certain provisions related to community residences.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES UNDER THE OVERSIGHT OF THE MUNICIPAL ACCOUNTABILITY REVIEW BOARD.
purpose: To require (1) legislative approval of certain contracts executed between the Office of Policy and Management, the Treasurer and certain municipalities under the oversight of the Municipal Accountability Review Board, and (2) the Auditors of Public Accounts to conduct annual audits of such municipalities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE FOR THE PROTECTION OF YOUTH AND INTRAMURAL AND INTERSCHOLASTIC ATHLETES.
purpose: To establish a task force to study injury prevention practices and safety protocols in youth sports leagues and intramural and interscholastic athletics.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TELEHEALTH.
purpose: To allow out-of-state health care providers to provide telehealth in the state on a permanent basis.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AGE OF ELIGIBILITY FOR THE POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION FUNDING PROGRAM OFFERED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES AND ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE FOR THE POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION OF ADOPTED YOUTH.
purpose: To increase the age for eligibility for the postsecondary education funding program offered by the Department of Children and Families from the age of twenty-one to twenty-six years of age and the age at which a postsecondary education program must be completed from the age of twenty-three to twenty-eight years of age.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE UNFUNDED PENSION LIABILITY PORTION OF THE FRINGE BENEFIT COST FOR EMPLOYEES OF THE CONSTITUENT UNITS OF THE STATE SYSTEM OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To require the Comptroller to fund the unfunded pension liability portion of the fringe benefit cost for employees of the constituent units of the state system of higher education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PLAN OF THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION CONCERNING THE NUMBER OF CHILD CARE CENTERS NEAR CAMPUSES.
purpose: To extend the deadline by which the Board of Regent's for Higher Education is required to submit a plan to increase the number and improve the quality of child care centers near campuses and to include additional requirements for such plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REPORTING FOR THE DEBT-FREE COMMUNITY COLLEGE PROGRAM.
purpose: To postpone the fall semester reporting deadline required under the debt-free community college program from October first to November first annually.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION TO ESTABLISH A POLICY REGARDING FREEDOM OF EXPRESSION ON CAMPUS.
purpose: To require public institutions of higher education to establish a policy regarding freedom of expression on campus.

title: AN ACT LIMITING SCHOLARSHIP DISPLACEMENT.
purpose: To prohibit institutions of higher education from reducing the amount of institutional financial aid or grant under the Roberta B. Willis Scholarship program awarded to a student as a result of such student receiving a scholarship.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINIMUM AGE TO BE ELIGIBLE TO MARRY.
purpose: To require that a person be not less than eighteen years of age to be eligible to marry.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DAMAGES TO PERSON OR PROPERTY CAUSED BY THE NEGLIGENT OPERATION OF A MOTOR VEHICLE OWNED BY A POLITICAL SUBDIVISION OF THE STATE.
purpose: To provide that governmental immunity is not a defense in a civil action for damages to person or property caused by the negligent operation of a motor vehicle owned by a political subdivision of the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF THE COURT TO ENTER AN ORDER OF SUPPORT FOR AN ADULT CHILD WHO HAS AN INTELLECTUAL OR MENTAL DISABILITY OR WHO IS PHYSICALLY DISABLED.
purpose: To permit a court to make appropriate orders of support for a person age twenty-six or under who has an intellectual or mental disability or who is physically disabled.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CREATION OF A STATE POLICE INVESTIGATIVE TASK FORCE TO ADDRESS ONLINE SEXUAL EXPLOITATION AND ABUSE OF MINORS.
purpose: To establish a state police sting operations unit to address online sexual abuse of minors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO DIAPER CHANGING TABLES IN PUBLIC BUILDINGS AND PLACES OF PUBLIC ACCOMMODATION.
purpose: To require the revision of the State Building Code to require baby diaper changing tables in certain new construction or substantial renovation projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL YOUTH CAMPS.
purpose: To specify that certain programs and activities advertised or operated by municipal departments shall be licensed as youth camps by the Office of Early Childhood.

title: AN ACT ENCOURAGING SOCIALIZATION FOR NURSING HOME RESIDENTS BY PROVIDING TRANSPORTATION FOR VISITS WITH FAMILY.
purpose: To increase socialization opportunities for nonambulatory nursing home residents by authorizing nursing homes to provide transportation for such residents to visit nearby family and establishing a grant program within available appropriations to pay for such transportation.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING SUPPORT FOR GRANDPARENTS AND OTHER NONPARENT RELATIVES RAISING CHILDREN.
purpose: To enhance the quality of life and reduce the effects of trauma on children by supporting grandparents and other nonparent relatives who are raising them.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM RATES.
purpose: To (1) allow an income tax deduction for long-term care insurance premiums, (2) require the Insurance Department to hold a public hearing for long-term care premium rate increase requests that exceed ten per cent, and (3) require that policyholders are provided advance notice of such hearing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AIR CONDITIONING IN NURSING HOMES.
purpose: To require nursing homes to have air conditioning in each resident's room and establish a loan program to provide loans to nursing homes to comply with such requirement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF THE CRISIS INITIATIVE PILOT PROGRAM THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Division of State Police to expand the CRISIS Initiative pilot program to all areas of the state.

title: AN ACT REVISING REQUIREMENTS FOR THE AFFIDAVIT RELATED TO SMOKE AND CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTORS IN RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS.
purpose: To revise requirements of the smoke and carbon monoxide detector affidavit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY INTERVENTION BY A POLICE OFFICER WHEN A PERSON IS INCAPACITATED BY DRUGS OR DUE TO A MEDICAL EMERGENCY.
purpose: To allow a police officer to take a person who appears to be incapacitated by drugs or due to a medical emergency into protective custody and have such person brought to a treatment facility or hospital.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PILOT PROGRAM REGARDING ADDICTION SERVICES EXPERTS AT POLICE DEPARTMENTS.
purpose: To establish a pilot program to provide funding to law enforcement units to hire addiction services experts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF EMERGENCY LIGHTS BY A CONSTABLE OR A MEMBER OF A VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE ASSOCIATION OR COMPANY.
purpose: To allow volunteer ambulance associations and company members to use blue, rather than green, lights on their vehicles and permit elected constables to use red lights on their vehicles while involved in traffic direction operations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT EXPENSES TAX CREDIT FOR PASS-THROUGH ENTITIES.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for research and development expenses of pass-through entities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY TO PROMOTE WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT USING THE GLOBAL ENTREPRENEUR IN RESIDENCE PROGRAM AS A MODEL.
purpose: To establish a working group to conduct a study and make recommendations regarding the feasibility of leveraging the H1-B visa cap exemption process to fill high-value job openings and promote workforce development, using the Global Entrepreneur In Residence program as a model.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUPPLEMENTAL NUTRITION ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To (1) adjust distribution of supplemental nutrition assistance benefits so that beneficiaries receive monthly benefits at multiple intervals during the month, and (2) ensure persons who received recent increases in Social Security payments don't lose such benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY MEDICAID COVERAGE OF DIAPERS AND OTHER HEALTH-RELATED SOCIAL NEEDS.
purpose: To provide Medicaid coverage, to the extent permissible under federal law, for diapers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENT STABILIZATION.
purpose: To prohibit a landlord from increasing rent during the first year of a tenancy and during a public health emergency or by more than a certain calculated amount on an annual basis, and to require a landlord provide written notice to a tenant not less than ninety days prior to increasing the rent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENT STABILIZATION IN MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOME PARKS.
purpose: To prohibit an owner of any mobile manufactured home park from increasing rent by more than four per cent plus the consumer price index on an annual basis or during a declared public health emergency and one year following the expiration of such emergency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN PROTECTIONS FOR GROUP AND FAMILY CHILD CARE HOMES.
purpose: To (1) clarify and enforce protections for licensed group child care homes and licensed family child care homes, (2) prevent landlords from placing restrictions on the operation of licensed group child care homes and licensed family child care homes, and (3) provide certain protections to landlords when their property is utilized by operators of licensed group child care homes and licensed family child care homes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONFIDENTIALITY OF CONSUMER COMPLAINTS REGARDING MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOME PARKS.
purpose: To require the Department of Consumer Protection to disclose records of an investigation or examination concerning a mobile manufactured home park during the pendency of any such investigation or examination.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONSIDERATION OF HOUSING NEEDS FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES IN MUNICIPAL AFFORDABLE HOUSING PLANS.
purpose: To require municipalities to consider accessibility improvements for affordable housing units for individuals with developmental disabilities in the adoption of affordable housing plans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING AUTHORITY JURISDICTION.
purpose: To allow a housing authority to expand its jurisdiction to include other municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONCOMPETE AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To set certain requirements for covenants not to compete and exclusivity agreements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN HISTORIC PRESERVATION TOOLKIT AND A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF AN HISTORIC PRESERVATION REVOLVING LOAN FUND PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study arts, culture and tourism issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY BY CONNECTICUT INNOVATIONS, INCORPORATED OF PRIVATE EQUITY INVESTMENT.
purpose: To require Connecticut Innovations, Incorporated to study private equity investment in the state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE BROWNFIELD REMEDIATION AND REVITALIZATION PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study infrastructure improvement issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSIDERATION OF CONTRIBUTORY NEGLIGENCE CAUSED BY A PERSON'S FAILURE TO WEAR A SEAT SAFETY BELT.
purpose: To permit consideration of a person's failure to wear a seat safety belt in violation of section 14-100a of the general statutes as contributory negligence in a civil action.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INTIMATE PARTNER VIOLENCE AND OTHER DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To combat intimate partner violence and other domestic violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR REGIONAL BEHAVIORAL HEALTH ACTION ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To ensure there is adequate funding for regional behavioral health action organizations.

title: AN ACT DECLARING HOMELESSNESS A PUBLIC HEALTH CRISIS.
purpose: To declare homelessness a public health crisis in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNERAL DIRECTORS AND FUNERAL HOMES.
purpose: To (1) give equal access to the electronic death registry system to funeral directors licensed in the state who have an out-of-state facility, (2) increase the availability of funeral services by allowing licensed funeral directors to not employ a full-time licensed embalmer if such funeral director is not the owner or part-owner of a funeral home, funeral service business or other establishment engaged in the practice of embalming, and (3) ensure healthy and safe practices in funeral homes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REDUCTION IN DUPLICATIVE HEALTH INSPECTIONS.
purpose: To reduce duplicative health inspections.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE BREAST AND CERVICAL CANCER EARLY DETECTION AND TREATMENT REFERRAL PROGRAM TO INCLUDE LUNG CANCER SCREENING.
purpose: To expand the breast and cervical cancer early detection and treatment referral program to include lung cancer screening.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRIMARY AREA SERVICE RESPONDERS.
purpose: To allow each municipality within a primary service area to designate the primary service area responder and establish a process by which a municipality may apply to the Department of Public Health for designation as a primary service area.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF CERTAIN PRODUCTS MADE FROM POLYSTYRENE.
purpose: To eliminate the use of school trays made from polystyrene and prohibit the use of certain polystyrene food containers by restaurants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NIGHTTIME LIGHTING OF STATE-OWNED BUILDINGS AT CERTAIN TIMES FOR THE PROTECTION OF BIRDS.
purpose: To require state-owned and leased buildings to turn off nonessential outdoor lighting during peak avian migration periods in order to assist in preventing birds from flying into the sides of such buildings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISTRIBUTION OF SINGLE-USE PLASTIC STRAWS AND STIRRERS BY CERTAIN RESTAURANTS.
purpose: To curtail the distribution of single-use plastic straws at certain restaurants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY FOR SMOKE DETECTORS.
purpose: To determine the need for extended producer responsibility for smoke detectors in order to keep potential hazardous wastes out of the solid waste stream and facilitate consumer disposal of such expired devices.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING "NO NET LOSS" OF STATE FORESTLANDS.
purpose: To hold state agencies accountable for any loss of state forestlands caused by their functions and operations through replanting plans and compensation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ON-LINE DOG LICENSES FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE.
purpose: To authorize the issuance of on-line dog licenses from the Department of Agriculture in addition to the current town clerk process for receiving such licenses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONPROFIT HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES PROVIDERS.
purpose: To ensure nonprofit health and human services providers contracting with state agencies may retain savings realized from contracted amounts and receive adequate compensation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRONIC ADVERTISEMENTS BY SKILLED TRADESPERSONS AND HOME IMPROVEMENT CONTRACTORS.
purpose: To provide that a skilled tradesperson or home improvement contractor is not required to disclose such tradesperson's or contractor's license or registration number in an electronic advertisement, but instead is required to include in any such advertisement the address of an Internet web site where a member of the public may view such license or registration number.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEBIT CARDS AND CASH DISCOUNTS FOR GASOLINE PURCHASES.
purpose: To: (1) Provide that no gasoline retailer may offer a discount to induce a buyer to purchase gasoline with cash unless such gasoline retailer also offers such discount to a buyer who purchases gasoline with a debit card; and (2) require certain gasoline retailers to publicly display and maintain any signs the Commissioner of Consumer Protection requires to inform the public that, if a discount is offered to a buyer who purchases gasoline with cash, any payment for gasoline by debit card shall be processed at the cash price per gallon.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOG RACING.
purpose: To eliminate various provisions concerning dog racing in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPANSION OF HUSKY HEALTH BENEFITS TO THOSE INELIGIBLE DUE TO IMMIGRATION STATUS.
purpose: To expand medical assistance to otherwise eligible persons regardless of immigration status.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING EQUITY IN COVERAGE FOR FERTILITY HEALTH CARE.
purpose: To provide equitable health insurance coverage for fertility health care to privately insured individuals and individuals insured through Medicaid.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL ASSISTANCE FOR CERTAIN PERSONS RECEIVING ABORTION CARE AND RELATED SERVICES IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To provide state-administered medical assistance for certain out-of-state residents receiving abortion care and related services in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROHIBITING PAY FOR DELAY.
purpose: To preserve consumer access to affordable generic drugs.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING COMPETITION IN CONTRACTS BETWEEN HEALTH CARRIERS AND HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To exclude the following in contracts between health carriers and health care providers: (1) All-or-nothing clauses; (2) anti-steering clauses; (3) anti-tiering clauses; (4) gag clauses; and (5) most-favored health carrier or health plan administrator clauses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RENEWAL OF SURPLUS LINES INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To exclude the signed statement requirement for a licensee who renews a policy with an unauthorized insurer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTIFICATION OR ACCREDITATION REQUIREMENT DEADLINES FOR A LAW ENFORCEMENT UNIT THAT SERVES A MUNICIPALITY AND CONSISTS SOLELY OF CONSTABLES OR RESIDENT STATE TROOPERS.
purpose: To delay, by one year, certification or accreditation requirements for a law enforcement unit that serves a municipality and consists solely of constables or resident state troopers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING BETWEEN THE COMMISSIONER OF EMERGENCY SERVICES AND PUBLIC PROTECTION AND CENTRAL CONNECTICUT STATE UNIVERSITY FOR POLICE DETECTIVE AND OTHER TRAINING.
purpose: To require a memorandum of understanding between the Commissioner of Emergency Services and Public Protection and Central Connecticut State University regarding the development of a forensic science laboratory and training programs aimed at detectives and other police officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RETIRED POLICE AND PAROLE OFFICERS PROVIDING SCHOOL SECURITY AND PEACE OFFICERS CARRYING FIREARMS ON SCHOOL PROPERTY.
purpose: To expand the types of retired officers who may provide armed security in schools and allow peace officers to carry firearms on school grounds at any time.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A RED LIGHT CAMERA PROGRAM IN THE CITY OF WATERBURY.
purpose: To authorize a red light camera program in the city of Waterbury.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE.
purpose: To establish a program of all-inclusive care for the elderly and require the Commissioner of Correction to conduct sex offender background checks and registration, if required, of any former inmate transferred to a nursing home facility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL'S PROPOSED REMEDIES FOR DEFICIENT LONG-TERM CARE.
purpose: To establish civil penalties to be enforced by the Attorney General for deficient long-term care resulting in bodily injury or potential to result in bodily injury.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID COVERAGE OF BIOMARKER TESTING.
purpose: To improve treatments for cancer and other conditions and diseases by approving Medicaid coverage for biomarker testing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEMPORARY FAMILY ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To extend the time limit for temporary family assistance to sixty months and to gradually reduce benefits for newly employed beneficiaries to encourage employment.

title: AN ACT INCREASING HUSKY C ASSET AND INCOME LIMITS.
purpose: To increase income and asset limits for medical assistance applicants and enrollees who are age sixty-five and older, have disabilities or are blind.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP ACT.
purpose: To specify that the provision of a notice required under the Common Interest Ownership Act shall not be deemed to constitute a violation of, or give rise to liability under, certain debt collection statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AFFORDABLE HOMEOWNERSHIP OPPORTUNITIES.
purpose: To allow the Commissioner of Housing to consider affordable homeownership opportunities as an exemption from the prohibition against selling, demolishing or otherwise disposing of housing authority projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A NEEDS ASSESSMENT AND FAIR SHARE PLANS FOR MUNICIPALITIES TO INCREASE AFFORDABLE HOUSING.
purpose: To (1) require an assessment of the state-wide need for affordable housing and an allocation of such need to planning regions and municipalities, (2) require the creation of fair share plans for each municipality, and (3) establish penalties for municipalities that fail to submit fair share plans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SITE OF SERVICE REIMBURSEMENTS.
purpose: To require that a seller of residential property provide notification of proper permitting to a prospective buyer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOG BREED INSURANCE UNDERWRITING AND LIABILITY OF OWNERS AND KEEPERS OF DOGS.
purpose: To prohibit homeowners' insurance and renters' insurance policies from discriminating based on harboring or owning any dog of a specific breed or mixture of breeds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF CRIME VICTIMS WHEN STANDING CRIMINAL PROTECTIVE ORDERS ARE IN EFFECT.
purpose: To ensure that the Board of Pardons and Paroles is not issuing pardons in matters involving crime victims who are protected by standing criminal protective orders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CRIME VICTIM'S PARTICIPATORY RIGHTS IN A VIOLATION OF PROBATION OR CONDITIONAL DISCHARGE HEARING.
purpose: To ensure that a crime victim has participatory rights in any hearing concerning a violation of probation or conditional discharge involving the person who committed the criminal act.

title: AN ACT REVISING THE STATE'S ANTIDISCRIMINATION STATUTES.
purpose: To provide consistency in the listing of protected classes in the state's antidiscrimination statutes and revise the statutory definition of "sexual orientation".

title: AN ACT ENSURING TIMELY SCHEDULING OF TEMPORARY FINANCIAL SUPPORT HEARINGS IN DIVORCE AND CUSTODY PROCEEDINGS.
purpose: To ensure timely scheduling of temporary financial support hearings in divorce and custody proceedings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOME VISITS AND EVALUATIONS BY THE COMMISSIONER OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To prohibit home visits and evaluations by the Commissioner of Children and Families by telephonic, video or other conferencing platform in certain circumstances.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PROOF OF AGE FOR PURCHASE OF LOTTERY TICKETS.
purpose: To require sellers of lottery tickets to require purchasers to provide proof of age.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A TITLE IX COMPLIANCE TOOLKIT FOR SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To identify or develop a federal Title IX compliance toolkit to assist school districts in properly implementing state and federal laws regarding the prevention, identification and response to adult sexual misconduct.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE PROVISION OF MENTAL HEALTH WELLNESS EXAMINATIONS.
purpose: To authorize Medicaid reimbursement for suicide risk assessments and other mental health evaluations and services conducted at school-based health centers and public schools, and to eliminate the requirement that a mental health wellness examination be conducted by a primary care provider for purposes of insurance coverage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISTRIBUTION OF INFORMATION REGARDING SPECIAL EDUCATION TO FAMILIES AND STUDENTS.
purpose: To require birth-to-three service coordinators to provide information regarding special education to the parents and guardians of children receiving birth-to-three program services and to require the Department of Education to develop an age-appropriate informational handout for students with individualized education programs and 504 plans.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTAL NOTIFICATION OF CERTAIN EVENTS BY FACILITIES PROVIDING INPATIENT PSYCHIATRIC, BEHAVIORAL HEALTH AND SUBSTANCE ABUSE TREATMENT SERVICES TO CHILDREN.
purpose: To require inpatient psychiatric and behavioral health treatment facilities licensed by the Department of Children and Families and the Department of Public Health to notify parents and guardians of children receiving treatment in such facilities of certain circumstances and events in and concerning such facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTIFICATES OF APPROVAL FOR MOTOR VEHICLE DEALERSHIPS AND REPAIR SHOPS.
purpose: To specify that applicants for licenses for dealing in or repairing motor vehicles shall obtain certificates of approval of location and use from the zoning commission of the municipality.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE PLAN OF CONSERVATION AND DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To amend certain requirements concerning the state plan of conservation and development.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE ONLINE RECORDING, INDEXING AND SEARCHING OF MUNICIPAL LAND RECORDS AND MAPS.
purpose: To require the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to (1) establish a commission for the online recording, indexing and searching of municipal land records and maps, and (2) create and maintain an online database for the recording, indexing and searching of municipal land records and maps.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GRANT FUNDING FOR REGIONAL COUNCILS OF GOVERNMENTS.
purpose: To permit regional councils of governments to apply for participation in certain municipal grant programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC ACCESS TO CERTAIN COASTAL RESOURCES.
purpose: To (1) clarify that certain goals and policies concerning coastal management shall apply to all public coastal resources, and (2) prohibit municipalities from restricting nonresident access to municipal parks and beaches that are accessible to residents or imposing fees for such access that are greater than fifty per cent of any fees charged to residents.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE IMPACT OF UNCLAIMED OR ABANDONED REAL PROPERTY ON MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To require the Office of Policy and Management to establish a working group to study the consequences of unclaimed or abandoned real property on the municipalities in which such property is located.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO STATUTES CONCERNING PLANNING AND DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To make minor and technical revisions to statutes concerning planning and development.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING EMAIL NOTICES OF THE EXPIRATION OF CERTAIN FIREARM PERMITS AND CERTIFICATES AND SECURITY OFFICER LICENSES.
