title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE EDUCATION STATUTES RELATED TO EDUCATOR COMPENSATION AND PARAEDUCATORS.
purpose: To (1) exclude mandated trainings from professional development programs for paraeducators, (2) include a paraeducator on professional development and evaluation committees, (3) require the collection of data concerning paraeducators on the state-wide public school information system, (4) require an annual report on paraeducator staffing levels, (5) require paraeducators to review a student's individualized education program with a supervisor, as needed, (6) require the establishment of a grant program to supplement teacher and paraeducator salaries, (7) establish a minimum salary for teachers and paraeducators, (8) require boards of education to (A) offer the Municipal Employee Health Insurance Plan to paraeducators, and (B) pay the employee contribution required under a retirement system for paraeducators, and (9) require the state to pay not less than fifty per cent of the cost to boards of education for providing the Municipal Employee Health Insurance Plan and for paying the employee contribution for retirement benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EDUCATION MANDATE RELIEF AND OTHER TECHNICAL AND ASSORTED REVISIONS AND ADDITIONS TO THE EDUCATION AND EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION STATUTES.
purpose: To (1) require the Department of Education to conduct a review of the education laws every two years to identify obsolete and duplicative mandates on the department and boards of education; (2) establish the Education Mandates Review Task Force to review and make recommendations concerning the repeal of or amendment to education mandates that are overly burdensome; (3) align existing in-service training requirements concerning school violence prevention training with those required under school security and safety plans; and (4) eliminate the completion of a capstone project as part of the high school graduation requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STUDENTS WITH DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.
purpose: To (1) establish an Office of Transition Services and an Office of Mediation Services within the Department of Education, (2) increase the age until which a student can receive special education services from twenty-one to twenty-two, (3) allow translators to attend planning and placement team meetings and for the individualized education program and other documents to be translated to the primary language of the student or family, (4) require coordination with agencies that provide programs for adults when a student turns fourteen years old, (5) require the publication of a plain language resource explaining the process for hearing complaints and of the decisions made from complaint hearings, (6) require the Department of Education to conduct random audits of special education programs, and (7) require the development of educator in-service training on the laws governing planning and placement team meetings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECRUITMENT, RETENTION AND ENHANCEMENT OF THE TEACHING PROFESSION.
purpose: To enhance the teaching profession in the state of Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID PAYMENT RATES.
purpose: To increase Medicaid payment rates for services provided by individual, fee-for-service providers and emergency medical transportation providers to Medicare rates for the same services and require a study of Medicaid payment rates for certain long-term acute care hospitals and methadone maintenance providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE CIVIL PROCEDURE LAWS OF THIS STATE.
purpose: To require a study of the civil procedure laws of this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADDITIONAL LEGAL PROTECTIONS FOR VICTIMS OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To (1) permit a sentence of life imprisonment without the possibility of release for those who commit murder in the course of a family violence crime, (2) prohibit the Board of Pardons and Paroles from taking any action in matters involving a conviction for murder with special circumstances, (3) provide for state-wide expansion of the electronic monitoring program for those who violate restraining orders and protective orders, (4) require the Victim Services Unit of the Department of Correction to provide certain information to enhance the safety of persons protected under court orders, and (5) ensure meaningful participation by the Office of the Victim Advocate on behalf of a victim of domestic violence in court proceedings relating to the acts of domestic violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING JUVENILE JUSTICE.
purpose: To implement various juvenile justice policy changes, including (1) expansion of the community-based diversion system, (2) expansion of the use of automatic prearrest diversion of children, (3) expansion of the membership of the Juvenile Justice Policy and Oversight Committee to include new members and funding for stipends for such members for childcare and transportation costs incurred due to their service on the committee, (4) development, implementation and funding for a comprehensive commissary implementation plan, (5) development of a reentry success plan, (6) full implementation of the plan to transition any person under eighteen years of age from the care and custody of the Department of Correction to the care and custody of the Judicial Branch, and (7) expansion of the Alvin W. Penn Racial Profiling Prohibition Act to address pedestrian stops.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILDREN FROM FAMILIES WITH SERVICE NEEDS.
purpose: To: (1) Require a case of a child accused of certain offenses to be adjudicated in the court in the geographical area in which the offense is alleged to have occurred, (2) require mandatory fingerprinting of a child arrested for certain offenses, (3) limit a child's release to a parent who lacks control over a child, (4) provide for automatic transfer to the regular criminal docket of a child who is at least fifteen years of age charged with a serious juvenile offense, (5) permit the court to order a Department of Children and Families investigation into the family circumstances of a juvenile charged with certain offenses, (6) restore the family with service needs petition process and include a child who is truant in the "family with service needs" definition, (7) allow the court to order restitution in motor vehicle theft cases, (8) allow for victim compensation in the case of property crimes committed by a juvenile, and (9) require a study of the implementation of victim impact panels in juvenile delinquency proceedings and, if feasible, implementation of such panels.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING QUALIFYING TRANSIT-ORIENTED COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To (1) provide financial incentives for municipalities that adopt certain transit-oriented development policies and to coordinate related state funds through the Office of Responsible Growth, and (2) establish the Office of Responsible Growth.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELECTRONIC PAYMENT OF MUNICIPAL TAXES.
purpose: To allow municipalities to accept property tax payments by electronic payment services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL BLIGHT ORDINANCES AND THE FINE FOR LITTERING.
purpose: To (1) remove the municipal population threshold for certain parties to petition the Superior Court for the appointment of a receiver for a blighted and abandoned property, (2) allow municipalities to enact blight ordinances concerning both residential and commercial real property, (3) increase the permissible fines for blight ordinance violations, (4) increase the fine for littering to five hundred dollars, (5) reduce notice requirements to lienors when a municipality remediates certain code violations, and (6) remove certain blight violations from the infractions list.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN ADJUSTMENTS TO GROSS ASSESSMENTS OF TAXABLE REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the development of vacant lots depicted on subdivision or resubdivision plans filed with municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTIFICATES OF NEED.
purpose: To require an evaluation of the certificate of need application process.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIREARMS AND STREET TAKEOVERS.
purpose: To require a study of the criminal laws of this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EARLY CHILDHOOD.
purpose: To study issues concerning early childhood.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MOBILE NARCOTIC TREATMENT PROGRAM.
purpose: To require a report on the Mobile Narcotic Treatment Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS FROM THE JUUL LABS SETTLEMENT.
purpose: To require the Attorney General to report on the expenditure of funds from the Juul Labs settlement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS BY THE LEGISLATIVE OFFICE OF FISCAL ANALYSIS TO CERTAIN EDUCATION DATA.
purpose: To allow the legislative Office of Fiscal Analysis to access certain education data.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRANSFORMING CHILDREN'S BEHAVIORAL HEALTH POLICY AND PLANNING COMMITTEE.
purpose: To change the name of the committee to reference children and to change the committee chair appointments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDENT LOAN REIMBURSEMENT PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a loan reimbursement pilot program for Connecticut residents in certain professions who graduated from a state college or university.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING YOUTH SERVICE BUREAUS AND ESTABLISHMENT OF A JUVENILE DIVERSIONARY PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the development of a juvenile diversionary program and make changes to the statute concerning youth service bureaus.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OVERSIGHT OF AND REQUIREMENTS FOR CERTAIN CONTRACTS OF THE CONNECTICUT PORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To prohibit construction managers on a quasi-public agency project from self-performing work on such project and to prohibit quasi-public agencies from entering into contracts or agreements for success fees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAMPAIGN FINANCE.
purpose: To (1) specify that certain online solicitations for political contributions are excluded from the definition of "expenditure", (2) increase the limit on contributions to state central committees, and (3) allow extensions to the required dismissal time frame for investigations by the State Elections Enforcement Commission concerning foreign spending and independent expenditures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE CONTRACTING AND THE DISPENSING, SALE AND DISTRIBUTION OF CERTAIN PHARMACEUTICALS.
purpose: To require entities to annually certify whether they have an official policy of refusing to dispense, sell or distribute certain pharmaceuticals in other states and to prohibit state and quasi-public agencies and municipalities from entering into a contract with any entity that has such a policy unless based upon a supported claim that such dispensing, sale or distribution is illegal in a state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEMBER PARTICIPATION DURING REMOTE AND HYBRID MUNICIPAL PUBLIC AGENCY MEETINGS UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To require members participating at a municipal public agency meeting by means of electronic equipment to be visible when voting or debating.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT PORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To make technical changes to a provision concerning the Connecticut Port Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRESIDENTIAL PREFERENCE PRIMARIES AND DEADLINES FOR MINOR PARTY NOMINATIONS.
purpose: To move up (1) the date of the presidential preference primary in years when the President of the United States is to be elected, and (2) the deadline for minor parties to certify their nominations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE AGENCY COMMUNICATIONS RELEVANT TO THE LATIN AMERICAN COMMUNITY.
purpose: To require state agencies to solicit feedback from members of a community before using terminology to describe such community.

title: AN ACT RESTORING THE CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) increase grant amounts for gubernatorial candidates, (2) modify the consumer price index adjustments for grant amounts and maximum individual contribution amounts across the Citizens' Election Program, as well as for organization expenditure amounts, (3) authorize adequate funding of the program, (4) provide grants in the event of adjourned primaries and court-ordered new elections or primaries, (5) establish in-state contributor thresholds for the qualifying amounts state-wide candidates are required to raise, (6) provide that certain supplemental campaign finance statements shall satisfy certain filing requirements, and (7) specify that individual contributions under the program may not exceed already-established contribution limits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROHIBITION ON CERTAIN CONTRIBUTIONS OR SOLICITATIONS OF CONTRIBUTIONS BY LOBBYISTS.
purpose: To make technical changes to a provision concerning ethics.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONDISCLOSURE OF INFORMATION REGARDING AND CONDUCT TOWARD CERTAIN ELECTION WORKERS.
purpose: To (1) allow certain election workers to request that their residential addresses be exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act, and (2) prohibit certain intimidating or harassing conduct toward election workers performing election-related duties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPIOIDS.
purpose: To combat the opioid pandemic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDS IN THE OPIOID AND TOBACCO SETTLEMENT FUNDS AND FUNDS RECEIVED BY THE STATE AS PART OF ANY SETTLEMENT AGREEMENT WITH A MANUFACTURER OF ELECTRONIC NICOTINE DELIVERY SYSTEM AND VAPOR PRODUCTS.
purpose: To make various revisions to the statutes concerning the use of funds in the opioid and tobacco settlement funds and funds received by the state as part of any settlement agreement with a manufacturer of electronic nicotine delivery system and vapor products.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANNABIS USE PREVENTION EFFORTS RELATED TO YOUTH.
purpose: To prevent cannabis use by youth.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CORRECTION ADVISORY COMMITTEE.
purpose: To require that any member of the Correction Advisory Committee who is employed by the Department of Correction while serving on said committee be a nonvoting member of said committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE CRIMINAL LAW AND CRIMINAL JUSTICE STATUTES.
purpose: To make various revisions to the criminal law and criminal justice statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ERASURE OF CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORDS.
purpose: To update and make technical and clarifying changes to the criminal history records erasure statutes and clarify liability issues concerning failure to erase criminal history records.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR CERTAIN PRE-BROADWAY AND POST-BROADWAY THEATER PRODUCTIONS.
purpose: To establish a credit for certain expenditures of accredited theater productions at qualifying production facilities in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HISTORIC HOMES REHABILITATION TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To authorize the historic home rehabilitation tax credit to be taken against the tax under chapter 229 or 208a of the general statutes, as applicable, and sunset the credit against the current enumerated taxes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AMOUNT OF THE APPRENTICESHIP TAX CREDIT FOR THE CONSTRUCTION TRADES AND APPRENTICESHIP REPORTING DATA.
purpose: To increase the amount of the apprenticeship tax credit for the construction trades.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BUSINESS OPERATING LOSS CARRY-OVER PERIOD.
purpose: To allow business operating losses incurred in income years commencing on or after January 1, 2024, to be deductible over thirty income years.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES ON AMBULANCE-TYPE MOTOR VEHICLES AND AMBULANCES.
purpose: To exempt ambulance-type motor vehicles and ambulances from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ASSIGNMENT OF FUNDS IN QUALIFIED ESCROW FUNDS AND THE APPOINTMENT OF AN AGENT BY CERTAIN TOBACCO PRODUCT MANUFACTURERS.
purpose: To authorize tobacco product manufacturers and their transferees to assign funds in qualified escrow funds to the state and to require nonparticipating tobacco product manufacturers to appoint an agent in this state for service of process.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CHILDREN'S CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR, PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT AND JOB-RELATED AND PERSONNEL TRAINING SERVICES FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt children's clothing and footwear, personal protective equipment and job-related and personnel training services from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR CERTAIN HOME HEALTH CARE EXPENSES.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for certain home health care expenses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN ADDITIONAL TAX CREDIT FOR CERTAIN CORPORATIONS FOR INVESTMENTS IN FIXED CAPITAL.
purpose: To establish an additional credit against the corporation business tax for certain corporations for investments in fixed capital.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX TREATMENT OF CERTAIN STUDENT LOAN FORGIVENESS AMOUNTS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for certain student loan forgiveness amounts includable as gross income for federal income tax purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FILM AND DIGITAL MEDIA PRODUCTION TAX CREDITS.
purpose: To (1) increase the amount of the film and digital media production tax credits to be claimed against the sales tax under certain circumstances, and (2) require eligible production companies to report information concerning job creation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES' RETIREMENT SYSTEM, A DEFERRED RETIREMENT OPTION FOR PARTICIPATING MEMBERS AND THE DEVELOPMENT OF BEST PRACTICES FOR GOVERNANCE STRUCTURES OF MUNICIPAL RETIREMENT PLANS.
purpose: To (1) require municipalities to provide certain information to the Comptroller regarding their retirement plans and governance structures for such plans, and (2) require the development of best practices and training resources to assist municipalities to implement or improve their governance structures for such plans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REPORTING FREQUENCY FOR THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To authorize carriers to file a return for and pay the highway use tax on a quarterly basis rather than monthly on and after July 1, 2023.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE RATE OF THE CREDIT REFUND VALUE FOR CERTAIN EXPENDITURES BY BIOTECHNOLOGY COMPANIES.
purpose: To increase the rate of the credit refund value for research and experimental expenditures or research and development expenses of biotechnology companies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN EXAMINATION OF THE TAXATION OF REAL PROPERTY AND TANGIBLE PERSONAL PROPERTY LOCATED ON CERTAIN INDIAN LANDS.
purpose: To establish a working group to examine the taxation of real property and tangible personal property located on certain Indian lands.

title: AN ACT MAKING ADJUSTMENTS TO THE PERSONAL INCOME AND THE EARNED INCOME TAX CREDIT AND CONCERNING THE HUMAN CAPITAL INVESTMENT TAX CREDIT, TAX GAP REPORTING AND THE TAX INCIDENCE REPORT.
purpose: To (1) make adjustments to certain personal income tax rates, (2) establish income phase-out thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for pension and annuity income and individual retirement accounts, (3) increase the applicable percentage of the earned income tax credit, (4) expand the tax credit for human capital investment, (5) require the Commissioner of Revenue Services to provide information related to the tax gap, and (6) require additional information to be included in the tax incidence report.

title: AN ACT AMENDING A CONVEYANCE OF A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE CITY OF BRIDGEPORT.
purpose: To amend a prior authorization for a conveyance of a parcel of state land in the city of Bridgeport to specify the sale price of said parcel and the amount to be deposited in the Special Transportation Fund.

title: AN ACT CONVEYING PARCELS OF STATE LAND TO THE NEW HAVEN PORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To convey parcels of state land in the city of New Haven to the New Haven Port Authority.

title: AN ACT AMENDING A CONVEYANCE OF STATE LAND TO THE NEW HAVEN PORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To amend the property description and cost of a prior conveyance of state land to the New Haven Port Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONVEYANCE OF PARCELS OF STATE LAND TO THE TOWN OF BEACON FALLS.
purpose: To convey parcels of state land to the town of Beacon Falls for economic development purposes.

title: AN ACT CONVEYING PARCELS OF STATE LAND TO THE CITY OF NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To convey parcels of state land in the city of New Haven to the city of New Haven for economic development or municipal purposes.

title: AN ACT AMENDING A CONVEYANCE OF A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE TOWN OF FAIRFIELD.
purpose: To amend a prior authorization for a conveyance of a parcel of state land to the town of Fairfield to allow a new use for said parcel.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE BUDGET FOR THE BIENNIUM ENDING JUNE 30, 2025, AND MAKING APPROPRIATIONS THEREFOR, AND PROVISIONS RELATED TO REVENUE AND OTHER ITEMS IMPLEMENTING THE STATE BUDGET.
purpose: NA

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND ADJUSTING BONDS OF THE STATE AND CONCERNING CERTAIN GRANT AND FINANCING PROGRAMS, STATE CONSTRUCTION RELATED THRESHOLDS, SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION PROJECTS, THE FAILURE TO FILE FOR CERTAIN GRAND LIST EXEMPTIONS, THE VALIDATION OF CERTAIN ACTIONS TAKEN BY CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES, CAPITAL CITY PROJECTS, CERTAIN CONSUMER AGREEMENTS, CERTAIN MODIFICATIONS TO MUNICIPAL CHARTERS AND PETITIONS FOR CERTAIN TOWN REFERENDA, ELECTIONS ADMINISTRATION AND CAMPAIGN FINANCE, CERTAIN CASES BEFORE THE COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS AND OPPORTUNITIES AND OTHER ITEMS IMPLEMENTING THE STATE BUDGET.
purpose: NA

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF EPINEPHRINE BY EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES PERSONNEL AND PROVISIONS RELATED TO ELECTIONS.
purpose: NA

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY IN EDUCATION.
purpose: To provide equal and comprehensive access to education and academic opportunities for all children in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MENTAL, PHYSICAL AND EMOTIONAL WELLNESS OF CHILDREN.
purpose: To improve access to mental, physical and emotional health services for children and provide a continuum of care in the delivery of such services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ONLINE PRIVACY, DATA AND SAFETY PROTECTIONS.
purpose: To (1) Establish standards concerning the provision of access to, and sharing of, consumer health data; (2) prohibit geofencing of certain health data; (3) establish additional requirements concerning minors' personal data and social media platform accounts; (4) revise disclosure requirements relating to warrants directed to providers of electronic communication services and remote computing services; (5) establish a duty of care owed by online dating operators to users relating to potential criminal activity of other users; (6) codify in statute the existence and prescribed duties of the Connecticut Internet Crimes Against Children Task Force; and (7) require employers to disclose known instances of sexual harassment and assault when making employment recommendations relating to former employees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONNECTICUT'S PRESENT AND FUTURE HOUSING NEEDS.
purpose: To promote fair and equitable housing opportunities in every community in the state.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING THE PROTECTIONS AGAINST AND RESPONSE TO DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To provide greater protections for and enhanced responses to individuals involved in domestic and intimate partner violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UTILIZATION REVIEW AND HEALTH CARE CONTRACTS, HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR NEWBORNS AND STEP THERAPY.
purpose: To: (1) Establish a utilization review exemption standard for certain participating providers; (2) require that each health carrier process utilization review requests more efficiently; (3) require that each health carrier develop an electronic prior authorization process; (4) extend the time period within which an insured shall provide notice of the birth of a newborn and pay any required premium or subscription fee to continue the newborn's coverage beyond such period; (5) prohibit health carriers from requiring the use of step therapy for drugs prescribed to treat behavioral health conditions or chronic, disabling or life-threatening conditions or diseases; and (6) to prohibit health carriers from requiring utilization review of a health care service or prescription drug after it has been certified through utilization review.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING PROTECTIONS FOR CONNECTICUT'S CONSUMERS OF ENERGY.
purpose: To promote a more equitable and transparent energy market that works in the best interest of Connecticut's consumers of energy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HIGHER EDUCATION AFFORDABILITY AND GRADUATE RETENTION.
purpose: To (1) extend the debt-free community college program to returning students, (2) increase the amount of minimum grants under the debt-free community college program, (3) reallocate ARPA funds under the Roberta B. Willis Scholarship program to the Connecticut State University System, (4) require the Connecticut Higher Education Supplemental Loan Authority to establish a Student Loan Subsidy Program to reduce the interest rate on authority loans to individuals employed in certain high-demand professions, and (5) provide a tax deduction to residents of the state who paid interest on student loans during the taxable year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH AND WELLNESS FOR CONNECTICUT RESIDENTS.
purpose: To equalize access to physical, mental and behavioral health care in the state and to strengthen the state's response to the fentanyl and opioid epidemic.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING ACCESS TO AFFORDABLE PRESCRIPTION DRUGS, HEALTH CARE COVERAGE, TRANSPARENCY IN HEALTH CARE COSTS, HOME AND COMMUNITY-BASED SUPPORT FOR VULNERABLE PERSONS AND RIGHTS REGARDING GENDER IDENTITY AND EXPRESSION.
purpose: To promote transparency in health care and prescription drug costs, expand access to affordable prescription drugs, integrate community health workers and social workers into delivery of health care and home and community-based services, expand the Covered Connecticut health care program, connect uninsured persons with coverage and protect rights regarding gender identity and expression.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE ANNUAL REPORT FILING FEE FOR LIMITED LIABILITY COMPANIES.
purpose: To eliminate the annual report filing fee for limited liability companies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIQUOR PERMITTEES AND LIQUOR LIABILITY INSURANCE.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to confirm that liquor permittees maintain liquor liability insurance coverage.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING BUSINESSES TO ISSUE NOTICES TO CONSUMERS UNDER SUBSCRIPTION CONTRACTS.
purpose: To require business entities to provide notices to consumers prior to expiration of any free trial period, promotional price or contract term.

title: AN ACT ENSURING THE SAFETY OF HEALTH CARE WORKERS.
purpose: To ensure the safety of health care workers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PENALTY FOR COMMERCIAL VEHICLES ON STATE PARKWAYS.
purpose: To impose a penalty for violations of the ban on commercial motor vehicles operating on parkways in this state.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO REIMBURSE BRISTOL HOSPITAL FOR UNCOMPENSATED AND UNDER-COMPENSATED HEALTH CARE COSTS.
purpose: To appropriate funds to cover uncompensated and under-compensated costs of providing health care in the Bristol area.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BENEFITS CLIFF BARRIER TO GAINFUL EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To adjust temporary family assistance benefit reductions imposed upon employment of a beneficiary to encourage beneficiaries to become gainfully employed.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY IN THE PUBLIC SCHOOL CURRICULUM.
purpose: To include financial literacy in the public school curriculum.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING FIBER OPTIC PROVIDERS AND CABLE COMPANIES FROM CHARGING CUSTOMERS THROUGH THE END OF THE BILLING CYCLE AFTER A SUBSCRIPTION IS CANCELLED.
purpose: To prevent cable companies, including fiber optic providers, from charging customers to the end of the billing cycle when they cancel a subscription.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACQUISITIONS AND MERGERS OF CABLE AND TELECOMMUNICATIONS PROVIDERS.
purpose: To require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to review any proposed acquisition or merger of a cable or telecommunications provider doing business in this state, and provide that no such provider may be the subject of such an acquisition or merger without having obtained prior approval from the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING EMPLOYERS FROM REQUIRING AN EMPLOYMENT PROMISSORY NOTE AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To prohibit all employers from requiring an employment promissory note as a condition of employment.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ALL FIRST RESPONDERS TO BE TRAINED IN THE ADMINISTRATION OF EPINEPHRINE.
purpose: To require all first responders to be trained in the administration of epinephrine.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPIOIDS.
purpose: To (1) create a pilot program to establish three sites in the state aimed at decreasing cases of opioid overdose, and (2) increase the availability of opioid antagonists, fentanyl test strips and opioid use disorder education in environments at higher risk for opioid use.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S PROGRAM PROVIDING HOUSING SUPPORT TO PERSONS WITH RESPIRATORY ILLNESSES.
purpose: To expand the Department of Public Health's program providing housing support to persons with respiratory illnesses to persons who are twenty-six years of age or younger.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING SAFE SOCIAL MEDIA AWARENESS WEEKEND AND RESPONSIBLE SCREEN TIME AWARENESS DAY.
purpose: To educate students about the safe and responsible use of social media and to assist families in developing plans for healthy activities during summer vacation.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING SMOKING IN MOTOR VEHICLES WHEN A CHILD IS PRESENT.
purpose: To protect children from secondhand smoke while riding in a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROTOCOL OFFICE WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To establish a Protocol Office within the Department of Economic and Community Development.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STEP THERAPY, ADVERSE DETERMINATION AND UTILIZATION REVIEWS.
purpose: To (1) prohibit certain health carriers from requiring the use of step therapy for drugs prescribed to treat behavioral health conditions or chronic, disabling or life-threatening conditions or diseases; (2) redefine "clinical peer" for the purposes of adverse determination and utilization reviews; (3) require health carriers to bear the burden of proving that certain health care services under adverse determination or utilization review are not medically necessary; and (4) require health carriers to provide certain clinical peers with authority to reverse initial adverse determinations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM COSTS.
purpose: To: (1) Require that the Insurance Department conduct a study evaluating an alternative pool for long-term care insurance policyholders; (2) require that the Insurance Department hold a public hearing for long-term care insurance premium rate increase requests that exceed seven per cent; (3) require that an insurer provide written notice to an individual prior to the purchase of a long-term care insurance policy of the risk of premium rate increases; (4) establish a tax credit for an individual that purchases a long-term care insurance policy; (5) allow for a tax deduction on a premium for a long-term care insurance policy that is increased above the baseline; and (6) establish a task force to study the long-term care insurance industry.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A MORATORIUM ON LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM RATE INCREASES.
purpose: To impose a three-year moratorium on long-term care insurance premium rate increases in this state.

title: AN ACT PROTECTING THE PUBLIC FROM DUI OFFENDERS.
purpose: To reduce the opportunity for persons who drive under the influence to reoffend.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING TAX-EXEMPT STATUS FOR HATE GROUPS.
purpose: To prohibit from eligibility for tax-exempt status any organization that is a hate group.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DIGITAL DEVICES SOLD IN THE STATE TO BE EQUIPPED WITH A USB TYPE-C PORT.
purpose: To require newly manufactured digital devices sold in Connecticut to use the USB Type-C industry standard port.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM AMOUNT OF RESOURCES A COMMUNITY SPOUSE OF AN INSTITUTIONALIZED MEDICAID RECIPIENT MAY RETAIN.
purpose: To increase the minimum amount of assets that may be retained by the community spouse of a Medicaid recipient who is a permanent resident of a nursing facility or medical institution.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PRIOR AUTHORIZATION PROCESS FOR HEALTH INSURANCE.
purpose: To require the Insurance Department to conduct a study to evaluate the prior authorization process for health insurance and related prior authorization issues for health care provider services in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING PROTECTIONS FOR VICTIMS OF FAMILY VIOLENCE.
purpose: To prohibit a landlord from taking certain adverse actions against or discriminating against a tenant or prospective tenant due to the tenant's or prospective tenant's family violence victim status.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENT STABILIZATION IN MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOME PARKS.
purpose: To protect the owners of mobile manufactured homes in mobile manufactured home parks from unfair and unreasonable rent increases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RISK PROTECTION ORDERS AND WARRANTS.
purpose: To update the administration of the risk protection orders to improve efficiency, promote utilization by police departments and to increase public safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ORGAN DONATION.
purpose: To encourage and facilitate organ donation.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING SMOKING AND VAPING AT STATE BEACHES AND PARKS AND ALLOWING MUNICIPALITIES TO RESTRICT SMOKING AND VAPING AT MUNICIPAL PARKS AND OTHER OUTDOOR VENUES.
purpose: To prohibit smoking and vaping at state beaches and parks and allow municipalities to restrict smoking and vaping at municipal parks and other outdoor venues.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF THE OFFICE OF THE ATTORNEY GENERAL TO BRING AN ACTION AGAINST A SELLER WHO ENGAGES IN PRICE GOUGING DURING A DISASTER OR EMERGENCY.
purpose: To enable the office of the Attorney General to bring an action against a seller who engages in price gouging during a disaster or emergency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CLIMATE SUSTAINABILITY SCORES OF COMPANIES INVESTED IN BY THE STATE TREASURER.
purpose: To increase climate accountability and sustainability with the investment of state pension funds in companies that act in compliance with state climate goals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BEST PRACTICES FOR THE PREVENTION OF FAILING CONCRETE FOUNDATIONS.
purpose: To require builders of new residential construction to follow industry best practices for the prevention of failing concrete foundations.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING EDUCATION IN THE DETECTION OF CONCUSSIONS AND DANGERS OF CHRONIC TRAUMATIC ENCEPHALOPATHY.
purpose: To prevent concussions in high school and college athletes, and educate coaches and gym teachers regarding early detection of concussions and dangers of chronic traumatic encephalopathy.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HIGH DEDUCTIBLE HEALTH PLAN DEDUCTIBLES TO CREDIT PAYMENTS MADE TO PURCHASE OUT-OF-PLAN PRESCRIPTION DRUGS.
purpose: To require that high deductible health plan deductibles credit payments made by insureds to purchase out-of-plan prescription drugs, provided the cost paid for such out-of-plan prescription drug is less than the cost would have been if purchased through the high deductible health plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSISTENT APPLICATION OF THE BEST INTEREST OF THE CHILD STANDARD IN CHILD CUSTODY DETERMINATIONS.
purpose: To ensure that a relevant and consistent best interest of the child standard is being applied by judges and guardians ad litem in child custody determinations.

title: AN ACT ADDING A RESIDENTIAL CONSTRUCTION EXPERT TO THE GOVERNOR'S WORKFORCE COUNCIL.
purpose: To add a member to the Governor's Workforce Council, who is an expert in residential construction.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SUNDAY HUNTING.
purpose: To expand hunting to Sundays during hunting season.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF MINORITY TEACHER RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION PROGRAMS AND POLICIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To study and evaluate the implementation and effectiveness of existing minority teacher recruitment and retention programs and policies and other issues relating to minority teacher recruitment and retention in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUPPORT FOR SURGE CAPACITY FOR EMERGENCY ROOMS, HOSPITALS AND NURSING CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To require emergency rooms, hospitals and nursing care facilities to be prepared for surge events.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING A HEALTH CARE PROXY FROM ACTING IN CONTRADICTION OF A PATIENT'S ADVANCE DIRECTIVE.
purpose: To prohibit a patient's health care proxy from acting in contradiction of the patient's properly executed advance directive.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF CERTAIN APPLICATIONS ON STATE GOVERNMENT DEVICES AND REQUIRING AUDITS TO ENSURE COMPLIANCE WITH SECURITY STANDARDS.
purpose: To protect sensitive data on state government devices from malicious foreign and domestic actors.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING VETERINARIANS TO REPORT CASES OF SUSPECTED AGGRAVATED ANIMAL CRUELTY AND AUTHORIZING THE REPORTING OF SUSPECTED ANIMAL CRUELTY.
purpose: To protect the health of animals and afford protection to veterinarians who report cases of suspected aggravated cruelty and neglect to the state.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS.
purpose: To increase the amount of the personal income tax deduction for Social Security benefits.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR THE COSTS OF HOME HEALTH CARE.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction of not more than sixty thousand dollars for the costs of full-time home health care services and medical supplies.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS.
purpose: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deduction for Social Security benefits.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO THE STATE-FUNDED CONNECTICUT HOME-CARE PROGRAM FOR THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To increase the number of persons eligible for the state-funded portion of the Connecticut home-care program for the elderly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSERVATOR COMPENSATION BY MEDICAID APPLICANTS AND RECIPIENTS.
purpose: To authorize a qualified deduction for conservator compensation from the income a Medicaid applicant or recipient must apply to the cost of care and not treat Probate Court-approved payments made by a Medicaid applicant or recipient to a conservator as an improper transfer of assets.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FEDERAL VETERANS' BENEFITS AND INCOME ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATIONS FOR CERTAIN PUBLIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAMS.
purpose: To disregard federal veterans' benefits from income eligibility determinations for certain public assistance programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EQUITABLE MEDICAID PAYMENT RATES AND ELIGIBILITY DETERMINATIONS.
purpose: To provide equitable Medicaid payments and eligibility determinations for applicants, recipients and family caregivers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MINIMUM NUMBER OF SWORN STATE POLICE PERSONNEL.
purpose: To protect public safety by ensuring appropriate staffing levels within the state police force.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM FOR INSTALLATION OF EXHAUST EXTRACTION SYSTEMS AT VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENTS.
purpose: To establish a grant program to assist volunteer fire departments in upgrading fire house ventilation systems and aid in cancer mitigation in volunteer firefighters.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE MUNICIPALITIES WITH FUNDING TO PURCHASE AUTOMATED UNDERWATER SEARCH AND RESCUE DRONES.
purpose: To protect rescue divers from extreme weather conditions by expanding the utilization of automated underwater search and rescue drones.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR THE CONNECTICUT FOUNDATION SOLUTIONS INDEMNITY COMPANY, INC.
purpose: To authorize additional funding to allow the Connecticut Foundation Solutions Indemnity Company, Inc. to continue its foundation repair work.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY UNIFORM LICENSING AND CERTIFICATION.
purpose: To establish a task force to study, and make recommendations concerning, uniform professional and technical licensing and certification to provide for greater reciprocity across states and with national licensing and certification bodies.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS, FIRE POLICE OFFICERS AND VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE MEMBERS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any stipend paid by a municipality, volunteer fire department or volunteer ambulance association to a volunteer firefighter, fire police officer or volunteer ambulance member.

title: AN ACT REVISING CONTINUING MEDICAL EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To decrease ongoing mandates on physicians.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TREE REMOVAL IN STATE PARKS AND CAMPGROUNDS.
purpose: To require an arborist review and public hearing regarding tree removal in state parks and campgrounds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SITING AND CONSTRUCTION OF ANAEROBIC DIGESTERS .
purpose: To promote the efficient disposal of agricultural and food wastes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY METHODS FOR THE ENFORCEMENT OF LAKE REGULATIONS.
purpose: To provide ways for lake regulations to be enforced.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN ARTICLES OF CHILDREN'S CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR AND PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt articles of children's clothing or footwear costing under fifty dollars and personal protective equipment from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING LOCAL REPRESENTATION ON THE CONNECTICUT SITING COUNCIL FOR LOCAL PROJECTS.
purpose: To require local representation on the Connecticut Siting Council.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR ABLE ACCOUNT DEPOSITS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for deposits made by a taxpayer to an ABLE account.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROTECTIONS FOR STATE AND LOCAL LAW ENFORCEMENT K9S.
purpose: To allow for protections for law enforcement K9s.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR PREMIUM PAYMENTS FOR CERTAIN LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for the amount of premiums paid to purchase an individual or group long-term care insurance policy that provides benefits for health care provided in an insured's home.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR CERTAIN SENIORS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for the amount of property taxes paid by a taxpayer on such taxpayer's residence, provided such taxpayer (1) is at least seventy years of age, (2) resides in the residence full time, and (3) meets certain income limits.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO ENCOURAGE INSURERS TO DEVELOP TECHNOLOGIES TO PREVENT TEXTING WHILE DRIVING.
purpose: To establish a task force to encourage insurers to develop technologies to prevent texting while driving.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FUND TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO HOMEOWNERS TO ADDRESS PROPERTY DAMAGE CAUSED BY A NATURAL DISASTER.
purpose: To establish a fund to assist homeowners who have property damage from natural disasters.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SHORTAGE OF CERTAIN DRUGS PRESCRIBED TO TREAT TYPE II DIABETES.
purpose: To provide that the Commissioner of Consumer Protection shall adopt regulations to ensure that there is a sufficient supply of dulaglutide and semaglutide to treat patients in this state who have been diagnosed with type II diabetes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF CONTINUED FUNDING FOR THE RIGHT TO COUNSEL PROGRAM.
purpose: To ensure continued funding for the Right to Counsel program in the housing session of the Superior Court.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING INCOME AND ASSET LIMITS FOR THE MED-CONNECT HEALTH INSURANCE PROGRAM FOR WORKING PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To expand Medicaid coverage for working persons with disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRIOR AUTHORIZATION FOR HEALTH CARE PROVIDER SERVICES.
purpose: To require that (1) the waiver negotiated and implemented in December 2022, that allows patients to step down to a skilled nursing facility before they can guarantee payment from insurance companies, remains in force until the Office of Health Strategy conducts a study and submits a report concerning prior authorization issues for health care provider services in the state, and (2) insurers accept prior authorizations electronically.

title: AN ACT OPENING THE STATE EMPLOYEE HEALTH INSURANCE PLAN TO SMALL BUSINESS EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To enable small business employees in this state to enroll in the state employee health insurance plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE REIMBURSEMENT PARITY FOR PODIATRISTS.
purpose: To prohibit a health carrier that delivers, issues for delivery, renews, amends or continues an individual or group health insurance policy in this state from paying a reduced reimbursement to a licensed health care provider who provides a covered benefit within such provider's scope of practice solely because such provider is a podiatrist.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INSURANCE COMMISSIONER TO CONSIDER AFFORDABILITY AS A FACTOR IN REVIEWING INDIVIDUAL AND GROUP HEALTH INSURANCE POLICY PREMIUM RATING FILINGS.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Commissioner consider affordability as a factor in reviewing individual and group health insurance policy premium rating filings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADVERSE DETERMINATION AND UTILIZATION REVIEWS.
purpose: To: (1) Redefine "clinical peer" for the purposes of adverse determination and utilization reviews; (2) require health carriers to bear the burden of proving that certain health care services under adverse determination or utilization review are not medically necessary; and (3) require health carriers to provide certain clinical peers with authority to reverse initial adverse determinations.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN HEALTH CARRIERS FROM REQUIRING STEP THERAPY FOR PRESCRIPTION DRUGS PRESCRIBED TO TREAT BEHAVIORAL HEALTH CONDITIONS OR CHRONIC, DISABLING OR LIFE-THREATENING CONDITIONS OR DISEASES.
purpose: To prohibit certain health carriers from requiring the use of step therapy for prescription drugs prescribed to treat behavioral health conditions or chronic, disabling or life-threatening conditions or diseases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF CERTAIN HIGH DEDUCTIBLE HEALTH PLANS.
purpose: To require certain high deductible health plans to apply annual deductibles on a calendar year basis to prevent an insured from being charged an annual deductible more than once per calendar year.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A DUTY OF CARE OWED BY PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS TO HEALTH CARRIERS OR OTHER HEALTH BENEFIT PLAN SPONSORS.
purpose: To establish that a pharmacy benefits manager owes a fiduciary duty of care, in accordance with the provisions of state and federal law, to a health carrier or other health benefit plan sponsor.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING WORKERS' COMPENSATION COVERAGE FOR POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS INJURIES FOR ALL EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To extend workers' compensation coverage for post-traumatic stress injuries to all employees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WAREHOUSE WORKERS.
purpose: To protect warehouse workers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPENSATION FOR CERTAIN EMPLOYEES WHOSE SCHEDULED SHIFT HAS BEEN REDUCED OR CANCELLED.
purpose: To require certain employers to provide advance notice to certain employees of changes in such employees' work schedules.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FORECLOSURE, ASSIGNMENT AND OTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS FOR UNPAID SEWER ASSESSMENTS AND OTHER FEES AND CHARGES.
purpose: To prohibit foreclosure, assignment and other enforcement actions for unpaid sewer assessment and other fees and charges in the case of owner-occupied real property for which the principal of such unpaid assessments, fees and charges is less than four thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT INCREASING OVERSIGHT OF THE ACQUISITION OF PHYSICIAN PRACTICES.
purpose: To increase oversight of the acquisition of physician practices and improve patient care.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REBUTTABLE PRESUMPTION THAT PERSONS KILLED IN A MOTORCYCLE ACCIDENT WHILE RIDING WITHOUT A HELMET WISH TO DONATE THEIR ORGANS.
purpose: To improve public health.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE USE OF HELMETS BY MOTORCYCLE OPERATORS AND PASSENGERS UNDER TWENTY-ONE YEARS OF AGE.
purpose: To reduce serious injuries and fatalities by requiring motorcycle operators and passengers under twenty-one years of age to wear helmets.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY PROGRAM FOR SOLAR PANELS.
purpose: To promote the recycling and reuse of solar panels.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MUNICIPAL GRANT PROGRAM FOR THE REMOVAL OF DEAD, DYING AND HAZARDOUS TREES.
purpose: To establish a municipal grant program to assist towns with the removal of dead, dying and hazardous trees.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ACCOUNT IN THE GENERAL FUND TO PROVIDE GRANTS TO TOWNS THAT NEED PFAS TESTING AND REMEDIATION.
purpose: To provide municipalities with needed resources to test for and remediate PFAS contamination on town-owned properties and to assist residential homeowners impacted by such contamination.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE TESTING OF WATER FOR THE PRESENCE OF PFAS DURING THE HOME INSPECTION CONDUCTED IN CONNECTION WITH THE SALE OF A HOME.
purpose: To inform prospective homeowners about the presence of PFAS contaminants in water.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF SECOND-GENERATION ANTICOAGULANT RODENTICIDES.
purpose: To reduce the lethal effect that second-generation anticoagulant rodenticides can have on hawks and other raptors.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A STATE TITLE INSURANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) establish a title insurance program similar to the title insurance program in the state of Iowa, and (2) require that all revenue from such program in the state that exceeds operating expenses be used to assist certain prospective homeowners with the cost of a down payment on the purchase of a home in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO EXAMINE THE BED SHORTAGES IN EMERGENCY DEPARTMENTS.
purpose: To prevent overcrowding of emergency departments and untimely deaths.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY CERTIFICATES ISSUED BY PHYSICIANS AND FIREARM POSSESSION AND SALES.
purpose: To add temporary commitments under physicians' emergency certifications to any registry of admissions for patients with psychiatric disabilities that is maintained by the Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services and reviewed when determining the suitability of a person to purchase or possess a firearm.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING REQUIREMENTS FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER TRAINING IN CRISIS INTERVENTION AND PROMOTING USE OF SOCIAL WORKERS WITHIN LAW ENFORCEMENT UNITS.
purpose: To ensure law enforcement officers receive training in crisis intervention techniques that allow officers to address the rise of incidences related to mental health and to provide officers with the tools they need for mental health awareness and crisis intervention in coordination with community partners.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO THE ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE RESPITE CARE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the number of persons eligible for the Alzheimer's disease respite care program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MATCHING GRANTS.
purpose: To study how the state can convert all matching grants in the budget into formula-based models.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCOUNTABILITY FOR THE EXPENDITURE OF FEDERAL CORONAVIRUS RELIEF FUNDS RECEIVED BY THE STATE.
purpose: To provide transparency, oversight and accountability for the state's expenditure of certain federal funds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ANNUAL STATE RETIREMENT BENEFITS.
purpose: To limit state retirees from collecting a pension greater than one hundred thousand dollars annually.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF A STATE EMPLOYEE PENSION BUYOUT.
purpose: To require the Office of Policy and Management to study a pension buyout plan.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CONNECTICUT BANKS TO LIST ACCOUNT HOLDERS OR OWNERS ON STATEMENTS.
purpose: To require a Connecticut bank to list all holders or owners of an account on all statements issued by such bank concerning the account.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL NURSES AND NURSE PRACTITIONERS.
purpose: To ensure that students receive qualified nursing care in school.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAREER TRAINING PROGRAMS.
purpose: To develop programs and present information related to trade schools at middle schools and high schools.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HEALTH CARE ACADEMY PROGRAM.
purpose: To develop a curriculum for a Health Care Academy Program for students in grades nine to twelve, inclusive.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ELIGIBILITY REQUIREMENTS FOR WHO MAY SERVE AS A SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICER.
purpose: To expand the eligibility of those persons who can serve as school resource officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAREER TRAINING PROGRAMS AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To develop programs and provide information concerning trade schools and careers for middle school and high school students and for high school graduates, establish a task force to examine transportation barriers related to work-based learning programs, amend the journeyperson to apprentice ratio until June 30, 2025, require an audit of workforce development programs and require instruction in financial literacy in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER PERIOD FOR CERTAIN READING CURRICULUM MODELS OR PROGRAMS.
purpose: To ease the administrative burden on school districts relating to the reading curriculum model or program mandate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICERS IN CONNECTICUT SCHOOLS.
purpose: To provide clarity around the use and duties of school resource officers in Connecticut schools.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY TO COMPLY WITH THE CONNECTICUT ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION ACT FOR ANY HISTORIC STRUCTURES AND LANDMARKS UNDER THE AUTHORITY'S CONTROL.
purpose: To provide for the preservation of historic structures and landmarks under the control of the Connecticut Airport Authority.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ENVIRONMENTAL IMPACT EVALUATIONS FOR CERTAIN ACTIONS OF THE CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To provide for environmental safeguards when the Connecticut Airport Authority expands operations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REPLANTING OF TREES IN PUBLIC AREAS CLEARED BY UTILITY COMPANIES.
purpose: To require utility companies to create and administer a fund that distributes money to municipalities for tree planting projects in public areas.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY, THE REGULATION OF ELECTRIC RATES AND STATE PUBLIC POLICY CONCERNING ELECTRICITY GENERATION.
purpose: To lower the cost of energy for ratepayers in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC PARTICIPATION IN ELECTRIC UTILITY RATE CASES.
purpose: To enhance public awareness and participation in electricity distribution rate review.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INDEXING OF INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To require that income thresholds for personal income tax be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RATE OF TAX ON DIESEL FUEL.
purpose: To reduce the rate of tax for diesel fuel to forty and one-tenth cents per gallon and establish a task force to recommend changes to the statutory formula that sets the applicable tax rate for diesel fuel.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PHASE-IN AND RATE OF THE TAX ON FUELS AND GASOHOL.
purpose: To delay the phase-in of the tax on fuels and gasohol by six months and require the Department of Revenue Services and the Office of Policy and Management make a joint recommendation as to the appropriate rate of such tax to ensure the state maintains its surface transportation infrastructure in good repair.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAP ON THE AGGREGATE AMOUNT OF PERSONAL INCOME TAX REVENUE THE STATE MAY COLLECT.
purpose: To establish a cap on the amount of aggregate personal income tax revenue that the state may collect, with any amount collected in excess of such cap to be refunded to taxpayers on a pro rata basis.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To eliminate the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A ONE-TIME CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR THE PURCHASE OF AN ENERGY-EFFICIENT HOME.
purpose: To establish for certain taxable years a one-time credit against the personal income tax for the purchase of an energy-efficient home.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CAPITAL GAINS TAX ON CERTAIN ENDOWMENT FUNDS OF INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To impose a capital gains tax on certain endowment funds of institutions of higher education and dedicate the revenue from such tax to reducing the amount that participants in the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program are required to contribute under section 31-49g of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE POSITION OF CHIEF ACCOUNTABILITY OFFICER.
purpose: To increase oversight of state and municipal activities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNANNOUNCED CLOSURES OF RETAIL PHARMACIES.
purpose: To ensure that patients are able to access prescription drugs during unannounced closures of retail pharmacies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HIRING RATIOS FOR CERTAIN SKILLED TRADES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to temporarily amend the hiring ratios for certain skilled trades, increase the amount of fines levied on contractors who do not comply with such ratios and require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection and Labor Commissioner to establish and publish standards for ratio relief that account for current workforce shortages.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MAXIMUM CHARGE FOR CERTAIN OCCUPATIONAL LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, PERMITS AND REGISTRATIONS.
purpose: To provide that neither the Commissioner of Consumer Protection nor the Department of Consumer Protection may charge certain individuals a license, permit, certification or registration fee in an amount that is greater than one hundred dollars per license, certification, permit or registration year.

title: AN ACT ALIGNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT RATES FOR PHYSICIAN AND AMBULANCE SERVICES WITH MEDICARE REIMBURSEMENT RATES.
purpose: To increase Medicaid reimbursement rates for physician and ambulance services to the Medicare reimbursement rates for such services.

title: AN ACT INCREASING HUSKY C ASSET LIMITS.
purpose: To allow elderly persons and persons with disabilities who otherwise qualify for Medicaid to have a small financial cushion for emergencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENT STABILITY AND NO-FAULT EVICTIONS.
purpose: To provide stability for renters in the state by capping annual rent increases and establishing rules for no-fault evictions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UTILIZATION OF THE PRIOR AUTHORIZATION PROCESS FOR HEALTH INSURANCE.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Department (1) conduct a study evaluating utilization of the prior authorization process by health insurers and the impacts of such process on health care providers and insureds, and (2) make recommendations to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR CERTAIN TAXPAYERS.
purpose: To reduce the personal income tax for working class and middle-class taxpayers.

title: AN ACT TEMPORARILY REDUCING THE RATE OF THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To reduce the rate of the sales and use taxes to five and ninety-nine-hundredths per cent through June 30, 2023.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE-OPERATED REINSURANCE PROGRAM AND HEALTH CARE COST GROWTH.
purpose: To: (1) Establish a state-operated reinsurance program; (2) require the state to apply for a state innovation waiver to fund such program; (3) require the Office of Health Strategy to consider and adjust for any unintended effects or impacts of primary care spending targets on funding for those with developmental disabilities when benchmarking; (4) require the Office of Health Strategy to institute a program for prescription drug benchmarking; and (5) establish a task force to study the impact of spread pricing with prescription drugs and the savings or potential savings under current and alternative programs for the pooling of purchasing of prescription drugs.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURERS TO PROVIDE COVERAGE FOR TREATMENT OF POSTPARTUM DEPRESSION.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for treatment of postpartum depression.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICES.
purpose: To expand access to public defender services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INTERROGATION TACTICS USED ON JUVENILES.
purpose: To protect juveniles and reduce the number of false confessions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES TO AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS IN CONTACT WITH OR UNDER THE CUSTODY OR CONTROL OF A PEACE OFFICER.
purpose: To require the provision of emergency medical services to an individual who experiences an emergency medical condition or is medically unstable while in contact with or under the custody or control of a peace officer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICABILITY OF GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY IN ACTIONS FILED AGAINST A POLICE OFFICER OR LAW ENFORCEMENT UNIT.
purpose: To allow police officers to assert governmental immunity in more situations and to permit interlocutory appeals of a trial court's denial of the application of the defense of governmental immunity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SAFE ENVIRONMENT FOR CORRECTION OFFICERS.
purpose: To provide for a safer environment for correction officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR CRIMES COMMITTED AGAINST THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To extend the statute of limitations for the prosecution of crimes committed against the elderly.

title: AN ACT INCREASING ENFORCEMENT OF SAFETY CODES ON CONSTRUCTION SITES.
purpose: To protect workers from corporations, and their agents, that fail to comply with safety protocols.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FULL EMPLOYMENT TRUST FUND.
purpose: To require the Labor Commissioner to conduct a study regarding the establishment of a full employment trust fund in order to create employment opportunities and job-training programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROTECTION OF WAREHOUSE WORKERS.
purpose: To create protections for warehouse workers against unreasonable quotas.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO ASSIST MUNICIPALITIES WITH FIRST RESPONDERS WORKERS' COMPENSATION CLAIMS FOR POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER.
purpose: To establish a grant program to cover the costs to municipalities first responder workers' compensation claims for post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A PERFORMANCE AUDIT OF CERTAIN WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS.
purpose: To measure the effectiveness of current workforce development programs in meeting the state's workforce needs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEVELOPMENT OF AN ALTERNATIVE PATHWAYS PROGRAM FOR HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATES.
purpose: To help meet the needs of Connecticut's workforce.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPENDITURES FROM THE HEALTHY HOMES FUND.
purpose: To allow for grants-in-aid to certain condominium associations in Hamden for the purpose of repairing damaged foundations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSIT-ORIENTED DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To create greater access to mass transportation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FAILURE TO FILE FOR CERTAIN PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS IN THE TOWN OF THOMASTON.
purpose: To authorize any person otherwise eligible for certain grand list exemptions for machinery and equipment in the town of Thomaston to file for such exemptions.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING COMBINED AND REGIONAL STORMWATER MANAGEMENT SYSTEMS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to enter into combined or regional stormwater management systems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF UNWANTED MUNICIPAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To provide municipalities the opportunity to purchase property located within its borders before such property is disposed of.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE PROBATE COURT ISSUE AN ORDER ALLOWING A PATIENT TO RECEIVE SHOCK THERAPY WHEN A PATIENT IS INCAPABLE OF GIVING INFORMED CONSENT.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that the Probate Court issue an order for a patient to receive shock therapy when the patient is incapable of giving informed consent if the shock therapy is medically recommended.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EARLY CHILDHOOD PSYCHOSIS TASK FORCE TO STUDY BARRIERS TO ADEQUATE AND EARLY TREATMENT OF PSYCHOSIS IN CHILDREN.
purpose: To establish an early childhood psychosis task force to study barriers to adequate and early treatment of psychosis in children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRANSFER OF MEDICAL RECORDS BETWEEN HEALTH CARE SYSTEMS.
purpose: To require the timely transfer of medical records between health care systems.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING RECIPROCAL LICENSING FOR CERTAIN OUT-OF-STATE HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To authorize reciprocal licensing for certain out-of-state health care providers.

title: AN ACT DEVELOPING AN INCENTIVE PROGRAM TO RETAIN HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS WHO ARE EDUCATED OR TRAINED IN THE STATE.
purpose: To alleviate the health care provider shortage by retaining in the state physicians, nurses and other health care providers who are educated or trained in the state.

title: AN ACT REINSTATING THE RELIGIOUS EXEMPTION FROM SCHOOL VACCINATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To reinstate the religious exemption from school vaccination requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INTIMATE PARTNER VIOLENCE AND OTHER DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To combat intimate partner violence and other domestic violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SEX OFFENDER BACKGROUND CHECKS FOR RESIDENTS AND STAFF OF LONG-TERM CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To protect long-term care residents and staff from the risk of abuse.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITY.
purpose: To strengthen services provided to persons with intellectual disability.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE CERTIFICATE OF NEED PROGRAM FOR HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To eliminate the certificate of need program for health care providers.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING PHARMACISTS TO PRESCRIBE BIRTH CONTROL MEDICATION.
purpose: To allow increased access to birth control medication.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TITLE PROTECTION FOR PERSONS ENGAGED IN THE PRACTICE OF MEDICINE.
purpose: To protect the title of physician and prevent the use of such title by persons without medical training and state licensing.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROGRAM THROUGH WHICH A PHYSICIAN MAY PROVIDE ONE HUNDRED HOURS OF FREE MEDICAL CARE IN LIEU OF PAYING THE STATE'S MEDICAL LICENSE FEE.
purpose: To allow physicians to provide one hundred hours of free medical care in lieu of paying the state's medical license fee.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF A TUITION REIMBURSEMENT PROGRAM FOR MENTAL HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To address the shortage of mental health professionals in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PROVISION OF EDUCATIONAL MATERIALS REGARDING PERINATAL MOOD AND ANXIETY DISORDERS TO HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To require the provision of educational materials regarding perinatal mood and anxiety disorders by the Department of Public Health.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF OPIOID SETTLEMENT FUNDS.
purpose: To combat the fentanyl crisis in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MUNICIPAL APPROVAL BEFORE THE CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY PURCHASES OR ACQUIRES AN AIRPORT OWNED OR CONTROLLED BY A MUNICIPALITY.
purpose: To prohibit the Connecticut Airport Authority from purchasing or acquiring an airport owned or controlled by a municipality without first obtaining the approval of the municipality within whose territorial limits the airport is located.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCOUNTABILITY FOR THE EXPENDITURE OF CERTAIN FEDERAL FUNDS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION.
purpose: To provide transparency, oversight and accountability for the expenditure of certain federal funds by the Department of Transportation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PREFERRED ADMISSION FOR GRADUATES OF AN AGRICULTURAL SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY EDUCATION CENTER.
purpose: To give preference to qualified graduates of agricultural science and technology education centers for admission to The University of Connecticut's College of Agriculture, Health and Natural Resources for the purpose of retaining such students in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE QUALITY OF, COSTS OF, REIMBURSEMENTS RATES FOR AND AVAILABILITY OF MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require a study of and report on the quality of, costs of, reimbursement rates for and availability of mental health services in the state.

title: AN ACT CODIFYING THE RULINGS OF CERTAIN UNITED STATES SUPREME COURT DECISIONS.
purpose: To preserve rights articulated by the United States Supreme Court for residents of this state, even if the court overturns its previous decisions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TAKING OF LAND PREVIOUSLY INTENDED FOR USE AS A PARK OR FOR OTHER RECREATIONAL OR OPEN-SPACE PURPOSES.
purpose: To specify that the provisions of section 7-131n of the general statutes apply to any municipality that takes or converts any land, including, but not limited to, land in such municipality's possession, for highway or other nonpark or open-space purposes, which land was purchased or acquired for park or other recreational or open-space purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NEONICOTINOIDS FOR NONAGRICULTURAL USE AND SEEDS TREATED WITH PESTICIDES.
purpose: To minimize the use of toxic pesticides that affect the environment and human health and to protect pollinators.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING SITE-NEUTRAL REIMBURSEMENTS FOR CERTAIN COVERED HEALTH INSURANCE BENEFITS.
purpose: To require health insurers to provide site-neutral reimbursements to health care providers for covered health insurance benefits for: (1) Current procedural terminology evaluation and management (CPT E/M) codes; (2) current procedural terminology assessment and management (CPT A/M) codes; (3) telehealth codes; and (4) drug infusion codes in amounts that do not vary based on ownership of the facility where a contracting health care provider provides such benefit.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH INSURERS FROM AUTOMATICALLY DOWN-CODING HEALTH INSURANCE CLAIMS AND REQUIRING THAT HEALTH INSURERS PROVIDE JUSTIFICATION FOR DOWN-CODING A HEALTH INSURANCE CLAIM.
purpose: To prohibit a health insurer from automatically down-coding health insurance claims and require that health insurers provide justification for down-coding a claim, to protect patient care.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE SILVER SNEAKERS PROGRAM.
purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide coverage for the silver sneakers program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRICE PARITY FOR CONSUMER GOODS.
purpose: To provide that no retailer that advertises a price for a consumer good online may charge a higher price for the consumer good if a consumer purchases such consumer good in person.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING TERMINALLY ILL PATIENTS THE MEDICAL DECISION TO END THEIR LIFE.
purpose: To allow terminally ill patients the medical decision to end their life.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING COMPOSTING.
purpose: To protect the environment, decrease methane production and reduce waste hauling costs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER OF CERTAIN PERFORMANCE BOND REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To authorize the waiver of certain performance bond requirements in municipal projects.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY TAX CAP.
purpose: To establish a property tax cap equal to the lesser of two per cent annually or the rate of inflation.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING OUT-OF-STATE TELEHEALTH PROVIDERS TO PROVIDE TELEHEALTH SERVICES TO PATIENTS IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To establish that the requirements for licensure, certification or registration of telehealth providers include out-of-state telehealth providers who are Medicaid-enrolled providers or in-network providers for commercially, fully insured health insurance providing telehealth services to patients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COST-OF-LIVING ADJUSTMENTS TO THE EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT FORMULA.
purpose: To provide cost-of-living increases to a town's ECS grant.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE COMPLETION OF CONSTRUCTION OF THE COLLINSVILLE FIRE STATION.
purpose: To provide funding to complete construction of the Collinsville fire station.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A WORKING GROUP FOR THE RESTORATION OF EEL GRASS.
purpose: To establish a working group to develop strategies for the restoration of eel grass along the state's shoreline.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY THE FEASIBILITY OF A TITLE IX ASSESSMENT OF CERTAIN RECREATION AREAS AND SPORTS FACILITIES.
purpose: To conduct a study of the feasibility of a federal Title IX assessment of certain recreation areas and sports facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNEMPLOYMENT LOANS RELATED TO COVID-19.
purpose: To reduce the burden on employers resulting from funds owed to the federal government for unemployment loans related to COVID-19.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY SHUTOFF MORATORIUM AND PAYMENT TERMS FOR DELINQUENT UTILITY CUSTOMERS.
purpose: To extend the shutoff moratorium that was ordered in March 2020 by the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority for ratepayers struggling to make ends meet and to review the terms of payment for delinquent utility ratepayers, especially low-income customers.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING A MUNICIPAL OCCUPANCY FEE FOR SHORT-TERM RENTALS.
purpose: To provide municipalities with an additional revenue stream.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TERM LIMITS FOR PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY COMMISSIONERS.
purpose: To set term limits for the commissioners of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority so that no commissioner may serve indefinitely.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE TO TWO VEHICLES REGISTERED BY AN INDIVIDUAL.
purpose: To limit the Passport to the Parks vehicle registration fee to the first two vehicles an individual registers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY FOR SOLAR PANELS AND LITHIUM-ION BATTERIES.
purpose: To require producers of solar panels and lithium-ion batteries to provide ways to properly dispose of these products without causing environmental harm.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEMP PRODUCERS AND RECREATIONAL CANNABIS.
purpose: To enable existing hemp producers to convert their current operations to cannabis cultivation by way of an expedited process.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SALARY FOR FAMILY MEMBERS WHO CARE FOR INDIVIDUALS EXPERIENCING DEMENTIA.
purpose: To provide a salary based on the state's minimum wage to family members who take time off from work to provide care for individuals experiencing all forms of dementia.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PHARMACISTS TO INFORM PATIENTS AND HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS REGARDING THE LEAST EXPENSIVE MEDICATION OPTION.
purpose: To require pharmacists to inform each patient and the patient's prescribing practitioner regarding the least expensive option for a medication or class of medicine that has been prescribed by the prescribing practitioner and the out-of-pocket cost of such medication or class of medicine if purchased without insurance.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE IMPACT OF PREVAILING WAGE REQUIREMENTS ON MUNICIPAL BUDGETS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the impact of prevailing wage requirements on municipal budgets.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UTILITY PAYMENT PLANS DURING A DECLARED EMERGENCY.
purpose: To require utilities to offer flexible payment plans to customers during an emergency.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO LOW-COST OR FREE TRANSPORTATION FOR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To expand daily access to low-cost or free transportation throughout the state for persons with disabilities to improve their quality of life and facilitate their ability to work.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICABILITY OF GOVERNMENTAL IMMUNITY IN ACTIONS INVOLVING A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICIAL AND THE ABILITY OF A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICIAL TO SEARCH A MOTOR VEHICLE WHEN THE OPERATOR OF THE VEHICLE CONSENTS TO SUCH SEARCH.
purpose: To allow a law enforcement official to assert governmental immunity in more situations, to permit interlocutory appeals of a trial court's denial of the defense of government immunity, and to restore the ability of a motor vehicle operator to consent to a search a motor vehicle upon the request of a law enforcement official.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FEDERAL HOUSING CHOICE PROGRAM VOUCHERS.
purpose: To make modifications to the use of vouchers obtained through the federal Housing Choice Program to assist the recipients of such vouchers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FAIR SHARE HOUSING PLANS FOR MUNICIPALITIES AND SUMMARY PROCESS ACTIONS.
purpose: To create better equity in housing by requiring a state-wide study of regional housing needs, establishing municipal fair share goals, creating financial incentives for municipalities to develop affordable housing, prohibiting certain evictions based on the expiration of the rental agreement, prohibiting excessive rent increases, establishing protections against collateral consequences for evicted tenants, and sealing and removing judicial records for eviction actions.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CONDOMINIUM RESERVE FUND ALLOCATIONS.
purpose: To require that condominium associations perform a reserve fund study and subsequently allocate the appropriate percentage of the annual assessments into the reserve fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REMEDIATION OF ENVIRONMENTAL CONTAMINANTS AND THE REDUCTION OF RISKS ASSOCIATED WITH SUCH CONTAMINATION.
purpose: To reduce environmental contaminants and the risks such contaminants present, in particular, to low-income communities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FLOOD MITIGATION AND RESILIENCY FOR CLIMATE CHANGE.
purpose: To mitigate flooding and associated damage caused by climate change.
