title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A VACANT PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To discourage the underuse of dwelling units by establishing a vacancy tax and requiring municipalities to expend revenues collected pursuant to such tax on affordable housing initiatives.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR AFFORDABLE HOUSING AND EXPANDING THE SCOPE OF FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To increase funding for affordable housing and expand the scope of fair rent commissions.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANY OPERATIONS.
purpose: To create a task force to study the operations of electric distribution companies within the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEARN HERE, LIVE HERE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the annual expenditure on the Learn Here, Live Here program to not more than five million dollars and to make such program available only to individuals whose income is fifty-five thousand dollars or less.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CERTIFICATION AND RECERTIFICATION PROCESSES FOR FIREFIGHTERS AND EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES PERSONNEL.
purpose: To ease the procedural and financial burden on prospective firefighters and emergency medical services personnel.

title: AN ACT ENSURING EACH INSTITUTION OF HIGHER EDUCATION IN THE STATE IMPLEMENTS ITS POLICY CONCERNING THE AVAILABILITY AND USE OF OPIOID ANTAGONISTS ON CAMPUS.
purpose: To address the opioid epidemic on college campuses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEMOLITION OF CERTAIN SINGLE-FAMILY RESIDENCES.
purpose: To remove ambiguity from state law that in order to demolish a home a demolition permit is required.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POLICE OFFICER MISCONDUCT, MEETINGS BETWEEN LAW ENFORCEMENT AND STAKEHOLDERS AND FUNDING FOR COMMUNITY POLICING PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase public safety by building trust between law enforcement officers and the communities they serve and holding law enforcement officers accountable for their actions.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING POLICE OFFICERS TO INFORM A DRIVER OF THE REASON FOR A TRAFFIC STOP.
purpose: To promote transparency and trust between law enforcement officers and the communities they serve by mandating that officers provide the reason for a vehicle stop.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESSIBLE PARKING PLACARDS.
purpose: To change currently used terminology with regards to removable windshield placards to be more inclusive and less derogatory.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE REMOVAL OF DEBRIS IN THE HOUSATONIC RIVER IN STRATFORD.
purpose: To provide resources to remove debris from the Housatonic River.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM AND THE PAYMENT OF CERTAIN GRANTS BEFORE STATE CONVENTIONS.
purpose: To (1) double the primary and general election grant amounts for major party candidates for Governor under the Citizens' Election Program, and (2) allow gubernatorial candidates participating in said program to apply for and receive (A) one-fourth of the grant amount for a primary campaign without waiting until the close of the state convention, and (B) the remaining three-fourths upon the occurrence of certain triggering events.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF PASSENGER RAIL SERVICE ON THE WATERBURY BRANCH OF THE METRO-NORTH COMMUTER RAILROAD.
purpose: To expand passenger rail service on the Waterbury Branch of the Metro-North Commuter Railroad to include the towns of Seymour, Shelton and Derby.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYEES' LOSS OF HEALTH CARE COVERAGE AS A RESULT OF A LABOR DISPUTE.
purpose: To protect employees' health by ensuring employees have access to health care coverage after losing coverage due to a labor dispute.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNEMPLOYMENT FOR STRIKING WORKERS.
purpose: To allow striking workers to collect unemployment benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADOPTION OF THE UNIFORM REAL PROPERTY TRANSFER ON DEATH ACT.
purpose: To provide for the adoption of the Uniform Real Property Transfer on Death Act.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INSURANCE COMMISSIONER TO PROMOTE DEVELOPMENT OF THE INSURANCE INDUSTRY AND INSURANCE WORK FORCE IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To require the Insurance Commissioner to promote development of, and employment opportunities within, the insurance industry in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAFFIC STOPS FOR SUSPECTED CANNABIS USE BY DRIVERS AND TESTS FOR THE DETECTION OF CANNABIS USE BY DRIVERS.
purpose: To promote public safety by enhancing enforcement of driving while under the influence of cannabis.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SELF-SERVICE STORAGE INSURANCE.
purpose: To establish licensing and regulatory requirements for the sale of self-service storage insurance in this state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF BACKGROUND CHECK ERRORS.
purpose: To require the Special Licensing and Firearms Unit of the Department of Emergency Services and Public Protection to study and report on errors in the background check process and prevent issuing firearms permits in the future to individuals who have a conviction that disqualifies such person from holding such permit.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO CONSTRUCT A FIREHOUSE IN BRISTOL.
purpose: To provide funding to construct Firehouse Station 3 in Bristol.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EDUCATION FOR CERTAIN HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS ON PERINATAL MOOD AND ANXIETY DISORDERS.
purpose: To require education for certain health care providers on perinatal mood and anxiety disorders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONDUCT OF POLICE OFFICERS AND LAW ENFORCEMENT UNITS.
purpose: To repeal certain provisions of the general statutes enacted pursuant to the Police Accountability bill of 2020, public act 20-1 of the July Special Session.

title: AN ACT REDUCING INCOME ELIGIBILITY FOR MEDICAID.
purpose: To reduce Medicaid income eligibility and steer persons no longer eligible to the Connecticut Health Insurance Exchange.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVOLVING LOAN FUND TO ASSIST CERTAIN ELDERLY PERSONS DELINQUENT ON PROPERTY TAX PAYMENTS.
purpose: To allow elderly persons to continue living in their homes by providing financial support to pay delinquent property taxes from a revolving loan fund.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO THE STATE-FUNDED PORTION OF THE CONNECTICUT HOME-CARE PROGRAM FOR THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To expand access to the state-funded portion of the Connecticut home-care program for the elderly by reducing copayments and increasing asset limits.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A BUY CONNECTICUT PROGRAM FOR DEFENSE CONTRACTORS.
purpose: To create incentives for defense contractors to utilize the services of in-state subcontractors and businesses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL REIMBURSEMENT FOR EMERGENCY RESPONSE SERVICES PROVIDED ON STATE HIGHWAYS.
purpose: To provide reimbursement to municipalities for emergency response services provided on state highways.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE BARRIERS TO TRANSPORTATION FOR WORK-BASED LEARNING EXPERIENCES.
purpose: To provide for a robust workforce to meet the state's workforce needs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELIGIBILITY TO HOLD PUBLIC OFFICE OR BE EMPLOYED BY THE STATE OR ANY MUNICIPALITY.
purpose: To provide that (1) state and municipal office holders who engage in rebellion or insurrection shall be permanently ineligible to be elected or appointed to any state or municipal office or to serve in the armed forces of the state in the future, and (2) persons convicted of sedition, rebellion or insurrection, or a felony in relation to such act, shall be permanently ineligible to be employed by the state or any municipality.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO THE ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE RESPITE CARE PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand eligibility for the Alzheimer's disease respite care program and support aging in place.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING AGING IN PLACE.
purpose: To expand opportunities for senior citizens to remain independently in their homes and communities and avoid state costs and costs to senior citizens on institutionalization.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ELDER ABUSE REGISTRY.
purpose: To protect senior citizens from abuse, neglect and exploitation with a public data base of persons convicted of crimes against elderly persons.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADDITIONAL RETIREMENT BENEFITS FOR TEACHERS WHO WORKED DURING AND AFTER THE COVID-19 PANDEMIC.
purpose: To provide educators with "hero pay" compensation through their retirement plan for their public service during the COVID-19 pandemic and for remaining in the teaching profession thereafter.

title: AN ACT ALLOCATING FUNDS FOR VICTIM SERVICES.
purpose: To allocate funds to address cuts in federal Victims of Crime Act funds to keep victim services, including domestic violence services, operational.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISTRIBUTION OF FUNDS FOR TOURISM DISTRICTS.
purpose: To provide allocated funds to tourism districts during the tourist season.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO ESTABLISH A SCHOOL-BASED HEALTH CENTER AT THE HIGH SCHOOL IN THE TOWN OF STONINGTON.
purpose: To establish a school-based health center at Stonington High School.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR COMMUNITY-BASED NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF HEALTH AND HUMAN SERVICES.
purpose: To provide financial support for nonprofit community providers that face increased demand for services.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR PUBLIC HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To increase funding for public higher education by twenty-five per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR TOWN-AID GRANTS FOR ROADS AND FOR LOCAL CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS.
purpose: To increase funding for the town-aid grants for roads and local capital improvement projects.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR SCHOOL READINESS AND CHILD DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase the reimbursement rate for school readiness and child development programs by forty per cent.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR FAMILY RESOURCE CENTERS.
purpose: To fully fund family resource centers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPENDITURE OF FUNDS IN THE TOBACCO SETTLEMENT FUND.
purpose: To require that the revenue in the Tobacco Settlement Fund be used to increase funding for tobacco prevention, cessation and enforcement programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR CHRONIC GAMBLING TREATMENT PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase funding for problem gambling to mitigate the impacts of online gaming.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STIPEND FOR CERTAIN LEGISLATORS FOR OVERNIGHT LODGING.
purpose: To ensure public safety and the safety of legislators with lengthy commutes by taking them off the road late at night.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR REGIONAL COUNCILS OF GOVERNMENTS.
purpose: To support and fund regional councils of governments to provide an incentive for regional cooperation and delivery of municipal services.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO DEVELOP COMMUNITY STOP-THE-BLEED PROGRAMS.
purpose: To develop and fund programs that help members of communities address bleeding emergencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ACCEPTANCE OF CREDIT AND DEBIT CARDS FOR THE PURCHASE OF VIRTUAL CURRENCY.
purpose: To provide that credit and debit cards may be accepted for the purchase of virtual currency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR INDOOR AIR QUALITY MANAGEMENT IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To establish a fund to help school districts pay for new or replacement heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems in schools for the purpose of removing initial investment barriers to indoor air quality management.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXCLUSION OF HABITUAL TRUANTS FROM THE CALCULATION OF A SCHOOL DISTRICT'S CHRONIC ABSENTEEISM RATE.
purpose: To exclude habitual truants from the calculation of a school district's chronic absenteeism rate after the board of education has exhausted all efforts to get such habitual truants to attend school.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE GRANT AMOUNT FOR ALLIANCE DISTRICTS.
purpose: To provide additional funding and assistance to alliance districts.

title: AN ACT INCREASING EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANTS FOR RURAL TOWNS.
purpose: To revise the education cost-sharing grant formula to better reflect the needs of rural towns.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER PERIOD FOR CERTAIN READING CURRICULUM MODELS OR PROGRAMS.
purpose: To ease the burden on school districts that meet or exceed student reading achievement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING QUALITY EDUCATION AND NUTRITIOUS LUNCHES FOR ALL.
purpose: To provide equal and comprehensive access to education and academic opportunities for all children in Connecticut and eliminate the stigma surrounding free lunches by making all school lunches the same.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL DISTRICT CURRICULUM COMMITTEES.
purpose: To determine whether school districts are in compliance with the requirement to establish curriculum committees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT FOR THE TOWN OF GROTON.
purpose: To adjust the education cost-sharing grant for the Town of Groton for the educational costs of children associated with the military base.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEACHER CERTIFICATION RECIPROCITY.
purpose: To require teacher certification reciprocity for teachers licensed in good standing in another state for not less than ten years, subject to passing any required background checks.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING BOARDS OF EDUCATION FROM REQUIRING STUDENTS TO SHOW PROOF OF A COVID-19 VACCINATION.
purpose: To allow parents to make health care decisions for their children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE USE OF PRINTED TEXTBOOKS AND DIGITAL TEXTBOOKS IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To study the benefits and cost savings of using printed textbooks or digital textbooks.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DIVERSION OF CHILD CARE SUBSIDY FUNDING TO UNION DUES.
purpose: To ensure that funding for child care subsidies not be diverted to increase provider union dues.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PARENTAL VISITATION IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
purpose: To study the feasibility of allowing parents to visit their child's classroom during the school day.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISPLAY OF THE DECLARATION OF INDEPENDENCE AND THE CONSTITUTION OF THE UNITED STATES FOR STUDENTS IN PUBLIC SCHOOLS THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To ensure that students are able to learn about the foundation of the rights and liberties of all citizens of the United States of America.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF SCHOOL VOUCHER PROGRAMS.
purpose: To remove any prohibitions against a board of education from establishing a program that distributes funds that follow an individual student and gives parents the freedom to choose the appropriate school for their children, and to create more opportunities for school choice in the state while not creating any additional mandates on students or their parents to participate in any public school system.

title: AN ACT PROTECTING A PARENT'S RIGHTS TO OPT THEIR CHILDREN OUT OF EDUCATION COURSES OR CLASSES PROVIDED BY THE SCHOOL DISTRICT.
purpose: To allow parents to meaningfully participate in the education process by ensuring that parents remain the ultimate authority in what their children are being taught in school.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING TRANSPARENCY IN DIVERSITY, EQUITY AND INCLUSION TRAINING MATERIALS.
purpose: To ensure that schools provide transparency in the training and instructional materials used to promote diversity, equity and inclusion and to give parents and students reasonable access to review such materials.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING POLITICAL BIAS IN THE CLASSROOM.
purpose: To prevent political bias in the classroom.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT A SCHOOL DISTRICT MAY REDUCE ITS MINIMUM BUDGET REQUIREMENT WHEN IT EXPERIENCES A DECLINE IN STUDENT ENROLLMENT.
purpose: To provide mandate relief by allowing school districts greater authority to reduce their education budgets when there is reduced student enrollment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PILOT PROGRAM TO ESTABLISH A PIPELINE FOR STUDENTS TO ENROLL IN CT AERO TECH SCHOOL FOR AVIATION MAINTENANCE TECHNICIANS.
purpose: To develop a pilot program that may be used by boards of education to establish a pipeline for students to enroll in CT Aero Tech School for Aviation Maintenance Technicians.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF FINANCIAL LITERACY IN THE PUBLIC SCHOOL CURRICULUM.
purpose: To include financial literacy in the public school curriculum.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC ACCESS TO A SCHOOL DISTRICT'S CURRICULUM AND THE PROHIBITION OF THE TEACHING OF BIASED POLITICAL IDEOLOGY IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To allow parents of students to have a meaningful role in their child's education by requiring access to public school curriculum and prohibiting the teaching of biased political ideology in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION EXCESS COST GRANT.
purpose: To fully fund the special education excess cost grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE USE OF LED LIGHTING IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To study the benefits of using LED lighting in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE INSTALLATION OF HIGH-EFFICIENCY HVAC SYSTEMS IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To study the benefits and cost savings of upgrading heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF SCHOOL MEAL PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require public schools and charter schools to provide free breakfasts and lunches to all students regardless of family income.

title: AN ACT INCLUDING CERTAIN HOLIDAYS ON THE SCHOOL CALENDAR OF ALL PUBLIC SCHOOLS.
purpose: To require each local and regional board of education to include Rosh Hashanah, Yom Kippur, Eid Ul Fitr and Diwali as legal holidays on the school calendar.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEACHERS WHO ARE CERTIFIED IN OTHER STATES AND CERTIFICATION APPLICATION FEES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Education to accept the certification of teachers who are certified in good standing in another state and to cap certification application fees at fifty dollars.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION TO STUDY EDUCATION REFORM.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to study education reform.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF THE NATURALIZATION TEST AS PART OF THE HIGH SCHOOL GRADUATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To encourage civic participation among high school students.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ONLINE POSTING OF SCHOOL CURRICULA AND OTHER COURSE MATERIALS.
purpose: To provide transparency in education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF SODIUM CHLORIDE TO MITIGATE SNOW AND ICE ACCUMULATIONS.
purpose: To provide training, certification and protection from liability for roadside applicators of sodium chloride who use best practices when applying sodium chloride which, in turn, will reduce the environmental impact of such applications.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NEONICOTINOID USE RESTRICTIONS AND RESTRICTIONS ON THE USE OF PESTICIDE TREATED SEEDS.
purpose: To protect pollinators.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENTS TO BOROUGHS AND TAXING DISTRICTS FOR NIPS SOLD IN SUCH BOROUGH OR DISTRICT.
purpose: To provide that payments made to municipalities for nips that are sold in such municipalities may also be made to boroughs and taxing districts.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SUNDAY HUNTING.
purpose: To allow hunting on Sundays.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERMITTING FOR LOCAL BUTCHER SHOPS TO PROCESS FARMER-OWNED LIVESTOCK.
purpose: To address the tremendous backlog by USDA facilities to process farmer's livestock.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BEAR HUNTING IN LITCHFIELD COUNTY.
purpose: To authorize bear hunting in Litchfield County.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING SUNDAY HUNTING.
purpose: To authorize Sunday hunting.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE PROVISION OF ALL-TERRAIN WHEELCHAIRS AT STATE PARKS.
purpose: To provide all-terrain wheelchairs for use by the public at state parks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF THE CLEAN AIR ACT IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To adopt the Clean Air Act in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLIMATE RESILIENCY FUNDS AND PROJECTS.
purpose: To encourage and promote municipalities to invest in coastal resiliency planning.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CENTRAL AIR CONDITIONING AND ENERGY EFFICIENT WINDOWS FROM PROPERTY VALUATION INCREASES.
purpose: To encourage the installation of energy efficient air conditioning systems and windows without affecting a property's valuation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEATING EFFICIENCY IN NEW CONSTRUCTION AND MAJOR ALTERATIONS OF RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS.
purpose: To require new construction of residential homes to use HVAC sources that do not use fossil fuels or electric resistance.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ACCUMULATION OF RESERVES IN DEPOSIT INITIATOR ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To assist deposit initiators in preparing for the increased refund value of a beverage container that begins next year.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A FUND TO ASSIST LAKE AUTHORITIES TO COMBAT INVASIVE AQUATIC SPECIES.
purpose: To provide funding for lake authorities to combat invasive aquatic species.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DELIBERATE FEEDING OF BLACK BEAR AND AUTHORIZING A LIMITED BEAR HUNT SEASON.
purpose: To protect residents of the state through the management of the black bear population.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DOG LICENSING FEES FOR DOGS THAT ARE NOT SPAYED OR NEUTERED.
purpose: To make the dog licensing fees equitable between dogs that are spayed or neutered and dogs that are not spayed or neutered.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING SUNDAY HUNTING.
purpose: To expand hunting to Sundays during hunting season.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY FOR CERTAIN ON-LINE RETAILERS.
purpose: To require that large online retailers provide recycling services to their customers.

title: AN ACT STUDYING THE BEHAVIORAL IMPACT OF BOTTLE DEPOSITS ON RECYCLING AND DELAYING IMPLEMENTATION OF INCREASED DEPOSIT FEES UNTIL SUCH STUDY IS COMPLETED.
purpose: To delay implementation of the increased bottle deposit until a behavioral science study on the deposit's impact on recycling is completed.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF SODIUM CHLORIDE TO MITIGATE SNOW AND ICE ACCUMULATIONS.
purpose: To reduce the environmental impact of sodium chloride use.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY RESPONSE BY TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANIES AFTER OUTAGES.
purpose: To promote accountability for service outages and to protect consumers of Internet and telecommunications services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMPETITION AND EXPANSION OF TELECOMMUNICATIONS SERVICES.
purpose: To ensure competition in the cable and Internet service industry and to create a program to expand cable and Internet coverage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INDEPENDENCE OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY, ELECTRIC RATE REGULATION AND STATE PUBLIC POLICY CONCERNING ELECTRICITY GENERATION.
purpose: To lower the cost of energy for ratepayers in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROTECTING THE ONLINE ECONOMY FROM DATA BREACHES AND LIMITS ON INTERNET DATA USAGE.
purpose: To protect the economy and online learning from data breaches and to remove limits on broadband usage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMUNITY ACCESS PROGRAMMING FUNDING.
purpose: To provide funding to support and maintain community access programming.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN ARTICULATION OF FEES COMPRISING THE DELIVERY PORTION OF AN ELECTRIC BILL.
purpose: To articulate fees that make up the delivery portion of an electric distribution customer's bill.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE VALUE OF ENERGY GENERATED FROM SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT.
purpose: To stabilize the value of the energy generated from energy-producing solid waste management facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ROAD REPAIR BY PUBLIC UTILITIES.
purpose: To require public utilities to repave or repair roads that have been altered or excavated by a public utility to the satisfaction of the local authority controlling the roadway.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING TELECOMMUNICATIONS COMPANIES FROM CHARGING CUSTOMERS TO RECEIVE PAPER BILLS.
purpose: To prohibit Internet, telephone and cable providers from charging customers to receive paper copies of their bills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL OF AMENDMENTS TO CONTRACTS FOR OFFSHORE WIND ENERGY.
purpose: To require legislative approval for amendments to wind procurement contracts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCUREMENT PROCESS FOR STANDARD SERVICE ELECTRICITY.
purpose: To minimize the effect of market fluctuations on standard service electric rates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PETROLEUM STORAGE LEVELS.
purpose: To ensure that state agencies in Connecticut and the region understand how much oil is available in case of emergency circumstances.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF ENERGIZE CONNECTICUT REBATES AND PUBLIC AWARENESS OF REBATE PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase the availability of energy efficiency rebates and increase public awareness of available programs.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CONNECTICUT NUCLEAR ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To create a Connecticut Nuclear Advisory Council to organize state resources and keep legislators and stakeholders informed of developments in the advancement of nuclear power as a carbon-free energy source.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY.
purpose: To make the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority a stand-alone agency, increase staffing, increase communication with the legislative branch, ensure end consumer costs are considered in rate cases and settlements, and address outage and grid connectivity problems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROHIBITION ON PUBLICLY TRADED UTILITY COMPANIES.
purpose: To prohibit the stock of any public utility company from being traded on a stock exchange.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECTS IN FAIRFIELD AND WESTPORT.
purpose: To provide funding to seed development of deed-restricted diverse affordable housing in Fairfield and Westport, including an affordable housing development under the management of the housing authorities of Fairfield and Westport, in conjunction with the towns, the Department of Housing and the United States Department of Housing and Urban Development.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF SMALL TOWN ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAM GRANTS.
purpose: To allow municipalities to use STEAP grants for capital projects on nonmunicipal property.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR DEMOLITION OF THE OLD ANNEX BUILDING IN PLAINFIELD AND CONSTRUCTION ON AND IMPROVEMENTS TO THE SITE.
purpose: To provide funding for the demolition of the old annex building in Plainfield and for construction on and other improvements to the site.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REDEVELOP A BUILDING OWNED BY THE TOWN OF MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding to redevelop a building owned by the town of Montville.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF AN ELDERLY HOUSING FACILITY IN LEBANON.
purpose: To provide funding to construct a sixteen-unit elderly housing facility in Lebanon.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR AN ELDERLY HOUSING FACILITY IN HEBRON.
purpose: To provide funding for a forty-unit elderly housing facility in Hebron.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A PUBLIC WORKS GARAGE AND EQUIPMENT IN COLUMBIA.
purpose: To provide funding for a public works garage in Columbia and necessary equipment.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR MYSTIC AQUARIUM.
purpose: To provide funding for the North American river otter exhibit at Mystic Aquarium.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A PUBLIC WORKS GARAGE IN LEBANON.
purpose: To provide funding to the town of Lebanon for a public works garage.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF A COMFORT STATION IN THE BOROUGH OF STONINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding for a comfort station in the borough of Stonington.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REPLACE THE HVAC SYSTEM AT THE TOWN HALL IN MARLBOROUGH.
purpose: To provide funding to replace the heating, ventilation and air conditioning system in the town hall in Marlborough.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO EXPAND TRAILS AT THE BLACKLEDGE RIVER GREENWAY IN MARLBOROUGH.
purpose: To provide funding to expand trails at the Blackledge River Greenway in Marlborough.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE REMEDIATION OF FILL PILE WASTE CONTAMINATION IN THE TOWN OF FAIRFIELD.
purpose: To provide funding for the remediation of waste contamination associated with the fill pile in the town of Fairfield.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR CONTRIBUTIONS TO 529 QUALIFIED STATE TUITION PROGRAM ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To expand the personal income tax deduction for contributions to 529 qualified state tuition program accounts to include contributions to such accounts established and maintained by other states.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STUDENT LOAN DEBT RELIEF RECEIVED BY A TAXPAYER.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for the amount of any student loan debt relief a taxpayer received for the taxable year.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE THRESHOLD FOR IMPOSITION OF THE LUXURY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To increase the threshold for imposition of the "luxury tax" on the sale, acceptance or receipt in this state of a motor vehicle to seventy-five thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME FOR MARRIED INDIVIDUALS FILING JOINTLY.
purpose: To increase to one hundred fifty thousand dollars the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income, for married individuals filing jointly.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN COMMERCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES FROM THE LUXURY TAX.
purpose: To exempt from the "luxury tax" motor vehicles used for commercial purposes and sold, accepted or received in this state for a sales price of eighty thousand dollars or less.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REPAIR CULVERTS AND SINKHOLES IN MARLBOROUGH.
purpose: To provide funding to repair culverts and sinkholes in Marlborough.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF AN EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES FACILITY IN THE TOWN OF EASTON.
purpose: To provide funding for the town of Easton for the construction of an emergency medical services facility in the town of Easton.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN AGRICULTURAL VEHICLES FROM THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To exempt all vehicles transporting agricultural commodities, machinery or supplies to or from a farm from the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RESTRUCTURING OF CERTAIN TAXES AND TAX EQUITY.
purpose: To restructure certain taxes to reduce taxes for middle-income taxpayers and seniors and to increase collections, investigations and reporting by certain state agencies.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CHILD TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To establish a child tax credit against the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO RECONSTRUCT BOW BRIDGE IN OLD LYME.
purpose: To provide funding to reconstruct Bow Bridge in Old Lyme.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE CONSTRUCTION OF A CHILD CARE CENTER IN GROTON.
purpose: To provide funding to Thames Valley Council for Community Action to construct a child care center in Groton.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE EXPANSION OF THE FIREHOUSE OF VOLUNTOWN VOLUNTEER FIRE COMPANY NO. 1.
purpose: To provide funding for the expansion of the firehouse of Voluntown Volunteer Fire Company No. 1, which serves the town and fights forest fires in Pachaug State Forest.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR PURCHASE OF A GENERATOR FOR THE LEDYARD SENIOR CENTER.
purpose: To provide funding to purchase a generator for the Ledyard Senior Center.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO PURCHASE A GENERATOR FOR THE SOCIAL SERVICES BUILDING IN MONTVILLE.
purpose: To providing funding to purchase a generator for the Social Services Building in Montville.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF A GENERATOR FOR THE LEDYARD FOOD PANTRY.
purpose: To provide funding for a generator at the Ledyard Food Pantry to ensure the preservation of food in the event of a power outage.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME AND CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNT DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR REPAIRS TO SANDY HOLLOW ROAD IN LEDYARD.
purpose: To provide funding for repairs to Sandy Hollow Road in Ledyard.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A SEWER PROJECT IN THE TOWN OF SPRAGUE.
purpose: To provide funding for the installation of a force main and sewer lines and associated costs in the village of Hanover in the town of Sprague.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO PURCHASE A GENERATOR FOR THE MONTVILLE SENIOR CENTER.
purpose: To provide funding for the purchase of a generator for the Montville Senior Center.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR PROJECTS OF THE SOUTHEASTERN CONNECTICUT WATER AUTHORITY.
purpose: To provide funding to the Southeastern Connecticut Water Authority to upgrade a pump station, add a storage tank and extend an emergency connection line into the town of Ledyard.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR BROWNFIELD REMEDIATION AT A SITE IN THE TOWN OF LISBON.
purpose: To provide funding to remediate a brownfield site in the town of Lisbon.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION AND IMPROVEMENT OF WATER LINES IN HEBRON.
purpose: To provide funding for the construction and improvement of water lines in Hebron.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF SEWER LINES IN BOZRAH.
purpose: To provide funding for construction of sewer lines in Bozrah.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE INSTALLATION OF A POLICE STATION IN THE CITY OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding for the installation of a police station in the city of Norwich.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF CERTAIN VEHICLES BY THE COLUMBIA VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To provide funding to the Columbia Volunteer Fire Department to purchase certain vehicles.

purpose: To reduce the marginal rates for the personal income tax, allow an eligible taxpayer to claim the entirety of an asset expense deduction under Section 179 of the Internal Revenue Code at once rather than incrementally and establish a task force to recommend a plan to offset the revenue loss resulting from the personal income tax reductions.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE FRANKLIN VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENT TO PURCHASE FIRE APPARATUS.
purpose: To provide funding to the Franklin Volunteer Fire Department to purchase fire apparatus.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CAPITAL IMPROVEMENTS TO THE LAUREL HILL FIRE DEPARTMENT IN THE CITY OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding for capital improvements to the Laurel Hill Fire Department in the city of Norwich.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR IMPROVEMENTS TO THE ATHLETIC FIELD AT RHAM HIGH SCHOOL IN HEBRON.
purpose: To provide funding for improvements to the athletic field at RHAM High School in Hebron.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE VOTING RIGHTS.
purpose: To allow for the challenge of certain election practices that may impair protected class voting rights.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE RATIFICATION OF THE GOVERNOR'S EMERGENCY DECLARATIONS.
purpose: To authorize any member of the General Assembly to call for a vote to ratify the issuance or renewal of an emergency declaration by the Governor and to require a two-thirds vote for passage of such ratification.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL OF CERTAIN EXECUTIVE ORDERS ISSUED WHILE THE LEGISLATURE IS IN REGULAR SESSION.
purpose: To require legislative review of executive orders issued pursuant to a public health or civil preparedness emergency declaration when the legislature is in regular session.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN LOCAL ELECTION OFFICIALS' USE OF THE STATE-WIDE CENTRALIZED VOTER REGISTRATION SYSTEM.
purpose: To (1) require certain local election officials to utilize the state-wide centralized voter registration system when performing certain duties related to election administration, and (2) provide a penalty for noncompliance with such requirement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF POLITICAL ACTIVITY BY NONPROFIT ORGANIZATIONS THAT RECEIVE STATE FUNDING OR PASS-THROUGH GRANTS.
purpose: To address political activity by nonprofit organizations that receive state funding or pass-through grants.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF PRIVATE FUNDS BY THE STATE AND MUNICIPALITIES FOR ELECTION ADMINISTRATION PURPOSES.
purpose: To prohibit the solicitation, receipt or use by the state and municipalities of private funds for the purpose of carrying out election administration functions.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF CERTAIN SOCIAL NETWORKING APPLICATIONS ON STATE GOVERNMENT EQUIPMENT.
purpose: To prohibit the use of TikTok and WeChat applications on state electronic equipment.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP AND OFFICE TO UNCOVER FRAUD AND WASTE IN STATE GOVERNMENT.
purpose: To prevent the waste of taxpayer dollars and investigate and prosecute claims of fraud or waste within state agencies or by private providers.

title: AN ACT MODIFYING THE PROCESS FOR CLAIMING AND RETURNING UNCLAIMED PROPERTY HELD BY THE TREASURER.
purpose: To revise the unclaimed property process in the state.

title: AN ACT AMENDING A CONVEYANCE OF A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE TOWN OF FAIRFIELD.
purpose: To amend a prior land conveyance to allow the town of Fairfield to utilize the conveyed land for charitable purposes.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING BOSNIAN GENOCIDE REMEMBRANCE DAY.
purpose: To designate Bosnian Genocide Remembrance Day in recognition of the Bosnian Genocide.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING INDIGENOUS PEOPLES DAY AS A STATE HOLIDAY.
purpose: To designate Indigenous Peoples Day as a state holiday.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPEN AND EARLIER PRIMARIES.
purpose: To allow unaffiliated electors to vote in political party primaries and require that such primaries be held earlier in the calendar year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRESIDENTIAL ELECTORS.
purpose: To nullify the vote of, remove and replace any faithless presidential elector.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ONLINE PLATFORMS AND CAMPAIGN FINANCE.
purpose: To regulate social media platforms for campaign finance purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RANKED-CHOICE VOTING.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REUSE OF WORKS OF ART IN STATE BUILDINGS.
purpose: To reduce state spending by reusing existing works of art in state buildings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRONIC TICKETING AND TICKET RESALE MARKETPLACES.
purpose: To impose various duties on operators of entertainment ticketing marketplaces and entertainment ticket resale marketplaces doing business in this state.

title: AN ACT BANNING ASBESTOS AND LEAD FROM COMMON PRODUCTS.
purpose: To ban asbestos and lead from common products.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING FEES FOR PAPER BILLS.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOCIAL MEDIA AND PARENTAL CONSENT.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING BUSINESSES TO ACCEPT CASH PAYMENTS.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CYBERBULLYING.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CONSUMER CHARGES FOR PAPER BILLS.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHARMACISTS AND PILL BOX PREPARATION.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING PHARMACISTS TO ADMINISTER ADDITIONAL CHILDHOOD VACCINATIONS.
purpose: To authorize pharmacists to administer additional vaccines to children in accordance with state and federal guidelines.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC ACCESS TO RESTROOMS IN COMMERCIAL AND RETAIL ESTABLISHMENTS.

purpose: To require institutions of higher education to adopt policies in accordance with federal and state constitutional free speech protections.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING EQUITABLE MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT RATES FOR METHADONE MAINTENANCE TREATMENT.
purpose: To increase and equalize Medicaid rates for methadone maintenance treatment and provide increased access to methadone treatment and related services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR SUBSTANCE ABUSE RECOVERY COACHES.
purpose: To allow recovery coaches to be eligible for Medicaid reimbursement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR PHARMACISTS DISPENSING BLISTER PACK MEDICATIONS.
purpose: To increase the dispensing fee by five dollars for pharmacists dispensing ninety-day prescriptions in medication blister packs to Medicaid enrollees.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID RATES FOR COMPLEX CARE NURSING SERVICES.
purpose: To increase Medicaid reimbursement rates for complex care nursing services provided in the homes of Medicaid beneficiaries and eliminate differentials in rates based on the age of a patient.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES FROM DISCOURAGING LEGAL REPRESENTATION OF APPLICANTS AND BENEFICIARIES AND FROM ENGAGING IN UNAUTHORIZED PRACTICE OF THE LAW.
purpose: To ensure adequate legal representation for applicants and beneficiaries of assistance programs administered by the Department of Social Services.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING MEDICAID COVERAGE TO MEDICAL SERVICES RELATED TO TREATMENT OF OBESITY.
purpose: To extend Medicaid coverage to medical services related to treatment of obesity.

title: AN ACT STRENGTHENING SUPPORT SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER.
purpose: To provide support and services for persons with autism spectrum disorder by ameliorating wait lists for Medicaid waiver programs and implementing policies designed to maximize federal and state resources to provide support and services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ALLEVIATING WAIT LISTS FOR AUTISM SPECTRUM DISORDER MEDICAID WAIVER SERVICES.
purpose: To increase the number of persons who may receive services through autism spectrum disorder Medicaid waiver programs by adding a waiver program or implementing a flexible dollar threshold for services.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING NATUROPATHS FROM MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT.
purpose: To exclude naturopaths from a list of providers eligible for Medicaid reimbursement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR RECOVERY COACHES AND COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKERS.
purpose: To authorize Medicaid reimbursement, capped at one hundred thousand dollars each, for substance abuse recovery coaches and community health workers.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT RATES FOR METHADONE MAINTENANCE TREATMENT.
purpose: To expand access to methadone maintenance treatment by increasing reimbursement rates under Medicaid and establishing a minimum rate of one hundred dollars per week, per client.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR EMPLOYERS WHO HIRE PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To expand employment opportunities for persons with disabilities by providing a tax credit for employers who hire persons with disabilities.

title: AN ACT INCREASING MEDICAID PAYMENT RATES TO NOT LESS THAN NINETY PER CENT OF MEDICARE RATES.
purpose: To ensure equitable and adequate Medicaid reimbursement rates.

title: AN ACT CODIFYING STATE ADOPTION OF THE INDIAN CHILD WELFARE ACT AND CLARIFYING ITS APPLICATION.
purpose: To codify state adoption of the Indian Child Welfare Act and clarify its application.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID COVERAGE FOR SOCIAL WORKER VISITS TO CLIENTS RECEIVING HOME CARE.
purpose: To better serve the needs of Medicaid beneficiaries receiving home care by providing Medicaid reimbursement for up to two social worker visits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR TELEHEALTH SERVICES.
purpose: To continue access to affordable and accessible health care by permanently providing Medicaid reimbursement for telehealth services to the same extent as such reimbursement for in-person services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING OPPORTUNITIES FOR PEOPLE WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To ensure the statutes regarding housing are consistent with the Americans with Disabilities Act and the Fair Housing Act to provide more housing opportunities in the community for people with disabilities.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE POPULATION THRESHOLD FOR REQUIRING FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To provide residents of small communities with the opportunity to advocate against unfair rent increases.

title: AN ACT DECLARING HOMELESSNESS A PUBLIC HEALTH CRISIS AND ESTABLISHING A COMMISSION ON HOMELESSNESS.
purpose: To declare homelessness a public health crisis and establish a commission on homelessness.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RIGHT TO HOUSING.
purpose: To establish a right to housing and form a right to housing committee.

title: AN ACT CREATING A FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYER SAVINGS ACCOUNT AND TAX DEDUCTION.
purpose: To establish a first-time homebuyer savings account program and tax deduction.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HOUSING AUTHORITY RESIDENT QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT GRANT PROGRAM AND A HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER TASK FORCE AND REQUIRING THE DISCLOSURE OF CERTAIN NATURAL PERSON OWNERSHIP INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To (1) establish a resident quality of life improvement grant program, (2) establish a housing choice voucher task force, and (3) require the disclosure of certain natural person ownership interests in real property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER PROTECTION IN THE LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE MARKET.
purpose: To ensure consumer protection in the long-term care insurance market.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MEDICAID AND THE CHILDREN'S HEALTH INSURANCE PROGRAM TO PROVIDE HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR PHYSICAL THERAPY SERVICES.
purpose: To require Medicaid and the Children's Health Insurance Program to provide health insurance coverage for physical therapy services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIREARMS SAFETY.
purpose: To reduce gun violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE-OPERATED REINSURANCE PROGRAM AND THE REGULATION OF HEALTH CARE COST GROWTH.
purpose: To reduce the cost of health care in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF PREMIUM RATES ON LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To: (1) Evaluate an alternative pool for long-term care policy holders in excess of twenty years; (2) require that the Insurance Department hold a public hearing for long-term care premium rate increase requests that exceed ten per cent; and (3) require that long-term care insurers provide potential policyholders with explicit notice, prior to the purchase of long-term care insurance policies, of the high risk of future premium rate increases.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THAT LEAVE PURSUANT TO THE CONNECTICUT PAID LEAVE AUTHORITY IS SECONDARY TO SHORT-TERM DISABILITY INSURANCE COVERAGE.
purpose: To require that leave pursuant to the Connecticut Paid Leave Authority is secondary to short-term disability insurance when individuals apply for short-term disability insurance coverage.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN ANNUAL AUDIT AND REPORT CONCERNING CERTAIN HEALTH CARE PLANS ADMINISTERED BY THIS STATE.
purpose: To provide for greater transparency in, and legislative oversight of, health care plans administered by this state and offered to persons other than state employees.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR CERTAIN SURGICAL PROCEDURES PERFORMED TO TREAT SEVERE OBESITY.
purpose: To require that individual and group health insurance policies provide coverage for certain surgical procedures performed to treat severe obesity, including, but not limited to, gastric bypass surgery, sleeve gastrectomy and duodenal switch surgery.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR DIABETES TEST STRIPS.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for diabetes test strips.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESIDENTIAL CONDITION REPORTS IN REAL ESTATE TRANSACTIONS.
purpose: To eliminate certain real estate disclosures required in residential condition reports.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF HEALTH STRATEGY ACCOUNTABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To require that the Office of Health Strategy conduct additional reporting, accounting and transparency measures.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO HEALTH CARE FOR FARM WORKERS.
purpose: To provide farm workers with expanded access to health care in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MAMMOGRAMS AND COST TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To require a health care provider to disclose to a patient whether any additional testing performed following a mammogram is an elective procedure, and require the health care provider to disclose whether the cost of such additional testing is covered by the patient's health insurance policy or provide the patient with an opportunity to determine whether such cost is covered by such policy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISTINCT BILLING SYSTEMS FOR HOSPITALS AND OFF-CAMPUS PROVIDER DEPARTMENTS OF HOSPITALS.
purpose: To require: (1) Off-campus provider departments of hospitals to obtain a separate national provider identifier and tax identification number from the main hospital campus; and (2) hospitals to use industry standard paper and electronic billing forms when billing for services provided at off-campus outpatient sites.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING CERTAIN SPONSORING ASSOCIATIONS TO CREATE MULTIPLE EMPLOYER WELFARE ARRANGEMENTS.
purpose: To permit sponsoring associations greater than a specified membership threshold to create multiple employer welfare arrangements.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR PERIOD PILLS.
purpose: To require that all individual and group health insurance policies in this state provide coverage for period pills.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CERTIFICATE OF NEED TASK FORCE.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the certificate of need task force established by public act 22-118, and that such task force be reestablished for an additional year.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR MOTORIZED WHEELCHAIRS.
purpose: To: (1) Require health insurance coverage for (A) motorized wheelchairs, including, but not limited to, used motorized wheelchairs, requested by insureds, (B) motorized wheelchair repairs, and (C) motorized wheelchair battery replacements; and (2) require health insurers to establish centralized locations to collect used motorized wheelchairs.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR MEDICAL FOODS FOR INDIVIDUALS DIAGNOSED WITH PHENYLKETONURIA.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for medical foods for individuals diagnosed with phenylketonuria.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF PUBLIC OPTION HEALTH CARE PLANS IN OTHER STATES AND A RECOMMENDATION FOR A PUBLIC OPTION HEALTH CARE PLAN IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To require the Comptroller and the Office of Health Strategy to (1) conduct a study evaluating public option health care plans in other states, and (2) submit a report, including a recommendation for a public option health care plan in this state, to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR THE THEFT OF ELECTRIC BICYCLES.
purpose: To require theft-only insurance coverage for electric bicycles.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR PEDIATRIC AUTOIMMUNE NEUROPSYCHIATRIC DISORDERS ASSOCIATED WITH STREPTOCOCCAL INFECTIONS AND PEDIATRIC ACUTE-ONSET NEUROPSYCHIATRIC SYNDROME.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for the diagnosis and treatment of pediatric autoimmune neuropsychiatric disorders associated with streptococcal infections and pediatric acute-onset neuropsychiatric syndrome.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS FROM DISCLOSING TO LIFE INSURANCE COMPANIES CERTAIN MEDICAL INFORMATION OF FIRST RESPONDERS DIAGNOSED WITH POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER.
purpose: To prohibit health care providers from disclosing to life insurance companies medical information of first responders diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder who seek medical treatment for suicidal ideations.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FOR OPTIONAL PAYMENT OF THE HEALTHY HOMES FUND SURCHARGE.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that insureds under certain homeowners insurance policies pay, and provide for optional payment of, the surcharge imposed pursuant to said section.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE CONNECTICUT HEALTH INSURANCE EXCHANGE TO REPORT ADDITIONAL DATA.
purpose: To require the Connecticut Health Insurance Exchange board of directors to report additional data to the joint standing committees of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance and public health.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSESSMENTS AND USER FEES CHARGED TO HEALTH CARRIERS BY THE CONNECTICUT HEALTH INSURANCE EXCHANGE.
purpose: To require the exchange, established pursuant to section 38a-1081 of the general statutes, to gain legislative approval before: (1) Modifying any existing assessment or user fee charged to health carriers; or (2) charging any new assessment or user fee to health carriers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR COCHLEAR IMPLANT SURGERY.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide coverage for cochlear implant surgery for certain individuals diagnosed with hearing loss.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR EQUINE THERAPY FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To require individual and group health insurance policies to provide health insurance coverage for equine therapy for veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FEES ASSESSED BY A NOTARY PUBLIC.
purpose: To increase the fee for any act performed by a notary public.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING PERSONS AGE SEVENTY OR OLDER TO OPT OUT OF JURY SERVICE.
purpose: To allow persons age seventy or older to opt out of service as a juror.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AMOUNT OF DAMAGES THAT MAY BE CLAIMED IN A SMALL CLAIMS ACTION.
purpose: To increase the amount of money damages that may be claimed in a small claims action.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FILING OF DISCRIMINATION AND HARASSMENT COMPLAINTS WITH THE SUPERIOR COURT.
purpose: To expedite access to justice for those claiming discrimination and harassment.

title: AN ACT CREATING A STATE CAUSE OF ACTION FOR INJURIES RECEIVED OR ILLNESS CAUSED BY VACCINATIONS OR MEDICINAL TREATMENT REQUIRED AS A CONDITION OF EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To create a cause of action allowing an employee to recover actual and punitive damages for injuries or illness caused by a vaccination or medicinal treatment program if the employer required the employee to receive the vaccine or medicinal treatment as a condition of employment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SINGLE-PARTY CONSENT TO THE RECORDING OF A CONVERSATION.
purpose: To provide for single-party consent to the recording of a conversation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL LIABILITY FOR INJURIES OCCURRING IN A SKATEBOARD OR DOG PARK MAINTAINED BY THE MUNICIPALITY.
purpose: To reduce a municipality's exposure to liability for injuries occurring in a municipally maintained skateboard or dog park.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE JURISDICTIONAL MONETARY LIMIT FOR SMALL CLAIMS MATTERS.
purpose: To expand access to small claims court for the resolution of legal disputes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GENDER-SPECIFIC FACILITIES AND ACTIVITIES IN PRIVATE BUSINESSES.
purpose: To set forth the right of  an individual business to determine the policies of the business establishment with respect to gender-specific access to facilities and activities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CIVIL IMMUNITY FOR INTERSCHOLASTIC ATHLETIC ORGANIZATIONS AND THE SANCTIONING BODIES OF PRIVATE YOUTH ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To provide civil immunity for interscholastic athletic organizations and the sanctioning bodies of private youth organizations when such entities adopt policies that require an athletic participant to compete on a team that matches the gender identity on the person's birth certificate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES OF CONSERVATORS.
purpose: To require that any person appointed as a conservator pursuant to the provisions of chapter 802h of the general statutes shall, not later than sixty days after the date of appointment, have and maintain on file a conserved person's next of kin, vital statistics and wishes for disposal of body and communicate such information to the appropriate individuals upon the conserved person's death.

title: AN ACT WAIVING THE ASSESSMENT OF FEES IN THE PROBATE COURT FOR WIDOWS AND WIDOWERS.
purpose: To eliminate Probate Court fees that are assessed and owed to the court by widows and widowers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MENTAL HEALTH OF THE STATE'S INCARCERATED POPULATION.
purpose: To provide sufficient resources to respond to the report by the Connecticut Sentencing Commission concerning the mental health of the state's incarcerated population.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING IMMUNITY FROM CIVIL LIABILITY TO A PHYSICIAN WHO ACCOMPANIES AND ASSISTS A STATE, REGIONAL OR MUNICIPAL SWAT TEAM.
purpose: To provide immunity to a physician who accompanies and assists a state, regional or municipal SWAT team.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING DISCRIMINATION MATTERS BEFORE THE COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS AND OPPORTUNITIES.
purpose: To increase the penalty for committing a discriminatory housing practice and require the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities to increase the number of staff assigned to investigate discriminatory housing complaints.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INVOLVEMENT OF CHILD PSYCHOLOGISTS IN FAMILY RELATIONS MATTERS.
purpose: To mandate that a child psychologist be appointed in every family relations matter involving children in order to better meet the ongoing needs of the children during the duration of the family relations matter.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING PERSONS WHO ARE CONVICTED OF A DOMESTIC VIOLENCE CRIME OR A FAMILY VIOLENCE CRIME FROM RECEIVING ALIMONY, PENSION PROCEEDS OR OTHER FINANCIAL SUPPORT FROM THE SPOUSE WHO WAS A VICTIM OF SUCH CRIME.
purpose: To protect victims of domestic and family violence.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICIAL'S ABILITY TO REQUEST THAT THE OPERATOR OF A MOTOR VEHICLE STOPPED FOR A MOTOR VEHICLE VIOLATION CONSENT TO A SEARCH OF SUCH VEHICLE.
purpose: To permit a law enforcement official to request that the operator of a motor vehicle stopped for a motor vehicle violation consent to a search of such vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PENALTY FOR ASSAULTING A COACH.
purpose: To promote safety of coaches in youth sports, thus promoting the safety of those promoting team sports and sportsmanship.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE OFFERING OF SLEEPING ACCOMMODATIONS AT HOTELS, MOTELS OR SIMILAR LODGINGS AT AN HOURLY RATE AND REQUIRING THAT USERS OF SUCH PLACES OF PUBLIC ACCOMMODATION PROVIDE THE OPERATOR WITH POSITIVE PROOF OF IDENTIFICATION.
purpose: To protect victims of sex trafficking and enhance the ability of law enforcement personnel to apprehend and prosecute individuals who promote sex trafficking.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REUNIFICATION OF CHILDREN IN THE TEMPORARY CUSTODY OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To ensure the timely reunification of children in the temporary custody of the Department of Children and Families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FOSTER PARENTS' BILL OF RIGHTS AND STAFF TURNOVER REDUCTION AND BIAS TRAINING AT THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Children and Families to create a foster parents' bill of rights, reduce staff and social worker turnover, and implement bias training for social workers.

title: AN ACT STUDYING THE FEASIBILITY OF ESTABLISHING A RETURN-TO-WORK PROGRAM.
purpose: To study the feasibility of establishing a return-to-work program to assist individuals in returning to the workforce.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CLEAR AND CONSPICUOUS STATEMENTS CONCERNING A STATE OR MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEE'S RIGHT TO OPT OUT OF A UNION.
purpose: To provide clear disclosures on collective bargaining agreements of a public employee's right to opt out of membership in the union.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOMEMAKERS AND COMPANIONS AND NONCOMPETE PROVISIONS.
purpose: To eliminate the prohibition on noncompete provisions in private employment contracts for homemakers and companions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN INCREASE TO THE PREVAILING WAGE THRESHOLD FOR RENOVATIONS.
purpose: To (1) raise the prevailing wage threshold for renovations, and (2) index the threshold to the inflation rate for new construction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TIME FRAMES FOR BINDING ARBITRATION.
purpose: To amend time frames for binding arbitration in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE EMPLOYEES AND THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE ACT.
purpose: To have state employees participate in the Paid Family and Medical leave program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RECALL REQUIREMENTS OF LAID-OFF WORKERS.
purpose: To repeal public act 21-189, which requires employers to recall certain laid-off workers in order of seniority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPALITIES AND THE PREVAILING WAGE REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To prevent municipalities from experiencing undue financial hardships due to public work projects' prevailing wage requirements.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE DAYS AN EMPLOYER CAN MANDATE AN EMPLOYEE TO WORK.
purpose: To protect workers' work-life balance, mental health and prevent burnout.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION AND THE PRESUMPTION FOR FIREFIGHTERS THAT A CANCER DIAGNOSIS AROSE OUT OF AND IN THE COURSE OF EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To create a presumption that a firefighter's diagnosis of cancer arose out of and in the course of employment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION BENEFITS FOR CERTAIN MENTAL OR EMOTIONAL INJURIES.
purpose: To allow workers' compensation coverage to all workers for mental or emotional injuries.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REQUIREMENTS AND PATHWAYS FOR STATE EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To increase the applicant pool for state employment.

title: AN ACT TRANSFERRING THE CHARTER OAK FRAME AND CONNECTICUT CONSTITUTION TO THE SENATE CHAMBER.
purpose: To allow visitors to see and appreciate an important piece of Connecticut history.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REMOVAL AND REPLACEMENT OF CERTAIN DEPICTIONS OF INDIGENOUS PEOPLE AND HISTORICAL STATUES WITHIN LEGISLATIVE BUILDINGS.
purpose: To remove certain statues and pictures in the Capitol to provide an accurate portrayal of Quinnehtukqut history.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE REIMBURSEMENT RATE FOR STATE-OWNED REAL PROPERTY UNDER THE PAYMENT IN LIEU OF TAXES PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase state reimbursements to municipalities for state-owned real property.

title: AN ACT RESTRICTING PROPERTY TAX GROWTH AND THE IMPOSITION OF NEW MANDATES ON MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To establish a cap on the annual growth of property tax imposed and require a two-thirds vote of the General Assembly for the imposition of any new mandate on a municipality.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY ISSUES RELATING TO THE REPEAL OF THE MOTOR VEHICLE PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the property tax on motor vehicles and replace resulting lost municipal revenue through the imposition of a tax on insurers on total direct net premiums from certain insurance policies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DELINQUENT PROPERTY TAX INTEREST RATE.
purpose: To reduce the interest rate charged against delinquent property tax payments and installments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR CERTAIN DISABLED VETERANS.
purpose: To authorize any municipality to exempt from property taxation any veteran with a one hundred per cent disability rating.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRONIC BOOK LICENSING.
purpose: To require publishers of electronic books to license such books to public libraries on reasonable terms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ONLINE PUBLIC NOTICES.
purpose: To permit municipalities to publish public notices on news Internet web sites that serve such municipalities in lieu of newspapers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENT FROM THE MASHANTUCKET PEQUOT AND MOHEGAN FUND TO THE TOWN OF EAST WINDSOR.
purpose: To require payment of one million dollars annually from the Mashantucket Pequot and Mohegan Fund to the town of East Windsor until the tribal property in the town of East Windsor is sold or developed.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO PUBLIC BEACHES.
purpose: To ensure access to public beaches.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REGULATION OF CERTAIN SEWAGE DISPOSAL SYSTEMS.
purpose: To permit the Department of Public Health to regulate sewage disposal systems with daily capacities of up to ten thousand gallons.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AN EXTENSION OF TIME FOR FILING AN ANNUAL DECLARATION OF PERSONAL PROPERTY FOR CERTAIN TAXPAYERS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to grant extensions for the filing of annual declarations of personal property to taxpayers who experienced a hardship that prevented the timely filing of such declarations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR SOLAR PROJECTS.
purpose: To clarify solar project property tax exemptions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CALCULATION OF STATE FOREST LAND IN CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES FOR PURPOSES OF GRANTS IN LIEU OF TAXES PAYMENTS.
purpose: To calculate the value of state forest land, for purposes of grants in lieu of taxes payments by the state to municipalities, as real property for any municipality in which over fifty per cent of the land within such municipality's boundaries is state forest.

title: AN ACT INCREASING CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY PAYMENTS TO CERTAIN TOWNS.
purpose: To adjust the payments representing property tax for property at Bradley International Airport to Windsor Locks, Suffield, East Granby and Windsor to reflect improvements since the payment amounts were set in 2012.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TRIBAL LAND TRUST STUDY TASK FORCE.
purpose: To establish a task force to evaluate the impact of the creation of tribal land trusts on municipalities and develop a plan to mitigate financial losses incurred by municipalities as a result.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NEW HARTFORD VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENT AND THE PINE MEADOW FIRE DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To authorize the consolidation of the New Hartford Volunteer Fire Department and the Pine Meadow Fire Department in the town of New Hartford.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENACTMENT OF NEW AND ENLARGED MUNICIPAL MANDATES.
purpose: To require any bill creating or enlarging a municipal mandate to be approved by a vote of not less than two-thirds of the members of each chamber of the General Assembly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF EMINENT DOMAIN FOR COMMERCIAL PURPOSES.
purpose: To prohibit the state and municipalities from exercising the use of eminent domain for commercial purposes.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE MUNICIPAL REGULATION OF FIREARMS.
purpose: To prohibit municipalities from adopting ordinances and regulations to regulate firearms.

title: AN ACT CLARIFYING THE ROLE OF ZONING BOARDS OF APPEALS IN THE LICENSING OF MOTOR VEHICLE DEALERSHIPS AND REPAIR SHOPS.
purpose: To clarify the role of the zoning boards of appeals in relation to the licensing of motor vehicle dealerships and repair shops.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MUNICIPAL NOTICE AND EXPLANATION OF CERTAIN TAX PAYMENT ISSUES.
purpose: To require municipalities to provide taxpayers notice and explanation of certain tax payment issues.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE POPULATION THRESHOLD FOR MUNICIPALITIES TO BE ELIGIBLE FOR RECEIVERS TO POSSESS AND REHABILITATE BUILDINGS.
purpose: To reduce to twenty-five thousand or more the population threshold for a municipality to be eligible for a receiver to take possession and undertake rehabilitation of a building within such municipality.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LICENSING AND REGULATION OF SHORT-TERM RENTAL PROPERTIES.
purpose: To permit municipalities to hire consultants to license and regulate short-term rental properties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ALTERNATE MEMBERS OF MUNICIPAL PLANNING COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To permit members of municipal zoning commissions and municipal boards of appeals to serve as alternate members of municipal planning commissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTION FOR SOLAR PROJECTS AND THE TAX CALCULATION OF SOLAR PROJECTS ON ONE PARCEL OF LAND.
purpose: To remove the property tax exemption for solar projects between one-half megawatt and seven megawatts and to consider solar projects on one parcel of land to be one solar project for tax calculation purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEAD AND DYING TREES ON MUNICIPAL ROADS AND LAND.
purpose: To establish a grant program to assist municipalities in removing certain dead and dying trees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PLACEMENT OF FLAGS AND CEMETERY OPERATING HOURS DURING CERTAIN HOLIDAYS.
purpose: To (1) permit the early placement of flags prior to Memorial Day and other state holidays and remembrance days, and (2) require cemeteries to permit visitors from 7:00 a.m. to 7:00 p.m. on such days.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM FOR THE RETENTION OF SOCIAL WORKERS AND COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKERS BY MUNICIPAL HOUSING AUTHORITIES.
purpose: To establish a pilot program for the retention of on-staff licensed social workers and community health workers by municipal housing authorities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY CERTAIN MANDATES TO MUNICIPALITIES AND SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study and make recommendations concerning unnecessary and unfunded mandates to municipalities and school districts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY METHODS OF CARDIAC SCREENING OF FIRST RESPONDERS FOR EARLY DETECTION OF CARDIAC ISSUES.
purpose: To establish a working group to study methods of cardiac screening of first responders for early detection of cardiac issues in first responders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LICENSURE REQUIREMENTS FOR ESTHETICIANS.
purpose: To require the Department of Public Health to evaluate and make adjustments to the licensure requirements for estheticians relative to employment opportunities, salary scales and student loan indebtedness.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PREVENTION OF HEALTH AND SAFETY INSPECTION REDUNDANCIES BETWEEN CERTAIN AGENCIES.
purpose: To prevent redundancies between local and state agencies with respect to health and safety inspections.

title: AN ACT REVISING THE STATUTORY DEFINITION OF A GROUP HOME.
purpose: To revise the statutory definition of a group home.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING MENTAL HEALTH AND BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICE OPTIONS TO INCLUDE ANIMAL THERAPY.
purpose: To expand mental health care and behavioral health care service options to include animal therapy.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE AVAILABILITY OF A PROTECTIVE VEST OR APRON FOR PATIENTS UNDERGOING AN X-RAY.
purpose: To ensure that each health care provider that operates a medical x-ray system has a protective vest or apron available to every patient who undergoes an x-ray.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING SCHOOLS, CHILD CARE FACILITIES AND EMERGENCY RESPONSE VEHICLES TO BE EQUIPPED WITH A PORTABLE AIRWAY CLEARANCE DEVICE.
purpose: To require each school, child care facility and emergency response vehicle to be equipped with a portable airway clearance device.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BLOOD TRANSFUSIONS FROM UNVACCINATED BLOOD DONORS.
purpose: To protect blood recipients' choice.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE REQUIREMENT THAT SELLERS REQUIRE IDENTIFICATION FROM EACH PERSON WHO PURCHASES CIGARETTES OR A TOBACCO PRODUCT.
purpose: To reduce the burden on retailers who sell tobacco products.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING IMMUNITY FROM LIABILITY FOR PHYSICIANS AND OTHER HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS WHO ARE UNABLE TO SEE A REFERRED PATIENT.
purpose: To establish immunity from liability for physicians and other health care providers who are unable to see referred patients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RATES FOR CERTIFIED AMBULANCE SERVICES.
purpose: To (1) require the Commissioner of Public Health to increase the rates for the conveyance and treatment of patients by licensed ambulance services and invalid coaches, and the rates for certified ambulance services and paramedic intercept services established pursuant to subparagraph (A) of subdivision (9) of section 19a-177 of the general statutes by at least ten per cent for the remainder of the calendar year; and (2) require the commissioner to report on or before January 1, 2024, regarding the amount of such rates.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PROVIDERS OF REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH CARE AND COUNSELING TO BE MANDATORY REPORTERS OF CHILD ABUSE AND NEGLECT.
purpose: To protect children by expanding the types of health care providers that are mandatory reporters of child abuse and neglect.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PARENTAL NOTIFICATION PRIOR TO THE TERMINATION OF A PREGNANCY BY A MINOR.
purpose: To ensure that the best interests of a minor are protected when facing an unplanned pregnancy.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING MANDATORY COVID-19 VACCINATION.
purpose: To prohibit the State of Connecticut or any employee thereof from mandating a COVID-19 vaccination.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE EXEMPTIONS TO THE REQUIRED IMMUNIZATIONS LAW FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To expand the exemptions to state mandatory vaccination laws for school-aged children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES INSTRUCTORS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that an emergency medical services instructor be certified as an emergency medical technician, advanced emergency medical technician or paramedic by the national organization for emergency medical certification.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RELIGIOUS LIBERTY FROM STATE MANDATES REGARDING THE COVID-19 VACCINE.
purpose: To prohibit the state from questioning a person's religious beliefs or the sincerity of such beliefs by requiring an employee, who is required to be vaccinated against COVID-19 and chooses not to receive the COVID-19 vaccine on religious grounds, to assert anything more than that the employee objects to receiving such vaccine on religious grounds.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE PHYSICAL THERAPY COMPACT.
purpose: To adopt the Physical Therapy Compact and improve access to physical therapy services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LICENSING RECIPROCITY FOR MENTAL HEALTH PROFESSIONALS WORKING IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To allow for licensing reciprocity for mental health professionals licensed in other states who work in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOSPICE AND PALLIATIVE CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To improve palliative and hospice care at home for end-of-life patients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF A NONBINARY MARKER ON BIRTH CERTIFICATES.
purpose: To list the sex of the parents and child on birth certificates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADEQUATE PRESCRIPTION OF PAIN MEDICATION FOR CANCER PATIENTS, PALLIATIVE AND NURSING HOME PATIENTS AND PATIENTS EXPERIENCING CHRONIC INTRACTABLE PAIN.
purpose: To allow health care practitioners to adequately prescribe pain medication.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING PROTECTIONS FOR RESIDENTS FROM MOLD INFESTATION.
purpose: To protect residents from mold infestation.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING CERTAIN OUT-OF-STATE HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS TO PROVIDE TELEHEALTH SERVICES IN THE STATE ON A PERMANENT BASIS.
purpose: To permanently allow the provision of telehealth services by certain out-of-state health care providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH OVERSIGHT OF THE PLAN FOR THE DELIVERY OF HEALTH CARE AND MENTAL HEALTH CARE SERVICES TO INMATES OF CORRECTIONAL INSTITUTIONS.
purpose: To review and address any concerns about the plan developed pursuant to P.A. 22-133.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DISCHARGE STANDARDS FOR PATIENTS BEING DISCHARGED FROM A SKILLED NURSING FACILITY.
purpose: To prevent a patient who has been discharged from a skilled nursing facility from being hospitalized or suffering other poor health outcomes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPIOID EDUCATION AND HARM REDUCTION RESOURCES.
purpose: To reduce youth overdoses through better access to harm reduction resources and education on our university and college campuses.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING NATUROPATHIC PHYSICIANS TO PRESCRIBE MEDICATION.
purpose: To lower the costs of health care for persons who receive care from a naturopathic physician and allow persons to receive prescriptions from their primary care provider.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING LICENSED CLINICAL SOCIAL WORKERS TO PERFORM CERTAIN ROLES PERFORMED BY PSYCHIATRISTS AND PSYCHOLOGISTS AND ESTABLISHING A REVIEW PROCESS FOR MENTAL HEALTH CARE ROLES IN SCHOOLS, POLICE DEPARTMENTS AND DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTION FACILITIES.
purpose: To increase the number of trained mental health care staff to address mental health needs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES DASHBOARD.
purpose: To require the Office of Health Strategy to create a state emergency medical services dashboard to examine response times, the reasons for emergency medical services calls and the frequency of the use of mutual aid by emergency medical services systems.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY ANTIBIOTIC RESISTANCE AND FUNDING BARRIERS TO THE CREATION OF NEW ANTIBIOTIC MEDICATIONS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study antibiotic resistance and funding barriers to the creation of new antibiotic medications.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY ON THE IMPACT OF THE USE OF INDEPENDENT CONTRACTORS BY HOSPITALS AND PRIVATE CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To study the impact of the use of independent contractors by hospitals and private care facilities on health care costs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNERAL DIRECTORS AND FUNERAL HOMES.
purpose: To (1) give equal access to the electronic death registry system to funeral directors licensed in the state who have an out-of-state facility, (2) increase the availability of funeral services by establishing a licensure program for funeral directors who do not engage in the practice of embalming, and (3) ensure healthy and safe practices in funeral homes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LICENSURE OF BIRTHING CENTERS.
purpose: To require licensure in the state only of birthing centers that are accredited using standards set forth by the Commissioner for the Accreditation of Birthing Centers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MANDATORY LIMITS ON OVERTIME FOR NURSES WORKING IN HOSPITALS.
purpose: To amend section 19a-490l of the general statutes by defining "overtime" in hospitals and deleting the provision concerning nurses covered by a collective bargaining agreement pursuant to subdivision (5) of subsection (c) of said section.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE OFFICE OF EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES TO PAY VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE COMPANIES FOR RESPONDING TO CALLS ON CERTAIN HIGHWAYS AND SECTIONS OF HIGHWAYS.
purpose: To provide support to volunteer ambulance companies supporting certain state functions.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CONNECTICUT TO JOIN THE PHYSICAL THERAPY LICENSURE COMPACT.
