purpose: To improve public health by increasing access to physical therapy services in the state through a reduction in regulatory barriers to licensure in Connecticut of physical therapists licensed in other states.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR THE SPEED ENFORCEMENT ON RURAL ROADS GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase funding for the speed enforcement on rural roads grant program to assist small, rural towns with local traffic enforcement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESIDENTIAL SWIMMING POOL SAFETY STANDARDS.
purpose: To adopt a safety standard for a residential swimming pool from the International Swimming Pool and Spa Code.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF POLICE POLICIES ON WELLNESS CHECKS.
purpose: To review policies of the State Police and municipal police departments on wellness checks.

title: AN ACT TO REQUIRE CARBON MONOXIDE DETECTORS IN EACH ROOM OF A HOTEL OR MOTEL.
purpose: To require all hotels and motels to install carbon monoxide detectors in each room.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RIGHT OF ENTRY ONTO PREMISES BY BUILDING OFFICIALS.
purpose: To allow building officials similar authority to enter premises as fire marshals, in order to promote public safety.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF INSTALLING BULLET-RESISTANT WINDOWS AND DOORS ON STATE AND MUNICIPAL POLICE PATROL VEHICLES.
purpose: To protect law enforcement.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE POLICE OFFICER STANDARDS AND TRAINING COUNCIL TO REVIEW AND MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING MANDATES ON LAW ENFORCEMENT UNITS AND OFFICERS.
purpose: To require the Police Officer Standards and Training Council to review and make recommendations regarding mandates on law enforcement units and officers, in order to alleviate unnecessary mandates and burdens on law enforcement.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STATE-WIDE PROTOCOL AND PROCEDURES REGARDING SUPPRESSION OF FIRES IN ELECTRIC VEHICLES.
purpose: To establish a protocol to fight electric vehicle fires.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A WAIVER OF INTEREST ON A LOTTERY SALES AGENT'S DELINQUENCY ASSESSMENT DUE TO HARDSHIP.
purpose: To allow the Connecticut Lottery Corporation to waive interest on a lottery sales agent's delinquency assessment due to hardship.

title: AN ACT RECOGNIZING THE SECOND AMENDMENT TO THE UNITED STATES CONSTITUTION AS THE AUTHORITY THAT DETERMINES ELIGIBILITY FOR RESIDENTS TO KEEP AND BEAR ARMS AND TO REPEAL PROVISIONS REGARDING A PERMIT TO CARRY A PISTOL OR REVOLVER.
purpose: To adopt a policy of constitutional carry and repeal provisions regarding a permit to carry a pistol or revolver.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE STATE FIRE SAFETY CODE AND THE USE OF A LOCK WITH TWO RELEASING MOTIONS.
purpose: To require a study of the State Fire Safety Code as it relates to the possible use of a lock that requires two releasing motions.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CYBERSECURITY TASK FORCE.
purpose: To establish a cybersecurity task force to ensure protection from cyber attacks and prevention of government, business and personal cyber attacks.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PILOT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE FUNDING TO CERTAIN POLICE DEPARTMENTS TO HIRE ADDICTION SERVICES EXPERTS.
purpose: To establish a pilot program to combat opioid addiction by providing funding for certain police departments to hire addiction services experts.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE STATE TO ENTER RECIPROCITY AGREEMENTS WITH OTHER STATES REGARDING PERMITS TO CARRY A PISTOL OR REVOLVER.
purpose: To provide for gun permit reciprocity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE AND MUNICIPAL EMPLOYEES INVOLVED IN GUN BUY-BACK PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require all state and municipal employees involved in gun buy-back programs to have a valid permit to carry a pistol or revolver.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICATION REQUIREMENTS FOR A TEMPORARY STATE PERMIT TO CARRY A PISTOL OR REVOLVER.
purpose: To specify uniform criteria for an application for a temporary state permit to carry a pistol or revolver so that each town and city will have the same criteria, standards and procedures for the application process.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AMENDMENTS TO THE STATE BUILDING CODE.
purpose: To require a financial impact statement for any proposed amendment to the State Building Code and a two-thirds vote by the General Assembly for adoption of any such amendment.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR THE INTENTIONAL INJURY OF A POLICE ANIMAL OR DOG IN A VOLUNTEER CANINE SEARCH AND RESCUE TEAM.
purpose: To increase the penalty for intentionally injuring a police animal or dog in a volunteer canine search and rescue team.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR THE INTENTIONAL INJURY OF A POLICE ANIMAL OR DOG IN A VOLUNTEER CANINE SEARCH AND RESCUE TEAM.
purpose: To increase the penalty for the intentional injury of a police animal or dog in a volunteer canine search and rescue team.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE USE OF COMBUSTIBLE GAS DETECTORS.
purpose: To study the use of combustible gas detectors.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE YANTIC FIRE ENGINE COMPANY.
purpose: To provide funding to the Yantic Fire Engine Company.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL POLICE DEPARTMENTS AND AMBER AND SILVER ALERTS.
purpose: To ensure that requests for amber and silver alerts are processed in a timely fashion.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REPORTING OF A LOST OR STOLEN ASSAULT WEAPON OR FIREARM.
purpose: To reduce the amount of time allowed to report the theft or loss of an assault weapon or a firearm.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MUNICIPAL EMERGENCY AND DISASTER PLANS TO ADDRESS THE PROTECTION AND SAFETY OF RESIDENTS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To require municipalities to address the protection and safety of residents with disabilities in their emergency and disaster plans.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR THE INTENTIONAL INJURY OF A POLICE ANIMAL OR DOG IN A VOLUNTEER CANINE SEARCH AND RESCUE TEAM.
purpose: To increase the penalty for intentionally injuring a police animal or dog in a volunteer canine search and rescue team.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING MODIFICATIONS TO THE BRAKE LIGHTS, TURN SIGNAL LIGHTS, WINDSHIELD AND FRONT SIDE WINDOWS OF A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To prohibit modifications to brake lights, turn signal lights, windshield and front side windows on a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DECIBEL TESTING FOR MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To require decibel testing for motor vehicles to combat noise pollution.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PLAN TO PRIVATIZE THE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To maximize savings at the Department of Motor Vehicles by developing a plan for privatization.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE ISSUANCE OF A DRIVE-ONLY MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSE.
purpose: To prohibit the issuance of a drive-only motor vehicle operator's license to a person who cannot provide proof of legal United States residency or a Social Security number.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPENDITURES FROM THE SPECIAL TRANSPORTATION FUND.
purpose: To ensure the resources of the Special Transportation Fund are expended on transportation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEMBERS OF CANINE SEARCH AND RESCUE ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To allow members of canine search and rescue organizations to safely respond to emergencies.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DISPLAY OF A NUMBER PLATE ONLY AT THE REAR OF A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To require the display of a number plate only at the rear of a motor vehicle as a cost-saving measure.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION INDEPENDENT OF EMISSIONS INSPECTION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To permit the registration of a motor vehicle independent of the motor vehicle's compliance with emissions inspection requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN INDEPENDENT ASSESSMENT OF TRANSPORTATION INFRASTRUCTURE PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide transparency in transportation projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY IN TRANSPORTATION PROJECTS.
purpose: To provide transparency in transportation projects.

title: AN ACT NAMING CONNECTICUT ROUTE 322 IN WOLCOTT IN HONOR OF EUGENE A. MIGLIARO, JR.
purpose: To name Connecticut Route 322 in Wolcott in honor of Eugene A. Migliaro, Jr., to recognize his service as a member of the United States Marine Corps, a member of the Connecticut House of Representatives, the mayor of Wolcott and the Commissioner of Veterans Affairs.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE STATE SUBSIDIZATION OF THE HARTFORD-NEW BRITAIN BUSWAY.
purpose: To prohibit the subsidization of the Hartford-New Britain busway and ensure that the passenger rates for ridership pay the cost of operation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COST OF MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION.
purpose: To provide savings to the registrants of motor vehicles in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NOTICE OF MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY RECALLS.
purpose: To ensure motor vehicle safety by notifying the owner of a motor vehicle if the motor vehicle is subject to an open recall during an emissions inspection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AN EXPANSION OF BUS SERVICE IN CHESHIRE AND THE GREATER WATERBURY AND NEW HAVEN AREAS.
purpose: To expand bus service in Cheshire and the greater Waterbury and New Haven areas and provide greater access to employment opportunities on Knotter Drive, Peck Lane and Schoolhouse Road in Cheshire.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REPORTS ON THE ISSUANCE OF SPECIAL NUMBER PLATES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to submit reports detailing the amount of the funds collected for the issuance of special number plates and how such funds were expended.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE FEE FOR PURPLE HEART NUMBER PLATES.
purpose: To allow veterans, members of the armed forces and surviving spouses of such veterans and members to obtain number plates recognizing the Military Order of the Purple Heart at no additional cost beyond the cost to register a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCOUNTABILITY FOR THE EXPENDITURE OF FEDERAL FUNDS RECEIVED BY THE STATE.
purpose: To provide accountability for the state's expenditure of funds received pursuant to the federal Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRIC CAR BATTERIES.
purpose: To increase transparency by providing an individual who purchases an electric vehicle with information concerning each battery in the electric vehicle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPORTATION PROJECT PRIORITIZATION.
purpose: To provide transparency regarding the prioritization of transportation initiatives and projects that use federal infrastructure funding.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPLICATION OF THE FEDERAL TRANSIT ADMINISTRATION SECTION 5310 GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the application of the Federal Transit Administration Section 5310 Grant Program to include the purchase of smaller and more efficient vehicles.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPENDITURE OF CERTAIN FEDERAL FUNDS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION.
purpose: To provide accountability regarding the expenditure of funds received pursuant to the federal Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RATES AND CHARGES FOR NONCONSENSUAL TOWING.
purpose: To ensure appropriate rates and charges for nonconsensual towing that accounts for the costs and overhead expenses incurred by the towing company.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF SOUND BARRIERS ALONG INTERSTATE ROUTE 95 IN THE TOWN OF FAIRFIELD.
purpose: To require the Department of Transportation to install sound barriers in the town of Fairfield to reduce the noise pollution created when the department clears trees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROGRESSIVE MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE.
purpose: To calculate the registration fee for a passenger motor vehicle based on the value of the motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT WAIVING THE MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION FEE FOR INDIVIDUALS WHO ARE SEVENTY-FIVE YEARS OF AGE OR OLDER.
purpose: To waive the motor vehicle registration fee for any person who is seventy-five years or age or older and has owned such person's motor vehicle for at least two years.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAFFIC SAFETY IN CENTRAL CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To promote traffic safety on certain state roads in central Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WRONG-WAY DETECTION SYSTEMS AND WRONG-WAY DRIVING COUNTERMEASURES.
purpose: To reduce highway fatalities and increase driver safety.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF ELECTRIC VEHICLE CHARGING STATIONS IN THE TOWN OF MARLBOROUGH.
purpose: To install three electric vehicle charging stations at the town facilities in the town of Marlborough which are located near Connecticut Route 2.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTALLATION OF SOLAR-POWERED CHARGING STATIONS.
purpose: To install solar-powered charging stations at bus stops, parks and other areas open to the public.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE FUTURE OF RAILROADS.
purpose: To study the future of railroads in the state, including the right-of-way between Hartford and Middletown.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FEE FOR COMMEMORATIVE MOTOR VEHICLE NUMBER PLATES FOR VETERANS AND MEMBERS OF THE ARMED FORCES.
purpose: To allow veterans and members of the armed forces to obtain commemorative number plates at no additional cost beyond the cost to register a motor vehicle.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATORS TO YIELD THE RIGHT-OF-WAY TO FUNERAL PROCESSIONS.
purpose: To give funeral processions the right-of-way and avoid collision with other motor vehicles.

title: AN ACT EQUIPPING COMMERCIAL MOTOR VEHICLES WITH GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEMS.
purpose: To increase public safety and reduce traffic by requiring commercial motor vehicles to be equipped with global positioning systems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A BANNER TO BE PLACED OVER U.S. ROUTE 1 IN THE TOWN OF MYSTIC.
purpose: To place a banner that contains a logo over U.S. Route 1 in the town of Mystic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAIN TRESTLES.
purpose: To ensure safe road and pedestrian transportation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PREVENTION OF WRONG-WAY DRIVING.
purpose: To prevent wrong-way driving and protect all drivers in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ROUTE SHIELD PAVEMENT MARKINGS AT MAJOR HIGHWAY INTERSECTIONS.
purpose: To improve the safety at major highway intersections.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN ACTIVE DUTY SERVICE MEMBERS FROM PAYING FEES FOR ANY MOTOR VEHICLE OPERATOR'S LICENSE AND REGISTRATION.
purpose: To exempt active duty service members who were not residents of Connecticut at the time of induction from paying fees for motor vehicle operator's licenses and registrations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SIGNS INDICATING THE LOCATION OF THE EASTERSEALS VETERANS RALLY POINT.
purpose: To erect signs informing motorists of the location of the Easterseals Veterans Rally Point.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SIGNS INDICATING THE LOCATION OF THE MARLBOROUGH ARTS CENTER.
purpose: To erect signs in Marlborough informing motorists and tourists of the location of the Marlborough Arts Center.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INSTALLATION OF CAMERA VIDEO SYSTEMS INSIDE SCHOOL BUSES AND STUDENT TRANSPORTATION VEHICLES USED TO TRANSPORT CHILDREN WITH SPECIAL NEEDS.
purpose: To ensure the safety of children with special needs by requiring the installation of camera video systems inside school buses or student transportation vehicles used for their transportation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NONEMERGENCY TRANSPORTATION OF ELDERLY PERSONS AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES CONFINED TO A STRETCHER.
purpose: To provide elderly persons and persons with disabilities an opportunity to travel in a stretcher van instead of an ambulance.

title: AN ACT NAMING A BRIDGE IN THE TOWN OF LITCHFIELD IN HONOR OF CORPORAL ROGER "DODGE" DOYLE.
purpose: To name a bridge in honor of Corporal Roger "Dodge" Doyle in recognition of his forty-six-year career in law enforcement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NORWALK TRANSIT DISTRICT.
purpose: To create a seamless system of public transportation for residents in Norwalk.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PENALTIES FOR DISTRACTED DRIVING.
purpose: To increase the fines and penalties for distracted driving so that such fines and penalties are similar with the fines and penalties for driving under the influence of intoxicating liquor or drugs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ILLEGAL PARKING IN A SPACE RESERVED FOR PERSONS WHO ARE BLIND OR PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To create a greater deterrent to using a parking space reserved for persons who are blind or persons with disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL GUARD AND MOTOR VEHICLE EMISSIONS TESTING.
purpose: To (1) exempt members of the National Guard from emissions testing requirements while serving on active duty, and (2) require such members to present their vehicles for such testing not later than ninety days after concluding such active duty service and to provide proof of such active duty service.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL VETERANS SERVICES.
purpose: To implement several changes designed to improve the provision of municipal veterans services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT NATIONAL GUARD AND CYBERSECURITY.
purpose: To authorize the Connecticut National Guard to provide the state and municipalities with cybersecurity functional support.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UPKEEP OF VETERANS' GRAVES.
purpose: To establish a process for complaints of neglect of veterans' graves in cemeteries and the resolution of such complaints by the Department of Consumer Protection and the Department of Veterans Affairs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR CERTAIN VETERANS.
purpose: To increase the maximum property tax exemption municipalities may provide to certain veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FEE WAIVER AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FOR CERTAIN VETERANS AND MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL GUARD.
purpose: To waive the payment of extension fees for certain veterans and members of the National Guard enrolled at public institutions of higher education in this state.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN DISABLED VETERANS FROM PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To fully exempt from the payment of property taxes any veteran with a one hundred per cent disability rating from the United States Department of Veterans Affairs.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GREEN ALERT SYSTEM FOR MISSING VETERANS.
purpose: To establish a green alert system to notify the public that a veteran is missing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A MILITARY OCCUPATIONAL SPECIALTY WORKING GROUP AND A GRANT PROGRAM FOR THE REIMBURSEMENT OF CERTAIN LICENSING, CERTIFICATION, REGISTRATION OR TUITION FEES.
purpose: To establish a military occupational specialty working group and a grant program for the reimbursement of certain occupational or educational fees.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO ADDRESS CONCERNS REGARDING THE UPKEEP OF VETERANS' GRAVES.
purpose: To expand existing procedures regarding credit for military training and experience, presently applied to certain trades regulated by the Department of Consumer Protection, to subsurface sewage disposal system work regulated by the Department of Public Health.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF MUNICIPAL OPTION TAX RELIEF FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To require a review of municipal option tax relief for veterans and of the municipalities in the state that have enacted such relief.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To increase veterans property tax exemptions.

title: AN ACT REDEFINING THE STATE SPENDING CAP.
purpose: To redefine the state "spending cap" to limit the growth of all state expenditures and eliminate inflation as a factor in the authorization of general budget expenditures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR REGIONAL FIRE TRAINING SCHOOLS.
purpose: To fund the nine regional fire training schools through appropriations in the state budget and not from any specific taxes or increased surcharges, including any fees on insurance premiums.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PUBLIC HEARING REQUIREMENT FOR BUDGET EARMARKS.
purpose: To require public hearings for earmarks.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF STATE FUNDS FOR BALLPARKS FOR PROFESSIONAL SPORTS TEAMS.
purpose: To prevent the misuse of state funds.

title: AN ACT REDUCING NONEDUCATION AID TO THE CITY OF HARTFORD.
purpose: To reverse the fiscal impact to the state of the debt service agreement between the state and the city of Hartford.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING COLLECTIVE BARGAINING AND ARBITRATION AGREEMENTS FROM CONFLICTING WITH STATE LAW.
purpose: To require collective bargaining agreements and arbitration agreements to comply with the provisions of state law.

title: AN ACT PREVENTING OVERTIME PAYMENTS FROM BEING USED TO CALCULATE THE RETIREMENT INCOME OF STATE EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To prohibit the calculation of a state employee's pension from including overtime pay.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO STUDY HARMFUL ADDITIVES IN ILLEGALLY SOLD CANNABIS.
purpose: To protect Connecticut citizens and understand the content of illegal cannabis and its harm to users.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REIMBURSEMENT TO VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENTS FOR FIREFIGHTER AND EMT COURSES.
purpose: To provide volunteer fire department personnel with training.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR CONTINUATION OF THE SOCIAL MEDIA IMPACT STUDY.
purpose: To fund the second year of the Social Media Impact Study.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO PROVIDE ALL-TERRAIN VEHICLES FOR THE VOLUNTOWN FIRE DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To fund ATVs for the Voluntown Fire Department to fight fires in Pachaug State Forest.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE WELCOME CENTER IN MYSTIC.
purpose: To fund the welcome center in Mystic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FIELDS OF MEMBERSHIP OF CONNECTICUT CREDIT UNIONS.
purpose: To provide that the field of membership of Connecticut credit unions may include associations of individuals, provided such associations were formed to serve a purpose other than expanding the field of membership of such credit unions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYER MORTGAGE LOANS FOR PROPERTIES IN CERTAIN LOCATIONS.
purpose: To provide that: (1) The Department of Banking shall develop an Internet web site for individuals who are first-time homebuyers to apply for mortgage loans for properties located in distressed municipalities or federally designated opportunity zones; (2) community banks may access such Internet web site to determine which loans to make; and (3) for such loans, the state shall provide credit enhancement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF AN INTERNET WEB SITE THROUGH WHICH CERTAIN BUSINESSES MAY APPLY FOR LOANS FROM COMMUNITY BANKS.
purpose: To (1) provide that the Department of Economic and Community Development and the Department of Banking jointly develop an Internet web site through which certain businesses may apply for loans and community banks may approve such loans, and (2) require the state to provide credit enhancement and accept the first loss for such loans.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE FEASIBILITY OF DEVELOPING A MULTIMODAL TRANSPORTATION CENTER IN THE TOWNS OF STONINGTON AND GROTON.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the feasibility of developing a multimodal transportation center in the towns of Stonington and Groton.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF A MEDICAL INTERDISTRICT MAGNET SCHOOL PROGRAM CURRICULUM.
purpose: To develop an interdistrict magnet school program with special emphasis on medical studies to allow students to enter a certified occupation within the health care field upon graduation or to pursue an advanced medical degree.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EARLY CHILDHOOD TRUST FUND.
purpose: To establish an early childhood trust fund to fund increased compensation for early childhood education providers, a pilot program to provide high-quality early childhood education, innovative early childhood projects and the building of a database on the Office of Early Childhood Internet web site.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING TRADESPEOPLE AND HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS TO CREDIT WORK EXPERIENCE TOWARD TEACHER CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To allow tradespeople and health care professionals to receive credit for work experience toward earning a teacher certification to teach a course in such person or professional's field.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE BIRTH-TO-THREE PROGRAM.
purpose: To ensure that services provided under the birth-to-three program continue for children ages three to five, inclusive, who are not eligible for special education and related services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSTRUCTION OF AMERICAN SIGN LANGUAGE IN SCHOOL IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To facilitate the instruction of American Sign Language in school in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF TEACHER RECIPROCITY AGREEMENTS WITH OTHER STATES.
purpose: To address the teacher shortage in Connecticut by expanding teacher reciprocity agreements with other states.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRAINING OF STUDENTS TO BECOME PARAEDUCATORS.
purpose: To train and hire more paraeducators in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STUDENTS WITH SPECIAL NEEDS WHO ATTEND SCHOOLS OUTSIDE OF DISTRICT.
purpose: To provide transportation or vouchers for students with special needs who attend schools outside of the school districts in which they reside.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDS GENERATED FROM THE GREENHOUSE GAS REDUCTION FEE.
purpose: .To use certain fees for the purpose of brownfield remediation.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE CREATION OF ALL-TERRAIN VEHICLE TRAILS ON STATE-OWNED PROPERTY.
purpose: To create all-terrain vehicle trails on state-owned property.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING PERSONS TO CARRY HANDGUNS IN STATE PARKS AND STATE FORESTS.
purpose: To prevent the state from restricting persons from carrying handguns in state parks and state forests for the purpose of self-defense.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DECOUPLING THE STATE'S LIGHT DUTY MOTOR VEHICLE EMISSION STANDARDS FROM THE STANDARDS OF CALIFORNIA.
purpose: To decouple the state's light duty motor vehicle emission standards from the standards of California.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING RECIPROCAL FISHING AGREEMENTS TO ACCOMMODATE LANDINGS BY COMMERCIAL FISHERMEN WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To require Rhode Island and New York to honor Connecticut's policy of allowing a commercial fisherman with a disability to make landings in such state even though such fisherman is not able to be aboard such vessel at the time of such landings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CALCULATION OF LANDING QUOTAS FOR COMMERCIAL FISHERMEN.
purpose: To allow retiring fishermen to transfer a license with a suitable quota that is an actual reflection of the landings for such license.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRANSFER OF OWNERSHIP OF COMMERCIAL FISHING VESSELS AND ATTENDANT LICENSES.
purpose: To allow the owner of a commercial fishing vessel to transfer such ownership, including state and federal landing licenses, to a resident of a neighboring state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EEL GRASS RESTORATION WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To establish an eel grass restoration working group.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE RESUBMISSION OF THE LONG ISLAND SOUND BLUE PLAN.
purpose: To require the modifications to the Long Island Sound Blue Plan to be resubmitted to the General Assembly for approval.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HUNTING AND RECREATIONAL FISHING FEES FOR PERSONS WHO ARE SIXTY-FIVE OR OLDER.
purpose: To exempt persons who are sixty-five or older from any fee associated with a hunting or recreational fishing permit, license stamp or tag.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANIES' RETURN ON EQUITY.
purpose: To adjust electric distribution companies' return on equity to a lower rate that would result in relief for ratepayers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE SEPARATION OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To restructure the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority as an independent governmental entity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BATTERY STORAGE.
purpose: To review the effectiveness of battery-storage technology and its impact on ratepayer bills.

title: AN ACT REMOVING ENERGY PROCUREMENT AUTHORITY FROM THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To remove energy procurement authority from the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING A CHARGE ASSESSED TO END USE CUSTOMERS OF ELECTRIC SERVICES.
purpose: To eliminate a surcharge assessed on electric bills which is deposited into the Clean Energy Fund.

title: AN ACT SUSPENDING THE COMBINED PUBLIC BENEFIT CHARGE.
purpose: To suspend the combined public benefit charge.

title: AN ACT MODIFYING ZERO-EMISSION ENERGY PROCUREMENT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To modify the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection's and the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority's zero-emission energy procurement authority to require that no contract may be approved at a rate higher than the wholesale rate.

title: AN ACT PRECLUDING THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION FROM WORKING ON THE TRANSPORTATION CLIMATE INITIATIVE.
purpose: To prevent the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection from working on the Transportation Climate Initiative.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHONE NUMBER PORTABILITY.
purpose: To allow customers to transfer phone numbers to a new provider without delay or fees.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CAPITAL REPAIRS TO PAVILIONS IN MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding for capital repairs to pavilions in Montville.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CAPITAL REPAIRS TO VFW POST 10060 IN THE TOWN OF MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding for capital repairs at VFW Post 10060 in Montville.

title: AN ACT REVISING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION AND ANNUITY INCOME AND DISTRIBUTIONS FROM CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To allow the personal income tax deduction for distributions from certain individual retirement accounts to be fully effective sooner and to revise the current personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension and annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT REDUCING A MARGINAL RATE FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX AND TEMPORARILY ADJUSTING THE RATE AND APPLICABILITY OF THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To (1) reduce the marginal rate for the personal income tax to four per cent for working class and middle-class taxpayers, (2) reduce the rate of the sales and use taxes to five and ninety-nine-hundredths per cent for the next fiscal year, and (3) suspend the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store for the next fiscal year.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REDEVELOP THE OLD TOWN HALL IN MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding to redevelop the Old Town Hall in Montville.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR EQUIPMENT FOR THE LEDYARD EMERGENCY SERVICES BUILDING.
purpose: To provide funding for equipment for the Ledyard Emergency Services Building.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE GALES FERRY VOLUNTEER FIRE COMPANY.
purpose: To provide funding for a new roof and equipment for the Gales Ferry Volunteer Fire Company.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE METHOD USED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF REVENUE SERVICES TO PROVIDE NOTIFICATION TO TAXPAYERS.
purpose: To require the Department of Revenue Services to provide notification to taxpayers by electronic means rather than by mail.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deduction for Social Security benefits.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME AND CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNT DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR IMPROVEMENTS TO THE GRISWOLD HIGH SCHOOL TRACK AND FIELDS.
purpose: To provide funding for improvements to the track and fields at Griswold High School for use by the community and the students.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF A WATER TOWER IN GRISWOLD.
purpose: To provide funding for construction of a water tower in Griswold to be used by area towns and for firefighting in the Pachaug State Forest.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO CONSTRUCT A BRIDGE THAT CROSSES FROM NORTH STONINGTON TO STONINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding to construct a bridge that crosses from North Stonington to Stonington.

title: AN ACT PHASING OUT THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS, PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME AND CERTAIN INDIVIDUAL RETIREMENT ACCOUNT DISTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To phase out the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits, pension or annuity income and distributions from certain individual retirement accounts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INFORMATION REQUIRED FOR SPECIAL FUEL TAX RETURNS.
purpose: To prohibit the Department of Revenue Services from requiring taxpayers to report nontaxable sales and uses information when filing special fuel tax returns.

title: AN ACT RESTORING THE RATE OF THE CREDIT AGAINST THE AFFECTED BUSINESS ENTITY TAX.
purpose: To restore the rate of the credit against the affected business entity tax to ninety-three and one-hundredths per cent.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING STATE TAXES OR FEES FOR WHICH COLLECTION COSTS EXCEED THE REVENUE RECEIVED.
purpose: To eliminate any state tax or fee for which the cost of collection exceeds the revenue received by the state from the imposition of such tax or fee.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE EARNED INCOME TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To eliminate the earned income tax credit.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NONREFUNDABLE PERSONAL INCOME TAX CREDIT FOR THE PURCHASE OF A GUN SAFE.
purpose: To establish a nonrefundable credit against the personal income tax of up to one hundred fifty dollars for the purchase of a gun safe for personal use.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR PREMIUM PAYMENTS FOR CERTAIN LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for the amount of premiums paid to purchase an individual or group long-term care insurance policy that provides benefits for health care provided in an insured's home.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO CERTAIN VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS OR VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE MEMBERS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any stipend paid by a municipality, volunteer fire department or volunteer ambulance association to certain volunteer firefighters or volunteer ambulance members.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POSTAGE FOR THE MAILING OF ABSENTEE BALLOTS.
purpose: To require the Secretary of the State to cover the postage costs for electors' returned absentee ballots.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING PANS AND PANDAS AWARENESS DAY.
purpose: To designate October ninth of each year as PANS and PANDAS awareness day.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISCLOSURE OF ABSENTEE BALLOT APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To provide that absentee ballot applications that have been completed and signed are public records subject to public inspection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONVEYANCE OF A PARCEL OF STATE LAND CONTAINING A GARAGE TO THE TOWN OF MARLBOROUGH.
purpose: To convey a parcel of state land containing a garage to the town of Marlborough.

title: AN ACT LIMITING CANDIDATES TO APPEARING ONLY ONCE ON THE ELECTION BALLOT.
purpose: To require that, for any candidate who has been nominated by multiple parties, the name of such candidate shall appear only once on the ballot.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF CERTAIN ABSENTEE VOTING PROCEDURES.
purpose: To establish a task force to study using a single envelope for the return of an absentee ballot.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ABSENTEE VOTING PROCESS.
purpose: To specify that absentee ballots may only be counted on election day, provide consistency among towns as to pre-election processing of such ballots and allow for the curing of unsigned absentee ballot envelopes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TITLING OF PROPOSED BILLS.
purpose: To ensure that bill titles reflect legislative intent.

title: AN ACT WITHDRAWING CONNECTICUT FROM THE NATIONAL POPULAR VOTE INTERSTATE COMPACT.
purpose: To withdraw the state from the National Popular Vote Interstate Compact.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PHOTO IDENTIFICATION FOR VOTING PURPOSES.
purpose: To (1) require the presentation of photo identification at the polls in order to vote, and (2) establish a program for waiving the fee associated with obtaining, for voting purposes, a form of government-issued photo identification.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MAILED ABSENTEE BALLOT APPLICATIONS.
purpose: To prohibit the unsolicited mailing of absentee ballot applications.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUDITING OF ELECTION DAY REGISTRATION.
purpose: To require the audit of election day registrations and subsequent confirmation notices of such registrations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUDITING OF SIGNED STATEMENTS OF ELECTORS PRIOR TO VOTING.
purpose: To require that statements signed by electors, in lieu of presenting certain identification at the polls, be audited for accuracy.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN ANALYSIS OF THE CONSTITUTIONALITY OF PROPOSED LEGISLATION.
purpose: To provide legislators with information regarding the constitutionality of proposed legislation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE AND THE LEGISLATIVE REGULATION REVIEW COMMITTEE.
purpose: To require legislative review of certain interpretations of election law by the Secretary of the State.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGISLATIVE OVERSIGHT OF ELECTION LAW CHANGES MADE BY EXECUTIVE ACTION.
purpose: To require the Secretary of the State to report to the legislature on election laws modified by executive branch authority for any election or primary held in 2020 or 2021.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION AND CAMPAIGN FINANCE.
purpose: To make several changes regarding the State Elections Enforcement Commission and campaign finance.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING SEVERAL CHANGES CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF ELECTIONS.
purpose: To implement several changes concerning the administration of elections.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE SIBERIAN HUSKY AS THE STATE DOG.
purpose: To establish the Siberian Husky as the state dog.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DISCLOSURE OF THE USE OF FACIAL RECOGNITION TECHNOLOGY IN PUBLIC SPACES.
purpose: To require a clear disclosure in all public spaces where facial recognition technology is being used to identify customers and guests.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSEHOLD APPLIANCE REPAIRER REGISTRATION.
purpose: To require any individual who, or organization that, is engaged in the business of repairing household appliances to register with the Department of Consumer Protection.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY OCCUPATIONAL LICENSING IN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To establish a task force to study occupational licensing in this state, with a focus on revising and removing barriers to employment and entrepreneurial activity.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RECIPROCAL SKILLED TRADE LICENSING AGREEMENT WITH THE OTHER NEW ENGLAND STATES.
purpose: To establish an interstate agreement for the purpose of establishing licensing reciprocity across New England for the skilled trades.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONPROFIT ENTITIES AND CHARITABLE RAFFLES.
purpose: To provide greater flexibility to nonprofit entities by allowing a nonprofit entity to compensate an individual for wages lost while assisting the nonprofit entity in operating a charitable raffle.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUDIT REPORT SUBMISSIONS BY CERTAIN CHARITABLE ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To exempt certain charitable volunteer public safety organizations from an audit-reporting requirement.

title: AN ACT ADOPTING THE HUMAN CELL PRODUCT LABELING ACT.
purpose: To adopt the Human Cell Product Labeling Act.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING TUITION WAIVERS AT THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT FOR THE FAMILY MEMBERS OF EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To prohibit tuition waivers at The University of Connecticut for family members of employees of said university.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF STATE FUNDS BY PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FOR SPEAKING FEES.
purpose: To prohibit the use of state funds by public institutions of higher education for politically related speaking fees or events costs.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To eliminate the Board of Regents for Higher Education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CRITICAL SKILLS IN DEMAND BY EMPLOYERS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Office of Workforce Strategy to provide a way to earn credentials for critical skills in demand by employers in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION OUTCOMES FOR STUDENTS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To establish a postsecondary services advisory committee for the purpose of improving outcomes for students with disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE IMPACT OF MARRIAGE ON ELIGIBILITY OF PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES FOR PUBLIC ASSISTANCE BENEFITS.
purpose: To study eligibility criteria for certain public assistance programs to determine whether marriage of a person with disabilities negatively impacts such person's eligibility for benefits and report on recommendations for necessary changes in such criteria consistent with federal law.

title: AN ACT DETERRING ABUSE OF PROTECTIONS AFFORDED TO OWNERS OF SERVICE ANIMALS.
purpose: To prevent abuse of the special protections that are afforded to service animals and the owners of such animals by penalizing persons masquerading untrained animals as service animals.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC ASSISTANCE APPLICANTS TO PROVIDE PROOF OF CITIZENSHIP.
purpose: To reduce fraud, waste and misuse of state resources.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A WORK REQUIREMENT FOR YOUNG ADULT MEDICAID BENEFICIARIES.
purpose: To reduce barriers to employment for young adult Medicaid beneficiaries who are able to work but fear losing benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FULLY STAFFED STATE MEDICAID FRAUD CONTROL UNIT.
purpose: To reduce fraud, waste and misuse of state resources.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF ELECTRONIC BENEFIT TRANSFER CARDS AT CERTAIN ESTABLISHMENTS.
purpose: To deter improper use of public assistance benefits.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PUBLIC ASSISTANCE BENEFICIARIES TO WORK OR VOLUNTEER.
purpose: To promote work among able-bodied recipients of public assistance.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE OR MUNICIPAL FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To prohibit state or municipal fair rent commissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STORAGE COSTS OF TENANTS' PERSONAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To allow landlords to recoup the costs of storing the personal property of evicted tenants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVIEW OF CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORDS OF PROSPECTIVE TENANTS.
purpose: To allow landlords to consider the criminal history records of prospective tenants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STORAGE OF PERSONAL PROPERTY OF EVICTED TENANTS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that municipalities or landlords store the personal property of evicted tenants.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING TENANTS TO MAKE ADVANCE RENTAL PAYMENTS.
purpose: To permit tenants to make advance rental payments.

title: AN ACT REMOVING SECURITY DEPOSIT LIMITS.
purpose: To mitigate the risk of landlords.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PROPERTY TAX CREDIT AMOUNTS AND QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE CIRCUIT BREAKER PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the property tax credit amounts and qualifying income thresholds for the circuit breaker program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICER ACCOUNTABILITY, STAKEHOLDER ROUNDTABLES AND FUNDING FOR COMMUNITY POLICING PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase public safety by building trust between law enforcement officers and the communities they serve and holding law enforcement officers accountable for their actions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL FUNDING FOR ADDICTION AND OVERDOSE PREVENTION AND TO COMBAT ILLEGAL DRUG SALES.
purpose: To provide municipal funding for addiction and overdose prevention and to combat illegal drug sales.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR SEWER PROJECTS IN OLD LYME.
purpose: To provide funding for sewer projects in Old Lyme to prevent wastewater from draining into Long Island Sound.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INCLUSION OF A HOLD HARMLESS PROVISION FOR THE EDUCATION COST-SHARING GRANT FORMULA.
purpose: To hold towns harmless in the rollout of the education cost-sharing formula.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO RESTORE AND RENOVATE A BOATHOUSE IN GROTON.
purpose: To provide funding to restore and renovate a historic boathouse in Groton.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AVAILABILITY OF MENSTRUAL PRODUCTS IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To ensure the appropriate use of menstrual products provided to children in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FULL REIMBURSEMENT OF A SCHOOL DISTRICT'S EXCESS COST FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To make school districts whole under the special education excess cost grant.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY OBSTACLES FACING THE EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION AND CHILD CARE INDUSTRIES.
purpose: To study the obstacles facing the early childhood education and early child care industries in order to find solutions through state law that will promote a financially viable industry.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FULL FUNDING OF THE SPECIAL EDUCATION EXCESS COST GRANT.
purpose: To provide the necessary funding for special education costs incurred by school districts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF FINANCIAL LITERACY CURRICULA FOR HIGH SCHOOLS.
purpose: To help high school students better understand basic financial concepts, such as savings and compound interest.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECRUITMENT AND RETENTION OF SCHOOL BUS DRIVERS.
purpose: To alleviate the school bus driver shortage by assisting municipalities and school districts in the recruitment and retention of school bus drivers.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING PAROLE OFFICERS TO PROVIDE SCHOOL SECURITY SERVICES.
purpose: To enable parole officers to serve as armed school security officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEVELOPMENT OF PARENT TRANSPARENCY PORTALS BY SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To require school districts to develop parent transparency portals.

title: AN ACT ENCOURAGING LOCAL SCHOOL DISTRICTS TO REGIONALIZE.
purpose: To encourage towns to join a regional school district.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE UNIFORM ASSESSMENT RATE FOR PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To increase the uniform assessment rate for property tax to seventy-five per cent of present true and actual value.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REFUNDABLE CHILD TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To establish a refundable child tax credit.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE APPLICABLE PERCENTAGE OF THE EARNED INCOME TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To increase the applicable percentage of the earned income tax credit to forty per cent of the federal earned income tax credit.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING REIMBURSEMENT PERCENTAGE INCENTIVES IN THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT GRANT PROGRAM FOR TOWNS THAT MEET CERTAIN AFFORDABLE HOUSING THRESHOLDS.
purpose: To encourage towns to allow more affordable housing to be constructed.

title: AN ACT ADJUSTING CERTAIN MARGINAL RATES FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX AND ESTABLISHING A CAPITAL GAINS SURCHARGE.
purpose: To adjust certain marginal rates for the personal income tax and establish a capital gains surcharge on certain taxpayers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DISTRIBUTION OF THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE.
purpose: To provide that the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store be distributed to the municipalities in which the revenue was generated.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE-WIDE PROPERTY TAX ON CERTAIN RESIDENTIAL REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To establish a state-wide property tax on residential real property with assessed values of more than one million five hundred thousand dollars and to dedicate such revenue to fully fund the equalization aid grants under section 10-262h of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PREVENTION OF GUN VIOLENCE.
purpose: To establish stricter gun control laws that promote responsible gun ownership and prevent gun violence.

title: AN ACT ENSURING THAT LOCAL AND STATE GOVERNMENT OFFICIALS FULLY COOPERATE WITH LAW ENFORCEMENT PERSONNEL IN THE ENFORCEMENT OF FEDERAL IMMIGRATION LAW.
purpose: To ensure that local and state officials are fully cooperating with law enforcement personnel in the enforcement of federal immigration law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CRIMINAL RECORD HISTORY.
purpose: To repeal the acts regarding automatic erasure of criminal record history.

title: AN ACT CREATING A STAND-YOUR-GROUND LAW.
purpose: To adopt a stand-your-ground policy.

title: AN ACT RESTRICTING EARLY RELEASE FOR PERSONS CONVICTED OF CRIMES INVOLVING SEXUAL ASSAULT OR FIREARMS.
purpose: To protect the citizens of Connecticut from early release of convicted violent felons.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING JUVENILES CHARGED WITH LARCENY INVOLVING THEFT OF A MOTOR VEHICLE.
purpose: To deter auto thefts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING JUVENILE JUSTICE POLICY AND CRIMES COMMITTED BY JUVENILES.
purpose: To reinstate certain juvenile justice policies in place prior to 2015 in order to provide law enforcement additional tools to combat juvenile crime.

title: AN ACT INCREASING PENALTIES FOR THE ILLEGAL SALE OF FENTANYL.
purpose: To combat the fentanyl crisis in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE OFFICE OF THE FOOD ACCESS ADVOCATE.
purpose: To coordinate state and private nonprofit efforts to ameliorate food insecurity.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING FEMALE GENITAL MUTILATION.
purpose: To provide for a program of education for prevention of female genital mutilation and a civil cause of action and criminal penalties for female genital mutilation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSTITUTIONAL SPENDING CAP AND EXEMPT EXPENDITURES.
purpose: To adjust the spending cap so that funding to certain municipalities can be increased.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELIGIBILITY FOR THE RURAL ROADS GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the rural roads grant program and aid municipalities in protecting the public from speeding vehicles.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR IMPROVEMENTS AT STODDARD HILL STATE PARK.
purpose: To provide funding for repairs to roads and a boat launch, drainage improvements and removal of a pier at Stoddard Hill State Park in Ledyard.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF A REGIONAL ANIMAL CONTROL FACILITY IN THE TOWN OF MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding to construct a regional animal control facility in Montville.

title: AN ACT DESIGNATING TAKE A BREAK FROM SOCIAL MEDIA DAY.
purpose: To designate Take a Break from Social Media Day.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENEWABLE ENERGY, ENERGY EFFICIENCY, STATE CONTRACTS, PROTECTING CONSUMERS AND REDUCING ENERGY COSTS.
purpose: To promote renewable energy, increase the energy efficiency of buildings, increase accountability in state contracting, provide consumer protection and lower costs for the state's energy consumers.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN EVALUATION OF METHODS TO ADDRESS THE SHORTAGE OF RESPIRATORY THERAPISTS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require an evaluation of methods to address the shortage of respiratory therapists in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRIC DISTRIBUTION COMPANIES' PROCUREMENT OF SUPPLY FOR STANDARD SERVICE.
purpose: To lower electric rates.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR RENOVATIONS BY THE MONTVILLE HOUSING AUTHORITY.
purpose: To provide funding for renovations to properties by the Montville Housing Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKING GROUP RECOMMENDATIONS RELATED TO INDOOR AIR QUALITY.
purpose: To adopt the recommendations of the Working Group To Study and Make Recommendations Related To Indoor Air Quality Within School Buildings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAREER PATHWAYS AND WORKFORCE TRAINING.
purpose: To develop a rubric for career pathway training programs and a new accelerated teacher certification pathway for people who work in the trades, establish a task force to examine transportation barriers related to work-based learning programs, amend the journeyperson to apprentice ratio until June 30, 2025, and require an audit of workforce development programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY ON THE EFFECTIVENESS OF DYSLEXIA EDUCATION STATUTES.
purpose: To study the efficacy of recent dyslexia education legislation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FREE APPLICATION FOR FEDERAL STUDENT AID.
purpose: To address the completion of the free application for federal student aid for the purpose of increasing college accessibility and affordability.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CARE 4 KIDS PROGRAM ELIGIBILITY FOR EARLY CHILDHOOD EDUCATION EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To make early childhood education employees eligible for the Care 4 Kids program for the purpose of assisting in the recruitment and retention of such employees.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FROM WITHHOLDING STUDENT TRANSCRIPTS.
purpose: To prohibit institutions of higher education from withholding student transcripts.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO RENOVATE AND EXPAND THE MONTVILLE BOAT LAUNCH.
purpose: To provide funding to renovate and expand the Montville Boat Launch.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REMOTE PUBLIC AGENCY MEETINGS.
purpose: To repeal sections 147 and 149 of public act 21-2 of the June special session which allow for remote governmental meetings to replace in-person meetings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYEES NOT CURRENTLY PARTICIPATING IN THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the state Paid Family and Medical Leave Program to include employees excluded because of their employer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LABOR DEPARTMENT AND DATA BREACHES.
purpose: To require the Labor Commissioner to conduct a study on data breaches and false unemployment claims suffered by the Labor Department.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXEMPTIONS TO THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE PROGRAM.
purpose: To exempt individuals who cannot file a claim under the Paid Family and Medical Leave Program from having to make contributions to the program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DIGITAL FINANCIAL SERVICES BY STATE-CHARTERED FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS.
purpose: To provide that the ability of each state-chartered financial institution to offer digital financial services shall be equal to the ability of other financial institutions to offer such services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINOR PARTY RULES.
purpose: To require minor parties to adhere to their party rules.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TUITION WAIVERS FOR LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To provide tuition waivers for certain law enforcement officers at the regional community-technical colleges, the Connecticut State University System and The University of Connecticut to assist in the recruiting of law enforcement officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RENTING OR LEASING OF PASSENGER MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To prohibit a car rental company from (1) requiring an additional driver to provide a credit card to such company as a condition to renting a passenger motor vehicle, provided the lessee provides a credit card or debit card, and (2) recovering the loss of use of a rented vehicle from a lessee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF CONSTABLES TO EXECUTE SUMMARY PROCESS EVICTIONS.
purpose: To amend state statutes to clarify that a constable may execute a summary process eviction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INVESTIGATIONS OF PEDESTRIAN FATALITIES.
purpose: To expedite the investigation of pedestrian fatalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SUSPENSION OF IMPLEMENTATION OF THE SURVEY ON READING INSTRUCTION.
purpose: To suspend implementation of the survey on reading instruction for the school year commencing July 1, 2022.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TAX PREPARER LIABILITY FOR UNDERPAID INCOME TAX.
purpose: To require that, where a taxpayer underpaid income tax due to tax preparer error, the tax preparer shall file an amended return at no cost to the taxpayer and be liable for any additional tax, penalties or interest owed.

title: AN ACT CREATING A TENANT'S BILL OF RIGHTS.
purpose: To protect the rights of tenants in dwelling units.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING THE STAMFORD POLICE ACTIVITIES LEAGUE FROM THE STATE LICENSURE REQUIREMENTS RELATING TO CHILD CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To exempt the Stamford Police Activities League, Inc., from the state licensure requirements relating to the provision of child care services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EVICTIONS UPON THE NONRENEWAL OF A RENTAL AGREEMENT.
purpose: To eliminate the lapse of time as good cause to evict a tenant if the landlord has sought an annual rent increase exceeding fifteen per cent.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CONNECTICUT REPARATIONS TASK FORCE.
purpose: To establish a Connecticut Reparations Task Force to study slavery and its effects throughout American history and make recommendations concerning reparations.

title: AN ACT RESTORING CAPITAL PUNISHMENT.
purpose: To restore the death penalty in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE COVERAGE FOR SELF-EMPLOYED FARMERS.
purpose: To require health insurance coverage for self-employed farmers.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING SEX OR GENDER-BASED DIFFERENTIAL PRICING FOR SUBSTANTIALLY SIMILAR SERVICES.
purpose: To prohibit sex or gender-based differential pricing for substantially similar services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE STATE TO RECOGNIZE EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES AS ESSENTIAL SERVICES.
purpose: To designate emergency medical services as services that are essential to the health, safety and welfare of the people of the state to ensure the safety and security of emergency medical services providers.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR REPAIRS TO A COLLAPSED BUILDING IN STONINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding to repair a collapsed building owned by the town of Stonington.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BOND AUTHORIZATIONS FOR AND GRANTS UNDER THE SMALL TOWN ECONOMIC ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase bond authorizations for STEAP, increase maximum grants to municipalities under the program and adjust requirements for receiving a grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEMPORARY WORKERS AND PAID SICK LEAVE.
purpose: To provide temporary workers annual paid sick leave.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CONSTRUCTION MANAGERS FROM SELF-PERFORMING WORK ON CERTAIN QUASI-PUBLIC AGENCY PROJECTS.
purpose: To prohibit construction managers from self-performing work on certain quasi-public agency projects.

title: AN ACT REPEALING CERTAIN PROVISIONS OF PA 20-1 OF THE JULY SPECIAL SESSION, ALSO KNOWN AS THE POLICE ACCOUNTABILITY ACT.
purpose: To repeal certain restrictions on law enforcement and protect officers and municipalities from frivolous lawsuits.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING JUVENILE COURT PROCEEDINGS BE OPEN TO THE PUBLIC.
purpose: To require that juvenile court proceedings are open to the public.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILD SEX TRAFFICKING.
purpose: To protect children and youth from sex trafficking in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSFER OF CERTAIN JUVENILE CASES TO ADULT COURT.
purpose: To allow for transfer of certain juvenile cases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AMUSEMENT PARKS AND THE EMPLOYMENT OF INDIVIDUALS AT LEAST FOURTEEN YEARS OF AGE.
purpose: To allow amusement parks to hire individuals who are at least fourteen years of age to perform nonhazardous jobs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUPERMARKETS AND THE HIRING OF INDIVIDUALS AT LEAST SIXTEEN YEARS OF AGE.
purpose: To allow supermarkets to employ individuals who are at least sixteen years of age in positions currently limited to individuals over eighteen years of age.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A BRIDGE IN STONINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding for a bridge project in Stonington.

title: AN ACT REDEFINING "STATE CONTRACT" FOR PURPOSES OF THE CAMPAIGN FINANCE LAWS.
purpose: To redefine "state contract" to exclude licensing fees for purposes of the campaign finance laws.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM AMOUNT OF RESOURCES THAT MAY BE RETAINED BY THE SPOUSE OF AN INSTITUTIONALIZED MEDICAID RECIPIENT.
purpose: To increase to sixty thousand dollars the minimum amount of assets that may be retained by the spouse of an institutionalized Medicaid recipient.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE APPLICABILITY OF THE ANGEL INVESTOR TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To expand the angel investor tax credit to be applicable against the corporation business tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX TO OFFSET INCREASED HEATING COSTS.
purpose: To establish a tax credit against the personal income tax to offset increased heating costs paid by middle-income residents for 2022 and 2023.

title: AN ACT CREATING A HOUSING AUTHORITY SAFETY AND SECURITY GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To create and fund a housing authority safety and security grant program.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE AND QUASI-PUBLIC AGENCIES FROM CHARGING SUCCESSOR FEES.
purpose: To prohibit state and quasi-public agencies from charging successor fees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAREER PATHWAYS AND WORKFORCE TRAINING.
purpose: To develop a rubric for career pathway training programs and a new accelerated teacher certification pathway for people who work in the trades, establish a task force to examine transportation barriers related to work-based learning programs, amend the journeyperson to apprentice ratio until June 30, 2025, and require an audit of workforce development programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY EQUIPMENT AND RESPONSE AT ATHLETIC FACILITIES ON COLLEGE CAMPUSES.
purpose: To require institutions of higher education in state have an automatic external defibrillator at any athletic facility on campus and to have staff present during normal operating hours and during sporting events who are trained to use an automatic external defibrillator and to provide cardiopulmonary resuscitation for the purpose of ensuring the safety of collegiate student athletes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HIGHER EDUCATION COLLABORATIVE WITHIN THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION'S TALENT OFFICE.
purpose: To establish a Higher Education Collaborative within the Department of Education's Talent Office to collaborate on higher education programming with the Office of Dyslexia and Reading Disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BAIL REFORM.
purpose: To replace the practice of setting high bail on a defendant with a practice in which bail amount is based on an analysis of the risk of flight and danger to the community, which may result in bail being denied under certain circumstances.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING INTOXICATED DRIVERS WHO ARE CONVICTED OF KILLING A PARENT TO PAY CHILD MAINTENANCE IN SUPPORT OF SURVIVING MINOR CHILDREN.
purpose: To require intoxicated drivers who are convicted of the killing of a parent to pay child maintenance in support of surviving minor children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL CLIMATE CONTROL.
purpose: To require all schools to modernize climate control systems in school buildings to include systems such as air conditioning for the purpose of supporting the health and well-being of students, teachers and staff.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EDUCATIONAL CONTINUITY AND SUPPORT SERVICES FOR CHILDREN DISPLACED BY EVICTION.
purpose: To establish grant programs to provide counseling, support services and educational continuity for children displaced by eviction and to require the Department of Education to provide recommendations for keeping children who are displaced by eviction in the school such children attended prior to such eviction for a transitory duration.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE DEBT-FREE COMMUNITY COLLEGE PROGRAM TO INCLUDE THE CONNECTICUT STATE UNIVERSITY SYSTEM.
purpose: To expand the debt-free community college program to include not more than two years of enrollment at a state university within the Connecticut State University System.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING EMPLOYERS TO RECOUP CERTAIN BONUSES.
purpose: To allow an employer to require an employee to repay a recruitment or retention bonus to the employer if the employee voluntarily leaves employment in breach of an employment contract.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEARN HERE, LIVE HERE PROGRAM.
purpose: To: (1) Require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to establish the Learn Here, Live Here program; (2) increase the annual expenditure on such program to not more than five million dollars; and (3) make such program available to individuals whose annual federal adjusted gross income is not more than seventy-five thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL BUS DRIVERS AND THE RECEIPT OF UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS.
purpose: To assist school bus drivers with unemployment claims.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE PROGRAM TO STATE, MUNICIPAL AND TRIBAL NATION EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To expanding the paid family and medical leave program to include state and municipal employees and employees of tribal nations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONVEYANCE OF A PARCEL OF STATE LAND IN THE TOWN OF CHESHIRE.
purpose: To require the conveyance of a parcel of state land in the town of Cheshire for economic development purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCEDURE AND REQUIRING A STUDY ON BUILDING APPLICATIONS AND BUILDING CODES.
purpose: To include certain market-rate properties in calculation of the affordable housing appeals procedure threshold, to require documentary verification of rents, to allow tax abatements for certain market-rate properties, to allow municipalities to choose the method of determining median income, and to require the Department of Housing to conduct a study on building applications and building codes and regulations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXEMPTIONS FOR BOROUGHS FROM THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCESS.
purpose: To clarify the affordable housing appeals threshold when a borough has reached such threshold.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LIMITATION OF RENT INCREASES FOR SUBSIDIZED MULTIFAMILY RENTAL PROPERTIES.
purpose: To stabilize rental prices of current or formerly subsidized rental properties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COUNTING OF UNITS TOWARDS AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS MORATORIUMS.
purpose: To expand the units which may be counted towards an affordable housing appeals moratorium.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING UNIT-EQUIVALENT POINTS AND CERTAIN PROPERTIES LOCATED NEAR TRANSIT STATIONS.
purpose: To (1) increase housing unit-equivalent points for elderly units, (2) include in the calculation of the threshold for the affordable housing appeals process certain properties located within one-half mile of any transit station, and (3) award housing unit-equivalent points for municipalities that submit affordable housing plans.

title: AN ACT REVISING THE UNIFORM RELOCATION ASSISTANCE ACT.
purpose: To revise the Uniform Relocation Assistance Act to allow the Department of Housing or another political entity of the state, other than the municipality that issued the code violation, to determine that a resident has been displaced due to municipal code enforcement activities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING AUTHORITY SERVICES.
purpose: To require housing authorities to administer services separately for seniors, second-chance community and young people with disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GROUP CHILD CARE HOMES.
purpose: To increase the supply of group child care homes to address the shortage of child care facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TENANT UNION REPRESENTATIVES AND FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To allow fair rent commissions to recognize tenant unions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLARITY AND SIMPLICITY OF MUNICIPAL REFERENDUM QUESTIONS.
purpose: To (1) establish standards for municipal referendum question language designed to increase clarity and simplicity for voters, and (2) provide for review, and approval or disapproval, of such municipal referendum question language by the Secretary of the State.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VETERANS AND GUN VIOLENCE PREVENTION.
purpose: To prevent gun violence among at-risk youths through mentorship and gun safety instruction by veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOMESTIC AND INTIMATE PARTNER VIOLENCE MURDER.
purpose: To ensure domestic violence deaths are charged as murder instead of manslaughter.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONTROL OF THE UNION AVENUE DETENTION CENTER IN NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To return responsibility for staffing and administration of the Union Avenue Detention Center in New Haven to the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PUNISHMENT FOR MURDER RESULTING FROM AN ACT OF DOMESTIC VIOLENCE.
purpose: To cause a person who commits murder resulting from an act of domestic violence to serve a life sentence without the opportunity for parole.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO CONNECTICUT INNOVATIONS, INCORPORATED TO PROMOTE CONNECTICUT AS A BIOSCIENCE HUB.
purpose: To increase the sum appropriated to Connecticut Innovations, Incorporated, for the purpose of promoting Connecticut as a bioscience hub.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO PROVIDE CERTAIN CAPACITY BUILDING GRANTS.
purpose: To authorize the Department of Economic and Community Development to provide capacity building grants to eligible Connecticut brownfield land banks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADDITIONAL CAREER TRAINING OPPORTUNITIES OFFERED BY THE OFFICE OF WORKFORCE STRATEGY.
purpose: To require the Office of Workforce Strategy to: (1) Identify additional career training opportunities to expand the program established pursuant to section 4-124mm of the general statutes; (2) identify training providers to use for such additional career training opportunities; and (3) submit a report regarding the identification of such additional career training opportunities and training providers.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE STATE WORKFORCE STRATEGY DEVELOPED BY THE CHIEF WORKFORCE OFFICER.
purpose: To implement the state workforce strategy developed by the Chief Workforce Officer, in consultation with the Governor's Workforce Council and the Workforce Cabinet, pursuant to section 4-124w of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR RENOVATIONS AND AN ADDITION TO THE LYMES' SENIOR CENTER.
purpose: To provide funding for renovations and an addition to the Lymes' Senior Center.

title: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE BOND ALLOCATION CAP.
purpose: To reduce debt-financed capital spending by limiting the amount of bond allocations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE CONTRACTING STANDARDS BOARD AND STATE CONTRACTING AGENCIES.
purpose: To ensure that all cost-benefit analyses are filed with the State Contracting Standards Board and that the board has the ability to oversee The University of Connecticut Health Center Finance Corporation and its activity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXERCISE OF CIVIL LIBERTIES DURING A PUBLIC HEALTH OR CIVIL PREPAREDNESS EMERGENCY.
purpose: To protect civil liberties during declarations of a public health or civil preparedness emergency.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING QUASI-PUBLIC AGENCY PROJECT CONSTRUCTION MANAGERS FROM SELF-PERFORMING WORK.
purpose: To prohibit construction managers from self-performing work on quasi-public agency projects to prevent fraud and abuse.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CONDOMINIUM OMBUDSMAN AND REQUIRING THE DISCLOSURE OF CERTAIN FINANCIAL INFORMATION.
purpose: To provide a venue to mediate condominium disputes and to increase transparency of condominium association budgets.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AFFORDABLE HOUSING APPEALS PROCESS AND WATERSHED PROTECTION LAND.
purpose: To exempt municipalities with a high proportion of watershed protection land from the affordable housing appeals process.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENTAL APPLICATION FEES AND TENANT SCREENING REPORTS.
purpose: To cap the amount landlords may charge for application fees and tenant screening reports and require landlords to show proof of any tenant screening report.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PENALTY FOR RISK OF INJURY TO A CHILD.
purpose: To protect children by increasing the penalty for risk of injury to a child.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE PENALTY FOR MANUFACTURE, SALE OR DISTRIBUTION OF FENTANYL.
purpose: To increase the penalty for manufacture, sale or distribution of fentanyl.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A CONTINUOUS COURSE OF CONDUCT OF SEXUAL INTERCOURSE AS RELATED TO THE CRIME OF SEXUAL ASSAULT.
purpose: To ensure that a continuous course of conduct of sexual intercourse is punishable under the penal code of the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER OF MIRANDA RIGHTS BY A MINOR.
purpose: To raise the age that minors can waive their Miranda rights without parental or guardian consent to eighteen years to prevent false confession and conviction of minors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A HOLISTIC SET OF POLICIES TO MAKE CONNECTICUT SAFER.
purpose: To end juvenile injustice, create opportunity and make Connecticut safer by adopting a holistic set of policies.

title: AN ACT CLASSIFYING THE DEALING OF ILLEGAL DRUGS THAT LEADS TO A DEATH AS MANSLAUGHTER IN THE FIRST DEGREE.
purpose: To classify the dealing of illegal drugs that leads to a death as manslaughter in the first degree.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF STRIP SEARCHES BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CORRECTION.
purpose: To govern the use of strip searches by the Department of Correction.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING COMMUNITY-BASED SENTENCING ALTERNATIVES FOR PRIMARY CARETAKERS OF DEPENDENT CHILDREN.
purpose: To establish community-based sentencing alternatives for primary caretakers of dependent children in order to help families stay intact.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINIMUM SENTENCING GUIDELINES FOR CRIMES COMMITTED WITH FIREARMS.
purpose: To direct the Connecticut Sentencing Commission to review and make recommendations on minimum sentencing guidelines for crimes committed with firearms.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A DEFENDANT'S COMPETENCY TO STAND TRIAL AND EARLY RELEASE INTO THE COMMUNITY.
purpose: To review and revise the laws surrounding defendants who are found not competent to stand trial and their early release into the community.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FENTANYL CRISIS.
purpose: To combat the state-wide public health and safety crisis of fentanyl.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING ELECTRIC SUPPLIERS FROM CHARGING FEES TO SWITCH TO A DIFFERENT ELECTRIC SUPPLIER.
purpose: To prohibit electric suppliers from charging fees to customers for switching to a different supplier.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN ONLINE SOLICITATIONS FOR POLITICAL CONTRIBUTIONS.
purpose: To exempt from the definition of "expenditure" certain online solicitations for political contributions.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION SPECIALIZED PROGRAMS AT MAGNET SCHOOLS.
purpose: To allow for special education specialized programs to take place at magnet schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HIGH-QUALITY AFFORDABLE CHILD CARE AND WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To address issues relating to early childhood care in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FUNCTIONS OF THE DEPARTMENTS OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION AND AGRICULTURE.
purpose: To study the functions of the Departments of Energy and Environmental Protection and Agriculture.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LABELING OF CERTAIN BEVERAGE CONTAINERS, THE REVIEW OF MUNICIPAL PROGRAMS FUNDED BY NIP PAYMENTS AND THE RETURN OF BEVERAGE CONTAINERS FOR THE REDEMPTION VALUE.
purpose: To clarify the definition of carbonated beverage, enable the sale of certain labeled beverage containers after January 1, 2024, and authorize temporary reserves in deposit initiator accounts for future increased refund values.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TREE REMOVAL ON PROPERTIES UNDER THE CONTROL OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To improve transparency and establish standards for the removal of trees that constitute an immediate public hazard at state parks and campgrounds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PATIENT'S DIRECTIONS REGARDING LIFE SUPPORT SYSTEMS.
purpose: To ensure that a patient's directions regarding the withholding or withdrawal of life support systems are followed.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE REQUIREMENT THAT THE PROBATE COURT ISSUE AN ORDER ALLOWING A PATIENT WHO IS INCAPABLE OF GIVING INFORMED CONSENT TO RECEIVE SHOCK THERAPY.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that the Probate Court issue an order allowing a patient who is incapable of giving informed consent to receive shock therapy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TITLE PROTECTION FOR PHYSICIANS.
purpose: To require title protection for physicians.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REVOLVING LOAN ACCOUNT TO ASSIST ELDERLY HOMEOWNERS.
purpose: To establish a revolving loan account to assist certain elderly homeowners who have been delinquent on property tax payments.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REGISTRY OF PERSONS CONVICTED OF FINANCIAL CRIMES AGAINST ELDERLY PERSONS.
purpose: To establish a registry of persons convicted of financial crimes against elderly persons.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF FAMILY COUNCILS IN MANAGED RESIDENTIAL COMMUNITIES PROVIDING ASSISTED LIVING SERVICES.
purpose: To encourage and support the establishment of family councils in managed residential communities providing assisted living services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF LONG-TERM CARE NEEDS.
purpose: To study long-term care needs to ensure adequate resources are allocated.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION AND CONCERNING STATE PARKWAYS, THE CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY, A TRANSPORTATION CARBON DIOXIDE REDUCTION TARGET, A TREE AND VEGETATION MANAGEMENT PLAN, MOTOR VEHICLE NOISE, THE ZERO-EMISSION TRUCK VOUCHER PROGRAM, STREET RACING, EMERGENCY LIGHTS AND THE NAMING OF CERTAIN ROADS AND BRIDGES.
