purpose: To (1) establish a penalty for a municipality that fails to comply with an order issued by the Office of the State Traffic Administration, (2) permit the use of symbols on pedestrian control signals, (3) require operators to stop for pedestrians in crosswalks, (4) prohibit local building officials from issuing a certificate of occupancy for certain developments until conditions of a certificate issued by the office have been completed, (5) require annual training for traffic authorities, and (6) permit speed limits up to sixty-five miles per hour on suitable multiple lane, limited access highways.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR PERMITS AND TOBACCO BARS.
purpose: To: (1) Establish permits for the retail sale of alcoholic liquor at auction, annual outdoor open-air liquor permits and event sales permits; (2) authorize wholesaler permittees to sell kegs containing cocktails and premixed drinks to certain retail permittees for on-premises consumption; (3) require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to amend certain regulations in order to provide that certain pipes and lines used to serve alcoholic liquor shall be cleaned at least once every two weeks; (4) eliminate the prohibition against provisional seasonal outdoor open-air liquor permits; (5) authorize spirits manufacturers to sell products they manufacture under farmers' market sales permits; (6) provide that neither the State Fire Marshal nor any local fire marshal may require any liquor permit premises to be inspected more than once during any calendar year; (7) amend the alcoholic beverages tax to provide that liquor, certain alcohol and liquor coolers are taxed at the same rate as beer; and (8) allow for the establishment of new tobacco bars and for existing tobacco bars to expand or change location.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING PROTECTIONS FOR VICTIMS OF FAMILY VIOLENCE.
purpose: To prohibit a landlord from taking certain adverse actions against a tenant based on such tenant's family violence victim status.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To require towns, cities or boroughs with a population of at least ten thousand to create fair rent commissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HOUSING TRUST FUND.
purpose: To eliminate an obsolete advisory committee for the administration of the housing trust fund program.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A RIGHT TO HOUSING.
purpose: To establish a right to housing for all residents of the state and a right to housing committee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERMANENT PARTIAL DISABILITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OFFSETS.
purpose: To prohibit municipal or special taxing district pension systems from diminishing or eliminating certain retirement rights and benefits.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE THRESHOLD AMOUNT FOR FELONY UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION FRAUD.
purpose: To increase the threshold dollar amount for misdemeanor and felony unemployment compensation fraud.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATUS OF PROBATE COURT SYSTEM EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To allow Probate Court employees to be recognized as state employees for the purpose of collective bargaining.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING WORKERS' COMPENSATION COVERAGE FOR POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS INJURIES FOR ALL EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To extend workers' compensation coverage for post-traumatic stress injuries to all employees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOVERY OF ATTORNEY'S FEES IN ACTIONS FOR WRONGFUL PROPERTY TAX ASSESSMENT.
purpose: To permit the recovery of reasonable attorney's fees in successful actions for wrongful property tax assessment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE GRANTING OF VARIANCES BY ZONING BOARDS OF APPEALS.
purpose: To specify the conditions under which zoning boards of appeals may grant variances.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FORECLOSURE, ASSIGNMENT AND OTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS FOR UNPAID SEWER ASSESSMENTS AND OTHER FEES AND CHARGES.
purpose: To prohibit foreclosure, assignment and other enforcement actions for unpaid sewer assessment and other fees and charges in the case of owner-occupied real property for which the principal of such unpaid assessments, fees and charges is less than four thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY THE IMPLEMENTATION OF FEDERAL TITLE IX PROTECTIONS FOR ALL MUNICIPAL RECREATION AREAS AND SCHOOL SPORTS FACILITIES.
purpose: To establish a working group to study the feasibility of a federal Title IX assessment of all municipal recreation areas and facilities used for the organized playing of sports and public school sports facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COASTAL SITE PLAN REVIEW.
purpose: To specify that where a project would require more than one coastal site plan review, only one such review shall be necessary.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY CHILDHOOD AND ADULT PSYCHOSIS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study childhood and adult psychosis.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE SALE OF KRATOM PRODUCTS TO INDIVIDUALS UNDER TWENTY-ONE YEARS OF AGE.
purpose: To prohibit the sale of kratom products to individuals under twenty-one years of age.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING REPORTING ON THE IMPLEMENTATION OF THE STUDENTS FIRST PLAN.
purpose: To require the Board of Regents for Higher Education to report on the implementation of the Students First plan.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING AN INSTITUTION OF HIGHER EDUCATION FROM WITHHOLDING TRANSCRIPTS.
purpose: To prohibit institutions of higher education from withholding student transcripts from employers, prospective employers or any branch of the military service of the United States as a means to collect a student debt.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE CONSIDERATION OF CRIMINAL HISTORY DURING THE ADMISSIONS PROCESS AT AN INSTITUTION OF HIGHER EDUCATION OR PRIVATE CAREER SCHOOL OR BY AN EDUCATIONAL OR APPRENTICESHIP PROGRAM.
purpose: To prohibit the consideration of criminal history during the admissions process at an institution of higher education or private career school or by any educational or apprenticeship program in which the state participates.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING IMMUNITY FROM CIVIL LIABILITY TO A PHYSICIAN WHO ACCOMPANIES AND ASSISTS A STATE, REGIONAL OR MUNICIPAL SWAT TEAM.
purpose: To provide immunity to a physician who accompanies and assists a state, regional or municipal SWAT team.

title: AN ACT CONFIRMING AND ADOPTING VOLUMES 1 TO 13, INCLUSIVE, OF THE GENERAL STATUTES REVISED TO JANUARY 1, 2023.
purpose: To adopt and confirm the general statutes, revised to January 1, 2023.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONS COMMITTED TO THE JURISDICTION OF THE PSYCHIATRIC SECURITY REVIEW BOARD.
purpose: To allow the state's attorney to make application for commitment of certain acquittees to a hospital for psychiatric disabilities prior to the acquittee's discharge at the expiration of the acquittee's maximum term of commitment if the acquittee would constitute a danger to himself or herself or others or is gravely disabled.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE'S CRIMINAL JUSTICE INFORMATION SYSTEM.
purpose: To require certain third-party vendors and contractors to maintain specifications that have been established and implemented by the Criminal Justice Information System Governing Board.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO STATUTES RELATING TO CHILDREN.
purpose: To make technical changes to certain statutes relating to children.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING SCHOOL MEAL PROGRAMS TO PROVIDE FREE SCHOOL MEALS TO ALL STUDENTS.
purpose: To provide free school meals to all students.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICE OF A PROPOSED INVOLUNTARY TRANSFER OR DISCHARGE OF A NURSING FACILITY RESIDENT TO THE STATE OMBUDSMAN.
purpose: To require nursing home facilities to notify the State Ombudsman of a proposed transfer or discharge of a resident.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO THE ALZHEIMER'S DISEASE RESPITE CARE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the number of persons eligible for the Alzheimer's disease respite care program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POLICE ANIMALS AND DOGS IN VOLUNTEER CANINE SEARCH AND RESCUE TEAMS.
purpose: To (1) increase the penalty for intentionally injuring a police animal or dog in a volunteer canine search and rescue team; (2) establish a penalty for annoying, teasing, tormenting or harassing a police animal confined in a motor vehicle; (3) allow emergency medical services personnel to provide emergency treatment and transportation to an injured police animal under certain circumstances; and (4) establish a grant program to provide canine officers with body armor.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CYBERSECURITY TASK FORCE.
purpose: To establish a cybersecurity task force.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PAYMENTS TO VOLUNTEER FIRE COMPANIES THAT RESPOND TO CALLS IN STATE PARKS AND STATE FORESTS.
purpose: To require payments from the State Fire Administrator to volunteer fire companies that respond to calls on the property of state parks or state forests.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING PENSIONS FOR POLICE OFFICERS AND FIREFIGHTERS EMPLOYED BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To require that municipalities employing police officers and firefighters provide such officers and firefighters with pensions through the Municipal Employees Retirement System or another system that offers comparable or superior benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To require the Board of Regents for Higher Education to study issues related to workforce development in the state.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING WORKERS' COMPENSATION BENEFITS FOR CERTAIN CANCERS IN FIREFIGHTERS.
purpose: To create a rebuttable presumption that a firefighter's diagnosis of cancer arose out of and in the course of employment for purposes of workers' compensation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS FOR STRIKING WORKERS.
purpose: To allow striking employees to collect unemployment benefits after a period of two consecutive weeks striking.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR CERTAIN FIRST-TIME HOME BUYERS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to abate up to five hundred dollars per assessment year of property taxes for certain first-time homebuyers who obtain a loan from the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WALK-THROUGH INSPECTIONS OF RENTAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To permit tenants to request an inspection of rental property prior to occupancy.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE RIGHT TO COUNSEL PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the right to counsel program to include any resident of a distressed municipality.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENTAL APPLICATION FEES.
purpose: To limit fees a landlord may charge in connection with tenant screenings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RETURN OF SECURITY DEPOSITS UPON THE TERMINATION OF TENANCY.
purpose: To require landlords to return any security deposit due to a tenant not later than ten days after the termination of tenancy.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE MAINTENANCE OF THE NATIONAL IWO JIMA MEMORIAL IN THE CITY OF NEW BRITAIN.
purpose: To appropriate funds for the maintenance of the National Iwo Jima Memorial in the city of New Britain.

title: AN ACT FACILITATING SAFE DISPOSAL OF OPIOID PRESCRIPTIONS BY MEDICAID BENEFICIARIES.
purpose: To facilitate safe opioid prescription disposal by Medicaid beneficiaries by providing Medicaid reimbursement to pharmacists who dispense safe opioid disposal systems along with opioid prescriptions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT HOME-CARE PROGRAM FOR THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To expand access to the state-funded portion of the Connecticut home-care program for the elderly, compensate family caregivers and authorize and compensate up to two visits by licensed social workers to home-care clients.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE MINIMUM AMOUNT OF RESOURCES A COMMUNITY SPOUSE OF AN INSTITUTIONALIZED MEDICAID RECIPIENT MAY RETAIN.
purpose: To increase from fifty thousand dollars to sixty thousand dollars the amount a spouse of an institutionalized Medicaid recipient may retain.

title: AN ACT ADDING CERTAIN MEMBERS TO THE GOVERNOR'S WORKFORCE COUNCIL.
purpose: To add a residential construction expert to the Governor's Workforce Council.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT AND SMALL BUSINESSES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study economic development issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF MANUFACTURING, WORKFORCE SHORTAGES AND TRAINING.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study manufacturing issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF LICENSING RECIPROCITY AGREEMENTS OR LICENSING COMPACTS FOR HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study workforce development issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAROLE ELIGIBILITY FOR AN INDIVIDUAL SERVING A LENGTHY SENTENCE FOR A CRIME COMMITTED BEFORE THE INDIVIDUAL REACHED THE AGE OF TWENTY-ONE AND CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORDS ERASURE.
purpose: To broaden eligibility for parole to include those individuals serving long sentences for crimes committed before the individual was twenty-five years of age, under certain circumstances.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RACIAL PROFILING.
purpose: To redefine racial profiling for purposes of the Alvin W. Penn Racial Profiling Prohibition Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REDUCTION OF ECONOMIC DAMAGES IN A PERSONAL INJURY OR WRONGFUL DEATH ACTION FOR COLLATERAL SOURCE PAYMENTS MADE ON BEHALF OF A CLAIMANT.
purpose: To permit a post-verdict collateral source reduction in damages in certain personal injury or wrongful death matters involving a right of subrogation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ANATOMICAL GIFTS.
purpose: To require reporting on anatomical gifts.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DISCHARGE STANDARDS REGARDING FOLLOW-UP APPOINTMENTS AND PRESCRIPTION MEDICATIONS FOR PATIENTS BEING DISCHARGED FROM A HOSPITAL OR NURSING HOME FACILITY.
purpose: To require discharge standards regarding follow-up appointments and prescription medications for patients being discharged from a hospital or nursing home facility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OVERSIGHT OF HEALTH CARE IN CORRECTIONAL INSTITUTIONS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH.
purpose: To establish an Office of Oversight of Health Care in Correctional Institutions within the Department of Public Health to ensure oversight of the delivery of health care services to inmates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TIMELY TRANSFER OF MEDICAL RECORDS BETWEEN HEALTH CARE INSTITUTIONS AND THE FEE CHARGED FOR COPIES OF MEDICAL RECORDS.
purpose: To require health care institutions to, upon receipt of a patient-approved medical records request, transfer such patient's medical records to another institution (1) immediately, if such request is urgent, or (2) within twenty-four hours, if such request is not urgent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MOLD IN RESIDENTIAL HOUSING AND COMMERCIAL BUILDINGS.
purpose: To establish protections for residents of residential property from mold infestation.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO EVALUATE EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT CROWDING.
purpose: To establish a working group to evaluate emergency department crowding.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CARBON-FREE SCHOOL REQUIREMENTS FOR NEW SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION AND ESTABLISHING OTHER SCHOOL CONSTRUCTION AND PUBLIC HEALTH REQUIREMENTS FOR SCHOOL DISTRICTS.
purpose: To require the use of project labor agreements when certain solar and energy efficiency projects are required of school districts and to require certain measures by the Department of Public Health concerning air quality and drinking water in school settings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF CERTAIN RODENTICIDES.
purpose: To prohibit the use of second-generation rodenticides in order to preserve hawk and other raptor populations in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NEONICOTINOIDS FOR NONAGRICULTURAL USE.
purpose: To prohibit the nonagricultural use of neonicotinoids.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSENT ORDERS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To require the consent of the other party to a consent order with the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection when such consent order is modified.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FUNDING FOR THE REMOVAL OF HAZARDOUS OR DEAD TREES BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To provide additional funding to municipalities for the removal of dead or hazardous trees in public areas and along town roads.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCUREMENT OF STANDARD SERVICE ELECTRICITY AND THE REGULATION OF PUBLIC UTILITIES.
purpose: To (1) require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to study standard service procurement, (2) prohibit recovery by public utilities of certain costs in rates, (3) amend ratemaking procedures and rate case regulations, including by placing limits on the use of settlements and requiring utilities to fund certain stakeholder groups' participation in rate cases, (4) regulate the compensation of executives and officers at public utility companies or parent companies, (5) change accident reporting rules, (6) change the rules applicable to utility outages, and (7) appropriate additional funding for the Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN PROCEDURES FOR BACKGROUND CHECKS OF PISTOL PERMIT APPLICANTS.
purpose: To revise certain background check procedures related to pistol permits.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING BACKGROUND CHECKS FOR RENEWAL OF A SECURITY OFFICER LICENSE.
purpose: To require an applicant for renewal of a security officer license to submit to a state and national criminal history records check.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VERIFICATION OF THE RESIDENTIAL ADDRESS OF A REGISTERED SEX OFFENDER.
purpose: To permit a registered sex offender to respond to an address verification request by facsimile or electronic mail.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A DOMESTIC TERRORISM PREVENTION PLAN ANNEX IN LOCAL EMERGENCY OPERATIONS PLANS.
purpose: To require a domestic terrorism prevention plan annex in local emergency operations plans.

title: AN ACT REVISING VARIOUS GAMING STATUTES.
purpose: To make revisions to statutes concerning gaming, including (1) establishing a live game employee license and revising certain licensing requirements, (2) requiring a person using a credit or debit card to fund an online gaming account to only use a card if the person is the sole account holder of such card, (3) prohibiting advertisements offering or advertising financial enticement to participate in online gaming or online or retail sports wagering, (4) allowing special officers to investigate offenses arising out of retail sports wagering, and (5) clarifying the prohibition on using animals as prizes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CRISIS INTERVENTION TRAINING FOR POLICE OFFICERS AND COLLABORATION BETWEEN POLICE OFFICERS AND SOCIAL WORKERS.
purpose: To require police officer training on strategies including crisis intervention, and to develop recommendations on how police officers and social workers may collaborate.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING ACCESS TO JUVENILE DELINQUENCY RECORDS TO EVALUATE A PROPOSED TRANSFER OF A FIREARM TO A PERSON UNDER AGE TWENTY-ONE.
purpose: To allow access to juvenile delinquency records to evaluate a proposed transfer of a firearm to a person under the age of twenty-one pursuant to federal law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUTOMATED KIOSKS FOR CONSUMER ELECTRONICS.
purpose: To: (1) Establish requirements concerning automated kiosks for consumer electronics operating in this state; (2) provide that any person who operates an automated kiosk for consumer electronics in this state in a manner that does not satisfy such requirements shall be guilty of a class D misdemeanor; (3) specify that automated kiosks for consumer electronics are not junk yards, recycling facilities or recycling centers; and (4) specify that persons operating automated kiosks for consumer electronics are not junk dealers, pawnbrokers or secondhand dealers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR MINOR AND TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO STATUTES CONCERNING CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To make minor and technical revisions to statutes concerning consumer protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH COVERAGE MANDATES FOR CERTAIN HEALTH CONDITIONS.
purpose: To require certain health insurance coverage for individual and group health insurance policies in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL ASSISTANCE FOR SURGERY AND MEDICAL SERVICES RELATED TO TREATMENT OF OBESITY.
purpose: To expand medical assistance for treatment of obesity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPANSION OF THE COVERED CONNECTICUT PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Social Services to (1) amend a federal Medicaid waiver program to expand health care coverage to persons whose earnings do not exceed two hundred per cent of the federal poverty level, and (2) develop a second tier of such program to cover persons whose earnings are between two hundred per cent and three hundred per cent of the federal poverty level.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF THE CONNECTICUT HOME ENERGY LABEL AND THE TREE CANOPY OF CERTAIN MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND ADJUSTING BONDS OF THE STATE, ESTABLISHING PROGRAMS TO FUND PROJECTS IN HIGH POVERTY-LOW OPPORTUNITY CENSUS TRACTS AND PROVIDE EXEMPTIONS FROM THE INCOME TAXES FOR RESIDENTS OF SUCH TRACTS, AND ESTABLISHING A REPORTING REQUIREMENT FOR CERTAIN STATE PROJECTS.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVENUE ITEMS TO IMPLEMENT THE BIENNIAL BUDGET.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE GOVERNOR'S BUDGET RECOMMENDATIONS CONCERNING HIGHER EDUCATION AND REPEALING THE TASK FORCE CONCERNING COLLABORATION AMONG STATE AND MUNICIPAL GOVERNMENTS.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT LIMITING ANTICOMPETITIVE HEALTH CARE PRACTICES.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT ACCELERATING THE STATE HIRING PROCESS.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT INCENTIVIZING HOUSING PRODUCTION.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT PROTECTING MATERNAL HEALTH.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADVANCE RENTAL PAYMENTS.
purpose: To remove the limits on the amounts of advance rental payments a landlord may charge a tenant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF A MOBILE MANUFACTURED HOME PARK BY ITS RESIDENTS.
purpose: To allow residents of a mobile manufactured home park that is being sold to buy such park by matching the sales price for such park.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONPROFIT PROVIDER RETENTION OF CONTRACT SAVINGS, COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKER MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT AND STUDIES OF MEDICAID RATES OF REIMBURSEMENT, NURSING HOME TRANSPORTATION AND NURSING HOME WAITING LISTS.
purpose: To (1) require air conditioning in each room at a nursing home, (2) require notification of the State Ombudsman when a nursing home plans to involuntarily transfer or discharge a patient, (3) establish a grant program for transportation of nonambulatory nursing home residents to homes of family members, (4) make changes in waiting list requirements for nursing homes, (5) require transparent cost reporting by nursing homes, (6) establish minimum nursing home staffing levels, and (7) impose stricter penalties for violations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COST-BASED REIMBURSEMENT FOR FEDERALLY QUALIFIED HEALTH CENTERS.
purpose: To require that Medicaid reimbursement for federally qualified health centers be based on costs incurred by such health centers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR COMMUNITY HEALTH WORKERS.
purpose: To provide Medicaid reimbursement to certified community health workers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DELINQUENT LOTTERY SALES AGENTS, WAIVER OF LICENSE RENEWAL FEES FOR CERTAIN CONNECTICUT LOTTERY CORPORATION EMPLOYEES AND DISCLOSURE OF THE NAME AND ADDRESS OF LOTTERY AND SPORTS WAGERING WINNERS.
purpose: To allow hardship waivers of interest due from delinquent lottery sales agents and require permission to disclose the name and address of lottery winners.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Connecticut Airport Authority.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES, STUDYING AN EMERGENCY CONTACT INFORMATION DATABASE OR REVISIONS TO MOTOR VEHICLE RECORDS AND CONCERNING THE SAFETY DRIVING COURSE, MOTOR VEHICLE DEALERS AND REPAIRERS, MOTOR VEHICLE SAFETY RECALLS, THE KNOWLEDGE TEST FOR AN OPERATOR'S LICENSE, RECIPROCAL RECOGNITION OF DRIVER TRAINING REQUIREMENTS, TRESPASS ON WATERSHED LAND, EMERGENCY LIGHTS, REMOVABLE WINDSHIELD PLACARDS, SCHOOL BUSES, REGISTRATION CERTIFICATES AND MINOR REVISIONS TO MOTOR VEHICLE STATUTES.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Department of Motor Vehicles regarding the application for a commercial driver's license or commercial driver's instruction permit, the elimination of the limited repairer's license, the renewal of a license to conduct a drivers' school, child restraint systems and the improper use of a number plate or operator's license.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REMOVABLE WINDSHIELD PLACARDS FOR PERSONS WHO ARE BLIND AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To (1) require a removable windshield placard to bear the words "Accessibility Parking Permit", (2) require the Commissioner of Motor Vehicles to check the state registration of deaths twice a year, and (3) establish a Removable Windshield Placard Advisory Council.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING DEVELOPMENT IN THE STATE, ESTABLISHING A HOUSING AUTHORITY RESIDENT QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT GRANT PROGRAM AND A HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER TASK FORCE AND REQUIRING THE DISCLOSURE OF CERTAIN NATURAL PERSON OWNERSHIP INTERESTS IN REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To (1) establish a resident quality of life improvement grant program, (2) establish a housing choice voucher task force, and (3) require the disclosure of certain natural person ownership interests in real property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE CLEAN ENERGY STATUTES.
purpose: To (1) facilitate the procurement of projects under the state's renewable energy programs by authorizing joint procurement of such projects and permitting multiple solicitations per year, (2) modify and clarify the rules of these programs and electric utilities' required purchases under the programs, and (3) make conforming changes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX ABATEMENT FOR CERTAIN CONSERVATION EASEMENTS AND ADDRESSING HOUSING AFFORDABILITY FOR RESIDENTS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to exempt from real property taxes any portion of land that (1) qualifies as a greenway, (2) is a terrestrial recreational trail that does not exceed one hundred feet in width, (3) is the subject of a conservation easement conveyed by the owner of the land to a municipality, the state or a nonprofit land conservation organization, and (4) to specify that a greenway trail corridor may be deemed open space land.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE UNIFORM ASSESSMENT RATE FOR PROPERTY TAX.
purpose: To increase the uniform assessment rate for property tax to seventy-five per cent of present true and actual value.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE OF CERTAIN MUNICIPALLY OWNED REAL PROPERTY.
purpose: To require a municipality that intends to sell real property located in whole or in part in another municipality to offer such other municipality the right of first refusal regarding the purchase of such property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN SEWAGE DISPOSAL SYSTEMS.
purpose: To grant regulatory authority over small community sewerage systems to the Department of Public Health.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ZONING ENFORCEMENT OFFICER CERTIFICATION.
purpose: To change the date by which zoning enforcement officers must obtain certification to January 1, 2024.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MUNICIPAL TREE REMOVAL GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a municipal tree removal grant program administered by the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ALTERNATE MEMBERS OF MUNICIPAL PLANNING COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To permit members of municipal zoning commissions and municipal boards of appeals to serve as alternate members of municipal planning commissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE POST-PANDEMIC NEEDS OF CHILDREN.
purpose: To study the post-pandemic needs of children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING URGENT CRISIS CENTERS.
purpose: To clarify the role of the Department of Children and Families in the operation of urgent crisis centers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRANSFER OF CERTAIN GUARDIANSHIP SUBSIDIES UPON THE DEATH OR SERIOUS ILLNESS OF AN ADOPTIVE PARENT OR GUARDIAN.
purpose: To permit the transfer of adoptive parent subsidies to a successor guardian.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LEGAL REPRESENTATION FOR CHILDREN IN CERTAIN PROCEEDINGS IN THE SUPERIOR COURT.
purpose: To specify that legal representation provided to children in certain proceedings in the Superior Court shall continue for the duration of such proceedings.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING IDENTIFIED ADOPTIONS.
purpose: To (1) require the Department of Children and Families to adopt regulations concerning adoptive placement of children by child-placing agencies, (2) specify the types of payments and reimbursements that may be made by prospective adoptive parents to pregnant parents and requirements for making such payments and reimbursements, (3) specify that a genetic parent's legal representative or prospective adoptive parent's legal representative may advertise through public media for the purposes of identified adoption or adoption through a child-placing agency, and (4) make minor revisions to statutes concerning adoption.

title: AN ACT PERMITTING THE DISCLOSURE OF CERTAIN RECORDS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES TO THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH.
purpose: To permit the disclosure of certain records of the Department of Children and Families to the Department of Public Health.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINOR REVISIONS TO A STATUTE OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To make minor revisions to a statute concerning the care of certain newborns at birthing hospitals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR REVISIONS TO STATUTES CONCERNING CHILDREN.
purpose: To (1) exempt certain applicants for foster care licensure and individuals eighteen years of age or older living in such applicants' homes from submitting to criminal history records checks requirements under certain circumstances, and (2) increase the age upon which an individual living in the home of an applicant for foster care licensure must submit to criminal history records checks and child abuse registry checks from sixteen to eighteen.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Housing to conduct a study concerning funding for common interest ownership community reserves.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INSURANCE AND CLIMATE CHANGE.
purpose: To require: (1) The Insurance Commissioner to (A) develop and implement criteria for each insurer doing business in this state to annually submit a report to the commissioner concerning climate risk, and (B) annually submit a report to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to insurance; and (2) each insurer doing business in this state to annually submit a report to the commissioner concerning climate risk.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING LIFE INSURANCE COMPANIES FROM DISCRIMINATING AGAINST FIRST RESPONDERS DIAGNOSED WITH POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER.
purpose: To prohibit life insurance companies from denying life insurance coverage to first responders diagnosed with post-traumatic stress disorder.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRUTH IN ADVERTISING BY HEALTH CARE PROVIDERS.
purpose: To require truth in advertising by health care providers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE ON THE SHORTAGE OF FIREFIGHTERS AND EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES PERSONNEL IN THE STATE.
purpose: To establish a task force to examine and make recommendations to address the shortage of firefighters and emergency medical services personnel in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CASH REFUNDS FOR GIFT CARD BALANCES.
purpose: To (1) increase the minimum balance amount for which consumers using gift cards may request cash refunds, and (2) eliminate the requirement that proof of purchase or a receipt be provided by consumers to receive cash refunds for the balance on certain gift cards.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STUDENT LOAN SERVICERS.
purpose: To clarify that subservicers of federal student loan servicers shall be registered in the state as federal student loan servicers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYER SAVINGS ACCOUNTS AND A RELATED TAX DEDUCTION.
purpose: To establish a first-time homebuyer savings account and a related tax deduction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE BANKING STATUTES.
purpose: To make a technical revision to the banking statutes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING POLICE OFFICERS TO INFORM DRIVERS OF THE PURPOSE OF A TRAFFIC STOP.
purpose: To require police officers to inform drivers of the reason for a traffic stop and encourage additional police officer training on de-escalation, use of force, customer service, diversity and bias.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROBATE COURT OPERATIONS.
purpose: To: (1) Update language specifying the provision of suitable court facilities, (2) establish a new time period by which the Council on Probate Judicial Conduct must publish its findings following the close of a public hearing, (3) make conforming changes to the Connecticut Parentage Act, (4) modify the service of process time period on a petition for parentage claim, (5) clarify Probate Court authority to order or deny genetic testing when parentage is at issue, and (6) require that a conservator of the person execute a written document in advance of the conserved person's death that directs disposition of such person's body upon death.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A DEMENTIA SERVICES COORDINATOR.
purpose: To establish within the Department of Aging and Disability Services a dementia services coordinator.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE HOMEMAKER-COMPANION AGENCY TASK FORCE.
purpose: To require (1) the Secretary of the Office of Policy and Management to develop a plan to transition registration and oversight responsibilities for homemaker-companion agencies from the Department of Consumer Protection to the Department of Public Health, (2) the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to revoke a certificate of registration if an agency violates certain provisions three times in one calendar year, (3) the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to (A) develop training standards, identify training programs and develop a model written contract and service plan for homemaker-companion agencies, and (B) develop a guide that details how to file a complaint against a homemaker-companion agency, (4) the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to develop a plan to implement mandatory training standards for agency employees, and (5) homemaker-companion agencies to (A) develop a person-centered plan of care and services for clients, and (B) have consumer brochures and maintain an Internet web site.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NURSING HOME STAFFING RATIOS.
purpose: To (1) establish minimum nursing home staffing levels, and (2) impose stricter penalties for violations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING THE JOBSCT TAX REBATE PROGRAM AND CERTAIN AEROSPACE MANUFACTURING PROJECTS.
purpose: To (1) replace provisions requiring a contract under the JobsCT tax rebate program with provisions requiring a rebate allocation notice, and (2) extend the time period an eligible taxpayer may utilize certain aerospace manufacturing project tax benefits earned under certain assistance agreements.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Department of Education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE EDUCATION AND EARLY CHILDHOOD STATUTES.
purpose: To make technical revisions to the education and early childhood statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LENDING ISSUES.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study lending issues.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BANKING ISSUES.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study banking issues.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN FINANCING DISCLOSURES.
purpose: To (1) require certain providers of commercial financing to make various commercial financing disclosures, (2) authorize the Banking Commissioner to adopt regulations concerning such disclosures, and (3) establish civil penalties for violations of such commercial financing disclosure requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE BANKING STATUTES.
purpose: To (1) redefine "APR" and "small loan", (2) define "finance charge", (3) require additional persons to obtain small loan licenses, (4) provide that certain small loan requirements apply to loans that are between five thousand and fifty thousand dollars, (5) provide that certain small loans shall not provide for an advance exceeding unpaid principal of fifty thousand dollars, (6) redefine "goods" and "sales finance company", (7) establish that guaranteed asset protection waivers are cancellable, (8) provide that certain qualified public depository reports shall be certified under oath unless such reports are filed electronically, (9) provide that certain persons shall not engage the services of certain lead generators, and (10) eliminate a requirement that certain persons demonstrate an ability to supervise mortgage servicing offices in person.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REQUIREMENTS FOR DEPOSIT ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To: (1) Establish certain exceptions to the requirement that financial institutions provide notice upon closing deposit accounts; and (2) provide that banking institutions shall not be required to offer basic banking accounts at out-of-state offices.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STOP WORK ORDERS.
purpose: To (1) expand the applicability of the issuance of a stop work order to include violations of the prevailing wage, and (2) increase fines for violations of stop work orders.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GREATER HARTFORD REGIONAL LAW ENFORCEMENT TASK FORCE TO COMBAT ILLEGAL ROADWAY TRAFFIC ACTIVITY.
purpose: To establish a Greater Hartford Regional Law Enforcement Task Force to Combat Illegal Roadway Traffic Activity.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SELF-SERVICE STORAGE INSURANCE.
purpose: To regulate the sale of self-service storage insurance in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAPTIVE INSURANCE COMPANIES.
purpose: To: (1) Allow protected cells of captive insurance companies to establish and maintain separate accounts, and transfer risk to such accounts; and (2) exempt dormant captive insurance companies from paying minimum premium tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE INSURANCE DEPARTMENT'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING FINANCIAL REGULATION, LIFE INSURANCE AND INSURANCE LICENSING REQUIREMENTS AND TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS AND REVISIONS TO THE LIFE AND HEALTH INSURANCE STATUTES.
purpose: To: (1) Update the financial regulation fee structure for certified reinsurers and reciprocal jurisdiction applications and to allow for the payment of fees electronically; (2) update the insurance licensing requirements; and (3) make technical corrections to the life and health insurance statutes and to conform infertility statutes with federal law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REMOTE NOTARIAL ACTS.
purpose: To permit a notary public to remotely notarize certain documents under certain specified circumstances.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE JURISDICTIONAL MONETARY LIMIT IN SMALL CLAIMS MATTERS.
purpose: To increase the jurisdictional monetary limit in small claims matters.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE DEPARTMENT OF ECONOMIC AND COMMUNITY DEVELOPMENT TO PROVIDE CAPACITY BUILDING GRANTS TO CONNECTICUT BROWNFIELD LAND BANKS.
purpose: To authorize the Department of Economic and Community Development to provide capacity building grants to Connecticut brownfield land banks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ROBERTA B. WILLIS SCHOLARSHIP PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Office of Higher Education to submit a report regarding the Roberta B. Willis Scholarship program and to incorporate the new federal student aid index on and after July 1, 2024.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDENT LOAN SUBSIDY PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Connecticut Higher Education Supplemental Loan Authority to establish a Student Loan Subsidy Program to reduce the interest rate on authority loans to individuals employed in certain high-demand professions.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE REQUIREMENT TO STORE THE PERSONAL PROPERTY OF EVICTED TENANTS.
purpose: To eliminate the requirement that landlords or municipalities store the personal property of evicted tenants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REDUCTION OF FOOD WASTE IN SCHOOLS.
purpose: To reduce the amount of food waste in schools by including school districts among the entities responsible for the composting of source-separated organic material and permitting schools to establish composting stations in cafeterias.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE COMMISSIONER OF EARLY CHILDHOOD TO ENTER INTO CERTAIN CONTRACTS.
purpose: To authorize the Commissioner of Early Childhood to allocate funds to regional educational service centers for the purpose of providing certain services to providers of early childhood care and education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FINDINGS OF NEGLECT AND RISK OF INJURY TO A CHILD.
purpose: To establish an affirmative defense to a misdemeanor concerning the supervision of children under twelve years of age.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENT STANDARDS AND APPLICATIONS FOR THE FEDERAL HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER PROGRAM.
purpose: To require (1) municipal housing authorities to post the value of housing choice vouchers and rules concerning such vouchers on their Internet web site, and (2) the Department of Housing to adopt regulations to establish a state-wide wait list for housing choice vouchers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING TASK FORCES TO STUDY THE EFFECTS OF EVICTIONS ON LANDLORDS AND RENT STABILIZATION POLICIES.
purpose: To establish (1) a task force to study the effects of evictions on landlords, and (2) a task force to study rent stabilization policies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILDREN'S SERVICES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families to conduct a study to determine whether policy and procedural changes in the Department of Children and Families may increase the effectiveness of services provided to children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AREA AGENCIES ON AGING.
purpose: To ensure that each area agency on aging has not less than two staff members dedicated to helping persons served by the agencies to navigate and obtain available services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY AND MAKE RECOMMENDATIONS CONCERNING THE ELDERLY NUTRITION PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a task force to study and make recommendations concerning the elderly nutrition program administered by the Department of Aging and Disability Services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE YOUTH ADVISORY COUNCIL ON SUMMER CAMPS WITHIN THE OFFICE OF EARLY CHILDHOOD.
purpose: To add two additional members who represent private youth camps to the Youth Camp Safety Advisory Council within the Office of Early Childhood.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILDREN'S PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families to conduct a study to evaluate the efficacy of the programs administered by the Department of Children and Families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILDREN'S SAFETY.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families to conduct a study to determine whether policy and procedural changes within the Department of Children and Families may increase the safety of children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE AND EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To (1) establish early voting beginning in 2023 for certain elections and beginning in 2024 for certain primaries, (2) establish the number of days and hours of, and implement procedures for the conduct of, such early voting, (3) provide for same-day election and same-day primary registrations during periods of early voting, (4) make conforming changes to deadlines for the performance of certain duties prior to an election or primary, and (5) require the Secretary of the State to undertake efforts to educate the public about early voting and train registrars of voters regarding the administration of early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHARITABLE ORGANIZATIONS, TELECOMMUNICATIONS AND THE ATTORNEY GENERAL'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To: (1) Implement the Attorney General's recommendations concerning (A) price gouging, (B) disclosure of certain records during the pendency of an investigation, (C) erasure, in lieu of return, of certain electronic materials upon completion of an investigation, (D) disclosure of precise geolocation data, (E) the privacy protection guaranty and enforcement account, (F) identity theft, (G) personal data privacy, (H) ticketing for entertainment events, (I) telemarketing, and (J) charitable solicitation campaigns; and (2) enable certain charitable organizations to include with their annual financial statements a review report in lieu of an audit report.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE OPERATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To (1) require certain persons doing business in this state to provide bills to certain consumers in paper form, (2) provide that certain persons doing business in this state shall not impose any charge or fee for providing bills to consumers in paper form, and (3) establish a task force to study the operations of the Department of Consumer Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE APPOINTMENT OF AN ADVOCATE IN PROCEEDINGS CONCERNING THE WELFARE OR CUSTODY OF ANIMALS.
purpose: To allow the court to appoint an advocate in proceedings concerning the welfare or custody of animals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY OWNER'S LIABILITY FOR THE EXPENSES OF REMOVING A FALLEN TREE OR TREE LIMB.
purpose: To impose liability on certain owners of real property for the expenses of removing a tree or tree limb that falls on an adjoining owner's private real property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROVISION OF EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES TO AN INDIVIDUAL WHO IS IN DIRECT CONTACT WITH OR IN THE CUSTODY OR CONTROL OF A PEACE OFFICER.
purpose: To require the provision of emergency medical services to an individual who experiences an emergency medical condition or is medically unstable while in direct contact with, or in the custody or control of, a peace officer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UTILITY COMMISSIONERS OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY.
purpose: To limit the number of Public Utilities Regulatory Authority commissioners to three and to establish a term limit of two four-year terms for such commissioners.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To (1) establish early voting beginning in 2023 for certain elections and beginning in 2024 for certain primaries, special elections and referenda, (2) establish the number of days and hours of, and implement procedures for the conduct of, such early voting, (3) provide for same-day election and same-day primary registrations during periods of early voting, (4) make conforming changes to deadlines for the performance of certain duties prior to an election or primary, and (5) require the Secretary of the State to undertake efforts to educate the public about early voting and train registrars of voters regarding the administration of early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES' RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING VARIOUS TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES STATUTES.
purpose: To make various technical revisions to developmental services statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING FOOD INSPECTORS.
purpose: To increase the number of certified food inspectors in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADEQUATE AND SAFE HEALTH CARE STAFFING.
purpose: To ensure adequate and safe health care staffing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING A HUMAN IMMUNODEFICIENCY VIRUS PRE-EXPOSURE PROPHYLAXIS AND POST-EXPOSURE PROPHYLAXIS DRUG ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide financial assistance to uninsured and underinsured individuals in need of pre-exposure or post-exposure prophylaxis who are unable to pay for medications that prevent HIV.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO CERTAIN DOMESTIC ANIMAL RELATED STATUTES.
purpose: To redefine "animal", regulate breeding kennels, provide certain procedures concerning the control of rabies and make other minor changes to domestic animal related statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROSECUTORIAL ACCOUNTABILITY.
purpose: To shorten the term of state's attorneys from eight to five years and require each state's attorney appear annually before the Criminal Justice Commission for testimony concerning certain case level data pertaining to defendants who are eighteen years of age or older at the time of the commission of an alleged offense.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DECEPTIVE OR COERCIVE INTERROGATION TACTICS.
purpose: To limit the use as evidence of any admission, confession or statement made by a person during a custodial interrogation by a law enforcement agency official, if the law enforcement agency official engaged in deception or coercive tactics during such interrogation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP ACT.
purpose: To make revisions to the Common Interest Ownership Act with respect to (1) access to records containing personally identifiable information, (2) the fee for a resale certificate, (3) a permitted variance in insurance requirements for a building in a common interest community if all of the units within the building are restricted to nonresidential use, and (4) voting processes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE ADMINISTRATION OF EPINEPHRINE BY FIRST RESPONDERS.
purpose: To require first responders to carry and administer epinephrine.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING LONG-TERM CARE FACILITY RESIDENTS TO UNDERGO A CRIMINAL HISTORY AND SEXUAL OFFENDER REGISTRY SEARCH.
purpose: To require long-term care facility residents to undergo a criminal history and sexual offender registry search.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOSPICE AND PALLIATIVE CARE.
purpose: To provide dignity to hospice care patients by allowing them to pass away comfortably in their home.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AID IN DYING FOR TERMINALLY ILL PATIENTS.
purpose: To provide aid in dying to terminally ill patients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ACCEPTANCE BY PHYSICIANS OF PATIENTS WHO ARE MEDICAID RECIPIENTS.
purpose: To increase the number of physicians who treat patients who are Medicaid recipients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RAIL SERVICE.
purpose: To require the Department of Transportation to restore service on the Shore Line East rail line, purchase new rail cars for the Waterbury and Danbury branches of the New Haven rail line, expand service on such branches, study the future of railroads in the state and select and contract with an operator for rail service on the Shore Line East rail line.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE CONNECTICUT COMMUTER RAIL COUNCIL.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Connecticut Commuter Rail Council regarding Shore Line East rail service, rail cars for the Waterbury and Danbury branches of the New Haven line, a public transportation mobile application, fare-free bus public transportation services, administrative support for the council and the community connectivity grant program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPORTATION SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH INTELLECTUAL AND DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.
purpose: To increase transportation services for persons with intellectual or developmental disabilities who receive services from the Department of Developmental Services by providing fare-free bus public transportation services and reduced fares for intrastate rail services, requiring a request for proposals for nonmedical transportation services for such persons, expanding access to travel training programs and issuing removable windshield placards to the caregivers of such persons.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF A GLOBAL POSITIONING SYSTEM ON A SCHOOL BUS AND THE SHORTAGE OF SCHOOL BUS DRIVERS.
purpose: To (1) permit the use of a mobile electronic device for navigation purposes on a school bus by a school bus driver, (2) waive the engine compartment portion of the commercial driver license's test for applicants seeking or renewing a public passenger endorsement to operate a school bus, (3) study policies and initiatives to address the nationwide school bus driver shortage, and (4) permit the advertising of employment opportunities for school bus drivers on school buses.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION REGARDING A REDUCTION IN BLOOD ALCOHOL LIMITS FOR IMPAIRED DRIVING AND BOATING.
purpose: To implement recommendations of the Department of Transportation concerning (1) lowering the blood alcohol content for driving and boating under the influence from eight-hundredths to five-hundredths of one per cent of alcohol, by weight, (2) establishing the Connecticut Public Transportation Council, (3) requiring the results of the study regarding the Shore Line East rail line be submitted on or before December 1, 2023, and (4) motor vehicles in livery service.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TRANSPORTATION CARBON BUDGET FOR THE STATE.
purpose: To establish a transportation carbon budget for the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LOW-INCOME HOUSING TAX CREDIT PROGRAM ADMINISTERED BY THE CONNECTICUT HOUSING FINANCE AUTHORITY.
purpose: To: (1) Require the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority to establish (A) a time to own down payment assistance loan program, (B) a down payment assistance rehabilitation loan pilot program, and (C) a small multifamily lending program; and (2) establish various requirements concerning the Low-Income Housing Tax Credit program administered by the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR CONNECTICUT BANKS AND CREDIT UNIONS OPENING BRANCHES IN DISTRESSED MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To authorize a property tax abatement for Connecticut banks and Connecticut credit unions opening branches in distressed municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COERCED DEBT.
purpose: To require: (1) Consumer collection agencies to cease collecting coerced debts from certain individuals; and (2) credit rating agencies to (A) reinvestigate debt identified as coerced debt, and (B) remove references to coerced debt from certain credit reports.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIMITS ON LOANS TO ONE OBLIGOR AND CONNECTICUT BANK INVESTMENTS.
purpose: To provide that Connecticut banks shall base certain calculations on capital and surplus instead of equity capital and reserves for loan and lease losses, and authorize Connecticut banks to elect to make such calculations based on equity capital and adjusted allowances for credit losses in certain circumstances.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FINANCIAL EXPLOITATION OF SENIOR CITIZENS.
purpose: To establish procedures to protect the elderly from financial exploitation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A WORKFORCE TRAINING AND EXPERIENTIAL LEARNING PROGRAM.
purpose: To require the Office of Workforce Strategy to develop an apprenticeship program to ensure access to training for certain careers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EMPLOYMENT OF CERTAIN MINORS AS YOUTH CAMP STAFF MEMBERS AND LIFEGUARDS.
purpose: To provide that persons between fifteen and eighteen years of age may be employed by certain employers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN BUSINESS REPORTING REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To eliminate certain business reporting requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ACQUISITION AND CONVEYANCE OF CERTAIN PROPERTIES BY CONNECTICUT BROWNFIELD LAND BANKS.
purpose: To: (1) Authorize Connecticut brownfield land banks to acquire and convey certain properties to enhance the aquatic life and environmental quality of rivers; and (2) authorize Connecticut brownfield land banks to enter into land banking agreements with regional councils of governments.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE JUVENILE JUSTICE POLICY AND OVERSIGHT COMMITTEE CONCERNING EDUCATION.
purpose: To (1) require school districts with high suspension and expulsion rates to submit a response and improvement plan to the Department of Education, (2) implement a phased-in classroom size cap, (3) recommend suicide assessments for at-risk students, (4) require reports concerning alternative educational opportunities by certain school districts, and (5) develop guidance to reduce the suspension or expulsion of children in grades preschool to two, inclusive.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE IMPLEMENTATION OF READING MODELS OR PROGRAMS.
purpose: To delay implementation of the requirements regarding reading models or programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICERS.
purpose: To require specificity concerning the use and duties of school resource officers in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CHARTER SCHOOL APPROVAL PROCESS.
purpose: To eliminate the process of the State Board of Education issuing an initial certificate of approval for a new charter school and to establish a charter school approval grant account for the purpose of funding new charter schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL NURSES.
purpose: To require the State Board of Education to adopt regulations to increase the qualifications and professional development requirements for school nurses and to create a special services endorsement for school nurses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC EDUCATION IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to conduct a study of public education in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CREATING A CONNECTICUT NUCLEAR ENERGY ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To establish a permanent council to promote the expansion of nuclear energy and organize state resources related to nuclear energy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE ENERGY STATUTES.
purpose: To make technical corrections to statutory provisions concerning energy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE NUCLEAR MORATORIUM STATUTE.
purpose: To clarify the statutory provisions related to the development of new nuclear power facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHARMACIES AND PHARMACISTS.
purpose: To: (1) Authorize (A) pharmacists to administer additional vaccines, tests and drugs, and (B) pharmacies to operate mobile pharmacies; and (2) provide that an institutional pharmacy located in a licensed health care facility may compound sterile pharmaceuticals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE, AUTOMATED DECISION-MAKING AND PERSONAL DATA PRIVACY.
purpose: To: (1) Establish an Office of Artificial Intelligence; (2) exempt air carriers from certain provisions concerning data privacy; (3) provide that a controller shall not process the personal data of a consumer for purposes of targeted advertising, or sell the consumer's personal data without the consumer's consent, under circumstances where a controller has actual knowledge, or wilfully disregards, that the consumer is at least thirteen years of age but younger than sixteen years of age; and (4) establish a task force to (A) study artificial intelligence, and (B) develop an artificial intelligence bill of rights.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE CONNECTICUT HEALTH AND EDUCATIONAL FACILITIES AUTHORITY.
purpose: To expand the types of projects for which the Connecticut Health and Educational Facilities Authority can issue bonds to include programs and services and to remove references to obsolete programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PERCENTAGE OF COURSES TAUGHT BY PART-TIME FACULTY AT THE REGIONAL COMMUNITY-TECHNICAL COLLEGES.
purpose: To require a phased-in reduction of the percentage of courses taught by part-time faculty at the regional community-technical colleges.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FOUNDATIONS OF THE REGIONAL COMMUNITY-TECHNICAL COLLEGES.
purpose: To allow the establishment of a foundation for a campus of the Connecticut State Community College.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONTRACTS, BIDS AND CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To (1) allow constituent units of the state system of higher education to enter into cooperative contracts with other such constituent units and federal agencies, (2) adjust the minimum amount at which competitive bids are solicited on the Internet from fifty thousand dollars to one hundred thousand dollars, (3) adjust the maximum amount that qualifies as a minor purchase from ten thousand dollars to twenty-five thousand dollars, (4) amend the requirements for a maximum price guarantee for renovations of an existing building, and (5) allow The University of Connecticut to prequalify contractors for a period of one year, with two-year renewal periods, for contracts costing more than one million dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ACCESS TO REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH CARE BY STUDENTS AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To require public institutions of higher education that have residential campuses to establish a plan for access to reproductive health care services by students.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT TO COMMUNITY LIVING ARRANGEMENTS, INTERMEDIATE CARE FACILITIES FOR INDIVIDUALS WITH INTELLECTUAL DISABILITIES, RESIDENTIAL CARE HOMES AND NURSING FACILITIES.
purpose: To adjust Medicaid reimbursement for Community Living Arrangements, Intermediate Care Facilities for Individuals with Intellectual Disabilities, residential care homes and nursing facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REQUIREMENTS FOR THIRD-PARTY MEDICAID PAYMENT REIMBURSEMENTS, VENDOR PAYMENT STANDARDS IN THE LOW-INCOME HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE PROGRAM AND MEDICAID PAYMENTS FOR MATERNITY SERVICES.
purpose: To (1) delete obsolete reporting requirements, (2) clarify liability of third-party private insurers and other obligors for the costs of certain medical assistance, (3) reduce from thirty to ten days the amount of time a fuel vendor participating in the Low-Income Home Energy Assistance Program shall be paid, and (4) establish bundled Medicaid payments for maternity services.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A WORKING GROUP TO STUDY EXCESS LICENSED BED CAPACITY AT SKILLED NURSING FACILITIES.
purpose: To reduce rates of reimbursement for empty beds in nursing homes below a minimum occupancy threshold and establish a new payment system for management and other costs not directly related to patient care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE.
purpose: To: (1) Establish a study regarding an alternative pool for long-term care policyholders; (2) require a public hearing concerning premium rate increases in excess of ten per cent; (3) require notice to individuals of the risk of premium increases prior to the purchase of any long-term care policy; and (4) implement a tax credit for individuals purchasing long-term care policies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FAIR RENT COMMISSIONS.
purpose: To require towns, cities or boroughs with a population of at least five thousand to create fair rent commissions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY TO PROHIBIT PRIVATE EQUITY OWNERSHIP IN HOSPICE CARE.
purpose: To require the Insurance Commissioner to study banning private equity ownership in hospice care.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SURCHARGE ON INSURANCE COMPANIES IN THIS STATE THAT UNDERWRITE FOSSIL FUEL COMPANIES.
purpose: To establish a surcharge on insurance companies in this state that underwrite fossil fuel companies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE-OPERATED REINSURANCE PROGRAM AND HEALTH CARE COST GROWTH.
purpose: To: (1) Implement a reinsurance program; (2) include hospitals in the health care cost growth and primary care spending target benchmark program administered by the Office of Health Strategy; and (3) require certain health insurers, preferred provider networks and other entities to include certain provisions in contracts with health care providers regarding reimbursement for certain covered health benefits.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING ADDITIONAL MEASURES TO PREVENT TRAFFICKING IN PERSONS AND EXPANDING THE COMPOSITION OF THE TRAFFICKING IN PERSONS COUNCIL.
purpose: To (1) include victims of sexual assault and trafficking as protected persons under the state's employment discrimination provisions, (2) revise the definition of stalking as relates to an application for a civil protection order, (3) prohibit a hotel, motel and similar lodging from offering an hourly rate for any sleeping accommodation and require such entities to establish a person's identity by means of a photo identification prior to providing such person any sleeping accommodation, and (4) expand the membership of the Trafficking in Persons Council.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE CONSOLIDATION OF THE FAMILY VIOLENCE MODEL POLICY GOVERNING COUNCIL AND THE DOMESTIC VIOLENCE OFFENDER PROGRAM STANDARDS ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To establish the Domestic Violence Criminal Justice Response and Enhancement Advisory Council.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BUSINESS REGISTRATIONS WITH THE OFFICE OF THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To: (1) Revise various provisions involving the registration of business entities in the state, (2) rename the Commercial Recording Division within the office of the Secretary of the State as the Business Services Division, and (3) create a listing of commercial registered agents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' RIGHTS.
purpose: To require the Labor Commissioner to study workers' rights in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CARE 4 KIDS PROVIDER RIGHTS.
purpose: To ensure providers in the Care 4 Kids program retain the same rights should the name of the program change.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION.
purpose: To require the Workers' Compensation Commission to study the workers' compensation system in the state.

title: AN ACT AMENDING CODIFICATION OF PREVAILING WAGE CONTRACT RATES.
purpose: To include residential construction in the existing prevailing wage contract rates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF PATHWAYS TO STATE EMPLOYMENT.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Administrative Services to conduct a study regarding the hiring practices for state service.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING APPRENTICESHIP REPORTING DATA.
purpose: To require sponsors of apprenticeship programs registered with the Labor Department to submit information pertaining to their programs to the Labor Department.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AUTHORITY OF PROFESSIONAL BONDSMEN, SURETY BAIL BOND AGENTS AND BAIL ENFORCEMENT AGENTS TO ENTER A RESIDENCE.
purpose: To require that a professional bondsman, surety bail bond agent or bail enforcement agent enter a residence to attempt to take a principal into custody in the same manner as a police officer may do so pursuant to a rearrest warrant.

title: AN ACT EXTENDING THE DEADLINES APPLICABLE TO THE TASK FORCE TO EXAMINE THE MOTOR VEHICLE ACCIDENT REPORT FORM USED BY LAW ENFORCEMENT OFFICERS.
purpose: To extend the deadlines for the appointment of members to, first meeting of and report of, the task force to examine the motor vehicle accident report form used by law enforcement officers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To (1) increase the dollar amounts of certain state-mandated property tax exemptions that are available to certain veterans or relatives of such veterans, (2) increase the dollar amounts of certain municipal option property tax exemptions that are available to certain veterans or relatives of such veterans, and (3) fully exempt from taxation the property of veterans with a one hundred per cent disability rating from the United States Department of Veteran Affairs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ASSISTANCE FOR PUBLICATION OF VETERANS' OBITUARIES.
purpose: To establish an account for the purposes of providing assistance to surviving family members of deceased veterans for costs associated with the publication of obituaries for such deceased veterans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A MILITARY OCCUPATIONAL SPECIALTY WORKING GROUP AND A GRANT PROGRAM FOR THE REIMBURSEMENT OF CERTAIN LICENSING, CERTIFICATION, REGISTRATION OR TUITION FEES.
purpose: To (1) establish a working group to revisit the work of the military occupational specialty task force established under special act 13-5 and the legislative changes enacted in public act 14-131, and (2) establish, and appropriate funds for, a grant program for the reimbursement of certain licensing, certification, registration and tuition fees.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VETERANS' SPECIALTY LICENSE PLATES AND DRIVER'S LICENSES FOR CERTAIN FORMER ARMED FORCES RESERVISTS.
purpose: To grant eligibility for veterans' specialty license plates and driver's licenses from the Department of Motor Vehicles to former members of the National Guard who do not qualify for federal veterans' benefits.

title: AN ACT EXCLUDING VETERANS' DISABILITY PAYMENTS FROM INCOME FOR PURPOSES OF ELIGIBILITY FOR CERTAIN STATE BENEFITS.
purpose: To exclude veterans' disability payments from calculations of income when determining eligibility to receive certain state benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CIRCUMSTANCES PRESENTING A SUBSTANTIAL RISK TO A CHILD'S HEALTH OR SAFETY.
purpose: To limit the finding of neglect or risk of injury to a child if the allegation of neglect is based on a child's participation in certain independent activities and the child is considered by the parent, guardian or caregiver of the child to be of sufficient maturity, physical condition and mental ability to avoid engaging in conduct that carries a substantial risk of physical harm.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECRUITMENT OF LAW SCHOOL STUDENTS FOR APPRENTICE PROSECUTOR POSITIONS.
purpose: To allow the Division of Criminal Justice to appoint third-year, second semester law school students as apprentice prosecutors who shall advance to the position of deputy assistant state's attorney upon gaining admission to the Connecticut bar within one year of the date of such student's graduation from law school.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE WAIVER OF CERTAIN PERFORMANCE BOND REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to waive the inclusion of a contract provision requiring the issuance of a performance bond for certain projects for which the estimated cost of labor and materials is less than five million dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FAILURE TO FILE CERTAIN GRAND LIST EXEMPTIONS.
purpose: To allow certain persons to file for property tax exemptions, notwithstanding certain statutory deadlines.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SHORT-TERM RENTAL FACILITATORS AND PROPERTIES.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to (1) levy a tax on short-term rental facilitators in an amount not to exceed two per cent of such operator's income from short-term rental properties during a tax year, and (2) engage consultants to assist in developing ordinances and regulations concerning the operation and use of short-term rental properties and requirements for licensure of short-term rental operators.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LOCAL GOVERNMENT.
purpose: To clarify certain responsibilities of the civil service board.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE METROPOLITAN DISTRICT OF HARTFORD COUNTY.
purpose: To clarify certain publication requirements of actions or decisions of a planning commission.

title: AN ACT VALIDATING THE APPOINTMENT OF CERTAIN INDIVIDUALS TO THE OFFICE OF JUSTICE OF THE PEACE.
purpose: To specify that a newly created office of justice of the peace may be filled by appointment prior to the next regular election.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSIT-ORIENTED DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To allow for the as of right development of housing with a minimum overall gross density of fifteen dwelling units per acre located within a one-half-mile radius of any passenger rail or commuter rail station or any bus rapid transit station.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN DELINQUENT PROPERTY TAX PAYMENTS.
purpose: To (1) reduce the interest rate on delinquent property tax payments from eighteen per cent to twelve per cent, (2) require tax collectors to waive interest on such delinquent payments if such delinquency is attributable to error and not any action or failure of the taxpayer, and (3) make technical changes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To require approval of revisions to the state's solid waste management plan and the Comprehensive Material's Management Strategy by the legislature's Environment Committee, prescribe certain signs concerning reverse vending machine outages and require the issuance of an RFI relating to the management of the state's solid waste stream.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE'S PROPERTY ACQUISITION AND CONDEMNATION AUTHORITY FOR CERTAIN FLOOD PREVENTION, CLIMATE RESILIENCE AND EROSION CONTROL SYSTEMS.
purpose: To establish authority for the state to take real property, by eminent domain and condemnation, for the construction of flood prevention, climate resilience or erosion control systems and grant authority for the Commissioner of Energy and Environmental Protection to establish and appoint interim flood prevention, climate resilience and erosion control boards for certain municipalities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF SECTOR SPECIFIC SUBTARGETS FOR GREENHOUSE GAS EMISSIONS REDUCTIONS.
purpose: To enforce the state's greenhouse gas emissions goals through the establishment of certain sector subtargets and authorize emission standards for certain small off-road engines.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO VARIOUS PROGRAMS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To revise training standard requirements for conservation officers, change notice publication requirements for certain fishing regulations, authorize the transfer of certain commercial fishing licenses, alter the location for the publication of notice for numerous permit applications submitted to the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection, authorize state open space grants for certain lands that are the subject of other federally funded, municipally funded or privately funded conservation easements or restrictions and repeal the Cricket Valley Energy Center air monitoring equipment technical assistance and support obligation of the department.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENVIRONMENTAL JUSTICE PROGRAM OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To enhance the environmental and public health considerations made under the state's environmental justice statute and provide the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection and the Connecticut Siting Council with the ability to deny certain permits for a new affecting facility and apply conditions to the expansion of an existing facility.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING CERTAIN KILLING OF BLACK BEAR AND PROHIBITING INTENTIONAL FEEDING OF POTENTIALLY DANGEROUS ANIMALS.
purpose: To establish permits for the taking of bear that damage crops, livestock or bees, authorize the killing of bears that cause harm to a person or pet or that enter an occupied building, provide for an annual bear hunt season in Litchfield County by lottery and prohibit the intentional and unintentional feeding of potentially dangerous animals.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING ALL RESTRICTIONS FOR SUNDAY HUNTING ON PUBLIC AND PRIVATE PROPERTY.
purpose: To authorize all Sunday hunting regardless of game and method on both public and private property.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE RISK-LIMITING AUDITS WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the risk-limiting audits working group.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE STATE CODES OF ETHICS.
purpose: To redefine "quasi-public agency" and "public official" for purposes of the codes of ethics and to require registrants to provide the name, title and contact information for individuals who are authorized filers on its registration statement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONTRACTING WITH QUASI-PUBLIC AGENCIES UNDER THE STATE CODE OF ETHICS.
purpose: To expand the prohibition against certain individuals contracting with state agencies under the state code of ethics unless awarded through an open and public process to include contracts with quasi-public agencies.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EXEMPTION FROM DISCLOSURE FOR CERTAIN HIGHER EDUCATION RECORDS PERTAINING TO STUDY, TEACHING OR RESEARCH UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To amend the Freedom of Information Act to exempt certain proprietary records held by a public institution of higher education pertaining to research or teaching from disclosure.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE AUDITORS OF PUBLIC ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Auditors of Public Accounts contained in their 2022 annual report, including to exempt the disclosure of whistleblower complaints received by the auditors, authorize the Department of Motor Vehicles to conduct periodic background checks of school bus and student transportation vehicle drivers, require the local legislative body or regional board of education to hold a public meeting before submitting a corrective action plan regarding certain audits and replace references to "comprehensive annual financial reports" with "annual comprehensive financial reports".

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION COMMISSION.
purpose: To make revisions to the Freedom of Information Act recommended by the Freedom of Information Commission, including concerning the application of the definition of "governmental function", which statutory provisions require training by the commission, the education records exemption, the definition of "hand-held scanner", electronic notice of special meetings and appeals for denial of access to certain public records.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CIRCULATORS OF NOMINATING AND PRIMARY PETITIONS.
purpose: To bring into compliance with federal case law certain state statutes relating to the circulation of nominating and primary petitions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYEES OF PUBLIC AGENCIES.
purpose: To expand the list of public agency employees whose residential addresses are exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act and require employee notification of mass requests prior to disclosure under said act.
