title: AN ACT DESIGNATING VARIOUS DAYS, WEEKS AND MONTHS.
purpose: To designate various days, weeks and months and make technical revisions to existing designations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PHARMACY BENEFITS MANAGERS AND DRUG AFFORDABILITY AND TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To: (1) Require the Insurance Department to conduct a study concerning pharmacy benefits managers; (2) require the Insurance Department to conduct a study concerning purchasing pools for prescription drugs and health care supplies; and (3) establish a prescription drug affordability board to monitor prescription drug pricing in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERINATAL MOOD AND ANXIETY DISORDERS.
purpose: To increase awareness of and education on perinatal mood and anxiety disorders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE SCHOOL-BASED HEALTH CENTER EXPANSION WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To provide grants to certain school-based health centers for expanded school-based health center medical and mental health services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING COMMUNITY ROUNDTABLES.
purpose: To require law enforcement units to hold community roundtables and establish a pilot program to fund community policing programs in certain municipalities, to reduce gun violence and improve relationships between law enforcement units and the communities they serve.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE USE OF OPIOID SETTLEMENT FUNDS TO PROVIDE MUNICIPAL POLICE OFFICERS WITH OPIOID ANTAGONISTS.
purpose: To authorize the use of opioid settlement funds to provide municipal police officers with opioid antagonists.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF THE REGULATIONS RELATING TO EDUCATION.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to submit a review of its regulations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FINANCIAL LITERACY INSTRUCTION.
purpose: To require financial literacy instruction in high school.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING IMPLEMENTATION OF THE CONNECTICUT SCHOOL CLIMATE POLICY.
purpose: To implement the Connecticut school climate policy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE STRUCTURE OF ENERGY POLICY AND REGULATION IN THE STATE AND THE SEPARATE FUNCTIONS OF THE PUBLIC UTILITIES REGULATORY AUTHORITY AND DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To (1) study whether the legal changes in 2011 that led to the creation of the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection accomplished their intended objectives, and (2) study the structure of energy policy-making and utility regulation in other states.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ENERGY SOURCES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the chairperson of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to conduct a study regarding energy sources in the state.

title: AN ACT MAKING REVISIONS TO CERTAIN STATUTES CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES.
purpose: To revise statutes concerning the Department of Administrative Services and clarify its authority to provide state-wide information technology services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PROCUREMENT OF ZERO-CARBON RESOURCES FROM ELIGIBLE NUCLEAR POWER GENERATING FACILITIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to study the potential need for procurement of zero-carbon electricity generated by nuclear power plants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PETROLEUM STORAGE LEVELS.
purpose: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to study whether the state should adopt hedging strategies to mitigate against the risk of a petroleum shortage in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ENERGY GENERATED FROM SOLID WASTE MANAGEMENT.
purpose: To require the state's solid waste management plan to implement the findings of the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority's report on trash-to-energy.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF SOCIAL SERVICES.
purpose: To require a study of the responsiveness of programs administered by the Department of Social Services to persons served by such programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINIMUM EMPLOYEE WAGES, HEALTH CARE COVERAGE AND RETIREMENT BENEFITS FOR NONPROFIT PROVIDERS OF STATE-ADMINISTERED SERVICES FOR PERSONS WITH INTELLECTUAL OR DEVELOPMENTAL DISABILITIES.
purpose: To raise minimum wages for employees of nonprofit providers that contract with the state to provide services for persons with intellectual and developmental disabilities, authorize health care coverage of such employees under a state partnership health plan and provide state funding to enhance employee retirement benefits.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To ensure the state medical assistance program is serving all those in need.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TELEHEALTH.
purpose: To allow audio-only telehealth services under the state medical assistance program and out-of-state health care providers to provide telehealth in the state on a permanent basis.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ONE FAIR WAGE.
purpose: To eliminate the subminimum wage in the state and create one minimum fair wage.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING CONNECTICUT PAID SICK DAYS.
purpose: To expand Connecticut paid sick days' law to (1) cover all private-sector employers and employees, (2) broaden the range of family members employees may use leave for, (3) increase rate at which employees accrue leave, (4) broaden reasons employees may use leave, and (5) increase the maximum amount of hours an employee may accrue.

title: AN ACT AMENDING CONNECTICUT PAID FAMILY MEDICAL LEAVE.
purpose: To amend both the Connecticut Paid Family and Medical Leave Act and Connecticut Family Medical Leave Act to (1) include tribal enterprises and transit districts, and (2) prohibit disability benefits from being offset by benefits received under such programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RIDESHARE AND DELIVERY DRIVER MINIMUM STANDARDS.
purpose: To establish reciprocity with neighboring states in order to allow Connecticut drivers to pick up passengers in such states and to require network companies to, (1) provide network workers with minimum pay per trip, (2) provide trip receipts to both workers and passengers, and (3) pay for other fees incurred during trips.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR CRIMES COMMITTED AGAINST THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To extend the statute of limitations for the prosecution of crimes committed against the elderly.

title: AN ACT CLARIFYING THE MEANINGS OF SEXUAL INTERCOURSE AND SEXUAL CONTACT.
purpose: To clarify the meanings of "sexual intercourse" and "sexual contact" following the Connecticut Supreme Court rulings in State v. Douglas C. and State v. Joseph V.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE CONSTRUCTION RELATED THRESHOLDS.
purpose: To permit constituent units of the state system of higher education and the Military Department to have charge and supervision of certain changes to real assets involving expenditures of not more than three million dollars, redefine "project" for purposes of the threshold for consultant services and permit the Commissioner of Administrative Services to adjust such threshold.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ADMINISTRATIVE SERVICES CONCERNING STATE CONTRACTING REQUIREMENTS AND CERTAIN PROCUREMENT THRESHOLDS AND CONCERNING CONTRACTS, BIDS AND CAPITAL IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS FOR THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To make revisions to various statutes concerning state contracting recommended by the Department of Administrative Services, including by permitting the department to make cooperative purchases from another state, increasing thresholds relating to contractor prequalification and competitive bidding waivers and revising provisions concerning set-aside goal reports and nondiscrimination affirmations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR MINOR AND TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE GOVERNMENT ADMINISTRATION AND ELECTION STATUTES.
purpose: To make minor and technical revisions to the government administration and election statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DATA GOVERNANCE, REQUESTS FOR PUBLIC RECORDS INVOLVING THE CONNECTICUT PRESCHOOL THROUGH TWENTY AND WORKFORCE INFORMATION NETWORK AND APPROVAL OF A SALE OF PROPERTY BY THE TOWN OF WINDHAM.
purpose: To permit the Office of Policy and Management to establish advisory boards for data governance, redefine executive branch agency, delete a requirement for an annual report concerning high value data and require records requests involving CP20 WIN be made to the originating agency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO PROVISIONS CONCERNING GOVERNMENT ADMINISTRATION.
purpose: To make technical provisions to statutes concerning government administration.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FOREIGN POLITICAL SPENDING.
purpose: To (1) prevent foreign interference in state referenda and elections and allow for greater enforcement of violations, (2) implement federal court rulings regarding independent expenditure political committees and contributions to such committees, (3) make adjustments to reflect the United States Supreme Court ruling on aggregate contribution limits for individuals, (4) more explicitly recognize referendum spending as a type of independent expenditure and require reporting as such, (5) impose attribution requirements for certain forms of referendum spending, (6) require, for organization expenditure party candidate listings, only the disclaimer of the paying committee and not the individual disclaimer of all candidates mentioned, and (7) make a conforming change regarding the distribution of surplus funds by candidate committees participating in the Citizens’ Election Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEADLINE FOR FILING NOMINATING PETITIONS WITH THE SECRETARY OF THE STATE.
purpose: To require that the deadline for filing nominating petitions with the Secretary of the State be seven days earlier than the deadline for filing such petitions with town clerks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REGIONAL ELECTION ADVISORS AND A TASK FORCE ON ELECTION ADMINISTRATION IN MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To (1) rename "regional election monitors" as "regional election advisors", (2) provide that a regional council of governments, or a combination of regional councils of governments and individual municipalities, may appoint regional election advisors for assistance with the performance of election administration duties, (3) provide for an annual grant to regional councils of governments that appoint a regional election advisor, and (4) establish a task force to study means of ensuring election administration in municipalities is fully staffed by properly trained election officials.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE USE OF A CERTAIN APPLICATION, SOFTWARE AND PROGRAMS ON STATE GOVERNMENT DEVICES AND REQUIRING MINIMUM SECURITY STANDARDS AND ANNUAL AUDITS OF SUCH DEVICES.
purpose: To prohibit the download or use of TikTok or other programs, software or devices determined to be a cyber security threat on state government devices, to require the development of minimum security standards to apply across state government and to require annual audits of such devices to ensure they comply with such minimum security standards.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKFORCE HOUSING OPPORTUNITY DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS AND BROWNFIELD DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS.
purpose: To (1) establish the workforce housing opportunity development program in opportunity zones, (2) to provide tax credits and other incentives for such developments, and (3) to provide grants for brownfield development projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVISOR'S TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO THE GENERAL STATUTES.
purpose: To make various technical changes concerning grammar, clarity and accuracy of internal references and consistency in the general statutes.

title: AN ACT RELIEVING CERTAIN REGISTRANTS OF THE REQUIREMENTS OF THE SEX OFFENSE REGISTRY AND CLARIFYING REGISTRATION REQUIREMENTS FOR PERSONS TRANSFERRED INTO THIS STATE AND WHO RESIDE IN CONGREGATE CARE SETTINGS.
purpose: To end registration requirements for persons released into the community during the ten-year period prior to the implementation of the sex offense registry and clarify registration requirements for persons transferred from out-of-state into congregate care settings in this state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING SECONDARY TRAFFIC VIOLATIONS.
purpose: To establish secondary traffic violations and prohibit a law enforcement officer from stopping a motor vehicle for a secondary traffic violation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TRANSFER OF PERSONS WHO ARE INCARCERATED BETWEEN CORRECTIONAL FACILITIES AND THE USE OF BODY SCANNING MACHINES IN CORRECTIONAL FACILITIES AS AN ALTERNATIVE TO THE USE OF STRIP SEARCHES.
purpose: To require (1) notification to a crime victim when the person who committed the crime involving the victim is transferred to a lower level correctional facility, and (2) a correctional officer to document such officer's probable cause belief that a person who is incarcerated is concealing contraband prior to such person being subject to a strip search.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To (1) allow boards of education to provide aerospace and aviation training to students through partnerships with local businesses, (2) allow the establishment of a dual enrollment or early college program related to health care, (3) allow students to be trained as paraeducators while in high school, (4) distribute information concerning vocational agriculture and technical education and career programs to students in middle school, (5) require the Auditors of Public Accounts to audit workforce development programs, (6) establish a grant program for boards of education that includes registered preapprenticeship programs in the high school curriculum, (7) require the expansion of dual credit and dual enrollment programs, and (8) require the establishment of a working group to determine the feasibility of developing an aerospace advanced manufacturing high school.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE SCHOOL INDOOR AIR QUALITY WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To (1) implement the recommendations of the school indoor air quality working group by extending and expanding the charge of the school indoor air quality working group, (2) establish the School Indoor Air Quality and HVAC Portal for the purpose of collecting and making available reports of inspections and evaluations of school indoor air quality and heating, ventilation and air conditioning systems, (3) increase the amount of funding under the heating, ventilation and air conditioning system grant program, and (4) require the Commissioner of Public Health to establish an optimal thermal comfort range in school buildings and facilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EQUITY IN EDUCATION.
purpose: To (1) establish the educator apprenticeship initiative, (2) add accountability to school districts regarding increasing educator diversity plans, (3) expand funding and opportunities under the Aspiring Educators Diversity Scholarship Program and other educator recruitment programs, (4) create an adjunct professor permit, (5) include cursive writing and world language in the kindergarten to grade eight model curriculum, and (6) provide high school graduation credit for completion of a learner engagement and attendance program and other credit recovery programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To (1) exclude certain federal funds from the calculation of net current expenditures per pupil for purposes of the excess cost grant, (2) permit the provision of dual instruction as part of remote learning if required by a student's IEP, (3) extend and expand the charge of the special education task force, (4) give parents the right to have an interpreter present at a planning and placement team meeting, (5) prohibit charter schools from requiring disclosure of special education needs on enrollment applications or as part of the criteria used for the holding of enrollment lotteries, (6) prohibit the use of seclusion in schools and make other revisions to the laws governing physical restraint, (7) extend the school-based health center expansion grant program, (8) require the Department of Education to post all decisions and corrective actions regarding special education complaints, and (9) protect school employees from discipline for making recommendations for accommodations under 504 Plans.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUTHORIZATION OF STATE GRANT COMMITMENTS FOR SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECTS AND REVISIONS TO THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECTS STATUTES.
purpose: To authorize state grant commitments for school building projects; to add members to the School Building Projects Advisory Council; to increase the reimbursement percentage range for new construction projects from ten to seventy per cent to ten to eighty per cent; and to allow boards of education to include any federal funds received as part of such board's local share of school building project costs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PRESCRIPTION DRUG AFFORDABILITY.
purpose: To (1) require that certain prescription drugs purchased in the state not exceed upper payment limits set by Medicare pursuant to the federal Inflation Reduction Act, (2) establish a Prescription Drug Payment Evaluation Committee to recommend upper payment limits on not less than eight drugs based on such limits in other states or countries, and (3) require the Office of Health Strategy to monitor and make public the costliest prescription drugs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAL DEBT.
purpose: To ameliorate the burden of medical debt.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT INDIAN CHILD WELFARE ACT.
purpose: To codify the provisions of the federal Indian Child Welfare Act into state law and apply its provisions to children of an Indian tribe recognized by the state of Connecticut and children of a federally recognized Indian tribe.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT FOR PEER RECOVERY SUPPORT SERVICES.
purpose: To provide Medicaid reimbursement for peer recovery support providers, including substance use disorder recovery coaches, who are certified and enrolled as Medicaid providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONTROL OF THE UNION AVENUE DETENTION CENTER IN NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide that the Union Avenue Detention Center in New Haven be under the jurisdiction of the Judicial Department.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE CIVIL LAWS IN THIS STATE.
purpose: To require a study of the state's civil laws.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING A ONE-YEAR DELAY TO CERTAIN CHANGES IN STATUTES CONCERNING THE ASSESSMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES FOR PROPERTY TAXATION.
purpose: To specify the manner in which motor vehicles used for commercial purposes and motor vehicles not used for commercial purposes shall be assessed for property taxation purposes.

title: AN ACT REPEALING THE NEW HARTFORD FIRE ASSOCIATION AND VALIDATING THE ACTIONS OF THE NEW HARTFORD VILLAGE FIRE DISTRICT AND PINE MEADOW FIRE DISTRICT CONCERNING THE CONSOLIDATION OF SAID DISTRICTS.
purpose: To consolidate the Pine Meadow Fire District into the New Hartford Fire Association.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY ISSUES CONCERNING RURAL HEALTH.
purpose: To establish a task force to study issues concerning rural health.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MENTAL HEALTH CRISIS CENTER PILOT PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a mental health crisis center pilot program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE CRIMINAL PROCEDURE LAWS OF THIS STATE.
purpose: To require a study of the criminal procedure laws of this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MASHANTUCKET PEQUOT AND MOHEGAN FUND.
purpose: To change the requirements for the distribution of funds deposited into the Mashantucket Pequot and Mohegan Fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY PAYMENTS IN LIEU OF TAXES TO MUNICIPALITIES AND THE STATE SPENDING CAP.
purpose: To study the potential for the state to fully fund the PILOT program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN EMPLOYEES WORKING IN INTERMEDIATE CARE FACILITIES.
purpose: To require a report on small hospitals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR STUDENT MEALS.
purpose: To require a study of funding needed to provide school meals for students.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PAYMENTS BY INSURANCE COMPANIES FOR DEPOSIT INTO THE INSURANCE FUND.
purpose: To realign the structure of payments by insurance companies into the Insurance Fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT BOARD'S RECOMMENDATIONS FOR CHANGES TO THE TEACHERS' RETIREMENT SYSTEM STATUTES.
purpose: To make the Teachers' Retirement Board's recommended changes to statutes concerning the Teachers' Retirement System.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FULLY FUNDING EXCESS COSTS FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To require a study of funding needed to fully cover excess costs for special education.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXEMPTION FROM DISCLOSURE OF RESIDENTIAL ADDRESSES UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To expand the list of public agency employees whose residential addresses are exempt from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act to include additional individuals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENFORCEMENT OF VIOLATIONS OF THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To increase the maximum penalty for certain violations of the Freedom of Information Act to ten thousand dollars, to permit the Freedom of Information Commission to seek judicial relief for certain public agency misconduct and to require public agencies to post information about open requests.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FEES FOR COPYING, REVIEWING AND REDACTING RECORDS CREATED BY POLICE BODY-WORN RECORDING EQUIPMENT AND DASHBOARD CAMERAS.
purpose: To authorize a public agency to charge a redaction fee for the disclosure of a record created by police body-worn equipment or dashboard cameras that contains portions not authorized to be disclosed under state or federal law.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE CONTRACTING STANDARDS BOARD.
purpose: To make revisions to provisions concerning the State Contracting Standards Board, including by giving the board authority over quasi-public agency procurement, requiring the hiring of full-time staff for the board, prohibiting the Governor from reducing allotments to the board and limiting the selection of contractors from a list without a competitive process to emergency procurements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM AND CERTAIN INFLATIONARY ADJUSTMENTS.
purpose: To eliminate the inflationary adjustment for the aggregate contribution amount that candidates participating in the Citizens' Election Program are required to raise to qualify for a grant under said program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REFERENDA, INDEPENDENT EXPENDITURES, STATE ELECTIONS ENFORCEMENT COMMISSION COMPLAINTS AND REPAYMENT OF SURPLUS CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM GRANT FUNDS.
purpose: To (1) create within the Citizens' Election Program a voucher system for the purpose of making grant moneys available to participating candidates for Governor prior to the state conventions, (2) establish the State Elections Enforcement Commission's jurisdiction over the administration of such system, and (3) set forth certain illegal practices with regard to the use of vouchers issued under such system.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATE VOTING RIGHTS IN RECOGNITION OF JOHN R. LEWIS.
purpose: To afford mechanisms for the challenge of certain election administration laws, practices or procedures that may impair the electoral rights of certain protected classes of individuals.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BONDING AUTHORITY OF THE CONNECTICUT MUNICIPAL REDEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE REPORTING OF MATERIAL FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS BY STATE AGENCIES, TAX-EXEMPT PROCEEDS FUND REFERENCES, AND THE NOTIFICATION OF THE SALE OR LEASE OF PROJECTS FINANCED WITH BOND PROCEEDS.
purpose: To (1) amend provisions concerning the bonding authority and liability of the Connecticut Municipal Redevelopment Authority, (2) require state actors to notify the Treasurer of reportable financial obligations and agreements, (3) require the prior approval of the Treasurer for certain transactions, and (4) delete provisions concerning the Tax-Exempt Proceeds Funds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATE'S HEALTH CARE WORKFORCE.
purpose: To address health care workforce shortages in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES.
purpose: To (1) include the reasons for calls for emergency medical services in the emergency medical services data collection system, (2) require the Commissioner of Public Health to report to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to public health regarding data collected by such data collection system, (3) require that the Emergency Medical Services Advisory Board include a member from the Connecticut Association of Paramedics and EMTs, and (4) require such advisory board to (A) study the shortage of emergency medical services personnel, and (B) annually report to the joint standing committee of the General Assembly having cognizance of matters relating to public health concerning emergency medical services in the state.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO PUBLIC DEFENDER SERVICES.
purpose: To expand access to public defender services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A DEFENDANT'S COMPETENCY TO STAND TRIAL AND EARLY RELEASE INTO THE COMMUNITY.
purpose: To revise laws concerning defendants who are found not competent to stand trial and their early release into the community by providing for (1) better notice to victims and their families, (2) independent examinations, (3) an extension of the period of placement and monitoring under a placement order, and (4) one final exam before release.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING DISCRIMINATION MATTERS BEFORE THE COMMISSION ON HUMAN RIGHTS AND OPPORTUNITIES.
purpose: To increase the penalties for committing discriminatory housing practices and provide the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities with additional funding to hire staff assigned to investigate claims of discriminatory housing practices.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING COMMUNITY-BASED SENTENCING ALTERNATIVES FOR PRIMARY CARETAKERS OF DEPENDENT CHILDREN AND OTHER ELIGIBLE CARETAKERS.
purpose: To establish community-based sentencing alternatives to incarceration for caretakers in order to help families stay intact and to protect the health and safety of dependents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FAILURE TO FILE FOR CERTAIN GRAND LIST EXEMPTIONS.
purpose: To allow certain persons to file for property tax exemptions, notwithstanding certain statutory deadlines.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE TREASURER'S RECOMMENDATIONS CONCERNING THE INVESTMENT ADVISORY COUNCIL AND RELATED STATUTES AND CONCERNING THE BABY BOND TRUST PROGRAM.
purpose: To implement the Treasurer's recommendations concerning the Investment Advisory Council and related statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AMOUNTS OF UNCLAIMED BEVERAGE CONTAINER DEPOSITS TO BE PAID FOR DEPOSIT IN THE GENERAL FUND.
purpose: To (1) allow the retention of certain balances outstanding in the special account for the purpose of reimbursement of the ten-cent refund value for redeemed beverage containers that commences January 1, 2024, and (2) reduce the percentages of the unclaimed beverage container deposits that are required to be paid by deposit initiators for deposit in the General Fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A PHASE-IN OF THE INCREASE IN THE UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE CHARGED RATE.
purpose: To phase-in the increase in the unemployment insurance maximum charged rate and implement an annual maximum increase percentage for employers during the phase-in.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REVIEW OF BOARDS OF ASSESSMENT APPEALS PROCEEDINGS.
purpose: To (1) allow owners of certain properties to appeal an action by an assessor by filing an application with the Superior Court rather than an appeal with the board of assessment appeals, and (2) increase the property value threshold for the requirement to file an appraisal with an application filed with the court.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN EMPLOYEE STOCK-SHARING ARRANGEMENTS.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR SUPPORTIVE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To provide funding for supportive housing developments to provide additional units of affordable housing with support services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUTHORIZATION OF BONDS OF THE STATE TO THE DEPARTMENT OF MENTAL HEALTH AND ADDICTION SERVICES FOR THE ESTABLISHMENT OF MENTAL HEALTH URGENT CARE CRISIS CENTERS.
purpose: To provide financial assistance to nonprofit providers of mental health care services to establish mental health urgent crisis centers in areas of need in the state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO FUND THE SMALL MULTIFAMILY LENDING PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide funding for the small multifamily lending program in order to create more affordable housing in the state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A CHILD CARE CENTER IN THE FAIR HAVEN NEIGHBORHOOD OF THE CITY OF NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide funding for a child care center in the Fair Haven neighborhood of the city New Haven, to ensure children continue to receive child care services in the neighborhood.

title: AN ACT INCREASING CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM GRANTS IN LIGHT OF THE IMPLEMENTATION OF EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To increase Citizens' Election Program grants so that participating candidates can help inform voters about the implementation of early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM GRANTS AND EARLY VOTING.
purpose: To increase Citizens' Election Program grants due to the implementation of early voting.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION OPPORTUNITIES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To study postsecondary education opportunities in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A NEEDS ASSESSMENT FOR THE DELIVERY OF POSTSECONDARY EDUCATION PROGRAMS IN CORRECTIONAL FACILITIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Correction to conduct a needs assessment of the facilities, materials and staffing required for the delivery of postsecondary education programs in correctional institutions.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING DISCLOSURE OF SCHOLARSHIP DISPLACEMENT POLICIES AT INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To require each institution of higher education to disclose its scholarship displacement policies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SUBSTANCE-FREE HOUSING ON COLLEGE CAMPUSES.
purpose: To require institutions of higher education to provide options for substance-free housing on campus.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PEER RECOVERY SUPPORT SERVICES.
purpose: To provide additional peer support services to residents suffering from substance use disorders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT PARITY FOR OPTOMETRISTS.
purpose: To end the practice in which optometrists are reimbursed ninety per cent of the fee paid to ophthalmologists in the Medicaid program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VETERANS' PENSIONS AND DISABILITY BENEFITS.
purpose: To exempt a veteran's military pension and veterans' disability benefit income from the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MILITARY RELIEF FUND.
purpose: To expand the purposes for which Military Relief Fund grants may be made.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A GRANT-IN-AID TO THE HUNEEBEE PROJECT IN NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To assist in equitable job preparedness for students.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SUBSIDY FOR RETIRED TEACHERS' HEALTH INSURANCE.
purpose: To provide a one-third state subsidy for the cost of teachers' Medicare supplement health insurance, which would treat all plans equitably.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE OFFICE OF THE CHILD ADVOCATE.
purpose: To ensure greater safety of the children in the care of the Department of Children and Families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE CITY OF NEW HAVEN'S YOUTH AT WORK PROGRAM.
purpose: To support children in the New Haven community by providing them with youth employment opportunities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FREE BUS SERVICE FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To provide free bus service on CT transit to veterans of the U.S. armed forces.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE FOR RETIRED PART-TIME FACULTY OF THE STATE SYSTEM OF PUBLIC HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To provide health insurance for retired adjunct faculty of the CSUS who taught not less than one hundred eighty credit hours in aggregate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EARNED WAGE ACCESS.
purpose: To: (1) Define "employer-integrated advance" and "expedited transfer fee"; and (2) establish exceptions to certain small loan lending laws for employer-integrated advances that meet various requirements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SHARED APPRECIATION AGREEMENT DISCLOSURES.
purpose: To require certain disclosures in connection with shared appreciation agreements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER CREDIT, CERTAIN BANK REAL ESTATE IMPROVEMENTS, THE CONNECTICUT UNIFORM SECURITIES ACT, SHARED APPRECIATION AGREEMENTS, INNOVATION BANKS, THE COMMUNITY BANK AND COMMUNITY CREDIT UNION PROGRAM AND TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE BANKING STATUTES.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study and submit a report concerning  banking issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF FINANCIAL TRANSACTIONS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study and submit a report concerning financial transactions in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ASSIGNMENT OF CERTAIN LIENS.
purpose: To (1) reduce the interest rate for certain municipal tax liens, and (2) provide that certain attorney's fees (A) may not be received, claimed or collected until commencement of a foreclosure action or a suit on the debt, and (B) shall not be more than fifteen per cent of the amount of any judgment.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INNOVATION BANKS.
purpose: To change various references from "uninsured bank" to "innovation bank".

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCLOSURES OF FINANCIAL RECORDS.
purpose: To: (1) Require financial institutions to provide certain financial records to the Commissioner of Social Services or any person deputized by said commissioner within twenty calendar days; and (2) provide that certain actions taken concerning such financial records shall not constitute a class C misdemeanor.

title: AN ACT RESTRUCTURING CERTAIN TAXES.
purpose: To restructure certain taxes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GROCERY STORE BEER PERMITTEES.
purpose: To redefine "grocery store" for purposes of the grocery store beer permit.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CAFE AND PACKAGE STORE PERMITTEES.
purpose: To allow (1) beer manufacturer permittees to sell and deliver kegs of beer at locations in this state that are within a five-mile radius of their permit premises, (2) package store permittees to provide fee-based spirits tastings, and (3) Connecticut craft cafe permittees to sell additional alcoholic beverages manufactured in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CANNABIS AND HEMP REGULATION.
purpose: To: (1) Redefine "high-THC hemp product" and "disproportionately impacted area"; (2) enable certain social equity applicants to engage in additional cultivation activities and apply for additional licenses; (3) modify certain common ownership requirements concerning equity joint ventures; (4) enable product packagers to expand their authorized activities; (5) limit the licensing period for certain provisional cultivator licenses; (6) modify requirements concerning the location of cultivation facilities; (7) authorize micro-cultivators to sell cannabis seedlings; (8) authorize hybrid retailers to provide access to pharmacists through telehealth; (9) establish additional requirements concerning dispensary facility and hybrid retailer relocations; (10) alter certain requirements applicable to packaging containing (A) multiple servings of cannabis, or (B) manufacturer hemp products; (11) provide that no cannabis establishment shall engage in certain advertising; and (12) make various minor, technical and conforming changes to statutes concerning cannabis and hemp regulation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOLAR LICENSING EXEMPTIONS.
purpose: To modify a licensing exemption by allowing certain persons, under the direction of a properly licensed solar contractor, to perform work limited to (1) uncrating, hoisting and job site distribution of solar collectors, photovoltaic panels, towers or turbines, (2) pile driving, (3) concrete form work, and (4) installation of ground screw supports and racking systems.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RENTERS IN COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To prohibit common interest ownership communities from enacting or enforcing restrictions that limit the number of rented units to less than fifty per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELIGIBILITY FOR WORKFORCE HOUSING DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS.
purpose: To modify the percentage of workforce housing opportunity development project units that shall be rented at market rate and to eligible workforce populations.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE SECURITY DEPOSIT GUARANTY PROGRAM.
purpose: To provide funding for the security deposit guaranty program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE HOUSING STATUTES.
purpose: To make technical revisions to the housing statutes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICES OF RENT INCREASES.
purpose: To prohibit (1) any rental agreement from providing a tenant with less than sixty days' notice of any increase in rent, and (2) a landlord from issuing a notice to quit based on a tenant's refusal to accept an increase in rent unless such tenant has been provided not less than sixty days' notice of such increase in rent.

title: AN ACT REPEALING PROVISIONS CONCERNING THE STATE-ASSISTED HOUSING SUSTAINABILITY FUND.
purpose: To repeal certain provisions pertaining to the State-Assisted Housing Sustainability Fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STANDARDIZED VALUATION OF AFFORDABLE RENTAL HOUSING.
purpose: To standardize the methodology used to determine the present true and actual value of real property classified as affordable housing.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE RESPONSIVENESS OF STATE AGENCIES AND THE JUDICIAL BRANCH TO ISSUES CONCERNING CHILD SEXUAL ABUSE.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the responsiveness of state agencies to issues concerning child sexual abuse.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MAINTENANCE OF LIABILITY INSURANCE COVERAGE BY CHILD CARE CENTERS, GROUP CHILD CARE HOMES AND FAMILY CHILD CARE HOMES.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of the Office of Early Childhood to adopt regulations requiring child care centers, group child care homes and family child care homes to maintain liability insurance coverage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILD SEXUAL ABUSE MATERIAL.
purpose: To change the term "child pornography" to "child sexual abuse material" in the general statutes.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CERTAIN AGENCIES TO REPORT COSTS ASSOCIATED WITH PROGRAMS SERVING CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Children and Families, Department of Social Services and Department of Developmental Services to submit reports describing current costs associated with programs serving children and families and anticipated costs associated with utilizing different eligibility criteria for participation in such programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INVESTIGATIONS CONDUCTED BY THE OFFICE OF EARLY CHILDHOOD.
purpose: To require the Office of Early Childhood to review and revise the codes used by the office to inform the public about the nature and outcome of certain investigations and disciplinary actions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNEMPLOYMENT BENEFITS.
purpose: To allow striking employees to access unemployment benefits after a period of two consecutive weeks of striking.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING CONNECTICUT FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE BENEFITS TO NONCERTIFIED SCHOOL EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To extend the state family and medical leave benefits to employees of a local or regional board of education who do not hold professional certification under chapter 166 of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING PAID SICK DAYS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To expand the paid sick days statutes to (1) apply to more employers and employees, (2) expand the categories of family members an employee may use paid sick leave to care for, (3) expand the permitted purposes that an employee may use paid sick leave for, (4) modify the rate at which an employee may receive paid sick leave, and (5) make other conforming and clarifying changes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY TAX ABATEMENT FOR CERTAIN FIRST-TIME HOMEBUYERS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to abate up to five hundred dollars per assessment year of property taxes for certain first-time homebuyers who obtain a loan from the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOLAR INSTALLATIONS IN CERTAIN COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To permit the installation of certain solar power generating systems that serve single-family detached units in common interest ownership communities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REQUIREMENT TO INSTALL SWIMMING POOL BARRIERS.
purpose: To prohibit the issuance of a building permit for the construction or substantial alteration of a swimming pool unless certain barriers are included in the construction plan.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAINING FOR MEMBERS AND EMPLOYEES OF INLAND WETLANDS AGENCIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to develop an online training program for members and staff of inland wetlands agencies and specify that extensions of time for certain decisions of municipal commissions, boards and agencies may be requested by petitioners and applicants or such commissions, boards and agencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER OF INTEREST ON CERTAIN DELINQUENT PROPERTY TAX PAYMENTS.
purpose: To require municipal tax collectors to waive interest on delinquent property tax payments if such delinquency is attributable to an error made by the tax assessor or tax collector, and not the result of any action or failure on the part of the taxpayer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ASSESSMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES FOR PROPERTY TAXATION.
purpose: To specify the manner in which motor vehicles used for commercial purposes and motor vehicles not used for commercial purposes shall be assessed for property taxation purposes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE ONLINE PUBLICATION OF LEGAL NOTICES BY MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To authorize the posting of advertisements of legal notices on municipal Internet web sites.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TEMPORARY SHELTER UNITS FOR PERSONS EXPERIENCING HOMELESSNESS OR REFUGEES LOCATED ON REAL PROPERTY OWNED BY RELIGIOUS ORGANIZATIONS.
purpose: To allow the installation of temporary shelter units for persons experiencing homelessness on real property owned by religious organizations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PURPLE PROPERTY BORDERS AS WARNING TO TRESPASSERS.
purpose: To provide that purple painted property borders serve as a warning to trespassers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE PROVISION OF EMERGENCY TREATMENT AND TRANSPORTATION TO AN ANIMAL THAT IS INJURED IN THE PERFORMANCE OF ITS DUTIES UNDER THE SUPERVISION OF A PEACE OFFICER.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the provision of emergency treatment and transportation to an animal that is injured in the performance of its duties under the supervision of a peace officer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE AND USE OF CERTAIN NONAERIAL AND NONEXPLOSIVE CONSUMER FIREWORKS.
purpose: To authorize the sale and use by consumers of certain nonaerial and nonexplosive consumer fireworks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING.
purpose: To provide funding for the Department of Housing for the development of housing projects comprised of one hundred per cent affordable units.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR PROGRAMS THAT ASSIST INDIVIDUALS EXPERIENCING HOMELESSNESS.
purpose: To provide funding for programs administered by the Department of Housing that provide assistance to persons experiencing homelessness.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION.
purpose: To (1) broaden access to the State Seal of Biliteracy, (2) increase the number of credits required for an adult education diploma, (3) authorize Goodwin University Magnet Schools to charge tuition to boards of education for enrolled students, (4) extend the dates for compliance with the magnet school enrollment standards in accordance with Sheff v. O'Neill stipulations, (5) change the Department of Education's responsibilities under the farm to school program from arranging interactions with farmers to providing technical assistance and support for interactions with farmers, and (6) amend definitions of terms and the department's responsibilities concerning transition programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PUBLIC EDUCATION IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to conduct a study of public education in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE EDUCATION AND EARLY CHILDHOOD STATUTES.
purpose: To make technical revisions to the education and early childhood statutes.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR RENOVATIONS AND IMPROVEMENTS TO VARIOUS SCHOOLS IN DANBURY.
purpose: To provide funding to the city of Danbury for renovations and improvements to various schools, including, but not limited to, elevator replacements, air conditioning system improvements, stadium and auditorium lighting, roof replacements, parking lot and drainage repairs, security vestibule construction and improvements, playground construction and improvements, bathroom renovations and fence, window and door replacements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REIMBURSEMENT OF CERTAIN FEES FOR VETERANS OR SPONSORS OF VETERANS IN APPRENTICESHIP PROGRAMS.
purpose: To allow reimbursement of certain licensing, certification, registration and tuition fees for veterans or sponsors of veterans in apprenticeship programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE AMERICA 250 SEMIQUINCENTENNIAL INITIATIVE.
purpose: To (1) temporarily increase the rates of the room occupancy tax for hotels and lodging houses and the sales and use taxes on the rental or leasing of a passenger motor vehicle, and (2) dedicate the additional revenue generated from such increases to be used for the America 250 semiquincentennial initiative.

title: AN ACT DEDICATING A PORTION OF THE ROOM OCCUPANCY TAX ON SHORT-TERM RENTALS TO MUNICIPALITIES.
purpose: To provide that a portion of the revenue generated from the room occupancy tax on short-term rentals be dedicated to the municipalities in which such rentals are located.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A GRANT-IN-AID FOR A CAREER ACADEMY IN WATERBURY.
purpose: To provide grant funding for career academy RIBA, Inc. in Waterbury.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FUNDING FOR BUS PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION FOR STUDENTS.
purpose: To provide free bus public transportation to students in kindergarten to grade twelve.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SMALL HARBOR IMPROVEMENT PROJECTS ACCOUNT.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to study the state's "blue economy" and ways to promote and grow economic activity on the state's coastline and waterways.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HISTORIC HOMES REHABILITATION TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To allow the historic homes rehabilitation tax credit to be applied against additional taxes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TAX CREDITS FOR SMALL EMPLOYERS THAT PURCHASE GOLD OR SILVER LEVEL HEALTH PLANS THROUGH THE CONNECTICUT HEALTH INSURANCE EXCHANGE.
purpose: To provide tax credits to small employers that purchase a group health plan at the gold or silver level through the Connecticut Health Insurance Exchange.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE PROPERTY TAX ON MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To eliminate the property tax on motor vehicles and require the state to reimburse municipalities for the resulting revenue loss.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR SECURITY CAMERAS IN THE FAIR HAVEN BUSINESS CORRIDORS IN THE CITY OF NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide funding for security cameras in the Fair Haven business corridors of the city of New Haven to improve security for residents and business owners.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR AFFORDABLE HOUSING PROJECTS LOCATED IN NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide funding for the construction of certain affordable housing projects located in the city of New Haven.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF REAL PROPERTY LOCATED IN NEW HAVEN.
purpose: To provide funding for the city of New Haven to acquire, remediate and develop certain real property located in the city of New Haven.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE PODIATRIC SCOPE OF PRACTICE.
purpose: To expand the podiatric scope of practice to include surgical treatment of complications within the tibial diaphysis related to the use of external fixation pins, the performance of total ankle replacements and the treatment of tibial pilon fractures.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOCIAL WORKERS.
purpose: To adopt the social work licensure compact.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TELEHEALTH.
purpose: To extend telehealth provisions adopted during the COVID-19 pandemic until June 30, 2027.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE SHORTAGE OF ATHLETIC TRAINERS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the shortage of athletic trainers in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH CARE ACCESSIBILITY FOR PERSONS WITH A DISABILITY.
purpose: To expand access to medical diagnostic equipment and examination rooms for persons with a disability.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF FUNDS IN THE TOBACCO SETTLEMENT FUND.
purpose: To require funding of tobacco control programs to prevent and reduce tobacco use at the amount recommended by the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE CONNECTICUT AIRPORT AUTHORITY.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Connecticut Airport Authority regarding vertiports, unmanned aircraft, lasers and the sale of alcoholic liquor at Bradley International Airport.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFERING PRICE OF A MOTOR VEHICLE AND AUTOMOBILE DEALER CONVEYANCE FEES.
purpose: To (1) limit the amount a dealer may charge for a conveyance fee or processing fee when selling or leasing a motor vehicle, and (2) prohibit a dealer from printing the order and invoice for the purchase of a motor vehicle with negotiable fees in advance of discussions with a prospective buyer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OPERATION OF LOW-SPEED VEHICLES.
purpose: To provide for the registration of low-speed vehicles and the operation of such vehicles on highways with posted speed limits of thirty-five miles per hour or less.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXCESSIVE, UNUSUAL OR UNNECESSARY MOTOR VEHICLE NOISE.
purpose: To ensure motor vehicles and the devices installed on motor vehicles are operated, installed, constructed and adjusted to prevent excessive, unusual or unnecessary motor vehicle noise.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ELIGIBILITY FOR STATE VETERANS' BENEFITS TO CERTAIN MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL GUARD.
purpose: To expand eligibility for state veterans' benefits to certain members of the National Guard.

title: AN ACT WAIVING OCCUPATIONAL LICENSING FEES FOR CERTAIN VETERANS AND FAMILY MEMBERS OF ACTIVE MILITARY.
purpose: To waive occupational licensing fees for certain veterans and family members of active military.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING TO THE DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS.
purpose: To increase funding to the Department of Veterans Affairs for various purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE PREMIUM RATES.
purpose: To (1) allow an income tax deduction for long-term care insurance premiums, (2) require a public hearing for long-term care premium rate increase requests that exceed ten per cent, and (3) require that policyholders are provided advance notice of such hearing.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ELDER JUSTICE UNIT IN THE DIVISION OF CRIMINAL JUSTICE.
purpose: To establish an elder justice unit in the Division of Criminal Justice.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VIRTUAL CURRENCY AND MONEY TRANSMISSION.
purpose: To: (1) Redefine "permissible investment" and define "receipt" in the money transmission statutes; (2) deem certain persons to be engaged in the business of money transmission and require such persons to be licensed; (3) require money transmission licensees to maintain a plan and accounting regarding winding down operations and to meet certain conditions in order to terminate such licensees' businesses; (4) establish a maximum fee that owners or operators of virtual currency kiosks may charge for a specific service and eliminate a certain requirement for customers to cancel and receive a refund for certain virtual currency transactions; (5) require money transmission licensees, or such licensees' authorized delegates, to provide receipts to senders; and (6) specify that the Banking Commissioner may adopt, amend and rescind regulations, forms and orders governing the business use of nonfungible tokens.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EDUCATION FUNDING.
purpose: To make revisions to how public education is funded in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DISCONNECTED YOUTH.
purpose: To improve school district data systems and practices to identify and support at-risk students and to establish coalitions and partnerships focused on supporting at-risk and disconnected youth.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BATTERSON PARK.
purpose: To care for, maintain and operate Batterson Park.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL AUTHORITY TO PROHIBIT THE SALE OF NIPS.
purpose: To authorize municipalities to prohibit the sale of nips in such town by vote of the applicable legislative body of such town following a public hearing on such proposal.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SAFETY CAPACITY AT GARDNER LAKE STATE PARK.
purpose: To develop a safety capacity for Gardner Lake State Park in order to protect public safety in the area.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF CERTAIN RODENTICIDES.
purpose: To restrict the use and sale of second-generation rodenticides in order to protect the health of hawks and other raptors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ESTABLISHMENT OF RIPARIAN BUFFERS AND REVISION OF CERTAIN INLAND WETLANDS PROVISIONS.
purpose: To develop buffers and setbacks from waterways and wetlands and require certain inland wetlands training and materials.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STANDARDS FOR THE SPRAYING OF HERBICIDES ALONG RAILROAD RIGHT-OF-WAYS.
purpose: To require railroad company vegetation management plans to be consistent with the requirements for such plans in the state of Massachusetts.

title: AN ACT EXAMINING THE VIABILITY OF AN EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY PROGRAM FOR SOLAR PANELS.
purpose: To examine whether an extended producer responsibility program for solar panels should be established.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OPERATION OF OUTDOOR WOOD-BURNING FURNACES ON NONATTAINMENT DAYS.
purpose: To prohibit the use of outdoor wood-burning furnaces on certain nonattainment days.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A NO-WAKE ZONE ON THE PAWCATUCK RIVER AND AUTHORIZING THE PURCHASE OF CERTAIN RIPARIAN BUFFERS.
purpose: To establish a no-wake-zone on the Pawcatuck River.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MINOR REVISIONS TO AGRICULTURE RELATED STATUTES AND TO OPEN SPACE ACQUISITION RELATED STATUTES.
purpose: To make minor, technical and conforming changes to certain agriculture-related statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SHARK FINNING.
purpose: To prohibit  the unauthorized practice of shark finning.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE INVASIVE PLANTS COUNCIL.
purpose: To implement the recent recommendations of the Invasive Plants Council by prohibiting the sale and cultivation of certain plants determined to be invasive or potentially invasive.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN EXTENDED PRODUCER RESPONSIBILITY PROGRAM FOR CONSUMER BATTERIES.
purpose: To establish an extended producer responsibility program for certain consumer batteries.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RELEASE OF CERTAIN LIENS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to release liens within a certain period of time when such lien has been satisfied.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE PURCHASE OF CERTAIN LANDS AT AGRICULTURAL VALUE.
purpose: To authorize the issuance of state funds for municipalities and nonprofits to purchase options to  purchase preserved agricultural lands at agricultural value.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE EELGRASS WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To implement certain of the recommendations of the eelgrass working group that are intended to assist in the preservation and restoration of eelgrass in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SMOKE DETECTORS IN THE SOLID WASTE STREAM.
purpose: To require the installation of certain types of smoke detectors and carbon monoxide detectors in single-family homes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVISIONS TO THE STATE'S NONRESIDENTIAL RENEWABLE ENERGY PROGRAM AND SHARED CLEAN ENERGY FACILITY PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) make revisions to the state's renewable energy programs, including suspending the caps and clarifying rules for state, agricultural and municipal customers, and (2) require the Public Utilities Regulatory Authority to study such programs and potential successor programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOLAR PROJECTS THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To (1) establish a uniform capacity tax on solar panels, (2) extend community benefit agreement requirements to more renewable energy projects, (3) study community solar, (4) require expedited permitting for solar canopies, (5) require the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to study solar canopies and develop a strategic plan, (6) revise programs of the Connecticut Green Bank, and (7) study how to promote municipal solar projects.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE OPERATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the operations of the Department of Consumer Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING ALCOHOLIC LIQUOR REGULATION.
purpose: To: (1) Define "business entity"; (2) specify the circumstances in which a franchisor or landlord may receive profits; (3) prohibit "placeholding"; (4) modify certain notice requirements; (5) require certain permittees that appoint additional wholesalers to disclose additional information; (6) allow additional permit holders to offer tastings and make donations; (7) empower the department to conduct additional investigations and impose additional fines; (8) allow the holders of certain permits to hold other permits; (9) modify requirements concerning changes to means of access; (10) modify certain notice and hearing requirements; (11) enable the department to accept offers in compromise; (12) enable applicants to appeal from denials of liquor permit applications; (13) authorize consumer service bars; (14) establish requirements concerning embargoes and confiscations; (15) indemnify and shield certain minors; (16) authorize electronic age statements; (17) impose additional requirements concerning intoxicated persons; and (18) make various conforming, technical and minor changes to the Liquor Control Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING CANNABIS REGULATION.
purpose: To: (1) Redefine "marijuana", "manufactured cannabinoid" and "synthetic cannabinoid" for the purposes of various statutes concerning cannabis regulation; (2) require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to designate any synthetic cannabinoid as a schedule I controlled substance; (3) provide that (A) cannabis shall not contain any synthetic cannabinoid, and (B) no cannabis establishment may sell any synthetic cannabinoid; (4) modify certain provisions that prohibit members of the Social Equity Council and certain employees of the council or the Department of Consumer Protection from holding certain interests in, or receiving certain moneys from, certain cannabis establishments or cannabis transactions; (5) specify that hemp that is lawfully produced under federal law may be transported or shipped through this state; and (6) make minor, technical and conforming changes to various statutes concerning cannabis regulation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RECOMMENDATIONS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To: (1) Implement the Department of Consumer Protection's recommendations concerning (A) landscape architects, (B) home improvement contractors and salespersons, (C) the Home Improvement Guaranty Fund, (D) appraisal management companies, (E) mobile manufactured home parks, (F) applications for licenses, permits, certificates and registrations and payments for outstanding fees, (G) sales of consumer commodities, (H) the Uniform Food, Drug and Cosmetic Act, (I) health clubs, contracts for health club services and the Connecticut Health Club Guaranty Fund, (J) well water, (K) unfair trade practices, (L) refund and exchange policies and practices, and (M) public weighmasters; (2) repeal various provisions concerning manufacturing, mixing, compounding, selling and offering for sale flour, white bread, rolls, corn meal, corn grits, macaroni and rice; and (3) make minor, technical and conforming changes to various statutes concerning (A) consumer protection, and (B) professional licensing, certification, permitting and registration.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING STUDENT SURVEYS DURING EVALUATION OF A PRIVATE CAREER SCHOOL TO RENEW A CERTIFICATE OF AUTHORIZATION.
purpose: To require student surveys as part of the evaluation of private career schools during the process for renewal of a certificate of authorization.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF THE MINIMUM AWARDS UNDER THE DEBT-FREE COMMUNITY COLLEGE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the amount of the minimum awards made under the debt-free community college program from two hundred fifty dollars for a full-time student to one thousand dollars and one hundred fifty dollars for a part-time student to five hundred dollars.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE PATH PROGRAM AND AMENDING THE CONNECTICUT COLLEGIATE AWARENESS AND PREPARATION PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) make nonprofit organizations that provide collegiate awareness and preparation programs eligible for grants, (2) establish an earlier application deadline and a one-year award period, and (3) increase funding for the Connecticut collegiate awareness and preparation program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MEDICAID COVERAGE FOR INFERTILITY TREATMENT.
purpose: To provide Medicaid coverage for the medically necessary diagnosis and treatment of infertility to the same extent such coverage is required by private insurers and eligible for Medicaid reimbursement under federal law.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A BUREAU COORDINATING SERVICES FOR DEAF, HARD OF HEARING OR DEAFBLIND PERSONS.
purpose: To establish a bureau to coordinate services and information for persons who are deaf, hard of hearing or deafblind.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COLLATERAL CONSEQUENCES OF CRIMINAL RECORDS ON HOUSING OPPORTUNITIES.
purpose: To prohibit housing providers from considering a prospective tenant's felony conviction in connection with a rental application after certain time periods.

title: AN ACT REVISING A STATUTE CONCERNING HOUSING DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To make technical changes to a statute concerning housing growth in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER GUIDELINES FOR AUTOMOBILE LIABILITY INSURANCE.
purpose: To direct the Insurance Commissioner to post on the Insurance Department's Internet web site guidelines for consumers of automobile liability insurance in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COPAYMENT-ONLY HEALTH PLANS.
purpose: To remove certain copayment limitations for copayment-only health plans offered in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ELECTRONIC POSTING OF CERTAIN DOCUMENTS BY INSURERS.
purpose: To allow insurers to post certain insurance policies and endorsements on such insurers' Internet web sites.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMPLOYEE HEALTH BENEFIT CONSORTIUMS.
purpose: To authorize employee health benefit consortiums in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH BENEFIT REVIEW.
purpose: To revise the manner in which health benefit reviews are performed and the content of such reviews.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONAL OPIOID DRUG DEACTIVATION AND DISPOSAL SYSTEMS AND THE OPIOID SETTLEMENT FUND.
purpose: To require pharmacies and pharmacists to provide personal opioid drug deactivation and disposal systems to patients, and dedicate moneys deposited in the Opioid Settlement Fund to reimburse pharmacies and pharmacists for expenses incurred in providing such systems to patients.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SELF-SERVICE STORAGE INSURANCE.
purpose: To regulate the sale of self-service storage insurance in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INSURANCE.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Department conduct a study concerning insurance in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPERTY AND CASUALTY INSURANCE IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Department conduct a study concerning issues relating to property and casualty insurance in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A FEASIBILITY STUDY OF INSURANCE POOLING FOR NONPROFIT ENTITIES.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Commissioner conduct a feasibility study of general liability and automobile liability insurance pooling for nonprofit entities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING BROKER PRICE OPINIONS BY REAL ESTATE BROKERS AND REAL ESTATE SALESPERSONS.
purpose: To permit real estate brokers and real estate salespersons to estimate the value of real estate for a fee or other valuable consideration and to perform comparative market analyses and provide price opinions or estimates of the value of real estate.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE FEASIBILITY OF ESTABLISHING A CAPTIVE INSURANCE COMPANY TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO FARMERS IMPACTED BY THE EFFECTS OF SEVERE WEATHER.
purpose: To require that the Insurance Commissioner, in consultation with the Commissioner of Agriculture, conduct a feasibility study for establishing a captive insurance company to provide financial assistance to farmers in the state impacted by the effects of severe weather.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIABILITY FOR INJURIES INHERENT IN CAMPING WHILE AT A PRIVATE CAMPGROUND.
purpose: To statutorily prescribe that each camper shall assume the risk for any injury to their person arising out of the hazards inherent in camping while at a private campground.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING LIABILITY FOR DAMAGE TO PERSON OR PROPERTY CAUSED BY A DOG.
purpose: To provide that the owner or keeper of a dog shall be jointly and severally liable for any dog causing damage to the person or property of another person.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE DOMESTIC VIOLENCE CRIMINAL JUSTICE RESPONSE AND ENHANCEMENT ADVISORY COUNCIL TO STUDY STATE COURT PROCESSES UPON RECEIPT OF A MILITARY PROTECTION ORDER.
purpose: To require state courts to extend full faith and credit to military protection orders.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN COURT ORDERS PERTAINING TO CHILD CUSTODY.
purpose: To permit the Superior Court to include in certain orders pertaining to child custody provisions concerning the identification of a neutral location where parents shall meet to drop off and pick up a child.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING AN EVALUATION OF SHORT-TERM ASSESSMENT AND RESPITE GROUP HOMES FOR CHILDREN.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families to submit a report concerning short-term assessment and respite group homes for children that are operated or licensed by the Department of Children and Families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSUMPTION OF ENERGY DRINKS BY CHILDREN.
purpose: To prohibit the sale of energy drinks to individuals under sixteen years of age.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHILD SEXUAL ABUSE.
purpose: To include a sexual abuse and assault awareness and prevention survey as part of the state-wide sexual abuse and assault awareness and prevention program implemented by school districts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE INTERSTATE COMPACT ON THE PLACEMENT OF CHILDREN AND THE UNIFORM CHILD CUSTODY JURISDICTION AND ENFORCEMENT ACT.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Children and Families, administrator of the Interstate Compact on the Placement of Children and Chief Court Administrator to submit a report concerning the placement of children pursuant to the Interstate Compact on the Placement of Children.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VOLUNTEER FIRE DEPARTMENTS AND AMBULANCE COMPANIES AND THE DEFINITION OF EMPLOYER UNDER THE STATE OCCUPATIONAL SAFETY AND HEALTH ACT.
purpose: To ensure volunteer fire departments and ambulance companies are considered under CONN-OSHA jurisdiction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' RIGHTS.
purpose: To require the Labor Commissioner to study workers' rights in the state.

title: AN ACT AMENDING THE TIME TO PROTEST BENEFIT CHARGES ON AN EMPLOYER'S UNEMPLOYMENT INSURANCE QUARTERLY STATEMENT.
purpose: To amend section 31-225a of the general statutes to shorten the time an employer can protest any unemployment benefits they contend have been improperly charged to their employer unemployment insurance quarterly statements due to fraud or error from sixty days to forty days.

title: AN ACT MAKING CHANGES TO AND REPEALING OBSOLETE PROVISIONS OF STATUTES RELEVANT TO THE LABOR DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Labor Department by (1) making changes to statutes relevant to the Labor Department, and (2) repealing obsolete provisions and statutes relevant to the Labor Department.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LABOR DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To require the Labor Commissioner to study the Labor Department.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONCOMPETE AGREEMENTS.
purpose: To prohibit the use of noncompete agreements and exclusivity agreements unless they meet certain requirements.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE THRESHOLD AMOUNT FOR FELONY UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION FRAUD.
purpose: To increase the threshold dollar amount for misdemeanor and felony unemployment compensation fraud.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE UNEMPLOYMENT COMPENSATION THRESHOLD FOR AGRICULTURAL EMPLOYERS.
purpose: To amend the definition of employment in section 31-222 of the general statutes to increase the compensation threshold that determines whether an agricultural employer and its employees are subject to the unemployment statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ENFORCEMENT OF REQUIREMENTS IMPOSED BY CERTAIN MUNICIPAL APPROVALS AND THE NEW HOME CONSTRUCTION GUARANTY FUND.
purpose: To (1) modify the dates upon which the approval of certain land use applications will expire, (2) increase the maximum payments from the New Home Construction Guaranty Fund from thirty thousand dollars to fifty thousand dollars, (3) allow the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to seek restitution from individual owners of new home construction contractors against whom judgments have been issued, and (4) to appropriate funds for the administration of the fund.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE INTERGOVERNMENTAL POLICY AND PLANNING DIVISION WITHIN THE OFFICE OF POLICY AND MANAGEMENT, AUDITS AND MUNICIPAL FINANCE.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Intergovernmental Policy and Planning Division within the Office of Policy and Management concerning assessment, tax collection, revaluation, discretionary funding, the regional performance incentive program, the renters' rebate program and the elimination of obsolete sections.

title: AN ACT REVISING THE CHARTER OF THE SECRET LAKE ASSOCIATION.
purpose: To revise provisions of the charter of the Secret Lake Association concerning annual and special meetings, the assessment and collection of taxes, and the approval of certain contracts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUDITS OF CERTAIN NONSTATE ENTITIES RECEIVING STATE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To increase the threshold for exemption from certain auditing requirements for nonstate entities from three hundred thousand dollars to five hundred thousand dollars, specify the permissible time period for granting extensions to file certain audit reports and make technical changes.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR CERTAIN REAL PROPERTY ACQUIRED BY INDEPENDENT INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To remove property tax exemptions for any real property acquired by an independent institution of higher education on and after October 1, 2024.

title: AN ACT AMENDING THE CHARTER OF THE SOUTH CENTRAL CONNECTICUT WATER AUTHORITY.
purpose: To amend the charter of the South Central Connecticut Water Authority to (1) allow the authority to conduct noncore business outside the state, (2) increase the compensation to members, (3) increase the membership from five to seven, (4) adjust meeting and quorum requirements, (5) allow for the reduction of late charges to users, (6) increase the ability of the authority to conduct certain repairs without a vote of the members, (7) require the public posting of annual financial statements, and (8) alter the terms concerning the issue or acquisition of certain bonds of the authority.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING INCENTIVES FOR TRANSIT-ORIENTED DEVELOPMENT.
purpose: To provide planning grants and other incentives for municipal transit-oriented development projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING AUTHORITY TO DECLARE THAT A FIREFIGHTER, POLICE OFFICER OR EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICE PERSONNEL DIED IN THE LINE OF DUTY.
purpose: To expand the presumption of workers' compensation coverage for the death or disability of a police officer or firefighter to include deaths or disabilities resulting from a cerebrovascular incident or pulmonary embolism and expand the period of time when such an officer or firefighter is considered in the line of duty to include twenty-four hours after attending training or engaging in duties.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE NATIONAL INTEGRATED BALLISTIC INFORMATION NETWORK.
purpose: To require participation in the National Integrated Ballistic Information Network, in place of operating the firearms evidence database, and revise various provisions related to ballistic evidence.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTING OR EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES PERSONNEL.
purpose: To allow a personal income tax deduction for a stipend paid by a municipality to a volunteer firefighter, fire police officer or ambulance member.

title: AN ACT ALLOWING HARDSHIP WAIVERS OF INTEREST DUE FROM A DELINQUENT LOTTERY SALES AGENT AND CONCERNING LICENSING OF CONNECTICUT LOTTERY CORPORATION EMPLOYEES.
purpose: To allow hardship waivers of interest due from delinquent lottery sales agents and permit the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to place an endorsement on a Connecticut Lottery Corporation employee's license to permit such employee to be involved with specified types of gaming without obtaining additional licenses.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CLASSIFICATION OF PAROLE OFFICERS AS PEACE OFFICERS.
purpose: To classify parole officers as peace officers.

title: AN ACT REVISING VARIOUS GAMING STATUTES.
purpose: To make revisions to various gaming statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VETERANS' SPECIALTY LICENSE PLATES AND DRIVER'S LICENSES FOR CERTAIN FORMER ARMED FORCES RESERVISTS.
purpose: To grant eligibility for veterans' specialty license plates and driver's licenses from the Department of Motor Vehicles to former members of the National Guard who do not qualify for federal veterans' benefits.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS FOR VARIOUS MEASURES TO SUPPORT AND ASSIST VETERANS.
purpose: To appropriate moneys to the Department of Veterans affairs for purposes of (1) driver's license and identity card renewals at department-sponsored events, (2) public awareness campaigns, (3) Internet web site updates and maintenance, and (4) publication of a municipal veterans' services directory.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FEES FOR VETERANS' SPECIALTY LICENSE PLATES.
purpose: To reduce by fifty per cent the fees paid by veterans or armed forces members for (1) the production costs of certain veterans' license plates, (2) Support Our Troops! license plates, and (3) certain administratively-created veterans and military organization license plates.

title: AN ACT ALIGNING STATE LAW WITH FEDERAL LAW CONCERNING SERVICE ANIMALS.
purpose: To (1) align state law with federal law concerning service animals, and (2) within available appropriations, make available through the Commission on Human Rights and Opportunities educational materials concerning service animals, emotional support animals and therapy animals.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS TO THE DEPARTMENT OF VETERANS AFFAIRS FOR ARTS THERAPY PROGRAMMING.
purpose: To appropriate moneys to the Department of Veterans Affairs for the purpose of expanding fine and performing arts therapy programming.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO THE PUBLIC HEALTH STATUTES.
purpose: To implement the Department of Public Health's recommendations regarding various revisions to the public health statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING IMPROVED OPIOID MONITORING.
purpose: To require each hospital that treats a patient for a nonfatal overdose of an opioid drug to administer a toxicology screening of such patient if medically appropriate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES' RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING COMMUNITY COMPANION HOMES.
purpose: To allow the Department of Developmental Services to disclose information regarding abuse and neglect cases that occur in licensed community companion homes to certain agencies and employers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES' RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING VARIOUS REVISIONS TO DEVELOPMENTAL SERVICES STATUTES.
purpose: To (1) establish an Oral Health and Dental Services Unit within the Department of Developmental Services and permit provisionally licensed dentists to provide services with such unit, (2) require the Commissioner of Housing to administer the existing program that provides grants-in-aid for supportive housing for persons with an intellectual disability or other developmental disability and allow said commissioner to provide deferred loans under such program, (3) allow the department to hire more general workers employed by the department as self-advocates, (4) make revisions regarding transfers of individuals within residential facilities, (5) establish human rights and program review committees in each of the department's service regions and the Southbury Training School, (6) allow the Office of Labor Relations to access the department's abuse and neglect registry, and (7) establish an Office of the Developmental Services Ombudsperson and make various revisions to notification requirements of intermediate care facilities for persons with intellectual disability.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A REGISTRY OF PERSONS CONVICTED OF FINANCIAL CRIMES AGAINST ELDERLY PERSONS.
