purpose: To protect victims of domestic violence, deter the unsolicited transmission of intimate images by means of an electronic communication device and to prohibit the use of certain nondisclosure agreements in the workplace.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL RESOURCES.
purpose: To support the state's public schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING.
purpose: To make housing more affordable for Connecticut residents.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONNECTICUT PAID SICK DAYS.
purpose: To support paid sick days.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DRUG AFFORDABILITY.
purpose: To make prescription drugs affordable and available for Connecticut residents.

title: AN ACT PROMOTING HOSPITAL FINANCIAL STABILITY.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING AND ADJUSTING BONDS OF THE STATE.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONNECTICUT RESILIENCY PLANNING AND PROVIDING MUNICIPAL OPTIONS FOR CLIMATE RESILIENCE.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ACCESS TO PAID SICK DAYS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT INCENTIVIZING STUDENT LOAN REPAYMENT ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT ASSISTING SCHOOL DISTRICTS IN IMPROVING EDUCATIONAL OUTCOMES, IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF EDUCATION AND THE TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND CAREER SYSTEM AND ESTABLISHING EARLY START CT.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING FEE DISCLOSURES.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REVENUE ITEMS TO IMPLEMENT THE GOVERNOR'S BUDGET.
purpose: To implement the Governor's budget recommendations.

title: AN ACT FUNDING THE STATE-WIDE FIREARMS TRAFFICKING TASK FORCE BY REDUCING CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM GRANTS.
purpose: To provide funding to the state-wide firearms trafficking task force in order to reduce the number of violent gun related crimes.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING CERTAIN FUNDING FOR THE XL CENTER AND THE CITY OF HARTFORD AND INCREASING FUNDING FOR SCHOOL RESOURCE OFFICERS.
purpose: To provide funding for school safety programs in all towns and cities in the state by reducing certain state funding for the XL Center and the city of Hartford.

title: AN ACT REDUCING NON-EDUCATION AID TO THE CITY OF HARTFORD.
purpose: To reverse the fiscal impact to the state of the debt service agreement between the state and the city of Hartford.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR REGIONAL FIRE TRAINING SCHOOLS.
purpose: To fund the nine regional fire training schools through appropriations in the state budget and not from any specific taxes or increased surcharges, including any fees on insurance premiums.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEARN HERE, LIVE HERE PROGRAM.
purpose: To increase the annual expenditure on the Learn Here, Live Here program to not more than five million dollars and to make such program available only to individuals whose income is seventy-five thousand dollars or less.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR THE COSTS OF HOME HEALTH CARE.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction of not more than sixty thousand dollars for the costs of full-time home health care services and medical supplies.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN ARTICLES OF CHILDREN'S CLOTHING AND FOOTWEAR AND PERSONAL PROTECTIVE EQUIPMENT FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt articles of children's clothing or footwear costing under fifty dollars and personal protective equipment from the sales and use taxes.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TAX CREDIT FOR PREMIUM PAYMENTS FOR CERTAIN LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICIES.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for the amount of premiums paid to purchase an individual or group long-term care insurance policy that provides benefits for health care provided in an insured's home.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PROPERTY TAX CREDIT AGAINST THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX FOR CERTAIN SENIORS.
purpose: To establish a credit against the personal income tax for the amount of property taxes paid by a taxpayer on such taxpayer's residence, provided such taxpayer (1) is at least seventy years of age, (2) resides in the residence full time, and (3) meets certain income limits.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE BOND AUTHORIZATION FOR THE CONNECTICUT BIOSCIENCE INNOVATION FUND.
purpose: To increase funding for bioscience innovation.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE DEVELOPMENT OF AFFORDABLE HOUSING IN CERTAIN TOWNS.
purpose: To provide funding for the development of deed-restricted affordable housing units in the towns of Fairfield, Easton, Newton and Bethel.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS DEDUCTION FROM THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To increase the qualifying income thresholds for the full Social Security benefits deduction from the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES PRICE THRESHOLD FOR MOTOR VEHICLES SUBJECT TO A HIGHER SALES AND USE TAXES RATE.
purpose: To increase to more than seventy-five thousand dollars the sales price threshold for a motor vehicle subject to the seven and three-fourths per cent sales and use taxes rate.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE QUALIFYING INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTIONS FOR SOCIAL SECURITY BENEFITS AND PENSION OR ANNUITY INCOME.
purpose: To eliminate the qualifying income thresholds for the personal income tax deductions for Social Security benefits and pension or annuity income.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE EARNED INCOME TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To eliminate the earned income tax credit.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF AN EMERGENCY MEDICAL SERVICES FACILITY IN THE TOWN OF EASTON.
purpose: To provide funding for the town of Easton for the construction of an emergency medical services facility in the town of Easton.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE REMEDIATION OF FILL PILE WASTE CONTAMINATION IN THE TOWN OF FAIRFIELD.
purpose: To provide funding for the remediation of waste contamination associated with the fill pile in the town of Fairfield.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAPITAL GAINS SURCHARGE.
purpose: To establish a capital gains surcharge on certain taxpayers, for deposit in the General Fund and the Special Transportation Fund.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A REFUNDABLE CHILD TAX CREDIT.
purpose: To establish a refundable child tax credit against the personal income tax.

title: AN ACT RESTORING THE RATE OF THE CREDIT AGAINST THE AFFECTED BUSINESS ENTITY TAX.
purpose: To restore the rate of the credit against the affected business entity tax to ninety-three and one-hundredths per cent.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE AMOUNT OF THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR CONTRIBUTIONS TO STATE-ESTABLISHED 529 QUALIFIED STATE TUITION PROGRAMS.
purpose: To increase the amount of the personal income tax deduction for contributions to accounts for 529 qualified state tuition programs established and maintained by the state.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING CERTAIN TAX CREDITS AND A CARRY-FORWARD AND PRIVATIZING THE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To eliminate the film production and digital animation production tax credits, privatize the Department of Motor Vehicles and eliminate the carry-forward under public act 23-204 for operating expenses for The University of Connecticut Health Center for the fiscal year ending June 30, 2025.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING STATE AGENCIES FROM CHARGING SERVICE FEES FOR PAYMENTS MADE BY CERTAIN MEANS.
purpose: To prohibit state agencies from charging payors a service fee for payment by means of a credit card, charge card or debit card.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE BOARD OF REGENTS FOR HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To eliminate the Board of Regents for Higher Education.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING THE STATE SUBSIDIZATION OF THE HARTFORD-NEW BRITAIN BUSWAY.
purpose: To prohibit the subsidization of the Hartford-New Britain busway and ensure that the passenger rates for ridership pay the cost of operation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COST OF MOTOR VEHICLE REGISTRATION.
purpose: To provide savings to the registrants of motor vehicles in Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXPENDITURES FROM THE SPECIAL TRANSPORTATION FUND.
purpose: To ensure the resources of the Special Transportation Fund are expended on transportation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROFESSIONAL APPLICATION AND LICENSING FEES.
purpose: To (1) eliminate application review fees charged by state licensing boards, and (2) limit the amount the state may charge for an occupational license to not more than one hundred dollars per two-year license period.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADDITIONAL STAFF AND FUNDING FOR THE OFFICE OF THE CHILD ADVOCATE.
purpose: To provide additional staff and increased funding for the Office of the Child Advocate.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING LICENSING FEES FOR SOCIAL WORKERS.
purpose: To increase the number of social workers by eliminating the financial burden of licensing fees.

title: AN ACT PROVIDING FUNDING TO THE SHORE LINE EAST RAIL LINE.
purpose: To increase the Shore Line East rail service between the city of New Haven and the town of Mystic in order to ease traffic congestion on Interstate Route 95 and promote tourism along the Connecticut shoreline during the summer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EXCLUSION OF AID TO DISTRESSED MUNICIPALITIES FROM THE SPENDING CAP.
purpose: To take aid to distressed municipalities outside the spending cap, as was the case from 1991 to 2017, and restructure the cap accordingly.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE PREAPPRENTICESHIP GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To fund the high school preapprenticeship grant program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE MYSTIC CHAMBER OF COMMERCE.
purpose: To fund the Chamber of Commerce in Mystic.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR PROGRAMMING AT THE EARLY CHILDHOOD CENTER IN NEW LONDON.
purpose: To provide funding to support programming at the Early Childhood Center in New London.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE STATE-WIDE NARCOTICS TASK FORCE.
purpose: To direct additional resources to combat the illegal manufacturing and sale of fentanyl in Hartford, New Haven, Bridgeport and Waterbury.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE EASY BREATHING ASTHMA PROGRAM.
purpose: To reinstate funding for the Easy Breathing asthma program.

title: AN ACT INCREASING FUNDING FOR TRUANCY CLINICS.
purpose: To increase funding for truancy clinics to address truancy and chronic absenteeism in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR SCHOOL-BASED HEALTH CENTERS IN EASTERN CONNECTICUT.
purpose: To ensure the continued operation of newly expanded school-based health centers in eastern Connecticut.

title: AN ACT ENTITLING TOWNS TO FULL REIMBURSEMENT UNDER THE EXCESS COST GRANT FOR SPECIAL EDUCATION.
purpose: To ensure that towns receive the amount entitled to them under the excess cost grant for special education regardless of the amount appropriated for such purpose in the state budget for the fiscal year.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE FEES AND CHARGES FOR AN EDUCATOR LICENSE.
purpose: To assist in the recruitment of teachers by lowering the cost of educator licensing fees and charges.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT AT CENTRAL MIDDLE SCHOOL IN GREENWICH.
purpose: To authorize the school building project at Central Middle School in Greenwich for a school building project grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SCHOOL BUILDING PROJECT AT THE INTERDISTRICT SCHOOL FOR ARTS AND COMMUNICATION IN NEW LONDON.
purpose: To provide a school building project grant in the amount of four million five hundred thousand dollars for the expansion of the school building and gymnasium at the Interdistrict School for Arts and Communication in the town of New London.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO STABILIZE AND RENOVATE THE FACILITY OF THE BOZRAH FIRE DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To provide funding to stabilize and renovate the facility of the Bozrah Fire Department.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO PURCHASE CAMP LAUREL IN LEBANON AS OPEN SPACE.
purpose: To provide funding to purchase Camp Laurel in Lebanon as open space.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF GENERATORS FOR THE LEDYARD SENIOR CENTER AND FOOD PANTRY.
purpose: To provide funding to purchase generators for the Ledyard Senior Center and food pantry.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REHABILITATE THE PAVILION AT CAMP OAKDALE IN THE TOWN OF MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding to rehabilitate the pavilion at Camp Oakdale in the town of Montville.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR PURCHASE OF A FIRE RESCUE BOAT AND A PERSONAL WATERCRAFT BY THE CITY OF MILFORD FOR MARINE RESCUES.
purpose: To provide funding for a fire rescue boat and a personal watercraft for marine rescues in the city of Milford.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR REPAIRS AND REHABILITATION OF PROPERTIES BY THE MONTVILLE HOUSING AUTHORITY.
purpose: To provide funding for repairs and rehabilitation of properties by the Montville Housing Authority.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR EQUIPMENT FOR THE HEBRON FIRE DEPARTMENT.
purpose: To provide funding for the purchase of equipment, including a rescue pumper truck, for the Hebron Fire Department.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO PREPARE SITES IN ADVANCE OF THE TWO HUNDRED FIFTIETH ANNIVERSARY OF THE FORMATION OF THE UNITED STATES OF AMERICA.
purpose: To provide funding to rehabilitate, upgrade and prepare sites throughout the state in advance of the two hundred fiftieth  anniversary of the formation of the United States of America.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REPLACE THE ROOF AND REPOINT BRICKS ON THE MONTVILLE TOWN HALL.
purpose: To provide funding to replace the roof and repoint bricks encasing the structure of the Montville Town Hall.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A GENERATOR FOR THE MONTVILLE SOCIAL SERVICES OFFICE AND FOOD PANTRY.
purpose: To provide funding for a generator for the Montville Social Services Office, including the food pantry.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR EXPANSION OF WATER LINES IN THE TOWN OF HEBRON.
purpose: To provide funding to the town of Hebron to expand water lines to allow expansion of affordable housing in the town.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A PUBLIC WORKS GARAGE AND EQUIPMENT IN THE TOWN OF COLUMBIA.
purpose: To provide funding for a public works garage and public works equipment in the town of Columbia.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING APPLICATION REVIEW FEES AND CAPPING LICENSURE FEES FOR HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS LICENSED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF PUBLIC HEALTH.
purpose: To eliminate application review fees and set a maximum fee of two hundred dollars for the fee for licensure of health care professionals by the Department of Public Health.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CLEAN UP OF AN ABANDONED BUILDING ABUTTING THE INTEGRATED DAY CHARTER SCHOOL IN THE CITY OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding for abatement, demolition, stabilization, renovation and repairs of an abandoned building abutting the Integrated Day Charter School in Norwich in order to clean up an abandoned building and allow the school to expand.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX MARGINAL RATES FOR CERTAIN TAXPAYERS AND CONCERNING THE ASSET EXPENSE DEDUCTION FOR CORPORATIONS.
purpose: To reduce the marginal rates for the personal income tax and allow an eligible taxpayer to claim the entirety of an asset expense deduction under Section 179 of the Internal Revenue Code at once rather than incrementally.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A CAPITAL GAINS TAX ON CERTAIN ENDOWMENT FUNDS OF INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION AND CONCERNING THE USE OF THE REVENUE GENERATED.
purpose: To impose a capital gains tax on certain endowment funds of institutions of higher education and dedicate the revenue from such tax to reducing the amount that participants in the Paid Family and Medical Leave Insurance Program are required to contribute under section 31-49g of the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALES AND USE TAXES IMPOSED ON MEALS SOLD BY AN EATING ESTABLISHMENT, CATERER OR GROCERY STORE AND THE USE OF A PORTION OF THE REVENUE GENERATED FROM SUCH TAXES.
purpose: To require a percentage of the revenue generated from the additional one per cent sales and use taxes imposed on meals sold by an eating establishment, caterer or grocery store be deposited in the Tourism Fund to support the hospitality, arts, culture and tourism needs of the state.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR QUALIFIED DATA CENTERS.
purpose: To eliminate the exemptions from the taxes imposed under chapters 203 and 219 of the general statutes for qualified data centers.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR IMPROVEMENTS AT STODDARD HILL STATE PARK.
purpose: To provide funding for repairs to roads and a boat launch, drainage improvements and removal of a pier at Stoddard Hill State Park in Ledyard.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN ARTICLES OF CLOTHING FROM THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To exempt from the sales and use taxes the sale of and the storage, use or other consumption in this state of articles of clothing costing under seventy-five dollars.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE RATE OF THE SALES AND USE TAXES.
purpose: To reduce the rate of the sales and use taxes to six per cent.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HIGHER SALES AND USE TAXES RATE APPLICABLE TO CERTAIN MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To (1) increase to more than sixty-five thousand dollars the sales price threshold for a motor vehicle subject to the seven and three-fourths per cent sales and use taxes rate, (2) index the sales price to reflect the rate of inflation, and (3) exempt commercial vehicles from the higher sales and use taxes rate.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR STIPENDS PAID TO CERTAIN VOLUNTEER FIREFIGHTERS OR VOLUNTEER AMBULANCE MEMBERS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for any stipend paid by a municipality, volunteer fire department or volunteer ambulance association to certain volunteer firefighters or volunteer ambulance members.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CORPORATION BUSINESS TAX SURCHARGE.
purpose: To sunset the corporation business tax surcharge this fiscal year rather than January 1, 2026.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CORPORATION BUSINESS TAX SURCHARGE.
purpose: To sunset the corporation business tax surcharge this fiscal year rather than January 1, 2026.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR INFRASTRUCTURE AND BUILDING REPAIRS AND EQUIPMENT FOR GEMMA E. MORAN UNITED WAY/LABOR FOOD CENTER IN NEW LONDON.
purpose: To provide funding for infrastructure and building repairs and equipment for the Gemma E. Moran United Way/Labor Food Center in New London.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR UPGRADES TO CULVERTS AND DRAINAGE IN THE TOWN OF MARLBOROUGH.
purpose: To provide funding for upgrades to culverts and drainage in the town of Marlborough.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A PUBLIC WORKS GARAGE IN LEBANON.
purpose: To provide funding to the town of Lebanon for a public works garage.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF SECURITY CAMERAS BY THE TOWN OF MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding to purchase security cameras to be installed to protect the fishing pier, boat launch and various recreation areas in the town of Montville.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO CONVERT THE HEATING SYSTEM IN THE MONTVILLE TOWN HALL FROM OIL TO NATURAL GAS.
purpose: To provide funding to convert the heating system in the Montville Town Hall from oil to natural gas.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR CONSTRUCTION OF A REGIONAL ANIMAL CONTROL FACILITY IN THE TOWN OF MONTVILLE.
purpose: To provide funding to construct a regional animal control facility in Montville.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A SEWER EXPANSION PROJECT IN THE FITCHVILLE SECTION OF BOZRAH.
purpose: To provide funding for a sewer expansion project in the Fitchville section of Bozrah.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE DESIGN AND ENGINEERING OF A DOCK AND WATER TAXI STOP IN THE TOWN OF STONINGTON.
purpose: To provide funds for the design and engineering of a dock and water taxi stop in the town of Stonington to support economic development and increase tourism.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE TO REPAIR THE SEA WALL ON ENDER'S ISLAND IN THE TOWN OF STONINGTON.
purpose: To provide funding to repair the sea wall on Ender's Island, which protects Mason Island and Mystic Harbor.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF A RESCUE ENGINE BY THE TOWN OF FRANKLIN.
purpose: To provide funding for the purchase of a rescue engine by the town of Franklin.

title: AN ACT ADJUSTING THE BOND ALLOCATION CAP.
purpose: To reduce debt-financed capital spending by limiting the amount of bond allocations.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR UPGRADES TO THE FACILITIES OF THE FIRE MARSHAL IN THE CITY OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding to upgrade the facilities of the fire marshal in the city of Norwich.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR THE PURCHASE OF A RESCUE ENGINE BY THE CITY OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding to Norwich to purchase a rescue engine.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR COLLEGE TUITION PAYMENTS MADE BY A TAXPAYER.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for college tuition payments made by the taxpayer.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE INDEXING OF INCOME THRESHOLDS FOR THE PERSONAL INCOME TAX.
purpose: To require that income thresholds for the personal income tax be indexed to reflect the rate of inflation.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RATE OF TAX FOR DIESEL FUEL.
purpose: To reduce the rate of tax for diesel fuel to forty and one-tenth cents per gallon.

title: AN ACT REDUCING CERTAIN PERSONAL INCOME TAX MARGINAL RATES.
purpose: To reduce the two lowest marginal rates for the personal income tax from two per cent to one and one-half per cent and from four and one-half per cent to four per cent.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING THE HIGHWAY USE TAX.
purpose: To eliminate the highway use tax.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE COMMUNITY INVESTMENT ACCOUNT.
purpose: To update the funding stream of the Community Investment Account.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT INITIATIVES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To study workforce development initiatives in the state.

title: AN ACT UPDATING REQUIREMENTS FOR CONSTRUCTION MANAGEMENT OVERSIGHT AT THE UNIVERSITY OF CONNECTICUT, PAUSING THE REQUIREMENT FOR A PLAN TO INCREASE THE NUMBER OF FULL-TIME FACULTY AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION AND REPLACING REFERENCES TO THE PRESIDENT OF THE CONNECTICUT STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES WITH THE CHANCELLOR OF THE CONNECTICUT STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES.
purpose: To remove reference to the defunct construction management oversight committee for UConn 2000 projects and repeal the requirement for the state universities to develop a plan to increase the number of full-time faculty.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF TRANSPORTATION BARRIERS THAT LIMIT ACCESS TO WORKFORCE DEVELOPMENT PROGRAMS.
purpose: To require the Department of Transportation and the Office of Workforce Strategy to study transportation barriers that limit access to workforce development programs.

title: AN ACT MODIFYING THE CONNECTICUT AUTOMATIC ADMISSIONS PROGRAM.
purpose: To change the requirement for a minimum class rank percentile to a minimum grade point average for students to qualify for admission to a participating institution of higher education through the Connecticut Automatic Admissions Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR ADDITIONAL STAFF IN THE OFFICE OF HEALTH STRATEGY.
purpose: To appropriate funds to the Department of Public Health to provide additional staff for the Office of Health Strategy to improve the certificate of need process.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOME ENERGY ASSISTANCE.
purpose: NA

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR PEDIATRIC HOSPICE SERVICES AT REGIONAL HOSPICE IN DANBURY.
purpose: To allocate funds for the expansion of the pediatric hospice program at Regional Hospice in Danbury.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR STATE COLLEGES AND UNIVERSITIES.
purpose: To appropriate funds to the state colleges and universities to mitigate pending cuts and stop approved tuition increases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR DAY KIMBALL HOSPITAL IN PUTNAM.
purpose: To appropriate ten million dollars to Day Kimball Hospital to allow the hospital to maintain services, health care delivery and jobs in northeastern Connecticut.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE TOWN OF WINDHAM AND THE MOTOR VEHICLE TAX GRANT.
purpose: To require the Office of Policy and Management to allocate one million two hundred three thousand six hundred one dollars to the Town of Windham in compliance with the car tax grant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDING FOR THE OFFICE OF DYSLEXIA AND READING DISABILITIES.
purpose: To provide an operating budget for the Office of Dyslexia and Reading Disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MARTIN LUTHER KING, JR. CORRIDORS.
purpose: To require the Banking Commissioner to designate seven Martin Luther King, Jr. Corridors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE BANKING STATUTES.
purpose: To make technical revisions to the banking statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY ON FINANCIAL INSTITUTIONS IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study and submit a report concerning  financial institutions in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY RELATING TO LENDING ISSUES IN THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Department of Banking to study and submit a report relating to lending issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ATTORNEY GENERAL, THE BANKING COMMISSIONER, THE DODD-FRANK WALL STREET REFORM AND CONSUMER PROTECTION ACT AND TELEPHONIC SALES CALLS FOR SOLICITING CONSUMER GOODS OR SERVICES.
purpose: To establish procedures for the Attorney General to enforce the Dodd-Frank Wall Street Reform and Consumer Protection Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE COMMUNITY BANK AND COMMUNITY CREDIT UNION PROGRAM.
purpose: To redefine "community credit union" for purposes of the community bank and community credit union program established by the State Treasurer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COERCED DEBT.
purpose: To (1) provide that no individual shall cause another individual to incur a coerced debt, and (2) establish procedures to (A) review documentation to determine whether debt is coerced debt, and (B) bring an action to establish whether debt is coerced debt.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONNECTICUT UNIFORM SECURITIES ACT.
purpose: To: (1) Exempt merger and acquisition broker-dealers and certain individuals representing such broker-dealers from certain registration requirements; (2) establish various requirements for Tier 2 offerings; and (3) provide that the Banking Commissioner may censure or impose a bar upon any registrant, any partner, officer, director of any registrant or any other person directly or indirectly controlling any registrant.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES RELATIVE TO IDENTIFIED ADOPTIONS AND REVISIONS TO CERTAIN TERMINOLOGY.
purpose: To (1) require the Department of Children and Families to adopt regulations concerning adoptive placement of children by child-placing agencies, (2) specify the types of payments and reimbursements that may be made by prospective adoptive parents to pregnant parents and requirements for making such payments and reimbursements, (3) specify that a genetic parent's legal representative or prospective adoptive parent's legal representative may advertise through public media for the purposes of identified adoption or adoption through a child-placing agency, and (4) make minor revisions to statutes concerning adoption and the safe care of newborns.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOME VISITS AND EVALUATIONS CONDUCTED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES.
purpose: To require the Department of Children and Families to conduct in-person home visits if a safety plan established by the department indicates that a parent or guardian in such home has a substance use disorder.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF CHILDREN AND FAMILIES RELATING TO BACKGROUND CHECKS, CERTAIN SUBSIDIES, URGENT CRISIS CENTERS, DEPARTMENTAL RECORDS AND SPECIAL POLICE OFFICERS.
purpose: To (1) exempt certain applicants for foster care licensure and individuals eighteen years of age or older living in such applicants' homes from submitting to criminal history records checks requirements under certain circumstances, (2) increase the age upon which an individual living in the home of an applicant for foster care licensure must submit to criminal history records checks and child abuse registry checks from sixteen to eighteen, (3) permit the transfer of adoptive parent subsidies to a successor guardian, (4) authorize the Department of Public Health to access certain records of the Department of Children and Families, (5) require the disclosure of certain educational records to the Department of Children and Families, (6) require the appointment of special police officers for the Department of Children and Families, and (7) make minor and technical changes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN FLAME RETARDANT CHEMICALS IN CHILDREN'S PRODUCTS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Consumer Protection to enter into an interstate agreement with New York and the other New England states to prohibit the sale and distribution of children's products containing organohalogen flame retardant chemicals.

title: AN ACT LIMITING THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE TO ONE CAR OWNED BY ANY INDIVIDUAL.
purpose: To limit the Passport to the Parks fee to just one car owned by an individual rather than applying it to each car owned by an individual.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING SENIOR CITIZENS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE PARKS FEE.
purpose: To exempt senior citizens from the Passport to the Parks Fee.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING VETERANS FROM THE PASSPORT TO THE STATE PARKS FEE.
purpose: To exempt veterans from the Passport to the Parks fee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DOG RACING.
purpose: To eliminate various provisions concerning dog racing in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REGULATION OF PRESCRIPTION DRUGS AND RELATED PROFESSIONS.
purpose: To: (1) Define various terms for purposes of the Pharmacy Practice Act and related statutes; (2) provide for advanced pharmacy technician endorsements and the registration of clerks; (4) authorize pharmacists and advanced pharmacy technicians to dispense drugs in compliance packaging; (5) empower the Commission of Pharmacy to take disciplinary action against certain persons who accept, for return to general inventory or regular stock, any drug that has been sold or delivered to a patient; (6) provide that an individual who is enrolled in an accredited pharmacy technician education program may, in certain circumstances, act as a pharmacy technician; (7) enable the department to take certain actions concerning pharmacy technicians without authorization by the commission; (8) provide that a pharmacist may order and administer certain vaccines; and (9) make minor, technical and conforming changes to various statutes concerning regulation of prescription drugs and related professions.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR MINOR AND TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO STATUTES CONCERNING CONSUMER PROTECTION.
purpose: To make minor and technical revisions to statutes concerning consumer protection.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A MAXIMUM CHARGE FOR CERTAIN OCCUPATIONAL LICENSES, CERTIFICATIONS, PERMITS AND REGISTRATIONS.
purpose: To provide that neither the Commissioner of Consumer Protection nor the Department of Consumer Protection may charge certain individuals a license, permit, certification or registration fee in an amount that is greater than one hundred dollars per license, certification, permit or registration year.

title: AN ACT MAKING CHANGES TO THE CONNECTICUT RETIREMENT SECURITY PROGRAM STATUTES.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Comptroller concerning the administration of the Connecticut Retirement Security Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING GAS, ELECTRIC, SEWER AND WATER DELIVERY WORK.
purpose: To require any contractor that enters into a contract for a public utility project to offer apprenticeship or preapprenticeship training programs and pay prevailing wage rates.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WAIVER OF CERTAIN CRIMINAL HISTORY RECORDS CHECK FEES FOR AN INDIGENT PERSON SEEKING A PARDON.
purpose: To allow the waiver of certain criminal history records check fees for an indigent person who is seeking a pardon.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DEVELOPMENT OF A FORENSIC SCIENCE TRAINING LABORATORY AND PROGRAMS FOR TRAINING POLICE DETECTIVES AND OTHER LAW ENFORCEMENT PERSONNEL AT CENTRAL CONNECTICUT STATE UNIVERSITY.
purpose: To require a memorandum of understanding regarding the development of a forensic science laboratory and training programs for police detectives and other law enforcement personnel at Central Connecticut State University and provide funding for such laboratory and programs.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SALE AND USE OF CONSUMER FIREWORKS.
purpose: To expand the sale and use of consumer fireworks in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF THE CRISIS INITIATIVE PILOT PROGRAM THROUGHOUT THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Division of State Police to expand the CRISIS Initiative pilot program to all areas of the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A HOUSING AUTHORITY RESIDENT QUALITY OF LIFE IMPROVEMENT GRANT PROGRAM AND A HOUSING CHOICE VOUCHER TASK FORCE.
purpose: To establish (1) a resident quality of life improvement grant program, and (2) a housing choice voucher task force.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EVICTIONS FOR CAUSE.
purpose: To require cause for the eviction of certain tenants and residents of mobile manufactured home parks.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RESERVE FUNDS IN COMMON INTEREST OWNERSHIP COMMUNITIES.
purpose: To require that the executive board of any common interest ownership community perform an annual study of the association's funds in reserve and to make recommendations concerning the allocation of funds to such reserves.

title: AN ACT APPROPRIATING FUNDS FOR THE HOMELESS RESPONSE SYSTEM.
purpose: To (1) appropriate funds for certain homelessness and housing programs, and (2) require the Commissioners of Housing and Mental Health and Addiction Services to submit a report on the expenditure of such funds.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADMINISTRATION OF THE RENTAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM AND OTHER HOUSING VOUCHER PROGRAMS.
purpose: To modify the rental assistance program to (1) increase the effective duration of rental assistance program certificates, (2) reduce eligible unit inspection periods, (3) require that program payments to landlords begin within ten days of the commencement of a qualifying tenancy, (4) provide for the electronic signature and electronic submission of all program documents, (5) create an online tool that allows interested parties to calculate housing authority payments under the program, (6) allow the Commissioner of Housing to adjust maximum rent levels for certain housing assistance programs, and (7) notify prospective tenants of the portability of rental assistance program certificates and other housing vouchers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE IMPLEMENTATION OF RENTAL SAVINGS ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the implementation of rental savings accounts.

title: AN ACT MAKING CERTAIN TERMS IN ELECTRONIC BOOK AND DIGITAL AUDIOBOOK LICENSE AGREEMENTS OR CONTRACTS UNENFORCEABLE.
purpose: To prohibit publishers of electronic books and digital audiobooks from including certain restrictions in contracts or license agreements with libraries in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FORECLOSURE, ASSIGNMENT AND OTHER ENFORCEMENT ACTIONS FOR UNPAID SEWER ASSESSMENTS AND OTHER FEES AND CHARGES.
purpose: To prohibit foreclosure, assignment and other enforcement actions for unpaid sewer assessment and other fees and charges in the case of owner-occupied real property for which the principal of such unpaid assessments, fees and charges is less than four thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING COMMUNITY INVESTMENT BOARDS AND NEIGHBORHOOD ASSISTANCE.
purpose: To (1) require certain municipalities to establish community investment boards to identify priorities for the use of municipal revenue sharing grants, (2) require the Office of Policy and Management to accept proposals for solutions to problems specific to urban areas and establish pilot programs to implement such proposals, and (3) establish a task force to study issues concerning nonprofit providers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE WORKING GROUP TO STUDY THE IMPLEMENTATION OF FEDERAL TITLE IX PROTECTIONS FOR ALL MUNICIPAL RECREATION AREAS AND SCHOOL SPORTS FACILITIES.
purpose: To extend the report deadline for the working group to study the implementation of federal Title IX protections for all municipal recreation areas and school sports facilities.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE OFFICE OF EARLY CHILDHOOD.
purpose: To exclude those child care services providers that provide services to only school-age children from the requirement that they post a copy of the developmental milestones document; to include children under subsidized guardianship as part of the protective services category for the Care 4 Kids program; to replace state Care 4 Kids regulations with federal regulations and policies and procedures developed by the Commissioner of Early Childhood based on such federal regulations; and to require child care services providers to allow birth-to-three providers to deliver on-site services to certain children.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE TECHNICAL EDUCATION AND CAREER SYSTEM.
purpose: To (1) update references to obsolete committees to "program advisory committee", (2) remove an obsolete reference to the Department of Education, (3) allow allocation of funds for regional educational service centers to provide certain services, and (4) detail the programs offered by, and the special education duties of, the Technical Education and Career System.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING VARIOUS AND ASSORTED REVISIONS TO THE EDUCATION STATUTES.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to study schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF TOBACCO SETTLEMENT FUNDS.
purpose: To authorize the use of twenty-two million seven hundred thousand dollars in tobacco settlement funds for tobacco prevention programs.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY REQUIRING NURSING HOMES TO SPEND A PERCENTAGE OF MEDICAID REIMBURSEMENT OR TOTAL REVENUE ON DIRECT CARE OF NURSING HOME RESIDENTS.
purpose: To require nursing home facilities to spend at least eighty per cent of Medicaid funding provided by the state on direct care.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A RESEARCH AND DEVELOPMENT EXPENSES TAX CREDIT FOR PASS-THROUGH ENTITIES.
purpose: To establish a tax credit for research and development expenses of pass-through entities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF THE EFFECT OF BACKGROUND CHECKS ON DEFENSE INDUSTRY EMPLOYMENT AND A STUDY OF STATE EMPLOYMENT OUTREACH EFFORTS.
purpose: To require (1) the Labor Commissioner to study the impact that background checks have on employment opportunities within the state's defense industry, and (2) the Commissioner of Administrative Services to study outreach and marketing efforts related to state employment opportunities.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE FEASIBILITY OF DEVELOPING A MULTIMODAL TRANSPORTATION CENTER IN THE TOWNS OF STONINGTON AND GROTON.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the feasibility of developing a multimodal transportation center in the towns of Stonington and Groton.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEARN HERE, LIVE HERE PROGRAM.
purpose: To: (1) Require the Commissioner of Economic and Community Development to establish the Learn Here, Live Here program; (2) increase the annual expenditure on such program to not more than five million dollars; and (3) make such program available to individuals whose annual federal adjusted gross income is not more than seventy-five thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR GRANTS-IN-AID TO HOME HEALTH AGENCIES TO PURCHASE SAFETY, TRACKING AND COMMUNICATIONS DEVICES.
purpose: To provide funding to home health agencies to purchase safety, tracking and communications devices to improve communication with and protect home care workers.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING TAX INCENTIVES TO SUPPORT PRESCRIPTION DRUG COMPOUNDING.
purpose: To offer tax incentives to pharmaceutical manufacturers and sterile compounding pharmacies that manufacture and compound essential drugs in this state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR GRANTS-IN-AID TO HOME HEALTH AGENCIES TO PURCHASE SAFETY, TRACKING AND COMMUNICATIONS DEVICES.
purpose: To provide funding to home health agencies to purchase safety, tracking and communications devices to improve communication with and protect home care workers.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR REVITALIZATION OF THE JOHN J. MITCHELL FAIRGROUNDS IN SOUTH WINDSOR.
purpose: To provide funding to the town of South Windsor to revitalize the John J. Mitchell Fairgrounds in South Windsor, including development of an event space for the community, installation of utilities and construction of a pavilion.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR CERTAIN LONG-TERM CARE INSURANCE POLICYHOLDERS.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for individual long-term care insurance policyholders for whom the premium rate for such policy increased by more than five per cent in a taxable year.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE INITIAL LICENSING FEE FOR HEALTH CARE PROFESSIONALS BY TWENTY PER CENT.
purpose: To reduce the initial licensing fee for health care professionals by twenty per cent.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR A SEWER PROJECT IN THE TOWN OF SPRAGUE.
purpose: To provide funding for the replacement of sewer lines in the village of Hanover in the town of Sprague.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR UPGRADES AND RENOVATIONS TO THE PLAYGROUND AT FRANKLIN ELEMENTARY SCHOOL IN THE TOWN OF FRANKLIN.
purpose: To provide funding for upgrades and renovations to the playground at Franklin Elementary School in the town of Franklin.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR ROOF REPLACEMENT AND OTHER INFRASTRUCTURE IMPROVEMENTS AND CONSTRUCTION AT ST. JOSEPH SCHOOL IN SPRAGUE.
purpose: To provide funding to St. Joseph School in the Baltic section of Sprague for roof replacement and other infrastructure improvements and construction.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR IMPROVEMENTS TO THE ATHLETIC FIELDS AT RHAM HIGH SCHOOL IN HEBRON.
purpose: To provide funding for renovations and upgrades to the athletic fields at RHAM High School in Hebron.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR BROWNFIELD REMEDIATION AT A SITE IN THE TOWN OF LISBON.
purpose: To provide funding to remediate a brownfield site in the town of Lisbon.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR INFRASTRUCTURE REPAIRS TO THE FIRST CONGREGATIONAL CHURCH OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding for infrastructure repairs to First Congregational Church of Norwich.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR IMPROVEMENTS TO THE FACILITIES OF VFW POST 594 IN THE CITY OF NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding for improvements to the facilities of VFW Post 594 in the city of Norwich.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING BONDS OF THE STATE FOR RENOVATIONS AND UPGRADES TO THE GREENVILLE FIRE STATION IN NORWICH.
purpose: To provide funding for renovations and upgrades to the Greenville Fire Station in Norwich.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FUNDS FOR THE RARE DISEASE ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To fund operations of the Rare Disease Advisory Council.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A PLAN TO ESTABLISH A HOSPICE AND PALLIATIVE CARE PROGRAM FOR CHILDREN.
purpose: To require the Department of Public Health to develop a plan to establish a hospice program for children in the state.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING NATUROPATHIC PHYSICIANS TO PRESCRIBE MEDICATION.
purpose: To authorize naturopathic physicians to prescribe medication.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING THE EDUCATION AND TRAINING OF BARBERS, HAIRDRESSERS AND COSMETICIANS TO INCLUDE WORKING WITH TEXTURED HAIR.
purpose: To require the education and training of barbers, hairdressers and cosmeticians to include working with textured hair.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING RATES FOR AMBULANCE AND PARAMEDIC SERVICES.
purpose: To change the maximum allowable rate for the conveyance and treatment of patients by licensed ambulance services and invalid coaches and emergency services rates for certified ambulance services and paramedic intercept services to a rate schedule accepted by providers and require insurance coverage for such services pursuant to such rate schedule.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADVERSE DETERMINATION AND UTILIZATION REVIEWS.
purpose: To (1) redefine "clinical peer" for the purposes of adverse determination and utilization reviews; (2) require health carriers to bear the burden of proving that certain health care services under adverse determination or utilization review are not medically necessary; and (3) require health carriers to provide certain clinical peers with authority to reverse initial adverse determinations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING EMERGENCY DEPARTMENT CROWDING.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Public Health to report data regarding emergency department crowding.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING CERTAIN HEALTH CARRIERS FROM REQUIRING STEP THERAPY FOR PRESCRIPTION DRUGS USED TO TREAT A MENTAL OR BEHAVIORAL HEALTH CONDITION OR A CHRONIC, DISABLING OR LIFE-THREATENING CONDITION.
purpose: To prohibit certain health carriers from requiring step therapy for prescription drugs used to treat a mental or behavioral health condition or a chronic, disabling or life-threatening condition.

title: AN ACT IMPLEMENTING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF MOTOR VEHICLES AND CONCERNING LOW-SPEED VEHICLES, THE TOWING OF OCCUPIED VEHICLES, SCHOOL BUSES, ELECTRIC COMMERCIAL VEHICLES, THE PASSENGER REGISTRATION OF PICK-UP TRUCKS AND REMOVABLE WINDSHIELD PLACARDS FOR PERSONS WHO ARE BLIND AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the Department of Motor Vehicles regarding the electronic issuance of registration and certificates of title, transporter's registration, dealers, repairers, motor vehicle recyclers, drivers' schools, altered, composite, grey-market and salvage vehicles, school buses and minor revisions to the motor vehicle statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RENTING OR LEASING OF PASSENGER MOTOR VEHICLES.
purpose: To (1) prohibit a car rental company from requiring an additional driver to provide a credit card to such company as a condition to renting a passenger motor vehicle, provided the lessee provides a credit card or debit card, and (2) limit the amount that a car rental company may recover for the loss of use of a rented vehicle from a lessee.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SCHOOL BUSES EQUIPPED WITH SEAT SAFETY BELTS.
purpose: To reinstate the program to offset a portion of the sales tax on the purchase of school buses equipped with seat safety belts.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING WEIGHT TOLERANCE EXEMPTIONS FOR ELECTRIC COMMERCIAL VEHICLES AND CONCERNING THE REGISTRATION OF CERTAIN PICK-UP TRUCKS.
purpose: To (1) grant electric commercial vehicles a weight tolerance exemption of two thousand pounds from statutory weight limits, and (2) issue passenger registration to pick-up trucks with a gross vehicle rating of eight thousand five hundred fifty pounds or less that are not used in part for commercial purposes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONSUMER CREDIT.
purpose: To: (1) Require cancellations of surety bonds filed in connection with mortgage lender, mortgage correspondent lender, mortgage broker, money transmission, debt adjustment, debt negotiation, mortgage servicer and consumer collection agency licenses to be submitted electronically; (2) revise procedures regarding changes to the legal names of mortgage lender, mortgage correspondent lender, mortgage broker, money transmission, debt adjustment, debt negotiation, mortgage servicer and consumer collection agency licensees; (3) redefine "sales finance company"; (4) establish procedures for registering as an exempt mortgage servicer; (5) define "balance due under the contract"; (6) establish limitations on actual and reasonable expenses in repossessions; (7) establish requirements regarding private student education loan cosigner releases; (8) establish enforcement authority regarding registrants; (9) prohibit receiving fees in connection with small loans without a license; (10) redefine "mortgage servicer"; (11) redefine "servicing"; and (12) establish requirements regarding timelines and fees for registrants that are exempt from licensing as a mortgage lender, mortgage correspondent lender or mortgage broker.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING CONNECTICUT BANKS TO LIST ALL ACCOUNT HOLDERS OR OWNERS ON PERIODIC STATEMENTS.
purpose: To require Connecticut banks to list all holders or owners of a deposit account on periodic statements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ISSUANCE OF PERMITS BY THE DEPARTMENT OF ENERGY AND ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION.
purpose: To establish a ninety-day limitation for permit issuance decisions by the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF NEONICOTINOIDS.
purpose: To prohibit the nonagricultural use of neonicotinoids.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FOOD SCRAP DIVERSION FROM THE SOLID WASTE STREAM AND THE REDEMPTION OF OUT-OF-STATE BEVERAGE CONTAINERS.
purpose: To require the diversion of food scraps from the solid waste stream and prohibit the redemption of out-of-state beverage containers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DAM SAFETY.
purpose: To enable the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection to more readily take action to protect the public safety when a dam poses an imminent risk.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING LEGISLATIVE APPROVAL OF THE EVICTION OF FARMERS OPERATING ON CERTAIN STATE-OWNED PROPERTY.
purpose: To require legislative approval of the eviction of any farmer leasing property from either the Department of Energy and Environmental Protection or the Department of Agriculture.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTAIN FARMING PROGRAMS OF THE DEPARTMENT OF AGRICULTURE.
purpose: To make minor revisions to certain farm-related programs of the Department of Agriculture.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE USE OF MAN-MADE STRUCTURES TO MARK THE COASTAL JURISDICTION LINE.
purpose: To authorize the use of man-made structures to mark the coastal jurisdiction line.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE HARVESTING OF RABBITS FOR THE LOCAL FOOD SUPPLY.
purpose: To provide authority for the inspection and processing of rabbits in the state for the purpose of supplying local restaurants and consumers.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE AVAILABILITY OF CERTAIN BUTCHER OPERATIONS WITHIN THE STATE.
purpose: To provide for meat processing operations for farmers in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING LOCAL REPRESENTATION ON THE CONNECTICUT SITING COUNCIL FOR LOCAL PROJECTS.
purpose: To establish local representation on the Connecticut Siting Council.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ONLINE PREVENTION EDUCATION FOR ELECTRONIC NICOTINE DELIVERY SYSTEM DEALER REGISTRATION.
purpose: To require the Department of Mental Health and Addiction Services to establish and administer, and the authorized owner of an applicant for an electronic nicotine delivery system dealer registration to successfully complete, an online prevention education program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING SOCIAL EQUITY APPLICANTS, INFUSED BEVERAGES AND MODERATE-THC HEMP PRODUCTS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study consumer protection measures in this state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING UNFAIR REAL ESTATE LISTING AGREEMENTS AND THE CONNECTICUT UNFAIR TRADE PRACTICES ACT.
purpose: To: (1) Provide that no person doing business in this state shall advertise, display or offer any price in trade or commerce unless such price clearly and conspicuously discloses the total price; (2) prohibit unfair service agreements; (3) require certain service providers to record notice concerning certain service agreements; and (4) implement the Attorney General's recommendations concerning (A) the New Home Construction Guaranty Fund, and (B) the Connecticut Unfair Trade Practices Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE DEPARTMENT OF CONSUMER PROTECTION'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING PRESCRIPTION DRUG CONTROL.
purpose: To: (1) Allow a licensed manufacturer or wholesaler to sell a hypodermic needle or syringe to an advanced practice registered nurse, optometrist or physician assistant; (2) redefine "commissioner", "pharmaceutical manufacturer" and "pharmaceutical marketing firm" for the purposes of various statutes concerning pharmaceutical marketing; (3) eliminate a requirement that the Department of Consumer Protection annually analyze certain information submitted to the department concerning pharmaceutical marketing; (4) extend the date by which the department is required to submit an annual report concerning pharmaceutical marketing; (5) eliminate an overlapping prohibition concerning automatic reciprocal discipline of pharmacists; (6) modify the actions the Commissioner of Consumer Protection may take following a violation of certain statutes concerning pharmaceutical marketing; (7) require certain practitioners that dispense, administer or prescribe controlled substances to make certain records available to the department; and (8) make minor, technical and conforming changes to various statutes concerning prescription drug control.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE CONSIDERATION OF FAMILIAL RELATIONSHIP DURING THE ADMISSIONS PROCESS BY AN INSTITUTION OF HIGHER EDUCATION.
purpose: To prohibit consideration by an institution of higher education of a prospective student's familial relationship to a graduate of such institution during the admissions process.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING THE DEBT-FREE COMMUNITY COLLEGE PROGRAM AND NAMING THE GRANTS AFTER MARY ANN HANDLEY.
purpose: To expand the debt-free community college program to out-of-state high school graduates, name the awards granted under the program after Mary Ann Handley and change the reporting deadlines from March first and October first to November first and March first.

title: AN ACT ELIMINATING INCOME AND ASSET LIMITS IN THE MED-CONNECT PROGRAM FOR EMPLOYEES WITH DISABILITIES.
purpose: To eliminate income and asset limits in a program providing Medicaid benefits for employees with disabilities.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EXPANSION OF THE KATIE BECKETT WAIVER PROGRAM.
purpose: To expand the Katie Beckett waiver program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HOUSING AUTHORITY JURISDICTION.
purpose: To allow a housing authority to expand its jurisdiction to include other municipalities.

title: AN ACT REVISING A STATUTE CONCERNING HOUSING.
purpose: To make technical changes to a statute concerning housing.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NONRESIDENT LANDLORD REGISTRATION AND INCREASING PENALTIES FOR REPEAT BUILDING AND FIRE CODE VIOLATIONS.
purpose: To (1) require certain nonresident landlords, project-based housing providers or agents in charge of rental properties to register certain personal identifying information, and (2) to increase penalties for repeat violations of building and fire codes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STATE-OPERATED REINSURANCE PROGRAM, HEALTH CARE COST GROWTH AND SITE OF SERVICE BILLING REQUIREMENTS.
purpose: To: (1) Implement a state-operated reinsurance program; (2) include hospitals in the health care cost growth and primary care spending target benchmark program administered by the Office of Health Strategy; and (3) require hospital-based facilities to submit such facility's national provider identifier and tax identification number with each claim for reimbursement.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING HEALTH INSURANCE.
purpose: To require the Insurance Department to conduct a study concerning health insurance issues in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REVISOR'S TECHNICAL CORRECTIONS TO THE GENERAL STATUTES.
purpose: To make various technical changes concerning grammar, clarity and accuracy of internal references and consistency in the general statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE REDUCTION OF ECONOMIC DAMAGES IN A PERSONAL INJURY OR WRONGFUL DEATH ACTION FOR COLLATERAL SOURCE PAYMENTS MADE ON BEHALF OF A CLAIMANT.
purpose: To permit a post-verdict collateral source reduction in damages in certain personal injury or wrongful death actions involving a right of subrogation.

title: AN ACT CONSOLIDATING STATUTORY PROVISIONS RELATING TO REPRODUCTIVE HEALTH CARE SERVICES AND GENDER-AFFIRMING HEALTH CARE SERVICES.
purpose: To consolidate various provisions of the general statutes relating to reproductive health care services and gender-affirming health care services by incorporating existing statutory language concerning gender-affirming health care services into existing statutes concerning reproductive health care services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING YOUTH CAMPS.
purpose: To impose requirements on how youth camps are inspected, to establish the Youth Camp Safety Advisory Council within the Office of Early Childhood, to require youth camps to submit annual reports and to permit the denial of a youth camp license if the applicant has had a license for a youth camp revoked in another state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY REGARDING THE USE OF AN ONLINE SOFTWARE APPLICATION TO ADDRESS THE MENTAL HEALTH NEEDS OF STUDENTS.
purpose: To require the Department of Education to conduct a study of the feasibility of using an online mental health needs software application in schools.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A UNIVERSAL PATIENT INTAKE FORM FOR RECIPIENTS OF BEHAVIORAL HEALTH SERVICES FOR CHILDREN.
purpose: To require providers of behavioral health services for children to utilize a universal patient intake form.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING TASK FORCES TO STUDY BEREAVEMENT AND GRIEF COUNSELING SERVICES AND SOCIAL ISOLATION AND LONELINESS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the creation and administration of a state-wide program for the delivery of bereavement and grief counseling services to children and families.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKING CONDITIONS.
purpose: To require the Labor Commissioner to adopt regulations regarding safe and equitable working conditions for all employees in the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CLARIFYING THE APPEALS PROCESS UNDER THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE STATUTES.
purpose: To clarify the process for an appeal to the Superior Court under the Paid Family and Medical Leave Statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE MINIMUM FAIR WAGE AND SERVICE CHARGES.
purpose: To phase out the recognition of gratuities as part of the fair minimum wage.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CHANGES TO THE PAID FAMILY AND MEDICAL LEAVE STATUTES.
purpose: To (1) amend the provisions of the paid family and medical leave statutes relating to employer requirements, federally recognized tribes, concurrent payments, overpayments and penalties, and (2) make other minor and technical changes to the paid family and medical leave statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING WORKERS' COMPENSATION.
purpose: To require the Workers' Compensation Commission to study the workers' compensation system in the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING NOTICE OF REVALUATION TO CERTAIN OWNERS OF RESIDENTIAL BUILDINGS WITH DEFECTIVE CONCRETE FOUNDATIONS.
purpose: To require municipal assessors to notify owners of residential buildings that have been reassessed due to defective concrete foundations of upcoming revaluation cycles, and make technical changes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PERSONAL PROPERTY TAX EXEMPTIONS FOR MOTOR VEHICLES USED EXCLUSIVELY FOR FARMING.
purpose: To make certain motor vehicles used exclusively for farming eligible for personal property tax exemptions.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE THRESHOLD FOR SEALED BIDDING ON CERTAIN MUNICIPAL CONTRACTS.
purpose: To increase the threshold for sealed bidding on municipal contracts for the purchase of real and personal property from twenty-five thousand dollars to fifty thousand dollars.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL INTERNET WEB SITES.
purpose: To require each municipality to register and maintain a ".gov" top-level Internet domain.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ANNUAL RANDOM AUDITS OF PROFESSIONAL BONDSMEN.
purpose: To require an annual audit of the fees and commissions charged by three randomly selected professional bondsmen.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A SCHOOL MAPPING DATA GRANT PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish a school mapping data grant program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MAILING OF TEST RESULTS RELATED TO OPERATING A MOTOR VEHICLE OR VESSEL UNDER THE INFLUENCE OF ALCOHOL OR DRUGS.
purpose: To limit the requirement to mail the results of a test to determine the amount of alcohol or drugs in a person's system, when obtained relating to operating a motor vehicle or vessel under the influence of alcohol or drugs, to breath tests.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE UNMANNED AERIAL VEHICLES TO LAW ENFORCEMENT UNITS AND FIRE DEPARTMENTS.
purpose: To establish a grant program to provide unmanned aerial vehicles to law enforcement units and fire departments.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A GRANT PROGRAM TO PROVIDE LAW ENFORCEMENT UNITS WITH AUTOMATED NUMBER PLATE RECOGNITION SYSTEMS.
purpose: To establish a grant program for law enforcement units to obtain automated number plate recognition systems.

title: AN ACT AUTHORIZING USE OF STEADY BLUE LIGHTS ON WRECKERS.
purpose: To permit wreckers to display steady blue lights when stationary.

title: AN ACT EXEMPTING CERTAIN LAW ENFORCEMENT RECORDS FROM DISCLOSURE UNDER THE FREEDOM OF INFORMATION ACT.
purpose: To exempt certain law enforcement records from disclosure under the Freedom of Information Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MILITARY LEAVE PROVISIONS UNDER THE STATE PERSONNEL ACT.
purpose: To update obsolete terminology utilized in the military leave provisions of the State Personnel Act, thereby facilitating use of such provisions by state employees who serve in the armed forces.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A FEE WAIVER AT PUBLIC INSTITUTIONS OF HIGHER EDUCATION FOR CERTAIN VETERANS AND MEMBERS OF THE NATIONAL GUARD.
purpose: To waive the payment of extension fees for certain veterans and members of the National Guard enrolled at public institutions of higher education in this state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A PERSONAL INCOME TAX DEDUCTION FOR MILITARY FUNERAL HONOR GUARD DETAIL COMPENSATION.
purpose: To establish a personal income tax deduction for compensation received as a result of participation in military funeral honor guard details.

title: AN ACT EXPANDING ELIGIBILITY FOR GRANTS FROM THE MILITARY RELIEF FUND.
purpose: To allow grants from the Military Relief Fund for essential household goods or services if payment for such goods or services would be a hardship to a serious injury or illness, or the death, of an eligible service member or an immediate family member thereof.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A GRANT PROGRAM FOR THE REIMBURSEMENT OF CERTAIN LICENSING, CERTIFICATION, REGISTRATION OR TUITION FEES.
purpose: To establish, and appropriate funds for, a grant program for the reimbursement of certain licensing, certification, registration and tuition fees.

title: AN ACT REDUCING FARES FOR BUS PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION SERVICES FOR VETERANS.
purpose: To allow any person who presents proof of being a veteran to pay fifty per cent of the lawful charge for state-owned or controlled bus public transportation services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF HEALTH STRATEGY'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING 340B PROGRAM TRANSPARENCY.
purpose: To require entities authorized to participate in the federal 340B Drug Pricing Program to report to the Health Systems Planning Unit of the Office of Health Strategy certain information regarding the program, including (1) aggregated acquisition costs, (2) aggregated payment information, (3) the number of claims for prescription drugs under the program, and (4) if the entity is a hospital, the national drug code number for the fifty most frequently dispensed prescription drugs by the hospital under the program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE OFFICE OF HEALTH STRATEGY'S RECOMMENDATIONS REGARDING THE ALL-PAYER CLAIMS DATABASE.
purpose: To expand the type of data collected by the all-payer claims database to include non-claims data.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING AN ASSERTIVE COMMUNITY TREATMENT PILOT PROGRAM FOR HOME HEALTH AGENCIES.
purpose: To establish an internal assertive community treatment pilot program for home health agencies to improve the provision of effective home health care services to persons with a serious behavioral health condition and one or more comorbidities and the safety of the workers providing such services.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY ON THE FEASIBILITY OF EXPANDING ACCESS TO RESPITE SERVICES BY PURSUING A FAMILY CAREGIVER SUPPORT BENEFIT THROUGH A MEDICAID DEMONSTRATION WAIVER.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Social Services to seek, and, if issued, implement a waiver under Section 1115 of the Social Security Act to seek federal funds to support the Alzheimer's disease respite care program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A STUDY OF LONG-TERM CARE NEEDS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Social Services to study long-term care needs in the state.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY TEMPORARY NURSING SERVICES PROVIDED TO NURSING HOME FACILITIES.
purpose: To establish a maximum rate, not to exceed two hundred per cent of the state's median hourly wage for nursing personnel, for temporary nursing services provided by a temporary nursing services agency to a nursing home facility.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE STATUTE OF LIMITATIONS FOR CRIMES COMMITTED AGAINST THE ELDERLY.
purpose: To extend the statute of limitations for the prosecution of crimes committed against the elderly.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING THE CONNECTICUT-IRELAND TRADE COMMISSION.
purpose: To establish the Connecticut-Ireland Trade Commission.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EARLY CHILDHOOD BUSINESS INCUBATOR PROGRAM.
purpose: To remove the limit on the duration of the early childhood business incubator program and change the number of facilities that may be approved under the program from one per specified municipality to twenty throughout the state.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE GLOBAL ENTREPRENEUR IN RESIDENCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To establish the Global Entrepreneur in Residence Program.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR TECHNICAL AND OTHER REVISIONS TO THE TAX AND RELATED STATUTES.
purpose: To make technical and other revisions to the tax and related statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING REFERENDA, INDEPENDENT EXPENDITURES AND OTHER CAMPAIGN FINANCE CHANGES.
purpose: To (1) implement federal court rulings regarding independent expenditure political committees and contributions to such committees, (2) reflect federal case law on aggregate contribution limits for individuals, (3) more explicitly recognize referendum spending as a type of independent expenditure and make changes related to reporting and attribution requirements, (4) adjust a disclaimer requirement to address certain organization expenditures, (5) make a conforming change regarding the distribution of surplus funds by candidate committees participating in the Citizens' Election Program, (6) allow the State Elections Enforcement Commission additional time to investigate certain complaints, (7) establish in-state contributor requirements for state-wide candidates participating in said program, (8) specify that individual contributions under said program may not exceed already-established contribution limits, and (9) provide for increased disclosure with respect to moneys paid to campaign consultants.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING FOREIGN POLITICAL SPENDING.
purpose: To prevent foreign interference in state referenda and elections and allow for greater enforcement of violations, including by affording the State Elections Enforcement Commission more time to investigate foreign political spending cases.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE RECOMMENDATIONS OF THE RISK-LIMITING AUDITS WORKING GROUP.
purpose: To implement the recommendations of the risk limiting audits working group.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE ADOPTION OF MUNICIPAL CONFLICT OF INTEREST PROVISIONS.
purpose: To require municipalities that do not have an adopted conflict of interest provision to adopt such a provision and all municipalities to submit a copy of such provision to the Office of State Ethics and post such provision on their Internet web site.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING DATA GOVERNANCE AND CERTAIN REQUESTS FOR STATE AGENCY DATA, RECORDS OR FILES.
purpose: To permit the Office of Policy and Management to establish advisory boards for data governance, redefine "executive branch agency", delete a requirement for an annual report concerning high value data and require certain requests for data, records or files be made to the originating agency.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTIFICATION OF AND CASTING OF BALLOTS BY PRESIDENTIAL ELECTORS.
purpose: To (1) specify that the Secretary of the State is the state executive for purposes of certifying presidential electors under the federal Electoral Count Reform Act of 2022, and (2) move later by one day the required meeting of the presidential electors.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE LEGISLATIVE COMMISSIONERS' RECOMMENDATIONS FOR MINOR AND TECHNICAL REVISIONS TO THE GOVERNMENT ADMINISTRATION AND ELECTIONS STATUTES.
purpose: To make minor and technical revisions to the government administration and elections statutes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONTRACTING WITH QUASI-PUBLIC AGENCIES UNDER THE STATE CODES OF ETHICS.
purpose: To expand the prohibition against certain individuals contracting with state agencies under the state codes of ethics unless awarded through an open and public process to include contracts with quasi-public agencies.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CONFLICTS OF INTEREST DUE TO AN EMPLOYER OTHER THAN THE STATE UNDER THE STATE CODE OF ETHICS FOR PUBLIC OFFICIALS.
purpose: To apply substantial conflict of interest provisions in the state code of ethics for public officials and state employees to conflicts involving the public official's or state employee's nonstate employer or spouse's employer.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING STATEMENTS OF FINANCIAL INTERESTS UNDER THE STATE CODE OF ETHICS FOR PUBLIC OFFICIALS.
purpose: To require members of certain boards, commissions, committees and councils within the Executive Department to file statements of financial interests and to permit the filing of the name of certain tax-sheltered annuity retirement plans in lieu of naming specific securities within such statements.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING MUNICIPAL CAMPAIGN FINANCE FILINGS.
purpose: To require that all municipal campaign registration and financial disclosure statements be filed with the State Elections Enforcement Commission, instead of with town clerks, and make several conforming changes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CITIZENS' ELECTION PROGRAM GRANTS FOR COURT-ORDERED PRIMARIES AND ELECTIONS AND FUNDING.
purpose: To (1) provide Citizens' Election Program grants in the event of certain adjourned primaries and court-ordered new elections or primaries, (2) ensure adequate funding for the program, and (3) include events at which a candidate or candidates are present in the definition of "organization expenditure".

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BONDING AUTHORITY OF THE CONNECTICUT MUNICIPAL REDEVELOPMENT AUTHORITY, THE REPORTING OF MATERIAL FINANCIAL OBLIGATIONS BY STATE AGENCIES, TAX-EXEMPT PROCEEDS FUND REFERENCES AND THE NOTIFICATION OF THE SALE OR LEASE OF PROJECTS FINANCED WITH BOND PROCEEDS.
purpose: To (1) amend provisions concerning the bonding authority and liability of the Connecticut Municipal Redevelopment Authority, (2) require state actors to notify the Treasurer of reportable financial obligations and agreements, (3) require the prior approval of the Treasurer for certain transactions, and (4) delete provisions concerning the Tax-Exempt Proceeds Fund.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING ANNUAL REPORTS CONCERNING WAITLISTS FOR THE RENTAL ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To require that the Commissioner of Housing report additional information concerning the administration of waitlists for the rental assistance program on an annual basis.

title: AN ACT INCREASING THE CONVEYANCE TAX FOR CERTAIN HOME SALES.
purpose: To increase the state conveyance tax upon residential properties sold to buyers who are not individuals.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF THE EFFECTS OF SHORT-TERM RENTALS ON THE HOUSING MARKET OF THE STATE.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Housing to conduct a study of the effects of short-term rentals on the housing market of the state.

title: AN ACT REQUIRING A STUDY OF ADVANCE RENTAL PAYMENTS.
purpose: To require the Commissioner of Housing to study the potential impacts of allowing landlords to accept advance rental payments from tenants of residential dwelling units.

title: AN ACT REDUCING THE SALES AND USE TAXES FOR CERTAIN GOODS USED IN NEW HOUSING CONSTRUCTION.
purpose: To reduce the sales and use taxes for certain tangible personal property used in new housing construction.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TAX CREDITS FOR THE CONVERSION OF COMMERCIAL PROPERTIES.
purpose: To provide certain tax credits for the conversion of commercial buildings into residential developments.

title: AN ACT ESTABLISHING A TASK FORCE TO STUDY THE IMPLEMENTATION OF RENT SAVINGS ACCOUNTS.
purpose: To establish a task force to study the implementation of rent savings accounts.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING ADOPTION OF THE CONNECTICUT UNIFORM TRUST DECANTING ACT.
purpose: To adopt the Connecticut Uniform Trust Decanting Act.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING NURSING HOME STAFFING.
purpose: To establish minimum staffing level requirements for nursing homes.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING OPIOIDS.
purpose: To require (1) the Connecticut Alcohol and Drug Policy Council to establish a standing subcommittee to examine programs and services for parents and caregivers impacted by substance use disorder and their children and make recommendations regarding such programs and services, and (2) the Commissioner of Social Services and the Insurance Commissioner to develop a plan to require Medicaid and private insurance coverage for opioid antagonists for certain hospital and emergency department patients.

title: AN ACT PROHIBITING NURSING HOMES FROM REJECTING A PATIENT SOLELY ON THE BASIS THAT SUCH PATIENT RECEIVED MENTAL HEALTH SERVICES.
purpose: To prohibit nursing homes from denying a patient admission solely on the basis that such person has, at any time, received mental health services.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE SAFETY OF SURGICAL PATIENTS.
purpose: To protect the safety of surgical patients by prohibiting representatives of medical device manufacturers from being present in an operating room of a hospital or outpatient surgical facility when a patient is undergoing a procedure in the operating room or outpatient surgical facility.

title: AN ACT RESTORING SERVICE ON THE SHORE LINE EAST RAIL LINE.
purpose: To require the Department of Transportation to restore service on the Shore Line East rail line.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRANSPARENCY RELATED TO FEDERAL FUNDS RECEIVED BY THE DEPARTMENT OF TRANSPORTATION FOR CAPITAL PROJECTS.
purpose: To require a quarterly report, public hearings and the posting of information on the Internet web site of the Department of Transportation regarding the receipt and expenditure of funds received pursuant to the Infrastructure Investment and Jobs Act, P.L. 117-58.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING CERTIFICATION FOR REMOVABLE WINDSHIELD PLACARDS FOR PERSONS WHO ARE BLIND AND PERSONS WITH DISABILITIES AND THE MEMBERSHIP OF THE ACCESSIBLE PARKING ADVISORY COUNCIL.
purpose: To (1) permit a licensed professional in the same group practice as the applicant's treating physician, physician assistant, advanced practice registered nurse to certify that the applicant meets the definition of a person with a disability which limits or impairs the ability to walk, and (2) amend the membership of the Accessible Parking Advisory Council.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING TRAIN CREW SIZE REQUIREMENTS AND THE INSTALLATION OF HOTBOX DETECTORS.
purpose: To (1) establish minimum train crew size requirements for freight railroad companies operating in the state, and (2) require the installation of hotbox detectors every twenty miles on any rail line in which passenger trains operate.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING PROPOSED FARE AND SERVICE CHANGES TO PUBLIC TRANSPORTATION.
purpose: To require a public hearing regarding a proposed service change to a rail line in a town with an intermediate transit station that serves a significant percentage of the line's ridership.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE BANKING COMMISSIONER'S APPROVAL OF CERTAIN BANK REAL ESTATE IMPROVEMENTS.
purpose: To modify an exemption from a requirement that the Banking Commissioner approve certain bank real estate improvements or alterations.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING THE EMERGENCY MORTGAGE ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) redefine "aggregate family income" and "financial hardship due to circumstances beyond the homeowner's control" in connection with the emergency mortgage assistance program, (2) change procedures (A) regarding applying for emergency mortgage assistance payments, (B) regarding making emergency mortgage assistance payments, (C) for establishing emergency mortgage assistance repayment agreements, and (D) regarding the posting of certain notices on the Connecticut Housing Finance Authority's Internet web site, (3) provide that the authority may adopt procedures to establish an aggregate limit on the amount of emergency mortgage assistance payments that certain homeowners may receive, and (4) require developers for certain projects to hire an advocate for the residents affected by such projects.

title: AN ACT CONCERNING A SECURITY DEPOSIT LOAN ASSISTANCE PROGRAM.
purpose: To (1) require the Commissioner of Housing to establish a security deposit loan assistance program, and (2) authorize a tax deduction for interest deferred by, or not charged to, an eligible renter in connection with a security deposit loan issued under such program.
